text: For the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
The earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep and God’s Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters.
God talk say, “Let there be light,” and there was light.
God see the light, and see that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness.
God call the light “day”, and the darkness he call “night”. There was evening and there was morning, the first day.
God talk say, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”
God made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and it was so.
God call the expanse “sky”. There was evening and there was morning, a second day.
God talk say, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear”; and it was so.
God call the dry land “earth”, and the gathering together of the waters he call “seas”. God see that it was good.
God talk say, “Let the earth yield grass, herbs yielding seeds, and fruit trees bearing fruit after dem kind, with dem seeds in it, on the earth”; and it was so.
The earth yielded grass, herbs yielding seed after dem kind, and trees bearing fruit, with dem seeds in it, after dem kind; and God see that it was good.
There was evening and there was morning, a third day.
God talk say, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to divide the day from the night; and Make dem be for signs to mark seasons, days, and years;
and Make dem be for lights in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth”; and it was so.
God made the two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. He also made the stars.
God set dem in the expanse of the sky to give light to the earth,
and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. God see that it was good.
There was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.
God talk say, “Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”
God created the large sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, after dem kind, and every winged bird after its kind. God see that it was good.
God blessed dem, saying, “Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”
There was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.
God talk say, “Let the earth produce living creatures after dem kind, livestock, creeping things, and animals of the earth after dem kind”; and it was so.
God made the animals of the earth after dem kind, and the livestock after dem kind, and everything that creeps on the ground after its kind. God see that it was good.

God talk say, “Make we make man in our image, after our likeness: and Make dem have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the sky, and over the livestock, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.”
God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created dem.

God blessed dem. God talk say to dem, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the sky, and over every living thing that moves on the earth.”
God talk say, “See am, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is on the surface of all the earth, and every tree, which bears fruit yielding seed. It Go be una chop.
To every animal of the earth, and to every bird of the sky, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which E get life, I have given every green herb for chop;” and it was so.
God see everything that he had made, and, see am, it was very good. There was evening and there was morning, a sixth day.
The heavens, the earth, and all dem vast array were finished.
On the seventh day God finished his work which he had done; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had done.
God blessed the seventh day, and made it holy, because he rested in it from all his work of creation which he had done.
This is the history of the generations of the heavens and of the earth when dem were created, in the day that Baba God made the earth and the heavens.
No plant of the field was yet in the earth, and no herb of the field had yet sprung up; for Baba God had not caused it to rain on the earth. There No be a man to till the ground,
but a mist go up from the earth, and watered the whole surface of the ground.
Baba God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
Baba God planted a garden eastward, in Eden, and there he put the man whom he had formed.

Out of the ground Baba God made every tree to grow that is pleasant to the sight, and good for chop, including the tree of life in the middle of the garden and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
A river go out of Eden to water the garden; and from there it was parted, and became the source of four rivers.
The name of the first is Pishon: it flows through the whole land of Havilah, where E get gold;
and the gold of that land is good. Bdellium and onyx stone are also there.
The name of the second river is Gihon. It is the same river that flows through the whole land of Cush.
The name of the third river is Hiddekel. This is the one which flows in front of Assyria. The fourth river is the Euphrates.
Baba God take the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.
Baba God commanded the man, saying, “You may freely eat of every tree of the garden;
but you no go eat of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil; for in the day that you eat of it, You go surely die.”
Baba God talk say, “It No be good for the man to be alone. I go make him a helper comparable to him.”

Out of the ground Baba God formed every animal of the field, and every bird of the sky, and bring dem to the man to see what he would call dem. Anything wey the man call every living creature became its name.
The man give names to all livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field; but for man there No be find a helper comparable to him.
Baba God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep. As the man slept, he take one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh in its place.
Baba God made a woman from the rib which he had taken from the man, and bring her to the man.
The man talk say, “This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh. She Go be call ‘woman,’ because she was taken out of Man.”
So a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and Dem go be one flesh.
The man and his wife were both naked, and dem No be ashamed.
Now the serpent was more subtle than any animal of the field which Baba God had made. He talk say to the woman, “Has God really talk say, ‘You no go eat of any tree of the garden?’”
The woman talk say to the serpent, “We may eat fruit from the trees of the garden,
but not the fruit of the tree which is in the middle of the garden. God has talk say, ‘You no go eat of it. You no go touch it, lest you die.’”
The serpent talk say to the woman, “You no go surely die,
for God knows that in the day you eat it, una eyes Go be opened, and You go be like God, knowing good and evil.”

When the woman see that the tree was good for chop, and that it was a delight to the eyes, and that the tree was to be desired to make one wise, she take some of its fruit, and ate; and she give some to her husband with her, and he ate it, too.
Dem eyes were opened, and dem both know that dem were naked. Dem sewed fig leaves together, and made coverings for themselves.
Dem heard Baba God’s voice walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of Baba God among the trees of the garden.
Baba God call to the man, and talk say to him, “Where are you?”
The man talk say, “I heard una voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.”
God talk say, “Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree that I commanded you not to eat from?”
The man talk say, “The woman whom you give to be with me, she give me fruit from the tree, and I ate it.”
Baba God talk say to the woman, “What have you done?” The woman talk say, “The serpent deceived me, and I ate.”

Baba God talk say to the serpent, “Because you have done this, You be cursed above all livestock, and above every animal of the field. You shall go on una belly and you shall eat dust all the days of una life.
I go put hostility between you and the woman, and between una offspring and her offspring. He will bruise una head, and You go bruise his heel.”
To the woman he talk say, “I go greatly multiply una pain in childbirth. In pain You go bear pikin dem. Una desire Go be for una husband, and he will rule over you.”

To Adam he talk say, “Because you have listened to una wife’s voice, and ate from the tree, about which I commanded you, saying, ‘You no go eat of it,’ the ground is cursed for una sake. You go eat from it with much labor all the days of una life.
It will yield thorns and thistles to you; and You go eat the herb of the field.
By the sweat of una face will you eat bread until you return to the ground, for out of it you were taken. For You be dust, and to dust you shall return.”
The man call his wife Eve because she would be the mother of all the living.
Baba God made coats of animal skins for Adam and for his wife, and clothed dem.
Baba God talk say, “See am, the man has become like one of us, knowing good and evil. Now, lest he reach out his hand, and also take of the tree of life, and eat, and live forever...”
So Baba God sent him out from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from which he was taken.
So he drove out the man; and he placed cherubim at the east of the garden of Eden, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to guard the way to the tree of life.
The man know Eve his wife. She conceived, and give birth to Cain, and talk say, “I have gotten a man with Baba God’s help.”
Again she give birth, to Cain’s brother Abel. Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.
As time passed, Cain bring an offering to Baba God from the fruit of the ground.
Abel also bring some of the firstborn of his flock and of its fat. Baba God respected Abel and his offering,
but he didn’t respect Cain and his offering. Cain was very angry, and the expression on his face fell.
Baba God talk say to Cain, “Why are you angry? Why has the expression of una face fallen?
If you do well, no go it be lifted up? If you no do well, sin crouches at the door. Its desire is for you, but You be to rule over it.”
Cain talk say to Abel, his brother, “Let’s go into the field.” While dem were in the field, Cain rose up against Abel, his brother, and killed him.
Baba God talk say to Cain, “Where is Abel, una brother?” He talk say, “I no know. Am I my brother’s keeper?”
Baba God talk say, “What have you done? The voice of una brother’s blood cries to me from the ground.
Now You be cursed because of the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive una brother’s blood from una hand.
From now on, when you till the ground, it no go yield its strength to you. You go be a fugitive and a wanderer in the earth.”
Cain talk say to Baba God, “My punishment is greater than I can bear.
See am, you have driven me out today from the surface of the ground. I go be hidden from una face, and I go be a fugitive and a wanderer in the earth. Anybody wey finds me will kill me.”
Baba God talk say to him, “So Anybody wey slays Cain, vengeance Go be taken on him sevenfold.” Baba God appointed a sign for Cain, so that anyone finding him would not strike him.
Cain left Baba God’s presence, and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden.
Cain know his wife. She conceived, and give birth to Enoch. He built a city, and call the name of the city, after the name of his son, Enoch.
To Enoch was born Irad. Irad became the father of Mehujael. Mehujael became the father of Methushael. Methushael became the father of Lamech.
Lamech take two wives: the name of the first one was Adah, and the name of the second one was Zillah.
Adah give birth to Jabal, who was the father of people wey live in tents and have livestock.
His brother’s name was Jubal, who was the father of all who handle the harp and pipe.
Zillah also give birth to Tubal Cain, the forger of every cutting instrument of brass and iron. Tubal Cain’s sister was Naamah.
Lamech talk say to his wives, “Adah and Zillah, hear my voice. You wives of Lamech, listen to my speech, for I have slain a man for wounding me, a young man for bruising me.
If Cain Go be avenged seven times, truly Lamech seventy-seven times.”
Adam know his wife again. She give birth to a son, and named him Seth, saying, “for God has given me another pikin instead of Abel, for Cain killed him.”
A son was also born to Seth, and he named him Enosh. At that time men began to call on Baba God’s name.
This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, he made him in God’s likeness.
He created dem male and female, and blessed dem. On the day dem were created, he named dem “Adam”.
Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and became the father of a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.
The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons and daughters.
All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.
Seth lived one hundred five years, then became the father of Enosh.
Seth lived after he became the father of Enosh eight hundred seven years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
All of the days of Seth were nine hundred twelve years, then he died.
Enosh lived ninety years, and became the father of Kenan.
Enosh lived after he became the father of Kenan, eight hundred fifteen years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
All of the days of Enosh were nine hundred five years, then he died.
Kenan lived seventy years, then became the father of Mahalalel.
Kenan lived after he became the father of Mahalalel eight hundred forty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters
and all of the days of Kenan were nine hundred ten years, then he died.
Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Jared.
Mahalalel lived after he became the father of Jared eight hundred thirty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
All of the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety-five years, then he died.
Jared lived one hundred sixty-two years, then became the father of Enoch.
Jared lived after he became the father of Enoch eight hundred years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
All of the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty-two years, then he died.
Enoch lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Methuselah.
After Methuselah’s birth, Enoch walked with God for three hundred years, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
All the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty-five years.
Enoch walked with God, and he No be find, for God take him.
Methuselah lived one hundred eighty-seven years, then became the father of Lamech.
Methuselah lived after he became the father of Lamech seven hundred eighty-two years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
All the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty-nine years, then he died.
Lamech lived one hundred eighty-two years, then became the father of a son.
He named him Noah, saying, “This one will comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, caused by the ground which Baba God has cursed.”
Lamech lived after he became the father of Noah five hundred ninety-five years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
All the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy-seven years, then he died.
Noah was five hundred years old, then Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
When men began to multiply on the surface of the ground, and daughters were born to dem,
God’s sons see that men’s daughters were beautiful, and dem take any that dem want for themselves as wives.
Baba God talk say, “My Spirit No go strive with man forever, because he also is flesh; so his days Go be one hundred twenty years.”
The Nephilim were in the earth in those days, and also after that, when God’s sons come in to men’s daughters and had pikin dem with dem. Those were the mighty men who were of old, men of renown.
Baba God see that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of man’s heart was continually only evil.
Baba God was sorry that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him in his heart.
Baba God talk say, “I go destroy man whom I have created from the surface of the ground — man, along with animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky — for I be sorry that I have made dem.”
But Noah find favor in Baba God’s eyes.
This is the history of the generations of Noah: Noah was a righteous man, blameless among the people of his time. Noah walked with God.
Noah became the father of three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
The earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.
God see the earth, and see that it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted dem way on the earth.
God talk say to Noah, “I go bring an end to all flesh, for the earth is filled with violence through dem. See am, I go destroy dem and the earth.
Make a ship of gopher wood. You shall make rooms in the ship, and shall seal it inside and outside with pitch.
This is how you shall make it. The length of the ship go be three hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits.
You shall make a roof in the ship, and you shall finish it to a cubit upward. You shall set the door of the ship in its side. You shall make it with lower, second, and third levels.
I, even I, do bring the flood of waters on this earth, to destroy all flesh having the breath of life from under the sky. Everything that is in the earth will die.
But I go establish my covenant with you. You shall come into the ship, you, una sons, una wife, and una sons’ wives with you.
Of every living thing of all flesh, you shall bring two of every sort into the ship, to keep dem alive with you. Dem go be male and female.
Of the birds after dem kind, of the livestock after dem kind, of every creeping thing of the ground after its kind, two of every sort will come to you, to keep dem alive.
Take with you some of all chop that is eaten, and gather it to yourself; and it Go be for chop for you, and for dem.”
Thus Noah did. He did all that God commanded him.
Baba God talk say to Noah, “Come with all of una household into the ship, for I have seen una righteousness before me in this generation.
You shall take seven pairs of every clean animal with you, the male and his female. Of the animals that No be clean, take two, the male and his female.
Also of the birds of the sky, seven and seven, male and female, to keep seed alive on the surface of all the earth.
In seven days, I go cause it to rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights. I go destroy every living thing that I have made from the surface of the ground.”
Noah did everything that Baba God commanded him.
Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters come on the earth.
Noah go into the ship with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives, because of the floodwaters.
Clean animals, unclean animals, birds, and everything that creeps on the ground
go by pairs to Noah into the ship, male and female, as God commanded Noah.
After the seven days, the floodwaters come on the earth.

In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on the same day all the fountains of the great deep were burst open, and the sky’s windows were opened.
It rained on the earth forty days and forty nights.
In the same day Noah, and Shem, Ham, and Japheth — the sons of Noah — and Noah’s wife and the three wives of his sons with dem, entered into the ship —
dem, and every animal after its kind, all the livestock after dem kind, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, every bird of every sort.
Pairs from all flesh with the breath of life in dem go into the ship to Noah.
People wey go in, go in male and female of all flesh, as God commanded him; then Baba God shut him in.
The flood was forty days on the earth. The waters increased, and lifted up the ship, and it was lifted up above the earth.
The waters rose, and increased greatly on the earth; and the ship floated on the surface of the waters.
The waters rose very high on the earth. All the high mountains that were under the whole sky were covered.
The waters rose fifteen cubits higher, and the mountains were covered.
All flesh died that moved on the earth, including birds, livestock, animals, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, and every man.
All on the dry land, in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, died.

Every living thing was destroyed that was on the surface of the ground, including man, livestock, creeping things, and birds of the sky. Dem were destroyed from the earth. Only Noah was left, and people wey were with him in the ship.
The waters flooded the earth one hundred fifty days.
God remember Noah, all the animals, and all the livestock that were with him in the ship; and God made a wind to pass over the earth. The waters subsided.
The deep’s fountains and the sky’s windows were also stopped, and the rain from the sky was restrained.
The waters continually receded from the earth. After the end of one hundred fifty days the waters decreased.
The ship rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on Ararat’s mountains.
The waters receded continually until the tenth month. In the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains were visible.
At the end of forty days, Noah opened the window of the ship which he had made,
and he sent out a raven. It go back and forth, until the waters were dried up from the earth.
He imself sent out a dove to see if the waters were abated from the surface of the ground,

but the dove find no place to rest her foot, and she come back into the ship to him, for the waters were on the surface of the whole earth. He put out his hand, and take her, and bring her to him into the ship.
He waited yet another seven days; and again he sent the dove out of the ship.
The dove come back to him at evening and, see am, in her mouth was a freshly plucked olive leaf. So Noah know that the waters were abated from the earth.
He waited yet another seven days, and sent out the dove; and she didn’t return to him anymore.

In the six hundred first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from the earth. Noah removed the covering of the ship, and looked. He see that the surface of the ground was dried.
In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.
God spoke to Noah, saying,
“Go out of the ship, you, una wife, una sons, and una sons’ wives with you.

Bring out with you every living thing that is with you of all flesh, including birds, livestock, and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, that dem may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply on the earth.”
Noah go out, with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives with him.
Every animal, every creeping thing, and every bird, Anything wey moves on the earth, after dem families, go out of the ship.
Noah built an altar to Baba God, and take of every clean animal, and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

Baba God smelled the pleasant aroma. Baba God talk say in his heart, “I go not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake because the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth. I go never again strike every living thing, as I have done.
While the earth remains, seed time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night No go cease.”
God blessed Noah and his sons, and talk say to dem, “Be fruitful, multiply, and replenish the earth.

The fear of you and the dread of You go be on every animal of the earth, and on every bird of the sky. Everything that moves along the ground, and all the fish of the sea, are delivered into una hand.
Every moving thing that lives Go be chop for you. As I give you the green herb, I have given everything to you.
But flesh with its life, that is, its blood, you no go eat.
I go surely require una blood of una lives; at the hand of every animal I go require it. At the hand of man, even at the hand of every man’s brother, I go require the life of man.
Anybody wey sheds man’s blood, his blood Go be shed by man, for God made man in his own image.
Be fruitful and multiply. Increase abundantly in the earth, and multiply in it.”
God spoke to Noah and to his sons with him, saying,
“As for me, see am, I establish my covenant with you, and with una offspring after you,
and with every living creature that is with you: the birds, the livestock, and every animal of the earth with you, of all that go out of the ship, even every animal of the earth.
I go establish my covenant with you: All flesh No go be cut off any more by the waters of the flood. There will never again be a flood to destroy the earth.”
God talk say, “This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:
I set my rainbow in the cloud, and it Go be a sign of a covenant between me and the earth.
When I bring a cloud over the earth, that the rainbow Go be seen in the cloud,
and I go remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh, and the waters will no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.
The rainbow Go be in the cloud. I go look at it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is on the earth.”
God talk say to Noah, “This is the token of the covenant which I have established between me and all flesh that is on the earth.”
The sons of Noah who go out from the ship were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Ham is the father of Canaan.
These three were the sons of Noah, and from these, the whole earth was populated.
Noah began to be a farmer, and planted a vineyard.
He drank of the wine and got drunk. He was uncovered within his tent.
Ham, the father of Canaan, see the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside.
Shem and Japheth take a garment, and laid it on both dem shoulders, go in backwards, and covered the nakedness of dem father. Dem faces were backwards, and dem didn’t see dem father’s nakedness.
Noah awoke from his wine, and know what his youngest son had done to him.
He talk say, “Canaan is cursed. He Go be a worker of workers to his brothers.”
He talk say, “Blessed be Baba God, the God of Shem. Let Canaan be his worker.
May God enlarge Japheth. Make e live in the tents of Shem. Let Canaan be his worker.”
Noah lived three hundred fifty years after the flood.
All the days of Noah were nine hundred fifty years, and then he died.
Now this is the history of the generations of the sons of Noah and of Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to dem after the flood.
The sons of Japheth were: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
The sons of Gomer were: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
The sons of Javan were: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
Of these were the islands of the nations divided in dem lands, everyone after his language, after dem families, in dem nations.
The sons of Ham were: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
The sons of Cush were: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah were: Sheba and Dedan.
Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one in the earth.
He was a mighty hunter before Baba God. So it is talk say, “like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before Baba God”.
The beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
Out of that land he go into Assyria, and built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,
and Resen between Nineveh and the great city Calah.
Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,
Pathrusim, Casluhim (which the Philistines descended from), and Caphtorim.
Canaan became the father of Sidon (his firstborn), Heth,
the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,
the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,
the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad.
The border of the Canaanites was from Sidon — as you go toward Gerar — to Gaza — as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim — to Lasha.
These are the sons of Ham, after dem families, according to dem languages, in dem lands and dem nations.
Pikin dem were also born to Shem, the father of all the pikin dem of Eber, the elder brother of Japheth.
The sons of Shem were: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.
The sons of Aram were: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.
Arpachshad became the father of Shelah. Shelah became the father of Eber.
To Eber were born two sons. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother’s name was Joktan.
Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
Dem dwelling extended from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.
These are the sons of Shem, by dem families, according to dem languages, lands, and nations.
These are the families of the sons of Noah, by dem generations, according to dem nations. The nations divided from these in the earth after the flood.
The whole earth was of one language and of one speech.
As dem traveled east, dem find a plain in the land of Shinar, and dem lived there.
Dem talk say to each other, “Come, let’s make bricks, and burn dem thoroughly.” Dem had brick for stone, and dem used tar for mortar.
Dem talk say, “Come, let’s build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top reaches to the sky, and let’s make a name for ourselves, lest we be scattered abroad on the surface of the whole earth.”
Baba God come down to see the city and the tower, which the pikin dem of men built.
Baba God talk say, “See am, Dem be one people, and dem have all one language, and this is Wetin dem begin to do. Now nothing Go be withheld from dem, which dem intend to do.
Come, let’s go down, and there confuse dem language, that dem may not understand each other’s speech.”
So Baba God scattered dem abroad from there on the surface of all the earth. Dem stopped building the city.
So its name was call Babel, because there Baba God confused the language of all the earth. From there, Baba God scattered dem abroad on the surface of all the earth.
This is the history of the generations of Shem: Shem was one hundred years old when he became the father of Arpachshad two years after the flood.
Shem lived five hundred years after he became the father of Arpachshad, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
Arpachshad lived thirty-five years and became the father of Shelah.
Arpachshad lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Shelah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
Shelah lived thirty years, and became the father of Eber.
Shelah lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Eber, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
Eber lived thirty-four years, and became the father of Peleg.
Eber lived four hundred thirty years after he became the father of Peleg, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
Peleg lived thirty years, and became the father of Reu.
Peleg lived two hundred nine years after he became the father of Reu, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
Reu lived thirty-two years, and became the father of Serug.
Reu lived two hundred seven years after he became the father of Serug, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
Serug lived thirty years, and became the father of Nahor.
Serug lived two hundred years after he became the father of Nahor, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
Nahor lived twenty-nine years, and became the father of Terah.
Nahor lived one hundred nineteen years after he became the father of Terah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
Terah lived seventy years, and became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
Now this is the history of the generations of Terah. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran became the father of Lot.
Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldees.
Abram and Nahor married wives. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife was Milcah, the daughter of Haran who was also the father of Iscah.
Sarai was barren. She had no pikin.

Terah take Abram his son, Lot the son of Haran, his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram’s wife. Dem go from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan. Dem come to Haran and lived there.
The days of Terah were two hundred five years. Terah died in Haran.
Now Baba God talk say to Abram, “Leave una country, and una relatives, and una father’s house, and go to the land that I go show you.
I go make of you a great nation. I go bless you and make una name great. You go be a blessing.
I go bless people wey bless you, and I go curse him who curses you. All the families of the earth Go be blessed through you.”
So Abram go, as Baba God had told him. Lot go with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he comot from Haran.

Abram take Sarai his wife, Lot his brother’s son, all dem possessions that dem had gathered, and the people whom dem had acquired in Haran, and dem go to go into the land of Canaan. Dem entered into the land of Canaan.
Abram passed through the land to the place of Shechem, to the oak of Moreh. The Canaanites were in the land, then.
Baba God appeared to Abram and talk say, “I go give this land to una offspring.” He built an altar there to Baba God, who had appeared to him.
He left from there to go to the mountain on the east of Bethel and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Ai on the east. There he built an altar to Baba God and call on Baba God’s name.
Abram traveled, still going on toward the South.
There was a famine in the land. Abram go down into Egypt to live as a foreigner there, for the famine was severe in the land.
When he had come near to enter Egypt, he talk say to Sarai his wife, “See now, I know that You be a beautiful woman to look at.
It will happen, when the Egyptians see you, that Dem go say, ‘This is his wife.’ Dem go kill me, but Dem go save you alive.
Please say that You be my sister, that it may be well with me for una sake, and that my soul may live because of you.”
When Abram had come into Egypt, Egyptians see that the woman was very beautiful.
The princes of Pharaoh see her, and praised her to Pharaoh; and the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house.
He dealt well with Abram for her sake. He had sheep, cattle, male donkeys, male workers, female workers, female donkeys, and camels.
Baba God afflicted Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram’s wife.
Pharaoh call Abram and talk say, “Wetin be this that you have done to me? Why didn’t you tell me that she was una wife?
Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I take her to be my wife? Now so, see una wife, take her, and go una way.”
Pharaoh commanded men concerning him, and dem escorted him away with his wife and all that he had.
Abram go up out of Egypt — he, his wife, all that he had, and Lot with him — into the South.
Abram was very rich in livestock, in silver, and in gold.
He go on his journeys from the South even to Bethel, to the place where his tent Bin dey at the beginning, between Bethel and Ai,
to the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first. There Abram call on Baba God’s name.
Lot also, who go with Abram, had flocks, herds, and tents.
The land No be able to bear dem, that dem might live together; for dem substance was great, so that dem could not live together.
There was strife between the herdsmen of Abram’s livestock and the herdsmen of Lot’s livestock. The Canaanites and the Perizzites lived in the land at that time.
Abram talk say to Lot, “Please, let there be no strife between you and me, and between una herdsmen and my herdsmen; for We be relatives.
No be the whole land before you? Please separate yourself from me. If you go to the left hand, then I go go to the right. Or if you go to the right hand, then I go go to the left.”

Lot lifted up his eyes, and see all the plain of the Jordan, that it was well-watered everywhere, before Baba God destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, like the garden of Baba God, like the land of Egypt, as you go to Zoar.
So Lot chose the Plain of the Jordan for imself. Lot traveled east, and dem separated themselves the one from the other.
Abram lived in the land of Canaan, and Lot lived in the cities of the plain, and moved his tent as far as Sodom.
Now the men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinners against Baba God.
Baba God talk say to Abram, after Lot was separated from him, “Now, lift up una eyes, and look from the place where You be, northward and southward and eastward and westward,
for all the land which you see, I go give to you, and to una offspring forever.
I go make una offspring as the dust of the earth, so that if a man can count the dust of the earth, then una offspring may also be counted.
Arise, walk through the land in its length and in its width; for I go give it to you.”
Abram moved his tent, and come and lived by the oaks of Mamre, which are in Hebron, and built an altar there to Baba God.
In the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar, Arioch, king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer, king of Elam, and Tidal, king of Goiim,
dem made war with Bera, king of Sodom, and with Birsha, king of Gomorrah, Shinab, king of Admah, and Shemeber, king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (also call Zoar).
All these joined together in the valley of Siddim (also call the Salt Sea).
Dem served Chedorlaomer for twelve years, and in the thirteenth year, dem rebelled.
In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer come, and the kings who were with him, and struck the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim, and the Zuzim in Ham, and the Emim in Shaveh Kiriathaim,
and the Horites in dem Mount Seir, to El Paran, which is by the wilderness.
Dem come back, and come to En Mishpat (also call Kadesh), and struck all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that lived in Hazazon Tamar.

The king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (also call Zoar) go out; and dem set the battle in array against dem in the valley of Siddim;
against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of Goiim, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings against the five.
Now the valley of Siddim was full of tar pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and some fell there, and people wey remain fled to the hills.
Dem take all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all dem chop, and go dem way.
Dem take Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who lived in Sodom, and his goods, and comot.
One who had escaped come and told Abram, the Hebrew. At that time, he lived by the oaks of Mamre, the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner; and dem were allies of Abram.
When Abram heard that his relative was taken captive, he led out his trained men, born in his house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued as far as Dan.
He divided imself against dem by night, he and his workers, and struck dem, and pursued dem to Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.
He bring back all the goods, and also bring back his relative, Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the other people.
The king of Sodom go out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him, at the valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).
Melchizedek king of Salem bring out bread and wine: and he was priest of God Most High.
He blessed him, and talk say, “Blessed be Abram of God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth:
and blessed be God Most High, who has delivered una enemies into una hand.” Abram give him a tenth of all.
The king of Sodom talk say to Abram, “Give me the people, and take the goods for yourself.”
Abram talk say to the king of Sodom, “I have lifted up my hand to Baba God, God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth,
that I go not take a thread nor a sandal strap nor anything that is yours, lest you should say, ‘I have made Abram rich.’
I go accept nothing from you except that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men who go with me: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. Make dem take dem portion.”
After these things Baba God’s word come to Abram in a vision, saying, “No fear, Abram. I be una shield, una exceedingly great reward.”
Abram talk say, “Lord Baba God, what will you give me, since I go childless, and person wey will inherit my estate is Eliezer of Damascus?”
Abram talk say, “See am, to me you have given no pikin dem: and, see am, one born in my house is my heir.”
See am, Baba God’s word come to him, saying, “This man No go be una heir, but person wey will come out of una own body Go be una heir.”
Baba God bring him outside, and talk say, “Look now toward the sky, and count the stars, if You be able to count dem.” He talk say to Abram, “So will una offspring be.”
He believe in Baba God, who credited it to him for righteousness.
He talk say to Abram, “I be Baba God who bring you out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give you this land to inherit it.”
He talk say, “Lord Baba God, how will I know that I go inherit it?”
E tell am say, “Bring me a heifer three years old, a female goat three years old, a ram three years old, a turtledove, and a young pigeon.”
He bring him all these, and divided dem in the middle, and laid each half opposite the other; but he didn’t divide the birds.
The birds of prey come down on the carcasses, and Abram drove dem away.
When the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell on Abram. Now terror and great darkness fell on him.
He talk say to Abram, “Know for sure that una offspring will live as foreigners in a land that No be dem own, and will serve dem. Dem go afflict dem four hundred years.
I go also judge that nation, whom Dem go serve. Afterward Dem go come out with great wealth,
but You go go to una fathers in peace. You go be buried at a good old age.
In the fourth generation Dem go come here again, for the wickedness of the Amorite No be yet full.”
E happen say that, when the sun go down, and it was dark, see am, a smoking furnace, and a flaming torch passed between these pieces.
In that day Baba God made a covenant with Abram, saying, “I have given this land to una offspring, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates:
the Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites,
the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaim,
the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.”
Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, bore him no pikin dem. She had a worker, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.
Sarai talk say to Abram, “See now, Baba God has restrained me from bearing. Please go in to my worker. It may be that I go obtain pikin dem by her.” Abram listened to the voice of Sarai.
Sarai, Abram’s wife, take Hagar the Egyptian, her worker, after Abram had lived ten years in the land of Canaan, and give her to Abram her husband to be his wife.
He go in to Hagar, and she conceived. When she see that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.
Sarai talk say to Abram, “This wrong is una fault. I give my worker into una bosom, and when she see that she had conceived, I was despised in her eyes. Baba God judge between me and you.”
But Abram talk say to Sarai, “See am, una maid is in una hand. Do to her Anything wey is good in una eyes.” Sarai dealt harshly with her, and she fled from her face.
Baba God’s angel find her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain on the way to Shur.
He talk say, “Hagar, Sarai’s worker, where did you come from? Where are you going?” She talk say, “I be fleeing from the face of my mistress Sarai.”
Baba God’s angel talk say to her, “Return to una mistress, and submit yourself under her hands.”
Baba God’s angel talk say to her, “I go greatly multiply una offspring, that Dem go not be counted for plenty people.”
Baba God’s angel talk say to her, “See am, You be with pikin, and will bear a son. You shall call his name Ishmael, because Baba God has heard una suffering.
He Go be like a wild donkey among men. His hand Go be against every man, and every man’s hand against him. He will live opposite all of his brothers.”
She call the name of Baba God who spoke to her, “You be a God wey see,” for she talk say, “Have I even stayed alive after seeing him?”
So the well was call Beer Lahai Roi. See am, it is between Kadesh and Bered.
Hagar bore a son for Abram. Abram call the name of his son, whom Hagar bore, Ishmael.
Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to Abram.
When Abram was ninety-nine years old, Baba God appeared to Abram and talk say to him, “I be God Almighty. Walk before me, and be blameless.
I go make my covenant between me and you, and will multiply you exceedingly.”
Abram fell on his face. God talked with him, saying,
“As for me, see am, my covenant is with you. You go be the father of a plenty people of nations.
Una name will no more be call Abram, but una name Go be Abraham; for I have made you the father of a plenty people of nations.
I go make you exceedingly fruitful, and I go make nations of you. Kings will come out of you.
I go establish my covenant between me and you and una offspring after you throughout dem generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God to you and to una offspring after you.
I go give to you, and to una offspring after you, the land where You be traveling, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession. I go be dem God.”
God talk say to Abraham, “As for you, You go keep my covenant, you and una offspring after you throughout dem generations.
This is my covenant, which you shall keep, between me and you and una offspring after you. Every male among you go be circumcised.
You go be circumcised in the flesh of una foreskin. It Go be a token of the covenant between me and you.
Person Wey eight days old Go be circumcised among you, every male throughout una generations, person Wey born in the house, or bought with money from any foreigner Wey be not of una offspring.
Person Wey born in una house, and person Wey bought with una money, must be circumcised. My covenant Go be in una flesh for an everlasting covenant.
The uncircumcised male Wey be not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that soul go be cut off from his people. He has broken my covenant.”
God talk say to Abraham, “As for Sarai una wife, you no go call her name Sarai, but her name Go be Sarah.
I go bless her, and moreover I go give you a son by her. Yes, I go bless her, and she Go be a mother of nations. Kings of peoples will come from her.”
Then Abraham fell on his face, and laughed, and talk say in his heart, “Will a pikin be born to him Wey be one hundred years old? Will Sarah, Wey be ninety years old, give birth?”
Abraham talk say to God, “Oh that Ishmael might live before you!”
God talk say, “No, but Sarah, una wife, will bear you a son. You shall call his name Isaac. I go establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant for his offspring after him.

As for Ishmael, I have heard you. See am, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly. He will become the father of twelve princes, and I go make him a great nation.
But my covenant I establish with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this set time next year.”
When he finished talking with him, God go up from Abraham.

Abraham take Ishmael his son, all who were born in his house, and all who were bought with his money; every male among the men of Abraham’s house, and circumcised the flesh of dem foreskin in the same day, as God had talk say to him.
Abraham was ninety-nine years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
Ishmael, his son, was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
In the same day both Abraham and Ishmael, his son, were circumcised.
All the men of his house, those born in the house, and those bought with money from a foreigner, were circumcised with him.
Baba God appeared to him by the oaks of Mamre, as he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day.
He lifted up his eyes and looked, and see that three men stood opposite him. When he see dem, he ran to meet dem from the tent door, and bowed imself to the earth,
and talk say, “My lord, if now I have find favor in una sight, please no go away from una worker.
Now let a little water be fetched, wash una feet, and rest unaself under the tree.
I go get a morsel of bread so you can refresh una heart. After that you may go una way, now that you have come to una worker.” Dem talk say, “Very well, do as you have talk say.”
Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah, and talk say, “Sharp-sharp prepare three seahs of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes.”
Abraham ran to the herd, and fetched a tender and good calf, and give it to the worker. He hurried to dress it.
He take butter, milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before dem. He stood by dem under the tree, and dem ate.
Dem ask him, “Where is Sarah, una wife?” He talk say, “See, in the tent.”
He talk say, “I go certainly return to you at about this time next year; and see am, Sarah una wife Go get a son.” Sarah heard in the tent door, which was behind him.
Now Abraham and Sarah were old, well advanced in age. Sarah had passed the age of childbearing.
Sarah laughed within sheself, saying, “After I have grown old will I have pleasure, my lord being old also?”
Baba God talk say to Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh, saying, ‘Will I really bear a pikin, yet I be old?’
Is anything too hard for Baba God? At the set time I go return to you, when the season comes round, and Sarah Go get a son.”
Then Sarah denied it, saying, “I didn’t laugh,” for she was afraid. He talk say, “No, but you did laugh.”
The men rose up from there, and looked toward Sodom. Abraham go with dem to see dem on dem way.
Baba God talk say, “Will I hide from Abraham what I do,
since Abraham will surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth Go be blessed in him?

For I have known him, to the end that he may command his pikin dem and his household after him, that dem may keep the way of Baba God, to do righteousness and justice; to the end that Baba God may bring on Abraham that which he has spoken of him.”
Baba God talk say, “Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because dem sin is very grievous,
I go go down now, and see whether dem deeds are as bad as the reports which have come to me. If not, I go know.”
The men turned from there, and go toward Sodom, but Abraham stood yet before Baba God.
Abraham come near, and talk say, “Will you consume the righteous with the wicked?
What if E get fifty righteous within the city? Will you consume and not spare the place for the fifty righteous Wey be in it?

Be it far from you to do things like that, to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous should be like the wicked. May that be far from you. Shouldn’t the Judge of all the earth do right?”
Baba God talk say, “If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I go spare the whole place for dem sake.”
Abraham answer, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord, although I be dust and ashes.
What if there will lack five of the fifty righteous? Will you destroy all the city for lack of five?” He talk say, “I go not destroy it if I find forty-five there.”
He spoke to him yet again, and talk say, “What if E get forty find there?” He talk say, “I go not do it for the forty’s sake.”
He talk say, “Oh no let the Lord be angry, and I go speak. What if E get thirty find there?” He talk say, “I go not do it if I find thirty there.”
He talk say, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord. What if E get twenty find there?” He talk say, “I go not destroy it for the twenty’s sake.”
He talk say, “Oh no let the Lord be angry, and I go speak just once more. What if ten are find there?” He talk say, “I go not destroy it for the ten’s sake.”
Baba God go his way, as soon as he had finished communing with Abraham, and Abraham come back to his place.
The two angels come to Sodom at evening. Lot sat in the gate of Sodom. Lot see dem, and rose up to meet dem. He bowed imself with his face to the earth,

and he talk say, “See now, my lords, please turn aside into una worker’s house, stay all night, wash una feet, and you can rise up early, and go on una way.” Dem talk say, “No, but We go stay in the street all night.”
He urged dem greatly, and dem come in with him, and entered into his house. He made dem a feast, and baked unleavened bread, and dem ate.
But before dem lay down, the men of the city, the men of Sodom, surrounded the house, both young and old, all the people from every quarter.
Dem call to Lot, and talk say to him, “Where are the men who come in to you this night? Bring dem out to us, that we may have sex with dem.”
Lot go out to dem to the door, and shut the door after him.
He talk say, “Please, my brothers, no act so wickedly.

See now, I have two virgin daughters. Please let me bring dem out to you, and you may do to dem what seems good to you. Only no do anything to these men, because dem have come under the shadow of my roof.”

Dem talk say, “Stand back!” Then dem talk say, “This one fellow come in to live as a foreigner, and he appoints imself a judge. Now will we deal worse with you, than with dem!” Dem pressed hard on the man Lot, and come near to break the door.
But the men reached out dem hand, and bring Lot into the house to dem, and shut the door.
Dem struck the men who were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great, so that dem wearied themselves to find the door.
The men talk say to Lot, “Do you have anybody else here? Sons-in-law, una sons, una daughters, and Anybody wey you have in the city, bring dem out of the place:
for We go destroy this place, because the outcry against dem has grown so great before Baba God that Baba God has sent us to destroy it.”

Lot go out, and spoke to his sons-in-law, who were pledged to marry his daughters, and talk say, “Get up! Get out of this place, for Baba God will destroy the city.” But he seemed to his sons-in-law to be joking.
When the morning come, then the angels hurried Lot, saying, “Get up! Take una wife, and una two daughters Wey be here, lest you be consumed in the wickedness of the city.”
But he lingered; and the men grabbed his hand, his wife’s hand, and his two daughters’ hands, Baba God being merciful to him; and dem take him out, and set him outside of the city.
E happen say, when dem had taken dem out, that he talk say, “Escape for una life! No look behind you, and no stay anywhere in the plain. Escape to the mountains, lest you be consumed!”
Lot talk say to dem, “Oh, not so, my lord.

See now, una worker has find favor in una sight, and you have magnified una loving kindness, which you have shown to me in saving my life. I no fit escape to the mountain, lest evil overtake me, and I die.
See now, this city is near to flee to, and it is a little one. Oh let me escape there (no be it a little one?), and my soul will live.”
E tell am say, “See am, I have granted una request concerning this thing also, that I go not overthrow the city of which you have spoken.
Hurry, escape there, for I no fit do anything until you get there.” So the name of the city was call Zoar.
The sun had risen on the earth when Lot come to Zoar.
Then Baba God rained on Sodom and on Gomorrah sulfur and fire from Baba God out of the sky.
He overthrew those cities, all the plain, all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew on the ground.
But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.
Abraham got up early in the morning to the place where he had stood before Baba God.
He looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and looked, and see that the smoke of the land go up as the smoke of a furnace.
When God destroyed the cities of the plain, God remember Abraham, and sent Lot out of the middle of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in which Lot lived.
Lot go up out of Zoar, and lived in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he was afraid to live in Zoar. He lived in a cave with his two daughters.
The firstborn talk say to the younger, “Our father is old, and there No be a man in the earth to come in to us in the way of all the earth.
Come, let’s make our father drink wine, and We go lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s family line.”
Dem made dem father drink wine that night: and the firstborn go in, and lay with her father. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she arose.

E happen say on the next day, that the firstborn talk say to the younger, “See am, I lay last night with my father. Make we make him drink wine again, tonight. You go in, and lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s family line. ”
Dem made dem father drink wine that night also. The younger go and lay with him. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she got up.
Thus both of Lot’s daughters were with pikin by dem father.
The firstborn bore a son, and named him Moab. He is the father of the Moabites to this day.
The younger also bore a son, and call his name Ben Ammi. He is the father of the pikin dem of Ammon to this day.
Abraham traveled from there toward the land of the South, and lived between Kadesh and Shur. He lived as a foreigner in Gerar.
Abraham talk say about Sarah his wife, “She is my sister.” Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and take Sarah.
But God come to Abimelech in a dream of the night, and talk say to him, “See am, You be a dead man, because of the woman whom you have taken. For she is a man’s wife.”
Now Abimelech had not come near her. He talk say, “Lord, will you kill even a righteous nation?
Didn’t he tell me, ‘She is my sister?’ She, even she sheself, talk say, ‘He is my brother.’ In the integrity of my heart and the innocence of my hands I have done this.”
God talk say to him in the dream, “Yes, I know that in the integrity of una heart you have done this, and I also withheld you from sinning against me. So I didn’t allow you to touch her.
Now so, restore the man’s wife. For he is a prophet, and he will pray for you, and You go live. If you no restore her, know for sure that You go die, you, and all Wey be yours.”
Abimelech rose early in the morning, and call all his workers, and told all these things in dem ear. The men were very scared.

Then Abimelech call Abraham, and talk say to him, “What have you done to us? How have I sinned against you, that you have bring on me and on my kingdom a great sin? You have done deeds to me that ought not to be done!”
Abimelech talk say to Abraham, “What did you see, that you have done this thing?”
Abraham talk say, “Because I thought, ‘Surely the fear of God No be in this place. Dem go kill me for my wife’s sake.’
Besides, she is indeed my sister, the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.
When God caused me to wander from my father’s house, I talk say to her, ‘This is una kindness which you shall show to me. Everywhere that we go, say of me, “He is my brother.”’”
Abimelech take sheep and cattle, male workers and female workers, and give dem to Abraham, and restored Sarah, his wife, to him.
Abimelech talk say, “See am, my land is before you. Live where it pleases you.”
To Sarah he talk say, “See am, I have given una brother a thousand pieces of silver. See am, it is for you a covering of the eyes to all that are with you. In front of all You be vindicated.”
Abraham prayed to God. God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his female workers, and dem bore pikin dem.
For Baba God had closed up tight all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah, Abraham’s wife.
Baba God visited Sarah as he had talk say, and Baba God did to Sarah as he had spoken.
Sarah conceived, and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.
Abraham call his son who was born to him, whom Sarah bore to him, Isaac.
Abraham circumcised his son, Isaac, when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.
Abraham was one hundred years old when his son, Isaac, was born to him.
Sarah talk say, “God has made me laugh. Everyone wey hear will laugh with me.”
She talk say, “Who would have talk say to Abraham, that Sarah would nurse pikin dem? For I have borne him a son in his old age.”
The pikin grew, and was weaned. Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.
Sarah see the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne to Abraham, mocking.
So she talk say to Abraham, “Throw out this worker and her son! For the son of this worker No go be heir with my son, Isaac.”
The thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight on account of his son.

God talk say to Abraham, “No let it be grievous in una sight because of the boy, and because of una worker. In all that Sarah says to you, listen to her voice. For una offspring Go be accounted as from Isaac.
I go also make a nation of the son of the worker, because he is una pikin.”

Abraham rose up early in the morning, and take bread and a bottle of water, and give it to Hagar, putting it on her shoulder; and give her the pikin, and sent her away. She comot, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.
The water in the bottle was spent, and she throw the pikin under one of the shrubs.
She go and sat down opposite him, a good way off, about a bow shot away. For she talk say, “No let me see the death of the pikin.” She sat over against him, and lifted up her voice, and wept.
God heard the voice of the boy. The angel of God call to Hagar out of the sky, and talk say to her, “What ails you, Hagar? No fear. For God has heard the voice of the boy where he is.
Get up, lift up the boy, and hold him in una hand. For I go make him a great nation.”
God opened her eyes, and she see a well of water. She go, filled the bottle with water, and give the boy drink.
God was with the boy, and he grew. He lived in the wilderness, and became, as he grew up, an archer.
He lived in the wilderness of Paran. His mother take a wife for him out of the land of Egypt.
At that time, Abimelech and Phicol the captain of his army spoke to Abraham, saying, “God is with you in all that you do.

Now, so, swear to me here by God that You go not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son’s son. But according to the kindness that I have done to you, you shall do to me, and to the land in which you have lived as a foreigner.”
Abraham talk say, “I go swear.”
Abraham complained to Abimelech because of a water well, which Abimelech’s workers had violently taken away.
Abimelech talk say, “I no know who has done this thing. You didn’t tell me, and I didn’t hear of it until today.”
Abraham take sheep and cattle, and give dem to Abimelech. Those two made a covenant.
Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.
Abimelech talk say to Abraham, “What do these seven ewe lambs which you have set by themselves mean?”
He talk say, “You shall take these seven ewe lambs from my hand, that it may be a witness to me, that I have dug this well.”
So he call that place Beersheba, because dem both swore there.
So dem made a covenant at Beersheba. Abimelech rose up with Phicol, the captain of his army, and dem come back into the land of the Philistines.
Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and call there on the name of Baba God, the Everlasting God.
Abraham lived as a foreigner in the land of the Philistines many days.
After these things, God tested Abraham, and talk say to him, “Abraham!” He talk say, “Here I be.”
He talk say, “Now take una son, una only son, whom you love, even Isaac, and go into the land of Moriah. Offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains which I go tell you of.”

Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his donkey, and take two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son. He split the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and go to the place of which God had told him.
On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and see the place far off.
Abraham talk say to his young men, “Stay here with the donkey. The boy and I go go yonder. We go worship, and come back to you.”
Abraham take the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son. He take in his hand the fire and the knife. Dem both go together.
Isaac spoke to Abraham his father, and talk say, “My father?” He talk say, “Here I be, my son.” He talk say, “Here is the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?”
Abraham talk say, “God will provide imself the lamb for a burnt offering, my son.” So dem both go together.
Dem come to the place which God had told him of. Abraham built the altar there, and laid the wood in order, bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar, on the wood.
Abraham stretched out his hand, and take the knife to kill his son.
Baba God’s angel call to him out of the sky, and talk say, “Abraham, Abraham!” He talk say, “Here I be.”
He talk say, “No lay una hand on the boy or do anything to him. For now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld una son, una only son, from me.”
Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and see that behind him was a ram caught in the thicket by his horns. Abraham go and take the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering instead of his son.
Abraham call the name of that place Baba God Will Provide. As it is talk say to this day, “On Baba God’s mountain, it Go be provided.”
Baba God’s angel call to Abraham a second time out of the sky,
and talk say, “I have sworn by myself, says Baba God, because you have done this thing, and have not withheld una son, una only son,
that I go bless you greatly, and I go multiply una offspring greatly like the stars of the heavens, and like the sand which is on the seashore. Una offspring will possess the gate of his enemies.
All the nations of the earth Go be blessed by una offspring, because you have obeyed my voice.”
So Abraham come back to his young men, and dem rose up and go together to Beersheba. Abraham lived at Beersheba.
After these things, Abraham was told, “See am, Milcah, she also has borne pikin dem to una brother Nahor:
Uz his firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel the father of Aram,
Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel.”
Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.
His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.
Sarah lived one hundred twenty-seven years. This was the length of Sarah’s life.
Sarah died in Kiriath Arba (also call Hebron), in the land of Canaan. Abraham come to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.
Abraham rose up from before his dead, and spoke to the pikin dem of Heth, saying,
“I be a stranger and a foreigner living with you. Give me a possession of a burying-place with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.”
The pikin dem of Heth answer Abraham, saying to him,
“Hear us, my lord. You be a prince of God among us. Bury una dead in the best of our tombs. None of us will withhold from you his tomb. Bury una dead.”
Abraham rose up, and bowed imself to the people of the land, even to the pikin dem of Heth.
He talked with dem, saying, “If you agree that I should bury my dead out of my sight, hear me, and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,
that he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he has, which is in the end of his field. For the full price Make e give it to me among you for a possession of a burying-place.”
Now Ephron was sitting in the middle of the pikin dem of Heth. Ephron the Hittite answer Abraham in the hearing of the pikin dem of Heth, even of all who go in at the gate of his city, saying,
“No, my lord, hear me. I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. In the presence of the pikin dem of my people I give it to you. Bury una dead.”
Abraham bowed imself down before the people of the land.
He spoke to Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, “But if You go, please hear me. I go give the price of the field. Take it from me, and I go bury my dead there.”
Ephron answer Abraham, saying to him,
“My lord, listen to me. Wetin be a piece of land worth four hundred shekels of silver between me and you? So bury una dead.”

Abraham listened to Ephron. Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver which he had named in the audience of the pikin dem of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, according to the current merchants’ standard.
So the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, the cave which was in it, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all of its borders, were deeded
to Abraham for a possession in the presence of the pikin dem of Heth, before all who go in at the gate of his city.
After this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre (that is, Hebron), in the land of Canaan.
The field, and the cave that is in it, were deeded to Abraham for a possession of a burying place by the pikin dem of Heth.
Abraham was old, and well stricken in age. Baba God had blessed Abraham in all things.
Abraham talk say to his worker, the elder of his house, who ruled over all that he had, “Please put una hand under my thigh.
I go make you swear by Baba God, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that you no go take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I live.
But you shall go to my country, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son Isaac.”
The worker talk say to him, “What if the woman no be willing to follow me to this land? Must I bring una son again to the land you come from?”
Abraham talk say to him, “Beware that you no bring my son there again.

Baba God, the God of heaven, who take me from my father’s house, and from the land of my birth, who spoke to me, and who swore to me, saying, ‘I go give this land to una offspring. He will send his angel before you, and you shall take a wife for my son from there.
If the woman no be willing to follow you, then you go be clear from this oath to me. Only you no go bring my son there again.”
The worker put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and swore to him concerning this matter.
The worker take ten camels, of his master’s camels, and comot, having a variety of good things of his master’s with him. He arose, and go to Mesopotamia, to the city of Nahor.
He made the camels kneel down outside the city by the well of water at the time of evening, the time that women go out to draw water.
He talk say, “Baba God, the God of my master Abraham, please give me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.
See am, I be standing by the spring of water. The daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water.

Let it happen, that the young lady to whom I go say, ‘Please let down una pitcher, that I may drink,’ and she will say, ‘Drink, and I go also give una camels a drink,’ — Make she be the one you have appointed for una worker Isaac. By this I go know that you have shown kindness to my master.”
Before he had finished speaking, see am, Rebekah come out, who was born to Bethuel the son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, with her pitcher on her shoulder.
The young lady was very beautiful to look at, a virgin. No man had known her. She go down to the spring, filled her pitcher, and come up.
The worker ran to meet her, and talk say, “Please give me a drink, a little water from una pitcher.”
She talk say, “Drink, my lord.” She hurried, and let down her pitcher on her hand, and give him drink.
When she had done giving him drink, she talk say, “I go also draw for una camels, until dem have done drinking.”
She hurried, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again to the well to draw, and drew for all his camels.
The man looked steadfastly at her, remaining silent, to know whether Baba God had made his journey prosperous or not.
As the camels had done drinking, the man take a golden ring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold,
and talk say, “Whose daughter are you? Please tell me. Is there room in una father’s house for us to lodge in?”
She talk say to him, “I be the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, whom she bore to Nahor.”
She talk say moreover to him, “We have both straw and feed enough, and room to lodge in.”
The man bowed his head, and worshiped Baba God.

He talk say, “Blessed be Baba God, the God of my master Abraham, who has not forsaken his loving kindness and his truth toward my master. As for me, Baba God has led me on the way to the house of my master’s relatives.”
The young lady ran, and told her mother’s house about these words.
Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban. Laban ran out to the man, to the spring.

When he see the ring, and the bracelets on his sister’s hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, “This is what the man talk say to me,” he come to the man. See am, he was standing by the camels at the spring.
He talk say, “Come in, you blessed of Baba God. Why do you stand outside? For I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.”
The man come into the house, and he unloaded the camels. He give straw and feed for the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men who were with him.
Chop was set before him to eat, but he talk say, “I go not eat until I have told my message.” He talk say, “Speak on.”
He talk say, “I be Abraham’s worker.
Baba God has blessed my master greatly. He has become great. He has given him flocks and herds, silver and gold, male workers and female workers, and camels and donkeys.
Sarah, my master’s wife, bore a son to my master when she was old. He has given all that he has to him.
My master made me swear, saying, ‘You no go take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I live,
but you shall go to my father’s house, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son.’
I ask my master, ‘What if the woman No go follow me?’
He talk say to me, ‘Baba God, before whom I walk, will send his angel with you, and prosper una way. You shall take a wife for my son from my relatives, and of my father’s house.
Then will you be clear from my oath, when you come to my relatives. If dem no give her to you, you go be clear from my oath.’
I come today to the spring, and talk say, ‘Baba God, the God of my master Abraham, if now you do prosper my way which I go —
see am, I be standing by this spring of water. Let it happen, that the maiden who comes out to draw, to whom I go say, “Please give me a little water from una pitcher to drink,”
and she will tell me, “Drink, and I go also draw for una camels,” — Make she be the woman whom Baba God has appointed for my master’s son.’
Before I had finished speaking in my heart, see am, Rebekah come out with her pitcher on her shoulder. She go down to the spring, and drew. I talk say to her, ‘Please let me drink.’
She hurried and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and talk say, ‘Drink, and I go also give una camels a drink.’ So I drank, and she also give the camels a drink.
I ask her, and talk say, ‘Whose daughter are you?’ She talk say, ‘The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor’s son, whom Milcah bore to him.’ I put the ring on her nose, and the bracelets on her hands.
I bowed my head, and worshiped Baba God, and blessed Baba God, the God of my master Abraham, who had led me in the right way to take my master’s brother’s daughter for his son.
Now if You go deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me. If not, tell me, that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.”
Then Laban and Bethuel answer, “The thing proceeds from Baba God. We no fit speak to you bad or good.
See am, Rebekah is before you. Take her, and go, and Make she be una master’s son’s wife, as Baba God has spoken.”
When Abraham’s worker heard dem words, he bowed imself down to the earth to Baba God.
The worker bring out jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and clothing, and give dem to Rebekah. He also give precious things to her brother and her mother.
Dem ate and drank, he and the men who were with him, and stayed all night. Dem rose up in the morning, and he talk say, “Send me away to my master.”
Her brother and her mother talk say, “Let the young lady stay with us a few days, at least ten. After that she will go.”
E tell dem say, “No hinder me, since Baba God has prospered my way. Send me away that I may go to my master.”
Dem talk say, “We go call the young lady, and ask her.”
Dem call Rebekah, and talk say to her, “Will you go with this man?” She talk say, “I go go.”
Dem sent away Rebekah, dem sister, with her nurse, Abraham’s worker, and his men.
Dem blessed Rebekah, and talk say to her, “Our sister, may you be the mother of thousands of ten thousands, and let una offspring possess the gate of people wey hate dem.”
Rebekah arose with her ladies. Dem rode on the camels, and follow the man. The worker take Rebekah, and go his way.
Isaac come from the way of Beer Lahai Roi, for he lived in the land of the South.
Isaac go out to meditate in the field at the evening. He lifted up his eyes, and see, and, see am, there were camels coming.
Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she see Isaac, she dismounted from the camel.
She talk say to the worker, “Wey be the man Wey be walking in the field to meet us?” The worker talk say, “It is my master.” She take her veil, and covered sheself.
The worker told Isaac all the things that he had done.
Isaac bring her into his mother Sarah’s tent, and take Rebekah, and she became his wife. He love her. Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.
Abraham take another wife, and her name was Keturah.
She bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.
Jokshan became the father of Sheba, and Dedan. The sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.
The sons of Midian were: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the pikin dem of Keturah.
Abraham give all that he had to Isaac,
but to the sons of Abraham’s concubines, Abraham give gifts. He sent dem away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, to the east country.
These are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived: one hundred seventy-five years.
Abraham give up his spirit, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years, and was gathered to his people.
Isaac and Ishmael, his sons, buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron, the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre,
the field which Abraham purchased of the pikin dem of Heth. Abraham was buried there with Sarah, his wife.
After the death of Abraham, God blessed Isaac, his son. Isaac lived by Beer Lahai Roi.
Now this is the history of the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s worker, bore to Abraham.
These are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by dem names, according to the order of dem birth: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
Mishma, Dumah, Massa,
