When you come near the border of the pikin dem of Ammon, no bother dem, nor contend with dem; for I go not give you any of the land of the pikin dem of Ammon for a possession; because I have given it to the pikin dem of Lot for a possession.”
(That also is considered a land of Rephaim: Rephaim lived there before; but the Ammonites call dem Zamzummim,
a great people, many, and tall, as the Anakim; but Baba God destroyed dem before dem; and dem succeeded dem, and lived in dem place;
as he did for the pikin dem of Esau, who live in Seir, when he destroyed the Horites from before dem; and dem succeeded dem, and lived in dem place even to this day:
and the Avvim, who lived in villages as far as Gaza, the Caphtorim, who come out of Caphtor, destroyed dem, and lived in dem place.)

“Rise up, take una journey, and pass over the valley of the Arnon: see am, I have given into una hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land; begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.
Today I go begin to put the dread of you and the fear of you on the peoples Wey be under the whole sky, who shall hear the report of you, and shall tremble, and be in anguish because of you.”
I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,
“Let me pass through una land. I go go along by the highway, I go turn neither to the right hand nor to the left.
You shall sell me chop for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink. Just let me pass through on my feet,
as the pikin dem of Esau who live in Seir, and the Moabites who live in Ar, did to me; until I pass over the Jordan into the land which Baba God our God gives us.”
But Sihon king of Heshbon would not Make we pass by him; for Baba God una God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into una hand, as it is today.
Baba God talk say to me, “See am, I have begun to deliver up Sihon and his land before you. Begin to possess, that you may inherit his land.”
Then Sihon come out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Jahaz.
Baba God our God delivered him up before us; and we struck him, his sons, and all his people.
We take all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones. We left Nobody remaining.
Only the livestock we take for plunder for ourselves, with the plunder of the cities which we had taken.
From Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the valley, even to Gilead, there No be a city too high for us. Baba God our God delivered up all before us.
Only to the land of the pikin dem of Ammon you didn’t come near; all the banks of the river Jabbok, and the cities of the hill country, and Anywhere wey Baba God our God forbade us.
Then we turned, and go up the way to Bashan. Og the king of Bashan come out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
Baba God talk say to me, “No fear him; for I have delivered him, with all his people, and his land, into una hand. You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.”
So Baba God our God delivered into our hand Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people. We struck him until Nobody was left to him remaining.
We take all his cities at that time. There No be a city which we didn’t take from dem; sixty cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
All these were cities fortified with high walls, gates, and bars; besides a great many villages without walls.
We utterly destroyed dem, as we did to Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones.
But all the livestock, and the plunder of the cities, we take for plunder for ourselves.
We take the land at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon.
(The Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, and the Amorites call it Senir.)
We take all the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, to Salecah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

(For only Og king of Bashan remain of the remnant of the Rephaim. See am, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron. No be it in Rabbah of the pikin dem of Ammon? Nine cubits was its length, and four cubits its width, after the cubit of a man.)
This land we take in possession at that time: from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, and half the hill country of Gilead, and its cities, give I to the Reubenites and to the Gadites:
and the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, give I to the half-tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, even all Bashan. (The same is call the land of Rephaim.
Jair the son of Manasseh take all the region of Argob, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and call dem, even Bashan, after his own name, Havvoth Jair, to this day.)
I give Gilead to Machir.

To the Reubenites and to the Gadites I give from Gilead even to the valley of the Arnon, the middle of the valley, and its border, even to the river Jabbok, which is the border of the pikin dem of Ammon;
the Arabah also, and the Jordan and its border, from Chinnereth even to the sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, under the slopes of Pisgah eastward.
I commanded you at that time, saying, “Baba God una God has given you this land to possess it. You shall pass over armed before una brothers the pikin dem of Israel, all the men of valor.
But una wives, and una little ones, and una livestock, (I know that you have much livestock), shall live in una cities which I have given you,

until Baba God gives rest to una brothers, as to you, and dem also possess the land which Baba God una God gives dem beyond the Jordan. Then you shall each return to his own possession, which I have given you.”
I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, “Una eyes have seen all that Baba God una God has done to these two kings. So shall Baba God do to all the kingdoms where you go over.
You no go fear dem; for Baba God una God imself fights for you.”
I begged Baba God at that time, saying,
“Lord Baba God, you have begun to show una worker una greatness, and una strong hand. For what god is there in heaven or in earth that can do works like yours, and mighty acts like yours?
Please let me go over and see the good land that is beyond the Jordan, that fine mountain, and Lebanon.”
But Baba God was angry with me for una sakes, and didn’t listen to me. Baba God talk say to me, “Let this satisfy you. Speak no more to me of this matter.
Go up to the top of Pisgah, and lift up una eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and see with una eyes; for you no go go over this Jordan.
But commission Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him; for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause dem to inherit the land which you shall see.”
So we stayed in the valley near Beth Peor.
Now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the ordinances, which I teach you, to do dem; that you may live, and go in and possess the land which Baba God, the God of una fathers, gives you.
You no go add to the word which I command you, neither shall you take away from it, that you may keep the commandments of Baba God una God which I command you.
Una eyes have seen what Baba God did because of Baal Peor; for all the men who follow Baal Peor, Baba God una God has destroyed dem from among you.
But you who were faithful to Baba God una God are all alive today.
See am, I have taught you statutes and ordinances, even as Baba God my God commanded me, that you should do so in the middle of the land where you go in to possess it.

Keep so and do dem; for this is una wisdom and una understanding in the sight of the peoples, who shall hear all these statutes, and say, “Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.”
For what great nation is there, that has a god so near to dem, as Baba God our God is whenever we call on him?
What great nation is there, that has statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law, which I set before you today?

Only be careful, and keep una soul diligently, lest you forget the things which una eyes see, and lest dem depart from una heart all the days of una life; but make dem known to una pikin dem and una pikin dem’s pikin dem;

the day that you stood before Baba God una God in Horeb, when Baba God talk say to me, “Assemble the people to me, and I go make dem hear my words, that dem may learn to fear me all the days that dem live on the earth, and that dem may teach dem pikin dem.”
You come near and stood under the mountain. The mountain burned with fire to the heart of the sky, with darkness, cloud, and thick darkness.
Baba God spoke to you out of the middle of the fire: you heard the voice of words, but you see no form; you only heard a voice.
He declared to you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even the ten commandments. He wrote dem on two stone tablets.
Baba God commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and ordinances, that you might do dem in the land where you go over to possess it.
Be very careful, for you see no kind of form on the day that Baba God spoke to you in Horeb out of the middle of the fire,
lest you corrupt unaself, and make yourself an engraved image in the form of any figure, the likeness of male or female,
the likeness of any animal that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged bird that flies in the sky,
the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the water under the earth;

and lest you lift up una eyes to the sky, and when you see the sun and the moon and the stars, even all the army of the sky, You be drawn away and worship dem, and serve dem, which Baba God una God has allotted to all the peoples under the whole sky.
But Baba God has taken you, and bring you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be to him a people of inheritance, as it is today.

Furthermore Baba God was angry with me for una sakes, and swore that I no suppose go over the Jordan, and that I no suppose go in to that good land, which Baba God una God gives you for an inheritance;
but I must die in this land. I must not go over the Jordan; but you shall go over, and possess that good land.
Be careful, lest you forget the covenant of Baba God una God, which he made with you, and make unaself an engraved image in the form of anything which Baba God una God has forbidden you.
For Baba God una God is a devouring fire, a jealous God.

When you shall father pikin dem, and pikin dem’s pikin dem, and you shall Don dey long in the land, and shall corrupt unaself, and make an engraved image in the form of anything, and shall do that which is evil in Baba God una God’s sight, to provoke him to anger;

I call heaven and earth to witness against you today, that You go soon utterly perish from off the land which you go over the Jordan to possess it. You go not prolong una days on it, but will utterly be destroyed.
Baba God will scatter you among the peoples, and You go be left few in number among the nations, where Baba God will lead you away.
There you shall serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
But from there you shall seek Baba God una God, and you shall find him, when you search after him with all una heart and with all una soul.
When You be in oppression, and all these things have come on you, in the latter days you shall return to Baba God una God, and listen to his voice.
For Baba God una God is a merciful God. He No go fail you, neither destroy you, nor forget the covenant of una fathers which he swore to dem.

For ask now of the days that are past, which were before you, since the day that God created man on the earth, and from the one end of the sky to the other, whether there Don dey anything as this great thing is, or Don dey heard like it?
Did a people ever hear the voice of God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as you have heard, and live?

Or has God tried to go and take a nation for imself from among another nation, by trials, by signs, by wonders, by war, by a mighty hand, by an outstretched arm, and by great terrors, according to all that Baba God una God did for you in Egypt before una eyes?
It was shown to you so that you might know that Baba God is God. E get Nobody else besides him.
Out of heaven he made you to hear his voice, that he might instruct you. On earth he made you to see his great fire; and you heard his words out of the middle of the fire.
Because he love una fathers, so he chose dem offspring after dem, and bring you out with his presence, with his great power, out of Egypt;
to drive out nations from before you greater and mightier than you, to bring you in, to give you dem land for an inheritance, as it is today.
Know so today, and take it to heart, that Baba God imself is God in heaven above and on the earth beneath. E get Nobody else.

You shall keep his statutes, and his commandments, which I command you today, that it may go well with you, and with una pikin dem after you, and that you may prolong una days in the land, which Baba God una God gives you, forever.
Then Moses set apart three cities beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise;
that the man slayer might flee there, who kills his neighbor unawares, and didn’t hate him in time past; and that fleeing to one of these cities he might live:
Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, for the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, for the Manassites.
This is the law which Moses set before the pikin dem of Israel.
These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which Moses spoke to the pikin dem of Israel, when dem come out of Egypt,
beyond the Jordan, in the valley over against Beth Peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon, whom Moses and the pikin dem of Israel struck, when dem come out of Egypt.
Dem take his land in possession, and the land of Og king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise;
from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, even to Mount Sion (also call Hermon),
and all the Arabah beyond the Jordan eastward, even to the sea of the Arabah, under the slopes of Pisgah.
Moses call to all Israel, and talk say to dem, “Hear, Israel, the statutes and the ordinances which I speak in una ears today, that you may learn dem, and observe to do dem.”
Baba God our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.
Baba God didn’t make this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, Wey be all of us here alive today.
Baba God spoke with you face to face on the mountain out of the middle of the fire,
(I stood between Baba God and you at that time, to show you Baba God’s word: for you were afraid because of the fire, and didn’t go up onto the mountain;) saying,
“I be Baba God una God, who bring you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
“You go get no other gods before me.
“You no go make an engraved image for yourself, any likeness of Wetin be in heaven above, or Wetin be in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.

You no go bow yourself down to dem, nor serve dem; for I, Baba God, una God, am a jealous God, visiting the wickedness of the fathers on the pikin dem, and on the third and on the fourth generation of people wey hate me;
and showing loving kindness to thousands of people wey love me and keep my commandments.
“You no go take the name of Baba God una God in vain: for Baba God No go hold him guiltless who takes his name in vain.
“Observe the Sabbath day, to keep it holy, as Baba God una God commanded you.
You shall labor six days, and do all una work;

but the seventh day is a Sabbath to Baba God una God, in which you no go do any work, you, nor una son, nor una daughter, nor una male worker, nor una female worker, nor una ox, nor una donkey, nor any of una livestock, nor una stranger Wey be within una gates; that una male worker and una female worker may rest as well as you.

You shall remember that you were a worker in the land of Egypt, and Baba God una God bring you out of there by a mighty hand and by an outstretched arm. So Baba God una God commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.
“Honor una father and una mother, as Baba God una God commanded you; that una days may be long, and that it may go well with you, in the land which Baba God una God gives you.
“You no go murder.
“You no go commit adultery.
“You no go steal.
“You no go give false testimony against una neighbor.
“You no go covet una neighbor’s wife. Neither shall you desire una neighbor’s house, his field, or his male worker, or his female worker, his ox, or his donkey, or anything that is una neighbor’s.”

Baba God spoke these words to all una assembly on the mountain out of the middle of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice. He added no more. He wrote dem on two stone tablets, and give dem to me.
When you heard the voice out of the middle of the darkness, while the mountain was burning with fire, you come near to me, even all the heads of una tribes, and una elders;

and you talk say, “See am, Baba God our God has shown us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the middle of the fire. We have seen today that God does speak with man, and he lives.
Now so why should we die? For this great fire will consume us. If we hear Baba God our God’s voice any more, then we shall die.
For Wey be there of all flesh, that has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as we have, and lived?
Go near, and hear all that Baba God our God shall say, and tell us all that Baba God our God tells you; and We go hear it, and do it.”

Baba God heard the voice of una words, when you spoke to me; and Baba God talk say to me, “I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which dem have spoken to you. Dem have well talk say all that dem have spoken.
Oh that there were such a heart in dem, that dem would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with dem, and with dem pikin dem forever!
“Go tell dem, ‘Return to una tents.’

But as for you, stand here by me, and I go tell you all the commandment, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which you shall teach dem, that dem may do dem in the land which I give dem to possess it.”
You shall observe to do so as Baba God una God has commanded you. You no go turn aside to the right hand or to the left.
You shall walk in all the way which Baba God una God has commanded you, that you may live, and that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong una days in the land which you shall possess.
Now this is the commandment, the statutes, and the ordinances, which Baba God una God commanded to teach you, that you might do dem in the land where you go over to possess it;

that you might fear Baba God una God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command you; you, and una son, and una son’s son, all the days of una life; and that una days may be prolonged.

Hear so, Israel, and observe to do it; that it may be well with you, and that you may increase mightily, as Baba God, the God of una fathers, has promised to you, in a land flowing with milk and honey.
Hear, Israel: Baba God is our God. Baba God is one.
You shall love Baba God una God with all una heart, with all una soul, and with all una might.
These words, which I command you today, go be on una heart;
and you shall teach dem diligently to una pikin dem, and shall talk of dem when you sit in una house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up.
You shall bind dem for a sign on una hand, and dem go be for frontlets between una eyes.
You shall write dem on the door posts of una house, and on una gates.
It go be, when Baba God una God brings you into the land which he swore to una fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give you, great and goodly cities, which you didn’t build,
and houses full of all good things, which you didn’t fill, and cisterns dug out, which you didn’t dig, vineyards and olive trees, which you didn’t plant, and you shall eat and be full;
then beware lest you forget Baba God, who bring you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
You shall fear Baba God una God; and you shall serve him, and shall swear by his name.
You no go go after other gods, of the gods of the peoples Wey be around you;
for Baba God una God among you is a jealous God; lest the anger of Baba God una God be kindled against you, and he destroy you from off the face of the earth.
You no go tempt Baba God una God, as you tempted him in Massah.
You shall diligently keep the commandments of Baba God una God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he has commanded you.
You shall do that which is right and good in Baba God’s sight; that it may be well with you, and that you may go in and possess the good land which Baba God swore to una fathers,
to thrust out all una enemies from before you, as Baba God has spoken.
When una son asks you in time to come, saying, “What do the testimonies, the statutes, and the ordinances, which Baba God our God has commanded you mean?”
then you shall tell una son, “We were Pharaoh’s slaves in Egypt. Baba God bring us out of Egypt with a mighty hand;
and Baba God showed great and awesome signs and wonders on Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his house, before our eyes;
and he bring us out from there, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he swore to our fathers.
Baba God commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear Baba God our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as We be today.
It go be righteousness to us, if we observe to do all this commandment before Baba God our God, as he has commanded us.”

When Baba God una God brings you into the land where you go to possess it, and casts out many nations before you, the Hittite, the Girgashite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, seven nations greater and mightier than you;
and when Baba God una God delivers dem up before you, and you strike dem; then you shall utterly destroy dem. You shall make no covenant with dem, nor show mercy to dem;
neither shall you make marriages with dem. You no go give una daughter to his son, nor shall you take his daughter for una son.
For he will turn away una son from following me, that dem may serve other gods. So Baba God’s anger would be kindled against you, and he would destroy you sharp-sharp.
But you shall deal with dem like this. You shall break down dem altars, dash dem pillars in pieces, and cut down dem Asherah poles, and burn dem engraved images with fire.
For You be a holy people to Baba God una God. Baba God una God has chosen you to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples Wey be on the face of the earth.
Baba God didn’t set his love on you, nor choose you, because you were more in number than any people; for you were the fewest of all peoples:

but because Baba God loves you, and because he desires to keep the oath which he swore to una fathers, Baba God has bring you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
Know so that Baba God una God imself is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness with dem who love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations,
and repays people wey hate him to dem face, to destroy dem. He No go be slack to him who hates him. He will repay him to his face.
You shall so keep the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances, which I command you today, to do dem.
It shall happen, because you listen to these ordinances, and keep and do dem, that Baba God una God will keep with you the covenant and the loving kindness which he swore to una fathers.

He will love you, bless you, multiply you. He will also bless the fruit of una body and the fruit of una ground, una grain and una new wine and una oil, the increase of una livestock and the young of una flock, in the land which he swore to una fathers to give you.
You go be blessed above all peoples. There no go be male or female barren among you, or among una livestock.
Baba God will take away from you all sickness; and none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which you know, will he put on you, but will lay dem on all people wey hate you.
You shall consume all the peoples whom Baba God una God shall deliver to you. Una eye no go pity dem: neither shall you serve dem gods; for that would be a snare to you.
If you shall say in una heart, “These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess dem?”
you no go be afraid of dem. You shall remember well what Baba God una God did to Pharaoh, and to all Egypt;

the great trials which una eyes see, the signs, the wonders, the mighty hand, and the outstretched arm, by which Baba God una God bring you out. So shall Baba God una God do to all the peoples of whom You be afraid.
Moreover Baba God una God will send the hornet among dem, until people Wey left, and hide themselves, perish from before you.
You no go be scared of dem; for Baba God una God is among you, a great and awesome God.
Baba God una God will throw out those nations before you little by little. You may not consume dem at once, lest the animals of the field increase on you.
But Baba God una God will deliver dem up before you, and will confuse dem with a great confusion, until Dem be destroyed.
He will deliver dem kings into una hand, and you shall make dem name perish from under the sky. Nobody Go be able to stand before you, until you have destroyed dem.

You shall burn the engraved images of dem gods with fire. You no go covet the silver or the gold that is on dem, nor take it for yourself, lest you be snared in it; for it is an abomination to Baba God una God.
You no go bring an abomination into una house, and become a devoted thing like it. You shall utterly detest it, and you shall utterly abhor it; for it is a devoted thing.
You shall observe to do all the commandments which I command you today, that you may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which Baba God swore to una fathers.

You shall remember all the way which Baba God una God has led you these forty years in the wilderness, that he might humble you, to prove you, to know what was in una heart, whether you would keep his commandments, or not.

He humbled you, and allowed you to be hungry, and fed you with manna, which you didn’t know, neither did una fathers know; that he might teach you that man No dey live by bread only, but man lives by every word that proceeds out of Baba God’s mouth.
Una clothing didn’t grow old on you, neither did una foot swell, these forty years.
You shall consider in una heart that as a man disciplines his son, so Baba God una God disciplines you.
You shall keep the commandments of Baba God una God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.
For Baba God una God brings you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of springs, and underground water flowing into valleys and hills;
a land of wheat and barley, and vines and fig trees and pomegranates; a land of olive trees and honey;
a land in which you shall eat bread without scarceness, you no go lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you may dig copper.
You shall eat and be full, and you shall bless Baba God una God for the good land which he has given you.
Beware lest you forget Baba God una God, in not keeping his commandments, and his ordinances, and his statutes, which I command you today;
lest, when you have eaten and are full, and have built fine houses, and lived in dem;
and when una herds and una flocks multiply, and una silver and una gold is multiplied, and all that you have is multiplied;
then una heart might be lifted up, and you forget Baba God una God, who bring you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage;
who led you through the great and terrible wilderness, with venomous snakes and scorpions, and thirsty ground where there was no water; who poured water for you out of the rock of flint;
who fed you in the wilderness with manna, which una fathers didn’t know; that he might humble you, and that he might prove you, to do you good at una latter end:
and lest you say in una heart, “My power and the might of my hand has gotten me this wealth.”
But you shall remember Baba God una God, for it is person wey gives you power to get wealth; that he may establish his covenant which he swore to una fathers, as it is today.
It go be, if you shall forget Baba God una God, and walk after other gods, and serve dem, and worship dem, I testify against you today that you shall surely perish.
As the nations that Baba God makes to perish before you, so you shall perish; because you wouldn’t listen to Baba God una God’s voice.
Hear, Israel! You be to pass over the Jordan today, to go in to dispossess nations greater and mightier than yourself, cities great and fortified up to the sky,
a people great and tall, the sons of the Anakim, whom you know, and of whom you have heard say, “Who can stand before the sons of Anak?”

Know so today, that Baba God una God is person wey goes over before you as a devouring fire. He will destroy dem, and he will bring dem down before you. So you shall drive dem out, and make dem perish sharp-sharp, as Baba God has spoken to you.

No say in una heart, after Baba God una God has thrust dem out from before you, saying, “For my righteousness Baba God has bring me in to possess this land”; because Baba God drives dem out before you because of the wickedness of these nations.

Not for una righteousness, or for the uprightness of una heart, do you go in to possess dem land; but for the wickedness of these nations Baba God una God does drive dem out from before you, and that he may establish the word which Baba God swore to una fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
Know so, that Baba God una God no dey give you this good land to possess for una righteousness; for You be a stiff-necked people.

Remember, and no forget, how you provoked Baba God una God to serious anger in the wilderness. From the day that you left the land of Egypt, until you come to this place, you Don dey rebellious against Baba God.
Also in Horeb you provoked Baba God to serious anger, and Baba God was angry with you to destroy you.

When I had gone up onto the mountain to receive the stone tablets, even the tablets of the covenant which Baba God made with you, then I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water.

Baba God delivered to me the two stone tablets written with God’s finger. On dem were all the words which Baba God spoke with you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly.
E happen say at the end of forty days and forty nights, that Baba God give me the two stone tablets, even the tablets of the covenant.

Baba God talk say to me, “Arise, get down sharp-sharp from here; for una people whom you have bring out of Egypt have corrupted themselves. Dem have sharp-sharp turned aside out of the way which I commanded dem. Dem have made a molten image for themselves!”
Furthermore Baba God spoke to me, saying, “I have seen this people, and see am, it is a stiff-necked people.
Leave me alone, that I may destroy dem, and blot out dem name from under the sky; and I go make of you a nation mightier and greater than dem.”
So I turned and come down from the mountain, and the mountain was burning with fire. The two tablets of the covenant were in my two hands.
I looked, and see am, you had sinned against Baba God una God. You had made unaself a molten calf. You had turned aside sharp-sharp out of the way which Baba God had commanded you.
I take hold of the two tablets, and threw dem out of my two hands, and broke dem before una eyes.

I fell down before Baba God, as at the first, forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water, because of all una sin which you sinned, in doing that which was evil in Baba God’s sight, to provoke him to anger.
For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure with which Baba God was angry against you to destroy you. But Baba God listened to me that time also.
Baba God was angry enough with Aaron to destroy him. I prayed for Aaron also at the same time.

I take una sin, the calf which you had made, and burned it with fire, and crushed it, grinding it very small, until it was as fine as dust. I threw its dust into the brook that descended out of the mountain.
At Taberah, and at Massah, and at Kibroth Hattaavah, you provoked Baba God to serious anger.

When Baba God sent you from Kadesh Barnea, saying, “Go up and possess the land which I have given you,” you rebelled against the commandment of Baba God una God, and you didn’t believe him, nor listen to his voice.
You Don dey rebellious against Baba God from the day that I know you.
So I fell down before Baba God the forty days and forty nights that I fell down, because Baba God had talk say he would destroy you.
I prayed to Baba God, and talk say, “Lord Baba God, no destroy una people and una inheritance, that you have redeemed through una greatness, that you have bring out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
Remember una workers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. No look at the stubbornness of this people, nor at dem wickedness, nor at dem sin,

lest the land you bring us out from say, ‘Because Baba God No be able to bring dem into the land which he promised to dem, and because he hated dem, he has bring dem out to kill dem in the wilderness.’
Yet Dem be una people and una inheritance, which you bring out by una great power and by una outstretched arm.”
At that time Baba God talk say to me, “Cut two stone tablets like the first, and come up to me onto the mountain, and make an ark of wood.
I go write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets which you broke, and you shall put dem in the ark.”
So I made an ark of acacia wood, and cut two stone tablets like the first, and go up onto the mountain, having the two tablets in my hand.

He wrote on the tablets, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which Baba God spoke to you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly: and Baba God give dem to me.
I turned and come down from the mountain, and put the tablets in the ark which I had made; and there Dem be as Baba God commanded me.
(The pikin dem of Israel traveled from Beeroth Bene Jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest’s office in his place.
From there dem traveled to Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of brooks of water.
At that time Baba God set apart the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of Baba God’s covenant, to stand before Baba God to minister to him, and to bless in his name, to this day.
So Levi has no portion nor inheritance with his brothers; Baba God is his inheritance, according as Baba God una God spoke to him.)
I stayed on the mountain, as at the first time, forty days and forty nights: and Baba God listened to me that time also; Baba God would not destroy you.
Baba God talk say to me, “Arise, take una journey before the people; and dem shall go in and possess the land, which I swore to dem fathers to give to dem.”
Now, Israel, what does Baba God una God require of you, but to fear Baba God una God, to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve Baba God una God with all una heart and with all una soul,
to keep Baba God’s commandments and statutes, which I command you today for una good?
See am, to Baba God una God belongs heaven and the heaven of heavens, the earth, with all that is inside am.
Only Baba God had a delight in una fathers to love dem, and he chose dem offspring after dem, even you above all peoples, as it is today.
Circumcise so the foreskin of una heart, and be no more stiff-necked.
For Baba God una God, he is God of gods, and Lord of lords, the great God, the mighty, and the awesome, who no dey respect persons, nor takes reward.
He does execute justice for the fatherless and widow, and loves the foreigner, in giving him chop and clothing.
So love the foreigner; for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt.
You shall fear Baba God una God; you shall serve him; and you shall cling to him, and you shall swear by his name.
He is una praise, and he is una God, who has done for you these great and awesome things, which una eyes have seen.
Una fathers go down into Egypt with seventy persons; and now Baba God una God has made you as the stars of the sky for plenty people.
So you shall love Baba God una God, and keep his instructions, his statutes, his ordinances, and his commandments, always.
Know this day: for I no speak with una pikin dem who have not known, and who have not seen the chastisement of Baba God una God, his greatness, his mighty hand, his outstretched arm,
his signs, and his works, which he did in the middle of Egypt to Pharaoh the king of Egypt, and to all his land;
and what he did to the army of Egypt, to dem horses, and to dem chariots; how he made the water of the Red Sea to overflow dem as dem pursued you, and how Baba God has destroyed dem to this day;
and what he did to you in the wilderness, until you come to this place;

and what he did to Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben; how the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed dem up, and dem households, and dem tents, and every living thing that follow dem, in the middle of all Israel;
but una eyes have seen all of Baba God’s great work which he did.
So you shall keep all the commandment which I command you today, that you may be strong, and go in and possess the land, where you go over to possess it;
and that you may prolong una days in the land, which Baba God swore to una fathers to give to dem and to dem offspring, a land flowing with milk and honey.
For the land, where you go in to possess it, no be as the land of Egypt, that you come out of, where you sowed una seed, and watered it with una foot, as a garden of herbs;
but the land, where you go over to possess it, is a land of hills and valleys which drinks water from the rain of the sky,
a land which Baba God una God cares for. Baba God una God’s eyes are always on it, from the beginning of the year even to the end of the year.
It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to my commandments which I command you today, to love Baba God una God, and to serve him with all una heart and with all una soul,
that I go give the rain of una land in its season, the former rain and the latter rain, that you may gather in una grain, una new wine, and una oil.
I go give grass in una fields for una livestock, and you shall eat and be full.
Be careful, lest una heart be deceived, and you turn aside, and serve other gods, and worship dem;

and Baba God’s anger be kindled against you, and he shut up the sky, so that E get no rain, and the land no dey yield its fruit; and you perish sharp-sharp from off the good land which Baba God gives you.
So you shall lay up these my words in una heart and in una soul. You shall bind dem for a sign on una hand, and dem go be for frontlets between una eyes.
You shall teach dem una pikin dem, talking of dem, when you sit in una house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up.
You shall write dem on the door posts of una house, and on una gates;
that una days may be multiplied, and the days of una pikin dem, in the land which Baba God swore to una fathers to give dem, as the days of the heavens above the earth.
For if you shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you, to do dem, to love Baba God una God, to walk in all his ways, and to cling to him;
then will Baba God drive out all these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess nations greater and mightier than unaself.
Every place whereon the sole of una foot treads go be yours: from the wilderness, and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even to the western sea go be una border.
No man Go be able to stand before you. Baba God una God will lay the fear of you and the dread of you on all the land that you tread on, as he has spoken to you.
See am, I set before you today a blessing and a curse:
the blessing, if you listen to the commandments of Baba God una God, which I command you today;
and the curse, if you No listen to the commandments of Baba God una God, but turn aside out of the way which I command you today, to go after other gods, which you have not known.
It shall happen, when Baba God una God brings you into the land where you go to possess it, that you shall set the blessing on Mount Gerizim, and the curse on Mount Ebal.
No be dem beyond the Jordan, behind the way of the going down of the sun, in the land of the Canaanites who live in the Arabah, near Gilgal, beside the oaks of Moreh?
For You be to pass over the Jordan to go in to possess the land which Baba God una God gives you, and you shall possess it, and live inside am.
You shall observe to do all the statutes and the ordinances which I set before you today.
These are the statutes and the ordinances which you shall observe to do in the land which Baba God, the God of una fathers, has given you to possess it, all the days that you live on the earth.
You shall surely destroy all the places in which the nations that you shall dispossess served dem gods, on the high mountains, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

You shall break down dem altars, and dash dem pillars in pieces, and burn dem Asherah poles with fire. You shall cut down the engraved images of dem gods. You shall destroy dem name out of that place.
You no go do so to Baba God una God.
But to the place which Baba God una God shall choose out of all una tribes, to put his name there, you shall seek his habitation, and there you shall come.
There you shall bring una burnt offerings, una sacrifices, una tithes, the wave offering of una hand, una vows, una freewill offerings, and the firstborn of una herd and of una flock.
There you shall eat before Baba God una God, and you shall glad well-well in all that you put una hand to, you and una households, in which Baba God una God has blessed you.
You no go do after all the things that we do here today, every man Anything wey is right in his own eyes;
for you haven’t yet come to the rest and to the inheritance, which Baba God una God gives you.
But when you go over the Jordan, and live in the land which Baba God una God causes you to inherit, and he gives you rest from all una enemies around you, so that you live in safety;

then it shall happen that to the place which Baba God una God shall choose, to cause his name to live there, there you shall bring all that I command you: una burnt offerings, una sacrifices, una tithes, the wave offering of una hand, and all una choice vows which you vow to Baba God.

You shall glad well-well before Baba God una God, you, and una sons, una daughters, una male workers, una female workers, and the Levite Wey be within una gates, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you.
Be careful that you no offer una burnt offerings in every place that you see;
but in the place which Baba God chooses in one of una tribes, there you shall offer una burnt offerings, and there you shall do all that I command you.

Notwithstanding, you may kill and eat meat within all una gates, after all the desire of una soul, according to Baba God una God’s blessing which he has given you. The unclean and the clean may eat of it, as of the gazelle, and as of the deer.
Only you no go eat the blood. You shall pour it out on the earth like water.

You may not eat within una gates the tithe of una grain, or of una new wine, or of una oil, or the firstborn of una herd or of una flock, nor any of una vows which you vow, nor una freewill offerings, nor the wave offering of una hand;

but you shall eat dem before Baba God una God in the place which Baba God una God shall choose, you, una son, una daughter, una male worker, una female worker, and the Levite Wey be within una gates. You shall glad well-well before Baba God una God in all that you put una hand to.
Be careful that you no forsake the Levite as long as you live in una land.
When Baba God una God enlarges una border, as he has promised you, and you shall say, “I want to eat meat,” because una soul desires to eat meat; you may eat meat, after all the desire of una soul.

If the place which Baba God una God shall choose, to put his name there, is too far from you, then you shall kill of una herd and of una flock, which Baba God has given you, as I have commanded you; and you may eat within una gates, after all the desire of una soul.
Even as the gazelle and as the deer is eaten, so you shall eat of it. The unclean and the clean may eat of it alike.
Only be sure that you no eat the blood; for the blood is the life. You no go eat the life with the meat.
You no go eat it. You shall pour it out on the earth like water.
You no go eat it; that it may go well with you, and with una pikin dem after you, when you shall do that which is right in Baba God’s eyes.
Only una holy things which you have, and una vows, you shall take, and go to the place which Baba God shall choose.
You shall offer una burnt offerings, the meat and the blood, on Baba God una God’s altar; and the blood of una sacrifices go be poured out on Baba God una God’s altar; and you shall eat the meat.
Observe and hear all these words which I command you, that it may go well with you, and with una pikin dem after you forever, when you do that which is good and right in Baba God una God’s eyes.
When Baba God una God cuts off the nations from before you, where you go in to dispossess dem, and you dispossess dem, and live in dem land;

be careful that you No be ensnared to follow dem, after that Dem be destroyed from before you; and that you not inquire after dem gods, saying, “How do these nations serve dem gods? I go do likewise.”
You no go do so to Baba God una God; for every abomination to Baba God, which he hates, have dem done to dem gods; for dem even burn dem sons and dem daughters in the fire to dem gods.
Anything wey thing I command you, that you shall observe to do. You no go add to it, nor take away from it.
If a prophet or a dreamer of dreams arises among you, and he gives you a sign or a wonder,
and the sign or the wonder comes to pass, of which he spoke to you, saying, “Make we go after other gods” (which you have not known) “and Make we serve dem”;
you no go listen to the words of that prophet, or to that dreamer of dreams; for Baba God una God is testing you, to know whether you love Baba God una God with all una heart and with all una soul.
You shall walk after Baba God una God, fear him, keep his commandments, and obey his voice, and you shall serve him, and cling to him.

That prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, go be put to death, because he has spoken rebellion against Baba God una God, who bring you out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, to draw you aside out of the way which Baba God una God commanded you to walk in. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

If una brother, the son of una mother, or una son, or una daughter, or the wife of una bosom, or una friend, Wey be as una own soul, entices you secretly, saying, “Make we go and serve other gods,” which you have not known, you, nor una fathers;
of the gods of the peoples Wey be around you, near to you, or far off from you, from the one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth;
you no go consent to him, nor listen to him; neither shall una eye pity him, neither shall you spare, neither shall you conceal him;
but you shall surely kill him. Una hand go be first on him to put him to death, and afterwards the hands of all the people.
You shall stone him to death with stones, because he has sought to draw you away from Baba God una God, who bring you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
All Israel shall hear, and fear, and no go do any more wickedness like this among you.
If you shall hear about one of una cities, which Baba God una God gives you to live there, that
certain base fellows have gone out from among you, and have drawn away the inhabitants of dem city, saying, “Make we go and serve other gods,” which you have not known;
then you shall inquire, and make search, and ask diligently. See am, if it is true, and the thing certain, that such abomination was done among you,
you shall surely strike the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it utterly, with all that is inside am and its livestock, with the edge of the sword.

You shall gather all its plunder into the middle of its street, and shall burn with fire the city, and all every bit of its plunder, to Baba God una God. It go be a heap forever. It no go be built again.

Nothing of the devoted thing shall cling to una hand, that Baba God may turn from the fierceness of his anger, and show you mercy, and have compassion on you, and multiply you, as he has sworn to una fathers;
when you listen to Baba God una God’s voice, to keep all his commandments which I command you today, to do that which is right in Baba God una God’s eyes.
You be the pikin dem of Baba God una God. You no go cut unaself, nor make any baldness between una eyes for the dead.
For You be a holy people to Baba God una God, and Baba God has chosen you to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples Wey be on the face of the earth.
You no go eat any abominable thing.
These are the animals which you may eat: the ox, the sheep, the goat,
the deer, the gazelle, the roebuck, the wild goat, the ibex, the antelope, and the chamois.
Every animal that parts the hoof, and has the hoof cloven in two and chews the cud, among the animals, that may you eat.

Nevertheless these you no go eat of dem that chew the cud, or of people wey have the hoof cloven: the camel, the hare, and the rabbit. Because dem chew the cud but no part the hoof, Dem be unclean to you.
The pig, because it has a split hoof but no dey chew the cud, is unclean to you. You no go eat dem meat, and you no go touch dem carcasses.
These you may eat of all that are in the waters: Anything wey has fins and scales may you eat.
You no go eat Anything wey no dey have fins and scales. It is unclean to you.
Of all clean birds you may eat.
But these are dem of which you no go eat: the eagle, the vulture, the osprey,
the red kite, the falcon, the kite after its kind,
every raven after its kind,
the ostrich, the owl, the seagull, the hawk after its kind,
the little owl, the great owl, the horned owl,
the pelican, the vulture, the cormorant,
the stork, the heron after its kind, the hoopoe, and the bat.
All winged creeping things are unclean to you. Dem no go be eaten.
Of all clean birds you may eat.

You no go eat of anything that dies of itself. You may give it to the foreigner living among you Wey be within una gates, that he may eat it; or you may sell it to a foreigner; for You be a holy people to Baba God una God. You no go boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.
You shall surely tithe all the increase of una seed, that which comes out of the field year by year.

You shall eat before Baba God una God, in the place which he chooses, to cause his name to live there, the tithe of una grain, of una new wine, and of una oil, and the firstborn of una herd and of una flock; that you may learn to fear Baba God una God always.

If the way is too long for you, so that you No be able to carry it, because the place is too far from you, which Baba God una God shall choose, to set his name there, when Baba God una God shall bless you;
then you shall turn it into money, and bind up the money in una hand, and shall go to the place which Baba God una God shall choose.

You shall trade the money for Anything wey una soul desires, for cattle, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for Anything wey una soul asks of you; and you shall eat there before Baba God una God, and you shall glad well-well, you and una household.
You no go forsake the Levite Wey be within una gates, for he has no portion nor inheritance with you.
At the end of every three years you shall bring all the tithe of una increase in the same year, and shall store it within una gates.

The Levite, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you, and the foreigner living among you, and the fatherless, and the widow, Wey be within una gates, shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied; that Baba God una God may bless you in all the work of una hand which you do.
At the end of every seven years, you shall cancel debts.

This is the way it go be done: every creditor shall release that which he has lent to his neighbor. He no go require payment from his neighbor and his brother; because Baba God’s release Don dey proclaimed.
Of a foreigner you may require it; but Anything wey of yours is with una brother, una hand shall release.
However there go be no poor with you (for Baba God will surely bless you in the land which Baba God una God gives you for an inheritance to possess it)
if only you diligently listen to Baba God una God’s voice, to observe to do all this commandment which I command you today.
For Baba God una God will bless you, as he promised you. You go lend to many nations, but You go not borrow. You go rule over many nations, but Dem go not rule over you.
If a poor man, one of una brothers, is with you within any of una gates in una land which Baba God una God gives you, you no go harden una heart, nor shut una hand from una poor brother;
but you shall surely open una hand to him, and shall surely lend him sufficient for his need, which he lacks.

Beware that there not be a base thought in una heart, saying, “The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand”; and una eye be evil against una poor brother, and you give him nothing; and he cry to Baba God against you, and it be sin to you.
You shall surely give, and una heart no go be grieved when you give to him; because that for this thing Baba God una God will bless you in all una work, and in all that you put una hand to.
For the poor will never cease out of the land. So I command you to surely open una hand to una brother, to una needy, and to una poor, in una land.
If una brother, a Hebrew man, or a Hebrew woman, is sold to you, and serves you six years; then in the seventh year you shall Make e go free from you.
When you Make e go free from you, you no go Make e go empty.
You shall furnish him liberally out of una flock, out of una threshing floor, and out of una wine press. As Baba God una God has blessed you, you shall give to him.
You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and Baba God una God redeemed you. So I command you this thing today.
It go be, if he tells you, “I go not go out from you,” because he loves you and una house, because he is well with you;
then you shall take an awl, and thrust it through his ear to the door, and he go be una worker forever. Also to una female worker you shall do likewise.
It no go seem hard to you, when you Make e go free from you; for he Don dey double value of a hired hand as he served you six years. Baba God una God will bless you in all that you do.
You shall dedicate all the firstborn males that are born of una herd and of una flock to Baba God una God. You shall do no work with the firstborn of una herd, nor shear the firstborn of una flock.
You shall eat it before Baba God una God year by year in the place which Baba God shall choose, you and una household.
If it has any defect, is lame or blind, or has any defect Anything wey, you no go sacrifice it to Baba God una God.
You shall eat it within una gates. The unclean and the clean shall eat it alike, as the gazelle, and as the deer.
Only you no go eat its blood. You shall pour it out on the ground like water.
Observe the month of Abib, and keep the Passover to Baba God una God; for in the month of Abib Baba God una God bring you out of Egypt by night.
You shall sacrifice the Passover to Baba God una God, of the flock and the herd, in the place which Baba God shall choose, to cause his name to live there.

You shall eat no leavened bread with it. You shall eat unleavened bread with it seven days, even the bread of suffering; for you come out of the land of Egypt in haste; that you may remember the day when you come out of the land of Egypt all the days of una life.
No yeast go be seen with you in all una borders seven days; neither shall any of the meat, which you sacrifice the first day at evening, remain all night until the morning.
You may not sacrifice the Passover within any of una gates, which Baba God una God gives you;

but at the place which Baba God una God shall choose, to cause his name to live in, there you shall sacrifice the Passover at evening, at the going down of the sun, at the season that you come out of Egypt.
You shall roast and eat it in the place which Baba God una God chooses. In the morning you shall return to una tents.
Six days you shall eat unleavened bread. On the seventh day go be a solemn assembly to Baba God una God. You shall do no work.
You shall count for unaself seven weeks. From the time you begin to put the sickle to the standing grain you shall begin to count seven weeks.
You shall keep the feast of weeks to Baba God una God with a tribute of a freewill offering of una hand, which you shall give, according as Baba God una God blesses you.

You shall glad well-well before Baba God una God: you, una son, una daughter, una male worker, una female worker, the Levite Wey be within una gates, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, Wey be among you, in the place which Baba God una God shall choose to cause his name to live there.
You shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt. You shall observe and do these statutes.
You shall keep the feast of tents seven days, after you have gathered in from una threshing floor and from una wine press.
You shall glad well-well in una feast, you, una son, una daughter, una male worker, una female worker, the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, Wey be within una gates.

You shall keep a feast to Baba God una God seven days in the place which Baba God chooses; because Baba God una God will bless you in all una increase, and in all the work of una hands, and you go be altogether joyful.

Three times in a year all of una males shall appear before Baba God una God in the place which he chooses: in the feast of unleavened bread, in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tents. Dem no go appear before Baba God empty.
Every man shall give as he is able, according to Baba God una God’s blessing which he has given you.
You shall make judges and officers in all una gates, which Baba God una God gives you, according to una tribes; and dem shall judge the people with righteous judgment.
You no go pervert justice. You no go show partiality. You no go take a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise, and perverts the words of the righteous.
You shall follow that which is altogether just, that you may live, and inherit the land which Baba God una God gives you.
You no go plant for unaself an Asherah of any kind of tree beside Baba God una God’s altar, which you shall make for unaself.
Neither shall you set yourself up a sacred stone which Baba God una God hates.
You no go sacrifice to Baba God una God an ox, or a sheep, in which is a defect, or anything evil; for that is an abomination to Baba God una God.
If E get find among you, within any of una gates which Baba God una God gives you, a man or woman wey do that which is evil in Baba God una God’s sight, in transgressing his covenant,
and has gone and served other gods, and worshiped dem, or the sun, or the moon, or any of the stars of the sky, which I have not commanded;
and You be told, and you have heard of it, then you shall inquire diligently. See am, if it is true, and the thing certain, that such abomination is done in Israel,
then you shall bring out that man or that woman, who has done this evil thing, to una gates, even that same man or woman; and you shall stone dem to death with stones.
At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, person Wey to die go be put to death. At the mouth of one witness he no go be put to death.
The hand of the witnesses go be first on him to put him to death, and afterward the hand of all the people. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

If there arises a matter too hard for you in judgment, between blood and blood, between plea and plea, and between stroke and stroke, being matters of controversy within una gates; then you shall arise, and go up to the place which Baba God una God chooses.
You shall come to the priests Wey be Levites, and to the judge who go be in those days. You shall inquire, and dem shall give you the verdict.
You shall do according to the decisions of the verdict which dem shall give you from that place which Baba God chooses. You shall observe to do according to all that dem shall teach you:

according to the decisions of the law which dem shall teach you, and according to the judgment which dem shall tell you, you shall do. You no go turn aside from the sentence which dem shall show you, to the right hand, nor to the left.
The man wey do presumptuously, in not listening to the priest who stands to minister there before Baba God una God, or to the judge, even that man shall die. You shall put away the evil from Israel.
All the people shall hear, and fear, and do no more presumptuously.
When you have come to the land which Baba God una God gives you, and possess it, and live in it, and say, “I go set a king over me, like all the nations that are around me”;
you shall surely set him king over unaself, whom Baba God una God chooses. You shall set as king over you one from among una brothers. You may not put a foreigner over you, Wey be not una brother.
Only he no go multiply horses to imself, nor cause the people to return to Egypt, to the end that he may multiply horses; because Baba God has talk say to you, “You no go go back that way again.”
He no go multiply wives to imself, that his heart not turn away. He no go greatly multiply to imself silver and gold.
It go be, when he sits on the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write imself a copy of this law in a book, out of that which is before the priests the Levites.
It go be with him, and he shall read from it all the days of his life; that he may learn to fear Baba God his God, to keep all the words of this law and these statutes, to do dem;

that his heart not be lifted up above his brothers, and that he not turn aside from the commandment, to the right hand, or to the left; to the end that he may prolong his days in his kingdom, he and his pikin dem, in the middle of Israel.
The priests the Levites, all the tribe of Levi, go get no portion nor inheritance with Israel. Dem shall eat the offerings of Baba God made by fire and his portion.
Dem go get no inheritance among dem brothers. Baba God is dem inheritance, as he has spoken to dem.
This go be the priests’ due from the people, from people wey offer a sacrifice, whether it be ox or sheep, that dem shall give to the priest the shoulder, the two cheeks, and the inner parts.
The first fruits of una grain, of una new wine, and of una oil, and the first of the fleece of una sheep, you shall give him.
For Baba God una God has chosen him out of all una tribes, to stand to minister in Baba God’s name, him and his sons for ever.
If a Levite comes from any of una gates out of all Israel, where he lives as a foreigner, and comes with all the desire of his soul to the place which Baba God shall choose;
then he shall minister in the name of Baba God his God, as all his brothers the Levites do, who stand there before Baba God.
Dem go get like portions to eat, in addition to that which comes from the sale of his family possessions.
When you have come into the land which Baba God una God gives you, you no go learn to imitate the abominations of those nations.
There no go be find with you Anybody wey makes his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, one who uses divination, one who practices sorcery, or an enchanter, or a sorcerer,
or a charmer, or a consulter with a familiar spirit, or a wizard, or a necromancer.
For Anybody wey does these things is an abomination to Baba God. Because of these abominations, Baba God una God drives dem out from before you.
You go be perfect with Baba God una God.
For these nations that you shall dispossess listen to people wey practice sorcery and to diviners; but as for you, Baba God una God has not allowed you so to do.
Baba God una God will raise up to you a prophet from among you, of una brothers, like me. You shall listen to him.

This is according to all that you desired of Baba God una God in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying, “Let me not hear again Baba God my God’s voice, neither let me see this great fire any more, that I not die.”
Baba God talk say to me, “Dem have well talk say that which dem have spoken.
I go raise dem up a prophet from among dem brothers, like you. I go put my words in his mouth, and he shall speak to dem all that I shall command him.
It shall happen, that Anybody wey No go listen to my words which he shall speak in my name, I go require it of him.
But the prophet who speaks a word presumptuously in my name, which I have not commanded him to speak, or who speaks in the name of other gods, that same prophet shall die.”
You may say in una heart, “How shall we know the word which Baba God has not spoken?”

When a prophet speaks in Baba God’s name, if the thing no dey follow, nor happen, that is the thing which Baba God has not spoken. The prophet has spoken it presumptuously. You no go be afraid of him.
When Baba God una God cuts off the nations, whose land Baba God una God gives you, and you succeed dem, and live in dem cities, and in dem houses;
you shall set apart three cities for unaself in the middle of una land, which Baba God una God gives you to possess it.
You shall prepare the way, and divide the borders of una land, which Baba God una God causes you to inherit, into three parts, that every man slayer may flee there.
This is the case of the man slayer who shall flee there and live. Anybody wey kills his neighbor unawares, and didn’t hate him in time past;

as when a man goes into the forest with his neighbor to chop wood, and his hand fetches a stroke with the ax to cut down the tree, and the head slips from the handle, and lights on his neighbor, so that he dies, he shall flee to one of these cities and live.

Otherwise, the avenger of blood might pursue the man slayer, while his heart is hot, and overtake him, because the way is long, and strike him mortally; even though he No be worthy of death, because he didn’t hate him in time past.
So I command you to set apart three cities for unaself.
If Baba God una God enlarges una border, as he has sworn to una fathers, and gives you all the land which he promised to give to una fathers;
if you keep all this commandment to do it, which I command you today, to love Baba God una God, and to walk ever in his ways; then you shall add three cities more for unaself, besides these three.
This is so that innocent blood No go be shed in the middle of una land which Baba God una God gives you for an inheritance, leaving blood guilt on you.
But if any man hates his neighbor, lies in wait for him, rises up against him, strikes him mortally so that he dies, and he flees into one of these cities;
then the elders of his city shall send and bring him there, and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood, that he may die.
Una eye no go pity him, but you shall purge the innocent blood from Israel, that it may go well with you.
You no go remove una neighbor’s landmark, which dem of old time have set, in una inheritance which you shall inherit, in the land that Baba God una God gives you to possess.
One witness no go rise up against a man for any wickedness, or for any sin, in any sin that he sins. At the mouth of two witnesses, or at the mouth of three witnesses, shall a matter be established.
If an unrighteous witness rises up against any man to testify against him of wrongdoing,
then both the men, between whom the controversy is, shall stand before Baba God, before the priests and the judges who go be in those days;
and the judges shall make diligent inquisition: and, see am, if the witness is a false witness, and has testified falsely against his brother;
then you shall do to him as he had thought to do to his brother. So you shall remove the evil from among you.
People wey remain shall hear, and fear, and will never again commit any such evil among you.
Una eyes no go pity: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.

When you go out to battle against una enemies, and see horses, chariots, and a people more than you, you no go be afraid of dem; for Baba God una God is with you, who bring you up out of the land of Egypt.
It go be, when you draw near to the battle, that the priest shall approach and speak to the people,
and shall tell dem, “Hear, Israel, you draw near today to battle against una enemies. No let una heart faint! No fear, nor tremble, neither be scared of dem;
for Baba God una God is person wey goes with you, to fight for you against una enemies, to save you.”

The officers shall speak to the people, saying, “What man is there who has built a new house, and has not dedicated it? Make e go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man dedicate it.
What man is there who has planted a vineyard, and has not used its fruit? Make e go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man use its fruit.
What man is there who has pledged to be married a wife, and has not taken her? Make e go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man take her.”
The officers shall speak further to the people, and dem shall say, “What man is there Wey be fearful and faint-hearted? Make e go and return to his house, lest his brother’s heart melt as his heart.”
It go be, when the officers have finished speaking to the people, that dem shall appoint captains of armies at the head of the people.
When you draw near to a city to fight against it, then proclaim peace to it.
It go be, if it makes you answer of peace, and opens to you, then it go be, that all the people Wey be find inside am shall become forced laborers to you, and shall serve you.
If it will make no peace with you, but will make war against you, then you shall besiege it.
When Baba God una God delivers it into una hand, you shall strike every male of it with the edge of the sword;

but the women, the little ones, the livestock, and all that is in the city, even all its plunder, you shall take for plunder for yourself. You may use the plunder of una enemies, which Baba God una God has given you.
Thus you shall do to all the cities which are very far off from you, which No be of the cities of these nations.
But of the cities of these peoples, that Baba God una God gives you for an inheritance, you shall save alive nothing that breathes;
but you shall utterly destroy dem: the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; as Baba God una God has commanded you;
that dem not teach you to follow all dem abominations, which dem have done to dem gods; so would you sin against Baba God una God.

When you shall besiege a city a long time, in making war against it to take it, you no go destroy its trees by wielding an ax against dem; for you may eat of dem. You no go cut dem down; for is the tree of the field man, that it should be besieged by you?
Only the trees that you know No be trees for chop, you shall destroy and cut dem down. You shall build bulwarks against the city that makes war with you, until it falls.
If someone is find slain in the land which Baba God una God gives you to possess, lying in the field, and it no be known who has struck him;
then una elders and una judges shall come out, and dem shall measure to the cities which are around him Wey be slain.
It go be that the elders of the city which is nearest to the slain man shall take a heifer of the herd, which hasn’t been worked with, and which has not drawn in the yoke.
The elders of that city shall bring the heifer down to a valley with running water, which is neither plowed nor sown, and shall break the heifer’s neck there in the valley.

The priests the sons of Levi shall come near; for dem Baba God una God has chosen to minister to him, and to bless in Baba God’s name; and according to dem word shall every controversy and every assault be decided.
All the elders of that city, Wey be nearest to the slain man, shall wash dem hands over the heifer whose neck was broken in the valley.
Dem shall answer and say, “Our hands have not shed this blood, neither have our eyes seen it.
Forgive, Baba God, una people Israel, whom you have redeemed, and no allow innocent blood among una people Israel.” The blood go be forgiven dem.
So you shall put away the innocent blood from among you, when you shall do that which is right in Baba God’s eyes.
When you go out to battle against una enemies, and Baba God una God delivers dem into una hands, and you carry dem away captive,
and see among the captives a beautiful woman, and you have a desire to her, and desire to take her as una wife;
then you shall bring her home to una house. She shall shave her head and trim her nails.

She shall take the clothing of her captivity off of sheself, and shall remain in una house, and bewail her father and her mother a full month. After that you shall go in to her and be her husband, and she go be una wife.
It go be, if you have no delight in her, then you shall Make she go where she desires; but you no go sell her at all for money. You no go deal with her as a slave, because you have humbled her.
If a man has two wives, the one beloved, and the other hated, and dem have borne him pikin dem, both the beloved and the hated; and if the firstborn son is hers who was hated;

then it go be, in the day that he causes his sons to inherit that which he has, that he may not give the son of the beloved the rights of the firstborn before the son of the hated, Wey be the firstborn;
but he shall acknowledge the firstborn, the son of the hated, by giving him a double portion of all that he has; for he is the beginning of his strength. The right of the firstborn is his.
If a man has a stubborn and rebellious son, who No go obey the voice of his father or the voice of his mother, and though dem chasten him, No go listen to dem;
then his father and his mother shall take hold of him and bring him out to the elders of his city, and to the gate of his place.
Dem shall tell the elders of his city, “This our son is stubborn and rebellious. He No go obey our voice. He is a glutton and a drunkard.”
All the men of his city shall stone him to death with stones. So you shall remove the evil from among you. All Israel shall hear, and fear.
If a man has committed a sin worthy of death, and he is put to death, and you hang him on a tree;

his body no go remain all night on the tree, but you shall surely bury him the same day; for person Wey hanged is accursed of God; that you no defile una land which Baba God una God gives you for an inheritance.
You no go see una brother’s ox or his sheep go astray, and hide yourself from dem. You shall surely bring dem again to una brother.
If una brother no be near to you, or if you no know him, then you shall bring it home to una house, and it go be with you until una brother comes looking for it, and you shall restore it to him.
So you shall do with his donkey. So you shall do with his garment. So you shall do with every lost thing of una brother’s, which he has lost, and you have find. You may not hide yourself.
You no go see una brother’s donkey or his ox fallen down by the way, and hide yourself from dem. You shall surely help him to lift dem up again.
A woman no go wear men’s clothing, neither shall a man put on women’s clothing; for Anybody wey does these things is an abomination to Baba God una God.
If you come across a bird’s nest on the way, in any tree or on the ground, with young ones or eggs, and the hen sitting on the young, or on the eggs, you no go take the hen with the young.
You shall surely let the hen go, but the young you may take for yourself; that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong una days.
When you build a new house, then you shall make a railing around una roof, so that you no bring blood on una house if anyone falls from there.
You no go sow una vineyard with two kinds of seed, lest all the fruit be defiled, the seed which you have sown, and the increase of the vineyard.
You no go plow with an ox and a donkey together.
You no go wear clothes of wool and linen woven together.
You shall make unaself fringes on the four corners of una cloak with which you cover yourself.
If any man takes a wife, and goes in to her, hates her,
accuses her of shameful things, and gives her a bad name, and says, “I take this woman, and when I come near to her, I didn’t find in her the tokens of virginity”;
then the young lady’s father and mother shall take and bring the tokens of the young lady’s virginity to the elders of the city in the gate.
The young lady’s father shall tell the elders, “I give my daughter to this man as his wife, and he hates her.

See am, he has accused her of shameful things, saying, ‘I didn’t find in una daughter the tokens of virginity;’ and yet these are the tokens of my daughter’s virginity.” Dem shall spread the cloth before the elders of the city.
The elders of that city shall take the man and chastise him.

Dem shall fine him one hundred shekels of silver, and give dem to the father of the young lady, because he has given a bad name to a virgin of Israel. She go be his wife. He may not put her away all his days.
But if this thing is true, that the tokens of virginity No be find in the young lady;

then dem shall bring out the young lady to the door of her father’s house, and the men of her city shall stone her to death with stones, because she has done folly in Israel, to play the prostitute in her father’s house. So you shall remove the evil from among you.
If a man is find lying with a woman married to a husband, then dem shall both die, the man who lay with the woman and the woman. So you shall remove the evil from Israel.
If E get a young lady Wey be a virgin pledged to be married to a husband, and a man finds her in the city, and lies with her;

then you shall bring dem both out to the gate of that city, and you shall stone dem to death with stones; the lady, because she didn’t cry, being in the city; and the man, because he has humbled his neighbor’s wife. So you shall remove the evil from among you.
But if the man finds the lady Wey be pledged to be married in the field, and the man forces her, and lies with her; then only the man who lay with her shall die;
but to the lady you shall do nothing. E get in the lady no sin worthy of death; for as when a man rises against his neighbor, and kills him, even so is this matter;
for he find her in the field, the pledged to be married lady cried, and there was Nobody to save her.
If a man finds a lady Wey be a virgin, Wey be not pledged to be married, grabs her, and lies with her, and Dem be find;
