In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri reigned seven days in Tirzah. Now the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.
The people who were encamped heard that Zimri had conspired, and had also killed the king. So all Israel made Omri, the captain of the army, king over Israel that day in the camp.
Omri go up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and dem besieged Tirzah.
When Zimri see that the city was taken, he go into the fortified part of the king’s house, and burned the king’s house over him with fire, and died,
for his sins which he sinned in doing that which was evil in Baba God’s sight, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did, to make Israel to sin.
Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he committed, no be dem written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
Then the people of Israel were divided into two parts: half of the people follow Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king; and half follow Omri.
But the people who follow Omri prevailed against the people who follow Tibni the son of Ginath; so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.
In the thirty-first year of Asa king of Judah, Omri began to reign over Israel for twelve years. He reigned six years in Tirzah.
He bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver; and he built on the hill, and call the name of the city which he built Samaria, after the name of Shemer, the owner of the hill.
Omri did that which was evil in Baba God’s sight, and dealt wickedly above all who were before him.
For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sins with which he made Israel to sin, to provoke Baba God, the God of Israel, to anger with dem vanities.
Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he showed, no be dem written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria; and Ahab his son reigned in his place.
In the thirty-eighth year of Asa king of Judah, Ahab the son of Omri began to reign over Israel. Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty-two years.
Ahab the son of Omri did that which was evil in Baba God’s sight above all that were before him.

As if it Bin dey a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, he take as wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians, and go and served Baal, and worshiped him.
He raised up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.
Ahab made the Asherah; and Ahab did more yet to provoke Baba God, the God of Israel, to anger than all the kings of Israel who were before him.

In his days Hiel the Bethelite built Jericho. He laid its foundation with the loss of Abiram his firstborn, and set up its gates with the loss of his youngest son Segub, according to Baba God’s word, which he spoke by Joshua the son of Nun.

Elijah the Tishbite, who was one of the settlers of Gilead, talk say to Ahab, “As Baba God, the God of Israel, lives, before whom I stand, there no go be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.”
Then Baba God’s word come to him, saying,
“Go away from here, turn eastward, and hide yourself by the brook Cherith, that is before the Jordan.
You shall drink from the brook. I have commanded the ravens to feed you there.”
So he go and did according to Baba God’s word; for he go and lived by the brook Cherith that is before the Jordan.
The ravens bring him bread and meat in the morning, and bread and meat in the evening; and he drank from the brook.
After a while, the brook dried up, because there was no rain in the land.
Baba God’s word come to him, saying,
“Arise, go to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon, and stay there. See am, I have commanded a widow there to sustain you.”

So he arose and go to Zarephath; and when he come to the gate of the city, see am, a widow was there gathering sticks. He call to her, and talk say, “Please get me a little water in a jar, that I may drink.”
As she was going to get it, he call to her, and talk say, “Please bring me a morsel of bread in una hand.”

She talk say, “As Baba God una God lives, I no have a cake, but a handful of meal in a jar, and a little oil in a jar. See am, I be gathering two sticks, that I may go in and bake it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.”
Elijah talk say to her, “No fear. Go and do as you have talk say; but make me a little cake from it first, and bring it out to me, and afterward make some for you and for una son.
For Baba God, the God of Israel says, ‘The jar of meal No go run out, and the jar of oil No go fail, until the day that Baba God sends rain on the earth.’”
She go and did according to the saying of Elijah; and she, and he, and her house, ate many days.
The jar of meal didn’t run out, and the jar of oil No fail, according to Baba God’s word, which he spoke by Elijah.
After these things, the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, became sick; and his sickness was so severe that there was no breath left in him.
She talk say to Elijah, “What have I to do with you, you man of God? You have come to me to bring my sin to memory, and to kill my son!”
E tell am say, “Give me una son.” He take him out of her bosom, and carried him up into the room where he stayed, and laid him on his own bed.
He cried to Baba God, and talk say, “Baba God my God, have you also bring evil on the widow with whom I be staying, by killing her son?”
He stretched imself on the pikin three times, and cried to Baba God, and talk say, “Baba God my God, please let this pikin’s soul come into him again.”
Baba God listened to the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the pikin come into him again, and he revived.
Elijah take the pikin, and bring him down out of the room into the house, and delivered him to his mother; and Elijah talk say, “See am, una son lives.”
The woman talk say to Elijah, “Now I know that You be a man of God, and that Baba God’s word in una mouth is truth.”
After many days, Baba God’s word come to Elijah, in the third year, saying, “Go, show yourself to Ahab; and I go send rain on the earth.”
Elijah go to show imself to Ahab. The famine was severe in Samaria.
Ahab call Obadiah, who was over the household. (Now Obadiah feared Baba God greatly;
for when Jezebel cut off Baba God’s prophets, Obadiah take one hundred prophets, and hid dem by fifty in a cave, and fed dem with bread and water.)
Ahab talk say to Obadiah, “Go through the land, to all the springs of water, and to all the brooks. Perhaps we may find grass and save the horses and mules alive, that we not lose all the animals.”
So dem divided the land between dem to pass throughout it. Ahab go one way by imself, and Obadiah go another way by imself.
As Obadiah was on the way, see am, Elijah met him. He recognized him, and fell on his face, and talk say, “Is it you, my lord Elijah?”
He answer him, “It is I. Go, tell una lord, ‘See am, Elijah is here!’”
He talk say, “How have I sinned, that you would deliver una worker into the hand of Ahab, to kill me?
As Baba God una God lives, E get no nation or kingdom where my lord has not sent to seek you. When dem talk say, ‘He No be here,’ he take an oath of the kingdom and nation, that dem didn’t find you.
Now you say, ‘Go, tell una lord, “See am, Elijah is here.”’

It will happen, as soon as I leave you, that Baba God’s Spirit will carry you I no know where; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he no fit find you, he will kill me. But I, una worker, have feared Baba God from my youth.
No be it told my lord what I did when Jezebel killed Baba God’s prophets, how I hid one hundred men of Baba God’s prophets with fifty to a cave, and fed dem with bread and water?
Now you say, ‘Go, tell una lord, “See am, Elijah is here”.’ He will kill me.”
Elijah talk say, “As Baba God of Armies lives, before whom I stand, I go surely show myself to him today.”
So Obadiah go to meet Ahab, and told him; and Ahab go to meet Elijah.
When Ahab see Elijah, Ahab talk say to him, “Is that you, you troubler of Israel?”
He answer, “I have not troubled Israel; but you, and una father’s house, in that you have forsaken Baba God’s commandments, and you have follow the Baals.
Now so send, and gather to me all Israel to Mount Carmel, and four hundred fifty of the prophets of Baal, and four hundred of the prophets of the Asherah, who eat at Jezebel’s table.”
So Ahab sent to all the pikin dem of Israel, and gathered the prophets together to Mount Carmel.
Elijah come near to all the people, and talk say, “How long will you waver between the two sides? If Baba God is God, follow him; but if Baal, then follow him.” The people didn’t say a word.
Then Elijah talk say to the people, “I, even I only, am left as a prophet of Baba God; but Baal’s prophets are four hundred fifty men.

Make dem so give us two bulls; and Make dem choose one bull for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay it on the wood, and put no fire under; and I go dress the other bull, and lay it on the wood, and put no fire under it.
You call on the name of una god, and I go call on Baba God’s name. The God who answers by fire, Make e be God.” All the people answer, “Wetin you say is good.”
Elijah talk say to the prophets of Baal, “Choose one bull for unaself, and dress it first; for You be many; and call on the name of una god, but put no fire under it.”

Dem take the bull which was given dem, and dem dressed it, and call on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, “Baal, hear us!” But there was no voice, and nobody answer. Dem leaped about the altar which was made.
At noon, Elijah mocked dem, and talk say, “Cry aloud; for he is a god. Either he is deep in thought, or he has gone somewhere, or he is on a journey, or perhaps he sleeps and must be awakened.”
Dem cried aloud, and cut themselves in dem way with knives and lances, until the blood gushed out on dem.
When midday was past, dem prophesied until the time of the evening offering; but there was no voice, no answer, and nobody paid attention.
Elijah talk say to all the people, “Come near to me!”; and all the people come near to him. He repaired Baba God’s altar that Bin dey thrown down.
Elijah take twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, to whom Baba God’s word come, saying, “Israel go be una name.”
With the stones he built an altar in Baba God’s name. He made a trench around the altar, large enough to contain two seahs of seed.
He put the wood in order, and cut the bull in pieces, and laid it on the wood. He talk say, “Fill four jars with water, and pour it on the burnt offering, and on the wood.”
He talk say, “Do it a second time”; and dem did it the second time. He talk say, “Do it a third time”; and dem did it the third time.
The water ran around the altar; and he also filled the trench with water.

At the time of the evening offering, Elijah the prophet come near, and talk say, “Baba God, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known today that You be God in Israel, and that I be una worker, and that I have done all these things at una word.
Hear me, Baba God, hear me, that this people may know that you, Baba God, are God, and that you have turned dem heart back again.”
Then Baba God’s fire fell, and consumed the burnt offering, the wood, the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.
When all the people see it, dem fell on dem faces. Dem talk say, “Baba God, he is God! Baba God, he is God!”
Elijah talk say to dem, “Seize the prophets of Baal! No let one of dem escape!” Dem seized dem; and Elijah bring dem down to the brook Kishon, and killed dem there.
Elijah talk say to Ahab, “Get up, eat and drink; for E get the sound of abundance of rain.”
So Ahab go up to eat and to drink. Elijah go up to the top of Carmel; and he bowed imself down on the earth, and put his face between his knees.
He talk say to his worker, “Go up now, and look toward the sea.” He go up, and looked, and talk say, “E get nothing.” He talk say, “Go again” seven times.
On the seventh time, he talk say, “See am, a small cloud, like a man’s hand, is rising out of the sea.” He talk say, “Go up, tell Ahab, ‘Get ready and go down, so that the rain no dey stop you.’”
In a little while, the sky grew black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. Ahab rode, and go to Jezreel.
Baba God’s hand was on Elijah; and he tucked his cloak into his belt and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.
Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and how he had killed all the prophets with the sword.
Then Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah, saying, “So let the gods do to me, and more also, if I no make una life as the life of one of dem by tomorrow about this time!”
When he see that, he arose, and ran for his life, and come to Beersheba, which belongs to Judah, and left his worker there.

But he imself go a day’s journey into the wilderness, and come and sat down under a juniper tree. Then he requested for imself that he might die, and talk say, “It is enough. Now, O Baba God, take away my life; for I be not better than my fathers.”
He lay down and slept under a juniper tree; and see am, an angel touched him, and talk say to him, “Arise and eat!”
He looked, and see am, there was at his head a cake baked on the coals, and a jar of water. He ate and drank, and lay down again.
Baba God’s angel come again the second time, and touched him, and talk say, “Arise and eat, because the journey is too great for you.”
He arose, and ate and drank, and go in the strength of that chop forty days and forty nights to Horeb, God’s Mountain.
He come to a cave there, and camped there; and see am, Baba God’s word come to him, and E tell am say, “Wetin be you doing here, Elijah?”

He talk say, “I Don dey very jealous for Baba God, the God of Armies; for the pikin dem of Israel have forsaken una covenant, thrown down una altars, and killed una prophets with the sword. I, even I only, am left; and dem seek my life, to take it away.”

He talk say, “Go out, and stand on the mountain before Baba God.” See am, Baba God passed by, and a great and strong wind tore the mountains, and broke in pieces the rocks before Baba God; but Baba God No be in the wind. After the wind there was an earthquake; but Baba God No be in the earthquake.
After the earthquake a fire passed; but Baba God No be in the fire. After the fire, there was a still small voice.
When Elijah heard it, he wrapped his face in his mantle, go out, and stood in the entrance of the cave. See am, a voice come to him, and talk say, “Wetin be you doing here, Elijah?”

He talk say, “I Don dey very jealous for Baba God, the God of Armies; for the pikin dem of Israel have forsaken una covenant, thrown down una altars, and killed una prophets with the sword. I, even I only, am left; and dem seek my life, to take it away.”
Baba God talk say to him, “Go, return on una way to the wilderness of Damascus. When you arrive, anoint Hazael to be king over Syria.
Anoint Jehu the son of Nimshi to be king over Israel; and anoint Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel Meholah to be prophet in una place.
Person wey escapes from the sword of Hazael, Jehu will kill; and person wey escapes from the sword of Jehu, Elisha will kill.
Yet I reserved seven thousand in Israel, all the knees of which have not bowed to Baal, and every mouth which has not kissed him.”
So he comot from there, and find Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth. Elijah go over to him, and put his mantle on him.
Elisha left the oxen, and ran after Elijah, and talk say, “Let me please kiss my father and my mother, and then I go follow you.” E tell am say, “Go back again; for what have I done to you?”

He come back from following him, and take the yoke of oxen, and killed dem, and boiled dem meat with the instruments of the oxen, and give to the people, and dem ate. Then he arose, and go after Elijah, and served him.
Ben Hadad the king of Syria gathered all his army together; and there were thirty-two kings with him, with horses and chariots. He go up and besieged Samaria, and fought against it.
He sent messengers to Ahab king of Israel, into the city, and talk say to him, “Thus says Ben Hadad,
‘Una silver and una gold is mine. Una wives also and una pikin dem, even the best, are mine.’”
The king of Israel answer, “It is according to una saying, my lord, O king. I be yours, and all that I have.”
The messengers come again, and talk say, “Ben Hadad says, ‘I sent indeed to you, saying, “You shall deliver me una silver, and una gold, and una wives, and una pikin dem;

but I go send my workers to you tomorrow about this time, and Dem go search una house, and the houses of una workers; Anything wey is pleasant in una eyes, Dem go put it in dem hand, and take it away.”’”

Then the king of Israel call all the elders of the land, and talk say, “Please notice how this man seeks mischief; for he sent to me for my wives, and for my pikin dem, and for my silver, and for my gold; and I didn’t deny him.”
All the elders and all the people talk say to him, “No listen, and no consent.”

So he talk say to the messengers of Ben Hadad, “Tell my lord the king, ‘All that you sent for to una worker at the first I go do; but this thing I cannot do.’” The messengers comot, and bring him back the message.
Ben Hadad sent to him, and talk say, “The gods do so to me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria Go be enough for handfuls for all the people who follow me.”
The king of Israel answer, “Tell him, ‘No Make e who puts on his armor brag like person wey takes it off.’”
When Ben Hadad heard this message, as he was drinking, he and the kings, in the pavilions, he talk say to his workers, “Prepare to attack!” Dem prepared to attack the city.

See am, a prophet come near to Ahab king of Israel, and talk say, “Baba God says, ‘Have you seen all this great plenty people? See am, I go deliver it into una hand today; and You go know that I be Baba God.’”
Ahab talk say, “By whom?” He talk say, “Baba God says, ‘By the young men of the princes of the provinces.’” Then he talk say, “Who shall begin the battle?” He answer, “You.”
Then he mustered the young men of the princes of the provinces, and dem were two hundred and thirty-two. After dem, he mustered all the people, even all the pikin dem of Israel, being seven thousand.
Dem go out at noon. But Ben Hadad was drinking imself drunk in the pavilions, he and the kings, the thirty-two kings who helped him.
The young men of the princes of the provinces go out first; and Ben Hadad sent out, and dem told him, saying, “Men are coming out from Samaria.”
He talk say, “If dem have come out for peace, take dem alive; or if dem have come out for war, take dem alive.”
So these go out of the city, the young men of the princes of the provinces, and the army which follow dem.
Dem each killed his man. The Syrians fled, and Israel pursued dem. Ben Hadad the king of Syria escaped on a horse with horsemen.
The king of Israel go out, and struck the horses and chariots, and killed the Syrians with a great slaughter.
The prophet come near to the king of Israel, and talk say to him, “Go, strengthen yourself, and mark, and see Wetin you do; for at the return of the year the king of Syria will come up against you.”
The workers of the king of Syria talk say to him, “Dem god is a god of the hills; so dem were stronger than we. But Make we fight against dem in the plain, and surely We go be stronger than dem.
Do this thing: take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in dem place.

Muster an army, like the army that you have lost, horse for horse, and chariot for chariot. We go fight against dem in the plain, and surely We go be stronger than dem.” He listened to dem voice, and did so.
At the return of the year, Ben Hadad mustered the Syrians, and go up to Aphek, to fight against Israel.
The pikin dem of Israel were mustered and given provisions, and go against dem. The pikin dem of Israel encamped before dem like two little flocks of young goats; but the Syrians filled the country.

A man of God come near and spoke to the king of Israel, and talk say, “Baba God says, ‘Because the Syrians have talk say, “Baba God is a god of the hills, but he No be a god of the valleys”; so I go deliver all this great plenty people into una hand, and you shall know that I be Baba God.’”
Dem encamped opposite each other for seven days. So it was, that in the seventh day the battle was joined; and the pikin dem of Israel killed one hundred thousand footmen of the Syrians in one day.
But the rest fled to Aphek, into the city; and the wall fell on twenty-seven thousand men who were left. Ben Hadad fled, and come into the city, into an inner room.

His workers talk say to him, “See now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings. Please Make we put sackcloth on our bodies, and ropes on our heads, and go out to the king of Israel. Maybe he will save una life.”

So dem put sackcloth on dem bodies and ropes on dem heads, and come to the king of Israel, and talk say, “Una worker Ben Hadad says, ‘Please let me live.’” He talk say, “Is he still alive? He is my brother.”

Now the men observed diligently, and hurried to take this phrase; and dem talk say, “Una brother Ben Hadad.” Then he talk say, “Go, bring him.” Then Ben Hadad come out to him; and he caused him to come up into the chariot.

Ben Hadad talk say to him, “The cities which my father take from una father I go restore. You shall make streets for yourself in Damascus, as my father made in Samaria.” “I”, talk say Ahab, “will let you go with this covenant.” So he made a covenant with him, and Make e go.
A certain man of the sons of the prophets talk say to his fellow by Baba God’s word, “Please strike me!” The man refused to strike him.
Then E tell am say, “Because you have not obeyed Baba God’s voice, see am, as soon as you have comot from me, a lion will kill you.” As soon as he had comot from him, a lion find him and killed him.
Then he find another man, and talk say, “Please strike me.” The man struck him and wounded him.
So the prophet comot, and waited for the king by the way, and disguised imself with his headband over his eyes.

As the king passed by, he cried to the king; and he talk say, “Una worker go out into the middle of the battle; and see am, a man turned aside, and bring a man to me, and talk say, ‘Guard this man! If by any means he is missing, then una life go be for his life, or else you shall pay a talent of silver.’
As una worker was busy here and there, he was gone.” The king of Israel talk say to him, “So shall una judgment be. You yourself have decided it.”
He hurried, and take the headband away from his eyes; and the king of Israel recognized that he was one of the prophets.

E tell am say, “Baba God says, ‘Because you have let go out of una hand the man whom I had devoted to destruction, so una life will take the place of his life, and una people take the place of his people.’”
The king of Israel go to his house sullen and angry, and come to Samaria.
After these things, Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard, which was in Jezreel, next to the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.

Ahab spoke to Naboth, saying, “Give me una vineyard, that I may have it for a garden of herbs, because it is near my house; and I go give you for it a better vineyard than it. Or, if it seems good to you, I go give you its worth in money.”
Naboth talk say to Ahab, “May Baba God forbid me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers to you!”

Ahab come into his house sullen and angry because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him; for he had talk say, “I go not give you the inheritance of my fathers.” He laid imself down on his bed, and turned away his face, and would eat no bread.
But Jezebel his wife come to him, and talk say to him, “Why is una spirit so sad, that you eat no bread?”

E tell am say, “Because I spoke to Naboth the Jezreelite, and talk say to him, ‘Give me una vineyard for money; or else, if it pleases you, I go give you another vineyard for it.’ He answer, ‘I go not give you my vineyard.’”
Jezebel his wife talk say to him, “Do you now govern the kingdom of Israel? Arise, and eat bread, and let una heart be merry. I go give you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.”
So she wrote letters in Ahab’s name, and sealed dem with his seal, and sent the letters to the elders and to the nobles who were in his city, who lived with Naboth.
She wrote in the letters, saying, “Proclaim a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.
Set two men, base fellows, before him, and Make dem testify against him, saying, ‘You cursed God and the king!’ Then carry him out, and stone him to death.”
The men of his city, even the elders and the nobles who lived in his city, did as Jezebel had instructed dem in the letters which she had written and sent to dem.
Dem proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.

The two men, the base fellows, come in and sat before him. The base fellows testified against him, even against Naboth, in the presence of the people, saying, “Naboth cursed God and the king!” Then dem carried him out of the city and stoned him to death with stones.
Then dem sent to Jezebel, saying, “Naboth Don dey stoned, and is dead.”

When Jezebel heard that Naboth Bin dey stoned, and was dead, Jezebel talk say to Ahab, “Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give you for money; for Naboth No be alive, but dead.”
When Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to take possession of it.
Baba God’s word come to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
“Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, who dwells in Samaria. See am, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, where he has gone down to take possession of it.

You shall speak to him, saying, ‘Baba God says, “Have you killed and also taken possession?”’ You shall speak to him, saying, ‘Baba God says, “In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth, dogs will lick una blood, even yours.”’”
Ahab talk say to Elijah, “Have you find me, my enemy?” He answer, “I have find you, because you have sold yourself to do that which is evil in Baba God’s sight.
See am, I go bring evil on you, and will utterly sweep you away and will cut off from Ahab Everybody wey urinates against a wall, and him Wey be shut up and him Wey be left at large in Israel.

I go make una house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah for the provocation with which you have provoked me to anger, and have made Israel to sin.”
Baba God also spoke of Jezebel, saying, “The dogs will eat Jezebel by the rampart of Jezreel.
The dogs will eat person wey dies of Ahab in the city; and the birds of the sky will eat person wey dies in the field.”
But there was Nobody like Ahab, who sold imself to do that which was evil in Baba God’s sight, whom Jezebel his wife stirred up.
He did very abominably in following idols, according to all that the Amorites did, whom Baba God throw out before the pikin dem of Israel.
When Ahab heard those words, he tore his clothes, and put sackcloth on his flesh, and fasted, and lay in sackcloth, and go softly.
Baba God’s word come to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
“See how Ahab humbles imself before me? Because he humbles imself before me, I go not bring the evil in his days; but I go bring the evil on his house in his son’s day.”
Dem continued three years without war between Syria and Israel.
In the third year, Jehoshaphat the king of Judah come down to the king of Israel.
The king of Israel talk say to his workers, “You know that Ramoth Gilead is ours, and we do nothing, and no take it out of the hand of the king of Syria?”
He talk say to Jehoshaphat, “Will you go with me to battle to Ramoth Gilead?” Jehoshaphat talk say to the king of Israel, “I be as You be, my people as una people, my horses as una horses.”
Jehoshaphat talk say to the king of Israel, “Please inquire first for Baba God’s word.”

Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and talk say to dem, “Should I go against Ramoth Gilead to battle, or should I refrain?” Dem talk say, “Go up; for the Lord will deliver it into the hand of the king.”
But Jehoshaphat talk say, “No be there here a prophet of Baba God, that we may inquire of him?”

The king of Israel talk say to Jehoshaphat, “E get yet one man by whom we may inquire of Baba God, Micaiah the son of Imlah; but I hate him, for he No dey prophesy good concerning me, but evil.” Jehoshaphat talk say, “No let the king say so.”
Then the king of Israel call an officer, and talk say, “Sharp-sharp get Micaiah the son of Imlah.”

Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah were sitting each on his throne, arrayed in dem robes, in an open place at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets were prophesying before dem.
Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made imself horns of iron, and talk say, “Baba God says, ‘With these You go push the Syrians, until Dem be consumed.’”
All the prophets prophesied so, saying, “Go up to Ramoth Gilead, and prosper; for Baba God will deliver it into the hand of the king.”
The messenger who go to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, “See now, the prophets declare good to the king with one mouth. Please let una word be like the word of one of dem, and speak good.”
Micaiah talk say, “As Baba God lives, what Baba God says to me, that I go speak.”

When he had come to the king, the king talk say to him, “Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall we forbear?” He answer him, “Go up and prosper; and Baba God will deliver it into the hand of the king.”
The king talk say to him, “How many times do I have to adjure you that you speak to me nothing but the truth in Baba God’s name?”
He talk say, “I see all Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd. Baba God talk say, ‘These have no master. Make dem each return to his house in peace.’”
The king of Israel talk say to Jehoshaphat, “Didn’t I tell una that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?”
Micaiah talk say, “So hear Baba God’s word. I see Baba God sitting on his throne, and all the army of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.
Baba God talk say, ‘Who will entice Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth Gilead?’ One talk say one thing; and another talk say another.
A spirit come out and stood before Baba God, and talk say, ‘I go entice him.’
Baba God talk say to him, ‘How?’ He talk say, ‘I go go out and Go be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.’ He talk say, ‘You go entice him, and will also prevail. Go out and do so.’
Now so, see am, Baba God has put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these una prophets; and Baba God has spoken evil concerning you.”
Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah come near, and struck Micaiah on the cheek, and talk say, “Which way did Baba God’s Spirit go from me to speak to you?”
Micaiah talk say, “See am, You go see on that day, when you go into an inner room to hide yourself.”
The king of Israel talk say, “Take Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king’s son.
Say, ‘Thus says the king, “Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of suffering and with water of suffering, until I come in peace.”’”
Micaiah talk say, “If you return at all in peace, Baba God has not spoken by me.” He talk say, “Listen, all you people!”
So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah go up to Ramoth Gilead.
The king of Israel talk say to Jehoshaphat, “I go disguise myself, and go into the battle; but you put on una robes.” The king of Israel disguised imself, and go into the battle.
Now the king of Syria had commanded the thirty-two captains of his chariots, saying, “No fight with small nor great, except only with the king of Israel.”
When the captains of the chariots see Jehoshaphat, dem talk say, “Surely that is the king of Israel!” and dem turned aside to fight against him. Jehoshaphat cried out.
When the captains of the chariots see that it No be the king of Israel, dem turned back from pursuing him.

A certain man drew his bow at random, and struck the king of Israel between the joints of the armor. So he talk say to the driver of his chariot, “Turn una hand, and carry me out of the battle; for I be severely wounded.”
The battle increased that day. The king was propped up in his chariot facing the Syrians, and died at evening. The blood ran out of the wound into the bottom of the chariot.
A cry go throughout the army about the going down of the sun, saying, “Every man to his city, and every man to his country!”
So the king died, and was bring to Samaria; and dem buried the king in Samaria.
Dem washed the chariot by the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood where the prostitutes washed themselves; according to Baba God’s word which he spoke.
Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he built, and all the cities that he built, no be dem written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place.
Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.
Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

He walked in all the way of Asa his father. He didn’t turn aside from it, doing that which was right in Baba God’s eyes. However the high places No be taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places.
Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.
Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he showed, and how he fought, no be dem written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
The remnant of the sodomites, that remain in the days of his father Asa, he put away out of the land.
There was no king in Edom. A deputy ruled.
Jehoshaphat made ships of Tarshish to go to Ophir for gold, but dem didn’t go; for the ships wrecked at Ezion Geber.
Then Ahaziah the son of Ahab talk say to Jehoshaphat, “Let my workers go with una workers in the ships.” But Jehoshaphat would not.
Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city. Jehoram his son reigned in his place.
Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria in the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned two years over Israel.
He did that which was evil in Baba God’s sight, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, in which he made Israel to sin.
He served Baal and worshiped him, and provoked Baba God, the God of Israel, to anger, in all the ways that his father had done so.
Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab.

Ahaziah fell down through the lattice in his upper room that was in Samaria, and was sick. So he sent messengers, and talk say to dem, “Go, inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron, whether I go recover of this sickness.”

But Baba God’s angel talk say to Elijah the Tishbite, “Arise, go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria, and tell dem, ‘Is it because E get no God in Israel, that you go to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron?
Now so Baba God says, “You go not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but You go surely die.”’” Then Elijah comot.
The messengers come back to him, and E tell dem say, “Why is it that you have come back?”

Dem tell am say, “A man come up to meet us, and talk say to us, ‘Go, return to the king who sent you, and tell him, “Baba God says, ‘Is it because E get no God in Israel, that you send to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron? So You go not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but You go surely die.’”’”
E tell dem say, “What kind of man was person wey come up to meet you, and told you these words?”
Dem answer him, “He was a hairy man, and wearing a leather belt around his waist.” He talk say, “It’s Elijah the Tishbite.”
Then the king sent a captain of fifty with his fifty to him. He go up to him; and see am, he was sitting on the top of the hill. E tell am say, “Man of God, the king has talk say, ‘Come down!’”
Elijah answer to the captain of fifty, “If I be a man of God, then let fire come down from the sky, and consume you and una fifty!” Then fire come down from the sky, and consumed him and his fifty.
Again he sent to him another captain of fifty with his fifty. He answer him, “Man of God, the king has talk say, ‘Come down sharp-sharp!’”
Elijah answer dem, “If I be a man of God, then let fire come down from the sky, and consume you and una fifty!” Then God’s fire come down from the sky, and consumed him and his fifty.

Again he sent the captain of a third fifty with his fifty. The third captain of fifty go up, and come and fell on his knees before Elijah, and begged him, and talk say to him, “Man of God, please let my life, and the life of these fifty of una workers, be precious in una sight.
See am, fire come down from the sky, and consumed the last two captains of fifty with dem fifties. But now let my life be precious in una sight.”
Baba God’s angel talk say to Elijah, “Go down with him. No fear of him.” Then he arose, and go down with him to the king.

E tell am say, “Baba God says, ‘Because you have sent messengers to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron, is it because E get no God in Israel to inquire of his word? So You go not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but You go surely die.’”
So he died according to Baba God’s word which Elijah had spoken. Jehoram began to reign in his place in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, because he had no son.
Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did, no be dem written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
When Baba God was about to take Elijah up by a whirlwind into heaven, Elijah go with Elisha from Gilgal.
Elijah talk say to Elisha, “Please wait here, for Baba God has sent me as far as Bethel.” Elisha talk say, “As Baba God lives, and as una soul lives, I go not leave you.” So dem go down to Bethel.

The sons of the prophets who were at Bethel come out to Elisha, and talk say to him, “Do you know that Baba God will take away una master from una head today?” He talk say, “Yes, I know it. Hold una peace.”
Elijah talk say to him, “Elisha, please wait here, for Baba God has sent me to Jericho.” He talk say, “As Baba God lives, and as una soul lives, I go not leave you.” So dem come to Jericho.

The sons of the prophets who were at Jericho come near to Elisha, and talk say to him, “Do you know that Baba God will take away una master from una head today?” He answer, “Yes, I know it. Hold una peace.”
Elijah talk say to him, “Please wait here, for Baba God has sent me to the Jordan.” He talk say, “As Baba God lives, and as una soul lives, I go not leave you.” Then dem both go on.
Fifty men of the sons of the prophets go, and stood opposite dem at a distance; and dem both stood by the Jordan.
Elijah take his mantle, and rolled it up, and struck the waters, and dem were divided here and there, so that dem both go over on dry ground.
When dem had gone over, Elijah talk say to Elisha, “Ask what I shall do for you, before I be taken from you.” Elisha talk say, “Please let a double portion of una spirit be on me.”
He talk say, “You have ask a hard thing. If you see me when I be taken from you, it Go be so for you; but if not, it No go be so.”
As dem continued on and talked, see am, a chariot of fire and horses of fire separated dem, and Elijah go up by a whirlwind into heaven.
Elisha see it, and he cried, “My father, my father, the chariots of Israel and its horsemen!” He see him no more. Then he take hold of his own clothes, and tore dem in two pieces.
He also take up Elijah’s mantle that fell from him, and go back, and stood by the bank of the Jordan.

He take Elijah’s mantle that fell from him, and struck the waters, and talk say, “Where is Baba God, the God of Elijah?” When he also had struck the waters, dem were divided apart, and Elisha go over.
When the sons of the prophets who were at Jericho over against him see him, dem talk say, “The spirit of Elijah rests on Elisha.” Dem come to meet him, and bowed themselves to the ground before him.

Dem tell am say, “See now, E get with una workers fifty strong men. Please Make dem go and seek una master. Perhaps Baba God’s Spirit has taken him up, and put him on some mountain, or into some valley. He talk say, “No send dem.”
When dem urged him until he was ashamed, he talk say, “Send dem.” So dem sent fifty men; and dem searched for three days, but didn’t find him.
Dem come back to him, while he stayed at Jericho; and E tell dem say, “Didn’t I tell una, ‘No go?’”
The men of the city talk say to Elisha, “See am, please, the situation of this city is pleasant, as my lord sees; but the water is bad, and the land is barren.”
He talk say, “Bring me a new jar, and put salt in it.” Then dem bring it to him.
He go out to the spring of the waters, and threw salt into it, and talk say, “Baba God says, ‘I have healed these waters. There no go be from there any more death or barren wasteland.’”
So the waters were healed to this day, according to Elisha’s word which he spoke.
He go up from there to Bethel. As he was going up by the way, some youths come out of the city and mocked him, and talk say to him, “Go up, you baldy! Go up, you baldy!”
He looked behind him and see dem, and cursed dem in Baba God’s name. Then two female bears come out of the woods, and mauled forty-two of those youths.
He go from there to Mount Carmel, and from there he come back to Samaria.
Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria in the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned twelve years.
He did that which was evil in Baba God’s sight, but not like his father, and like his mother, for he put away the pillar of Baal that his father had made.
Nevertheless he held to the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin. He didn’t depart from dem.
Now Mesha king of Moab was a sheep breeder; and he supplied the king of Israel with the wool of one hundred thousand lambs, and of one hundred thousand rams.
But when Ahab was dead, the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.
King Jehoram go out of Samaria at that time, and mustered all Israel.

He go and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, saying, “The king of Moab has rebelled against me. Will you go with me against Moab to battle?” He talk say, “I go go up. I be as You be, my people as una people, my horses as una horses.”
He talk say, “Which way shall we go up?” He answer, “The way of the wilderness of Edom.”
So the king of Israel go with the king of Judah and the king of Edom, and dem marched for seven days along a circuitous route. There was no water for the army or for the animals that follow dem.
The king of Israel talk say, “Alas! For Baba God has call these three kings together to deliver dem into the hand of Moab.”

But Jehoshaphat talk say, “No be there a prophet of Baba God here, that we may inquire of Baba God by him?” One of the king of Israel’s workers answer, “Elisha the son of Shaphat, who poured water on the hands of Elijah, is here.”
Jehoshaphat talk say, “Baba God’s word is with him.” So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom go down to him.

Elisha talk say to the king of Israel, “What have I to do with you? Go to the prophets of una father, and to the prophets of una mother.” The king of Israel talk say to him, “No, for Baba God has call these three kings together to deliver dem into the hand of Moab.”
Elisha talk say, “As Baba God of Armies lives, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I respect the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look toward you, nor see you.
But now bring me a musician.” When the musician played, Baba God’s hand come on him.
He talk say, “Baba God says, ‘Make this valley full of trenches.’
For Baba God says, ‘You go not see wind, neither will you see rain, yet that valley Go be filled with water, and You go drink, both you and una livestock and una other animals.
This is an easy thing in Baba God’s sight. He will also deliver the Moabites into una hand.
You shall strike every fortified city, and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all springs of water, and mar every good piece of land with stones.’”
In the morning, about the time of offering the sacrifice, see am, water come by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.
Now when all the Moabites heard that the kings had come up to fight against dem, dem gathered themselves together, all who were able to put on armor, young and old, and stood on the border.
Dem rose up early in the morning, and the sun shone on the water, and the Moabites see the water opposite dem as red as blood.
Dem talk say, “This is blood. The kings are surely destroyed, and dem have struck each other. Now so, Moab, to the plunder!”
When dem come to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and struck the Moabites, so that dem fled before dem; and dem go forward into the land attacking the Moabites.

Dem beat down the cities; and on every good piece of land each man throw his stone, and filled it. Dem also stopped all the springs of water, and felled all the good trees, until in Kir Hareseth all dem left was its stones; however the men armed with slings go around it, and attacked it.
When the king of Moab see that the battle was too severe for him, he take with him seven hundred men who drew a sword, to break through to the king of Edom; but dem could not.

Then he take his oldest son who would have reigned in his place, and offered him for a burnt offering on the wall. There was great serious anger against Israel; and dem comot from him, and come back to dem own land.

Now a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets cried out to Elisha, saying, “Una worker my husband is dead. You know that una worker feared Baba God. Now the creditor has come to take for imself my two pikin dem to be slaves.”
Elisha talk say to her, “What should I do for you? Tell me: what do you have in the house?” She talk say, “Una worker has nothing in the house, except a pot of oil.”
Then he talk say, “Go, borrow empty containers from of all una neighbors. No borrow just a few containers.
Go in and shut the door on you and on una sons, and pour oil into all those containers; and set aside those which are full.”
So she go from him, and shut the door on sheself and on her sons. Dem bring the containers to her, and she poured oil.
When the containers were full, she talk say to her son, “Bring me another container.” E tell am say, “There no be another container.” Then the oil stopped flowing.
Then she come and told the man of God. He talk say, “Go, sell the oil, and pay una debt; and you and una sons live on the rest.”
One day Elisha go to Shunem, where there was a prominent woman; and she persuaded him to eat bread. So it was, that as often as he passed by, he turned in there to eat bread.
She talk say to her husband, “See now, I perceive that this is a holy man of God who passes by us continually.
Please Make we make a little room on the roof. Make we set for him there a bed, a table, a chair, and a lamp stand. When he comes to us, he can stay there.”
One day he come there, and he go to the room and lay there.
He talk say to Gehazi his worker, “Call this Shunammite.” When he had call her, she stood before him.

E tell am say, “Say now to her, ‘See am, you have cared for us with all this care. Wetin be to be done for you? Would you like to be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the army?’” She answer, “I live among my own people.”
He talk say, “What then is to be done for her?” Gehazi answer, “Most certainly she has no son, and her husband is old.”
He talk say, “Call her.” When he had call her, she stood in the door.
He talk say, “At this season, when the time comes around, You go embrace a son.” She talk say, “No, my lord, you man of God, No lie to una worker.”
The woman conceived, and bore a son at that season, when the time come around, as Elisha had talk say to her.
When the pikin was grown, one day he go out to his father to the reapers.
He talk say to his father, “My head! My head!” He talk say to his worker, “Carry him to his mother.”
When he had taken him, and bring him to his mother, he sat on her knees until noon, and then died.
She go up and laid him on the man of God’s bed, and shut the door on him, and go out.
She call to her husband, and talk say, “Please send me one of the workers, and one of the donkeys, that I may run to the man of God, and come again.”
He talk say, “Why would you want go to him today? It No be a new moon or a Sabbath.” She talk say, “It’s alright.”
Then she saddled a donkey, and talk say to her worker, “Drive, and go forward! No slow down for me, unless I ask you to.”
So she go, and come to the man of God to Mount Carmel. When the man of God see her far away off, he talk say to Gehazi his worker, “See am, E get the Shunammite.
Please run now to meet her, and ask her, ‘Is it well with you? Is it well with una husband? Is it well with una pikin?’” She answer, “It is well.”

When she come to the man of God to the hill, she caught hold of his feet. Gehazi come near to thrust her away; but the man of God talk say, “Leave her alone; for her soul is troubled within her; and Baba God has hidden it from me, and has not told me.”
Then she talk say, “Did I ask you for a son, my lord? Didn’t I say, ‘No deceive me’?”

Then he talk say to Gehazi, “Tuck una cloak into una belt, take my staff in una hand, and go una way. If you meet any man, no greet him; and if anyone greets you, no answer him again. Then lay my staff on the pikin’s face.”
The pikin’s mother talk say, “As Baba God lives, and as una soul lives, I go not leave you.” So he arose, and follow her.
Gehazi go ahead of dem, and laid the staff on the pikin’s face; but there was no voice and no hearing. So he come back to meet him, and told him, “The pikin has not awakened.”
When Elisha had come into the house, see am, the pikin was dead, and lying on his bed.
He go in so, and shut the door on dem both, and prayed to Baba God.
He go up, and lay on the pikin, and put his mouth on his mouth, and his eyes on his eyes, and his hands on his hands. He stretched imself on him; and the pikin’s flesh grew warm.
Then he come back, and walked in the house once back and forth; and go up, and stretched imself out on him. Then the pikin sneezed seven times, and the pikin opened his eyes.
He call Gehazi, and talk say, “Call this Shunammite!” So he call her. When she had come in to him, he talk say, “Take up una son.”
Then she go in, fell at his feet, and bowed sheself to the ground; then she picked up her son, and go out.

Elisha come again to Gilgal. There was a famine in the land; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him; and he talk say to his worker, “Get the large pot, and boil stew for the sons of the prophets.”
One go out into the field to gather herbs, and find a wild vine, and gathered a lap full of wild gourds from it, and come and cut dem up into the pot of stew; for dem didn’t recognize dem.
So dem poured out for the men to eat. As dem were eating some of the stew, dem cried out, and talk say, “Man of God, E get death in the pot!” And dem could not eat it.
But he talk say, “Then bring meal.” He threw it into the pot; and he talk say, “Serve it to the people, that dem may eat.” And there was nothing harmful in the pot.

A man from Baal Shalishah come, and bring the man of God bread some of the first fruits: twenty loaves of barley, and fresh ears of grain in his sack. He talk say, “Give to the people, that dem may eat.”
His worker talk say, “What, should I set this before a hundred men?” But he talk say, “Give the people, that dem may eat; for Baba God says, ‘Dem go eat, and Go get some left over.’”
So he set it before dem, and dem ate, and had some left over, according to Baba God’s word.

Now Naaman, captain of the army of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honorable, because by him Baba God had given victory to Syria: he was also a mighty man of valor, but he was a leper.
The Syrians had gone out in bands, and had bring away captive out of the land of Israel a little maiden; and she waited on Naaman’s wife.
She talk say to her mistress, “I wish that my lord were with the prophet Wey be in Samaria! Then he would heal him of his leprosy.”
Someone go in, and told his lord, saying, “The maiden Wey be from the land of Israel talk say this.”
The king of Syria talk say, “Go now, and I go send a letter to the king of Israel.” He comot, and take with him ten talents of silver, and six thousand pieces of gold, and ten changes of clothing.
He bring the letter to the king of Israel, saying, “Now when this letter has come to you, see am, I have sent Naaman my worker to you, that you may heal him of his leprosy.”

When the king of Israel had read the letter, he tore his clothes, and talk say, “Am I God, to kill and to make alive, that this man sends to me to heal a man of his leprosy? But please consider and see how he seeks a quarrel against me.”

It was so, when Elisha the man of God heard that the king of Israel had torn his clothes, that he sent to the king, saying, “Why have you torn una clothes? Make e come now to me, and he shall know that E get a prophet in Israel.”
So Naaman come with his horses and with his chariots, and stood at the door of the house of Elisha.
Elisha sent a messenger to him, saying, “Go and wash in the Jordan seven times, and una flesh shall come again to you, and you go be clean.”

But Naaman was angry, and go away, and talk say, “See am, I thought, ‘He will surely come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of Baba God his God, and wave his hand over the place, and heal the leper.’
No be Abanah and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? No fit I wash in dem, and be clean?” So he turned and go away in a rage.

His workers come near, and spoke to him, and talk say, “My father, if the prophet had ask you do some great thing, wouldn’t you have done it? How much rather then, when he says to you, ‘Wash, and be clean?’”
Then go he down, and dipped imself seven times in the Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God; and his flesh was restored like the flesh of a little pikin, and he was clean.

He come back to the man of God, he and all his company, and come, and stood before him; and he talk say, “See now, I know that E get no God in all the earth, but in Israel. Now so, please take a gift from una worker.”
But he talk say, “As Baba God lives, before whom I stand, I go receive none.” He urged him to take it; but he refused.

Naaman talk say, “If not, then, please let two mules’ burden of earth be given to una worker; for una worker will from now on offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice to other gods, but to Baba God.

In this thing may Baba God pardon una worker: when my master goes into the house of Rimmon to worship there, and he leans on my hand, and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon. When I bow myself in the house of Rimmon, may Baba God pardon una worker in this thing.”
E tell am say, “Go in peace.” So he comot from him a little way.

But Gehazi the worker of Elisha the man of God, talk say, “See am, my master has spared this Naaman the Syrian, in not receiving at his hands that which he bring. As Baba God lives, I go run after him, and take something from him.”
So Gehazi follow after Naaman. When Naaman see one running after him, he come down from the chariot to meet him, and talk say, “Is all well?”

He talk say, “All is well. My master has sent me, saying, ‘See am, even now two young men of the sons of the prophets have come to me from the hill country of Ephraim. Please give dem a talent of silver and two changes of clothing.’”

Naaman talk say, “Be pleased to take two talents.” He urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of clothing, and laid dem on two of his workers; and dem carried dem before him.
When he come to the hill, he take dem from dem hand, and stored dem in the house. Then he let the men go, and dem comot.
But he go in, and stood before his master. Elisha talk say to him, “Where did you come from, Gehazi?” He talk say, “Una worker go nowhere.”

E tell am say, “Didn’t my heart go with you, when the man turned from his chariot to meet you? Is it a time to receive money, and to receive garments, and olive groves and vineyards, and sheep and cattle, and male workers and female workers?
So the leprosy of Naaman will cling to you and to una offspring forever.” He go out from his presence a leper, as white as snow.
The sons of the prophets talk say to Elisha, “See now, the place where we live and meet with you is too small for us.
Please Make we go to the Jordan, and each man take a beam from there, and Make we make us a place there, where we may live.” He answer, “Go!”
One talk say, “Please be pleased to go with una workers.” He answer, “I go go.”
So he go with dem. When dem come to the Jordan, dem cut down wood.
But as one was cutting down a tree, the ax head fell into the water. Then he cried, and talk say, “Alas, my master! For it was borrowed.”
The man of God ask, “Where did it fall?” He showed him the place. He cut down a stick, threw it in there, and made the iron float.
He talk say, “Take it.” So he put out his hand and take it.
Now the king of Syria was at war against Israel; and he take counsel with his workers, saying, “My camp Go be in such and such a place.”
The man of God sent to the king of Israel, saying, “Beware that you not pass this place; for the Syrians are coming down there.”
The king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of; and he saved imself there, not once or twice.
The king of Syria’s heart was very troubled about this. He call his workers, and talk say to dem, “No go you show me which of us is for the king of Israel?”
One of his workers talk say, “No, my lord, O king; but Elisha, the prophet Wey be in Israel, tells the king of Israel the words that you speak in una bedroom.”
He talk say, “Go and see where he is, that I may send and get him.” He was told, “See am, he is in Dothan.”
So he sent horses, chariots, and a great army there. Dem come by night, and surrounded the city.
When the worker of the man of God had risen early, and gone out, see am, an army with horses and chariots was around the city. His worker talk say to him, “Alas, my master! What shall we do?”
He answer, “No fear; for people Wey with us are more than people Wey with dem.”

Elisha prayed, and talk say, “Baba God, please open his eyes, that he may see.” Baba God opened the young man’s eyes; and he see: and see am, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire around Elisha.
When dem come down to him, Elisha prayed to Baba God, and talk say, “Please strike this people with blindness.” He struck dem with blindness according to Elishah’s word.
Elisha talk say to dem, “This No be the way, neither is this the city. Follow me, and I go bring you to the man whom you seek.” He led dem to Samaria.
When dem had come into Samaria, Elisha talk say, “Baba God, open these men’s eyes, that dem may see.” Baba God opened dem eyes, and dem see; and see am, dem were in the middle of Samaria.
The king of Israel talk say to Elisha, when he see dem, “My father, shall I strike dem? Shall I strike dem?”

He answer, “You no go strike dem. Would you strike those whom you have taken captive with una sword and with una bow? Set bread and water before dem, that dem may eat and drink, and go to dem master.”
He prepared great feast for dem. When dem had eaten and drunk, he sent dem away, and dem go to dem master. So the bands of Syria stopped raiding the land of Israel.
After this, Benhadad king of Syria gathered all his army, and go up and besieged Samaria.
There was a great famine in Samaria. See am, dem besieged it, until a donkey’s head was sold for eighty pieces of silver, and the fourth part of a kab of dove’s dung for five pieces of silver.
As the king of Israel was passing by on the wall, a woman cried to him, saying, “Help, my lord, O king!”
He talk say, “If Baba God no dey help you, where could I get help for you? From of the threshing floor, or from the wine press?”
The king talk say to her, “Wetin be una problem?” She answer, “This woman talk say to me, ‘Give una son, that we may eat him today, and We go eat my son tomorrow.’
So we boiled my son, and ate him: and I talk say to her on the next day, ‘Give una son, that we may eat him;’ and she has hidden her son.”
When the king heard the words of the woman, he tore his clothes. Now he was passing by on the wall, and the people looked, and see am, he had sackcloth underneath on his body.
Then he talk say, “God do so to me, and more also, if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat stays on him today.”

But Elisha was sitting in his house, and the elders were sitting with him. Then the king sent a man from before him; but before the messenger come to him, he talk say to the elders, “Do you see how this son of a murderer has sent to take away my head? See am, when the messenger comes, shut the door, and hold the door shut against him. No be the sound of his master’s feet behind him?”
While he was still talking with dem, see am, the messenger come down to him. Then he talk say, “See am, this evil is from Baba God. Why should I wait for Baba God any longer?”
Elisha talk say, “Hear Baba God’s word. Baba God says, ‘Tomorrow about this time a seah of fine flour Go be sold for a shekel, and two seahs of barley for a shekel, in the gate of Samaria.’”

Then the captain on whose hand the king leaned answer the man of God, and talk say, “See am, if Baba God made windows in heaven, could this thing be?” He talk say, “See am, You go see it with una eyes, but No go eat of it.”
Now there were four leprous men at the entrance of the gate. Dem talk say to each other, “Why do we sit here until we die?

If we say, ‘We go enter into the city,’ then the famine is in the city, and We go die there. If we sit still here, we also die. Now so come, and Make we surrender to the army of the Syrians. If dem save us alive, We go live; and if dem kill us, We go only die.”
Dem rose up in the twilight, to go to the camp of the Syrians. When dem had come to the outermost part of the camp of the Syrians, see am, no man was there.

For the Lord had made the army of the Syrians to hear the sound of chariots, and the sound of horses, even the noise of a great army; and dem talk say to each other, “See am, the king of Israel has hired against us the kings of the Hittites and the kings of the Egyptians to attack us.”
So dem arose and fled in the twilight, and left dem tents, and dem horses, and dem donkeys, even the camp as it was, and fled for dem life.

When these lepers come to the outermost part of the camp, dem go into one tent, and ate and drink, and carried away silver, gold, and clothing, and go and hid it. Then dem come back, and entered into another tent, and carried things from there also, and go and hid dem.

Then dem talk say to each other, “We no be doing right. Today is a day of better news, and we keep silent. If we wait until the morning light, punishment will overtake us. Now so come, let’s go and tell the king’s household.”

So dem come and call to the city gatekeepers; and dem told dem, “We come to the camp of the Syrians, and, see am, there was no man there, not even a man’s voice, but the horses tied, and the donkeys tied, and the tents as dem were.”
He call the gatekeepers; and dem told it to the king’s household within.

The king arose in the night, and talk say to his workers, “I go now show you what the Syrians have done to us. Dem know that We be hungry. So are dem gone out of the camp to hide themselves in the field, saying, ‘When dem come out of the city, we shall take dem alive, and get into the city.’”

One of his workers answer, “Please let some people take five of the horses that remain, which are left in the city. See am, Dem be like all the plenty people of Israel Wey be left in it. See am, Dem be like all the plenty people of Israel Wey be consumed. Make we send and see.”
So dem take two chariots with horses; and the king dem sent out to the Syrian army, saying, “Go and see.”
Dem go after dem to the Jordan; and see am, all the path was full of garments and equipment which the Syrians had throw away in dem haste. The messengers come back, and told the king.
The people go out and plundered the camp of the Syrians. So a seah of fine flour was sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, according to Baba God’s word.

The king appointed the captain on whose hand he leaned to be in charge of the gate; and the people trampled over him in the gate, and he died as the man of God had talk say, who spoke when the king come down to him.
It happened as the man of God had spoken to the king, saying, “Two seahs of barley for a shekel, and a seah of fine flour for a shekel, go be tomorrow about this time in the gate of Samaria”;

and that captain answer the man of God, and talk say, “Now, see am, if Baba God made windows in heaven, might such a thing be?” and he talk say, “See am, You go see it with una eyes, but No go eat of it.”
It happened like that to him; for the people trampled over him in the gate, and he died.

Now Elisha had spoken to the woman whose son he had restored to life, saying, “Arise, and go, you and una household, and stay for a while Anywhere wey you can; for Baba God has call for a famine. It will also come on the land for seven years.”
The woman arose, and did according to the man of God’s word. She go with her household, and lived in the land of the Philistines for seven years.
At the end of seven years, the woman come back from the land of the Philistines. Then she go out to beg the king for her house and for her land.
Now the king was talking with Gehazi the worker of the man of God, saying, “Please tell me all the great things that Elisha has done.”

As he was telling the king how he had restored to life him who was dead, see am, the woman, whose son he had restored to life, begged the king for her house and for her land. Gehazi talk say, “My lord, O king, this is the woman, and this is her son, whom Elisha restored to life.”

When the king ask the woman, she told him. So the king appointed to her a certain officer, saying, “Restore all that was hers, and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land, even until now.”
Elisha come to Damascus; and Benhadad the king of Syria was sick. He was told, “The man of God has come here.”
The king talk say to Hazael, “Take a present in una hand, and go, meet the man of God, and inquire of Baba God by him, saying, ‘Will I recover from this sickness?’”

So Hazael go to meet him, and take a present with him, even of every good thing of Damascus, forty camels’ burden, and come and stood before him, and talk say, “Una son Benhadad king of Syria has sent me to you, saying, ‘Will I recover from this sickness?’”
Elisha talk say to him, “Go, tell him, ‘You go surely recover;’ however Baba God has shown me that he will surely die.”
He settled his gaze steadfastly on him, until he was ashamed. Then the man of God wept.

Hazael talk say, “Why do you weep, my lord?” He answer, “Because I know the evil that You go do to the pikin dem of Israel. You go set dem strongholds on fire, and You go kill dem young men with the sword, and will dash dem little ones in pieces, and rip up dem pregnant women.”
Hazael talk say, “But Wetin be una worker, Wey be but a dog, that he could do this great thing?” Elisha answer, “Baba God has shown me that You go be king over Syria.”
Then he comot from Elisha, and come to his master, who talk say to him, “What did Elisha say to you?” He answer, “He told me that you would surely recover.”
On the next day, he take a thick cloth, dipped it in water, and spread it on his face, so that he died. Then Hazael reigned in his place.
In the fifth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Jehoshaphat being king of Judah then, Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah began to reign.
He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign. He reigned eight years in Jerusalem.
He walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did Ahab’s house; for he married Ahab’s daughter. He did that which was evil in Baba God’s sight.
However Baba God would not destroy Judah, for David his worker’s sake, as he promised him to give to him a lamp for his pikin dem always.
In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.
Then Joram passed over to Zair, and all his chariots with him: and he rose up by night, and struck the Edomites who surrounded him, and the captains of the chariots; and the people fled to dem tents.
So Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah to this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time.
The rest of the acts of Joram, and all that he did, no be dem written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
Joram slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place.
In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah began to reign.
Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Athaliah the daughter of Omri king of Israel.
He walked in the way of Ahab’s house, and did that which was evil in Baba God’s sight, as did Ahab’s house; for he was the son-in-law of Ahab’s house.
He go with Joram the son of Ahab to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth Gilead, and the Syrians wounded Joram.

King Joram come back to be healed in Jezreel from the wounds which the Syrians had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah go down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.
Elisha the prophet call one of the sons of the prophets, and talk say to him, “Put una belt on una waist, take this vial of oil in una hand, and go to Ramoth Gilead.
When you come there, find Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi, and go in, and make him rise up from among his brothers, and take him to an inner room.
Then take the vial of oil, and pour it on his head, and say, ‘Baba God says, “I have anointed you king over Israel.”’ Then open the door, flee, and no wait.”
So the young man, even the young man, the prophet, go to Ramoth Gilead.
When he come, see am, the captains of the army were sitting. Then he talk say, “I have a message for you, captain.” Jehu talk say, “To which of us all?” He talk say, “To you, O captain.”
He arose, and go into the house. Then he poured the oil on his head, and talk say to him, “Baba God, the God of Israel, says, ‘I have anointed you king over the people of Baba God, even over Israel.
You must strike una master Ahab’s house, that I may avenge the blood of my workers the prophets, and the blood of all the workers of Baba God, at the hand of Jezebel.
For the whole house of Ahab will perish. I go cut off from Ahab Everybody wey urinates against a wall, both him Wey be shut up and him Wey be left at large in Israel.
I go make Ahab’s house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah.
The dogs will eat Jezebel on the plot of ground of Jezreel, and there go be Nobody to bury her.’” Then he opened the door and fled.
When Jehu come out to the workers of his lord, and one talk say to him, “Is all well? Why did this mad fellow come to you?” E tell dem say, “You know the man and how he talks.”
Dem talk say, “That is a lie. Tell us now.” He talk say, “He talk say to me, ‘Baba God says, I have anointed you king over Israel.’”
Then dem hurried, and each man take his cloak, and put it under him on the top of the stairs, and blew the trumpet, saying, “Jehu is king.”
So Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi conspired against Joram. (Now Joram was keeping Ramoth Gilead, he and all Israel, because of Hazael king of Syria;

but king Joram had come back to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria.) Jehu talk say, “If this is una thinking, then let Nobody escape and go out of the city, to go to tell it in Jezreel.”
So Jehu rode in a chariot and go to Jezreel, for Joram lay there. Ahaziah king of Judah had come down to see Joram.

Now the watchman was standing on the tower in Jezreel, and he spied the company of Jehu as he come, and talk say, “I see a company.” Joram talk say, “Take a horseman, and send to meet dem, and Make e say, ‘Is it peace?’”

So one go on horseback to meet him, and talk say, “Thus says the king, ‘Is it peace?’” Jehu talk say, “What do you have to do with peace? Fall in behind me!” The watchman talk say, “The messenger come to dem, but he no be coming back.”
Then he sent out a second on horseback, who come to dem, and talk say, “Thus says the king, ‘Is it peace?’” Jehu answer, “What do you have to do with peace? Fall in behind me!”
The watchman talk say, “He come to dem, and no be coming back. The driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi, for he drives furiously.”

Joram talk say, “Get ready!” Dem got his chariot ready. Then Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah go out, each in his chariot, and dem go out to meet Jehu, and find him on Naboth the Jezreelite’s land.
When Joram see Jehu, he talk say, “Is it peace, Jehu?” He answer, “What peace, so long as the prostitution of una mother Jezebel and her witchcraft abound?”
Joram turned his hands, and fled, and talk say to Ahaziah, “This is treason, Ahaziah!”
Jehu drew his bow with his full strength, and struck Joram between his arms; and the arrow go out at his heart, and he sunk down in his chariot.

Then Jehu talk say to Bidkar his captain, “Pick him up, and throw him in the plot of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite; for remember how, when you and I rode together after Ahab his father, Baba God laid this burden on him:

‘Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth, and the blood of his sons,’ says Baba God; ‘and I go repay you in this plot of ground,’ says Baba God. Now so take and throw him onto the plot of ground, according to Baba God’s word.”

But when Ahaziah the king of Judah see this, he fled by the way of the garden house. Jehu follow after him, and talk say, “Strike him also in the chariot!” Dem struck him at the ascent of Gur, which is by Ibleam. He fled to Megiddo, and died there.
His workers carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his tomb with his fathers in David’s city.
In the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab, Ahaziah began to reign over Judah.
When Jehu had come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it; and she painted her eyes, and adorned her head, and looked out at the window.
As Jehu entered in at the gate, she talk say, “Do you come in peace, Zimri, you murderer of una master?”
He lifted up his face to the window, and talk say, “Wey be on my side? Who?” Two or three eunuchs looked out at him.
He talk say, “Throw her down!” So dem threw her down; and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses. Then he trampled her under foot.
When he had come in, he ate and drank. Then he talk say, “See now to this cursed woman, and bury her; for she is a king’s daughter.”
Dem go to bury her, but dem find no more of her than the skull, the feet, and the palms of her hands.
So dem come back, and told him. He talk say, “This is Baba God’s word, which he spoke by his worker Elijah the Tishbite, saying, ‘The dogs will eat the flesh of Jezebel on the plot of Jezreel,
and the body of Jezebel Go be as dung on the face of the field on Jezreel’s land, so that dem no go say, “This is Jezebel.”’”
Now Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. Jehu wrote letters, and sent to Samaria, to the rulers of Jezreel, even the elders, and to people wey bring up Ahab’s sons, saying,
“Now as soon as this letter comes to you, since una master’s sons are with you, and you have chariots and horses, a fortified city also, and armor,
Select the best and fittest of una master’s sons, set him on his father’s throne, and fight for una master’s house.”
But dem were exceedingly afraid, and talk say, “See am, the two kings didn’t stand before him! How then shall we stand?”

Person wey was over the household, and person wey was over the city, the elders also, and people wey raised the pikin dem, sent to Jehu, saying, “We be una workers, and will do all that you ask us. We go not make any man king. You do that which is good in una eyes.”

Then he wrote a letter the second time to dem, saying, “If You be on my side, and if You go listen to my voice, take the heads of the men Wey be una master’s sons, and come to me to Jezreel by tomorrow this time.” Now the king’s sons, being seventy persons, were with the great men of the city, who bring dem up.
When the letter come to dem, dem take the king’s sons and killed dem, even seventy people, and put dem heads in baskets, and sent dem to him to Jezreel.
A messenger come and told him, “Dem have bring the heads of the king’s sons.” He talk say, “Lay dem in two heaps at the entrance of the gate until the morning.”
In the morning, he go out, and stood, and talk say to all the people, “You be righteous. See am, I conspired against my master and killed him, but who killed all these?
Know now that nothing will fall to the earth of Baba God’s word, which Baba God spoke concerning Ahab’s house. For Baba God has done that which he spoke by his worker Elijah.”
So Jehu struck all that remain of Ahab’s house in Jezreel, with all his great men, his familiar friends, and his priests, until he left him Nobody remaining.
He arose and comot, and go to Samaria. As he was at the shearing house of the shepherds on the way,

Jehu met with the brothers of Ahaziah king of Judah, and talk say, “Wey be you?” Dem answer, “We be the brothers of Ahaziah. We be going down to greet the pikin dem of the king and the pikin dem of the queen.”
He talk say, “Take dem alive!” Dem take dem alive, and killed dem at the pit of the shearing house, even forty-two men. He didn’t leave any of dem.

When he had comot from there, he met Jehonadab the son of Rechab coming to meet him. He greeted him, and talk say to him, “Is una heart right, as my heart is with una heart?” Jehonadab answer, “It is.” “If it is, give me una hand.” He give him his hand; and he take him up to him into the chariot.
He talk say, “Come with me, and see my zeal for Baba God.” So dem made him ride in his chariot.
When he come to Samaria, he struck all who remain to Ahab in Samaria, until he had destroyed him, according to Baba God’s word, which he spoke to Elijah.
Jehu gathered all the people together, and talk say to dem, “Ahab served Baal a little; but Jehu will serve him much.

Now so call to me all the prophets of Baal, all of his worshipers, and all of his priests. Let Nobody be absent; for I have a great sacrifice to Baal. Anybody wey is absent, he no go live.” But Jehu did deceptively, intending to destroy the worshipers of Baal.
Jehu talk say, “Sanctify a solemn assembly for Baal!” So dem proclaimed it.
