Above the expanse that was over dem heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone; and on the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man on it above.

I see as it were glowing metal, as the appearance of fire within it all around, from the appearance of his waist and upward; and from the appearance of his waist and downward I see as it were the appearance of fire, and there was brightness around him.

As the appearance of the rainbow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness all around. This was the appearance of the likeness of Baba God’s glory. When I see it, I fell on my face, and I heard a voice of one that spoke.
He talk say to me, “Son of Man, stand on una feet, and I go speak with you.”
The Spirit entered into me when he spoke to me, and set me on my feet; and I heard him who spoke to me.
He talk say to me, “Son of Man, I send you to the pikin dem of Israel, to a nation of rebels who have rebelled against me. Dem and dem fathers have transgressed against me even to this very day.
The pikin dem are impudent and stiff-hearted. I be sending you to dem, and you shall tell dem, ‘Thus says the Lord Baba God.’
Dem, whether Dem go hear, or whether Dem go forbear, (for Dem be a rebellious house), yet shall know that there Don dey a prophet among dem.

You, Son of Man, No fear of dem, neither be afraid of dem words, though briers and thorns are with you, and you do live among scorpions. No fear of dem words, nor be dismayed at dem looks, though Dem be a rebellious house.
You shall speak my words to dem, whether Dem go hear, or whether Dem go forbear; for Dem be most rebellious.
But you, Son of Man, hear what I tell una. No be rebellious like that rebellious house. Open una mouth, and eat that which I give you.”
When I looked, see am, a hand was stretched out to me; and, see am, a scroll of a book was inside am;
He spread it before me: and it was written within and without; and there were written inside am lamentations, and mourning, and woe.
He talk say to me, “Son of Man, eat Wetin you find. Eat this scroll, and go, speak to the house of Israel.”
So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat the scroll.
He talk say to me, “Son of Man, cause una belly to eat, and fill una bowels with this scroll that I give you.” Then I ate it; and it was as sweet as honey in my mouth.
He talk say to me, “Son of Man, go to the house of Israel, and speak my words to dem.
For you No be sent to a people of a strange speech and of a hard language, but to the house of Israel;
not to many peoples of a strange speech and of a hard language, whose words you can not understand. Surely, if I sent you to dem, dem would listen to you.
But the house of Israel No go listen to you, for Dem go not listen to me; for all the house of Israel are obstinate and hard-hearted.
See am, I have made una face hard against dem faces, and una forehead hard against dem foreheads.
I have made una forehead as a diamond, harder than flint. No fear of dem, neither be dismayed at dem looks, though Dem be a rebellious house.”
Moreover he talk say to me, “Son of Man, all my words that I shall speak to you receive in una heart, and hear with una ears.
Go to dem of the captivity, to the pikin dem of una people, and speak to dem, and tell dem, ‘Thus says the Lord Baba God;’ whether Dem go hear, or whether Dem go forbear.
Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me the voice of a great rushing, saying, “Blessed be Baba God’s glory from his place.”
I heard the noise of the wings of the living creatures as dem touched each other, and the noise of the wheels beside dem, even the noise of a great rushing.
So the Spirit lifted me up, and take me away; and I go in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; and Baba God’s hand was strong on me.
Then I come to dem of the captivity at Tel Aviv, that lived by the river Chebar, and to where dem lived; and I sat there overwhelmed among dem seven days.
At the end of seven days, Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
“Son of Man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel. So hear the word from my mouth, and warn dem from me.

When I tell the wicked, ‘You go surely die;’ and you give him no warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life; the same wicked man shall die in his wickedness; but I go require his blood at una hand.
Yet if you warn the wicked, and he no dey turn from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he shall die in his wickedness; but you have delivered una soul.”

“Again, when a righteous man turns from his righteousness, and commits wickedness, and I lay a stumbling block before him, he shall die. Because you have not given him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteous deeds which he has done no go be remember; but his blood will I require at una hand.
Nevertheless if you warn the righteous man, that the righteous not sin, and he No dey sin, he shall surely live, because he take warning; and you have delivered una soul.”
Baba God’s hand was there on me; and he talk say to me, “Arise, go out into the plain, and I go talk with you there.”
Then I arose, and go out into the plain: and see am, Baba God’s glory stood there, as the glory which I see by the river Chebar; and I fell on my face.
Then the Spirit entered into me, and set me on my feet. He spoke with me, and talk say to me, “Go, shut yourself inside una house.
But you, Son of Man, see am, Dem go put ropes on you, and will bind you with dem, and You go not go out among dem.
I go make una tongue stick to the roof of una mouth, that You go be mute, and No go be to dem a reprover; for Dem be a rebellious house.

But when I speak with you, I go open una mouth, and you shall tell dem, ‘Thus says the Lord Baba God.’ Person wey hears, Make e hear; and person wey forbears, Make e forbear: for Dem be a rebellious house.”
“You also, Son of Man, take a tile, and lay it before yourself, and portray on it a city, even Jerusalem.
Lay siege against it, build forts against it, and throw up a mound against it. Also set camps against it and plant battering rams against it all around.

Take for yourself an iron pan, and set it for a wall of iron between you and the city: and set una face toward it. It go be besieged, and you shall lay siege against it. This go be a sign to the house of Israel.
“Moreover lie on una left side, and lay the wickedness of the house of Israel on it. According to the number of the days that you shall lie on it, you shall bear dem wickedness.
For I have appointed the years of dem wickedness to be to you a number of days, even three hundred ninety days: so you shall bear the wickedness of the house of Israel.
“Again, when you have accomplished these, you shall lie on una right side, and shall bear the wickedness of the house of Judah. I have appointed forty days, each day for a year, to you.
You shall set una face toward the siege of Jerusalem, with una arm uncovered; and you shall prophesy against it.
See am, I put ropes on you, and you no go turn yourself from one side to the other, until you have accomplished the days of una siege.

“Take for yourself also wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt, and put dem in one vessel. Make bread of it. According to the number of the days that you shall lie on una side, even three hundred ninety days, you shall eat of it.
Una chop which you shall eat go be by weight, twenty shekels a day. From time to time you shall eat it.
You shall drink water by measure, the sixth part of a hin. From time to time you shall drink.
You shall eat it as barley cakes, and you shall bake it in dem sight with dung that comes out of man.”
Baba God talk say, “Even thus shall the pikin dem of Israel eat dem bread unclean, among the nations where I go drive dem.”

Then I talk say, “Ah Lord Baba God! See am, my soul has not been polluted; for from my youth up even until now I have not eaten of that which dies of itself, or is torn of animals; neither come there abominable meat into my mouth!”
Then he talk say to me, “See am, I have given you cow’s dung for man’s dung, and you shall prepare una bread on it.”
Moreover he talk say to me, “Son of Man, see am, I go break the staff of bread in Jerusalem. Dem go eat bread by weight, and with fearfulness; and dem shall drink water by measure, and in dismay;
that dem may lack bread and water, be dismayed one with another, and pine away in dem wickedness.
“You, Son of Man, take a sharp sword. You shall take it as a barber’s razor to yourself, and shall cause it to pass over una head and over una beard. Then take balances to weigh and divide the hair.

A third part you shall burn in the fire in the middle of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled. You shall take a third part, and strike with the sword around it. A third part you shall scatter to the wind, and I go draw out a sword after dem.
You shall take of it a few in number, and bind dem in una skirts.
Of these again you shall take, and throw dem into the middle of the fire, and burn dem in the fire; from it shall a fire come out into all the house of Israel.
“Thus says the Lord Baba God: ‘This is Jerusalem. I have set her in the middle of the nations, and countries are around her.

She has rebelled against my ordinances in doing wickedness more than the nations, and against my statutes more than the countries that are around her; for dem have rejected my ordinances, and as for my statutes, dem have not walked in dem.’

“So thus says the Lord Baba God: ‘Because You be turbulent more than the nations that are around you, and have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept my ordinances, neither have done after the ordinances of the nations that are around you;
so thus says the Lord Baba God: ‘See am, I, even I, am against you; and I go execute judgments among you in the sight of the nations.
I go do in you that which I have not done, and which I go not do any more the like, because of all una abominations.
So the fathers will eat the sons within you, and the sons will eat dem fathers. I go execute judgments on you; and I go scatter the whole remnant of you to all the winds.

So as I live,’ says the Lord Baba God, ‘surely, because you have defiled my sanctuary with all una detestable things, and with all una abominations, so I go also diminish you. My eye no go spare, and I go have no pity.

A third part of You go die with the pestilence, and with famine shall dem be consumed within you. A third part will fall by the sword around you. A third part I go scatter to all the winds, and will draw out a sword after dem.

“‘Thus my anger Go be accomplished, and I go cause my serious anger toward dem to rest, and I go be comforted. Dem go know that I, Baba God, have spoken in my zeal, when I have accomplished my serious anger on dem.
“‘Moreover I go make you a desolation and a reproach among the nations that are around you, in the sight of all that pass by.

So it go be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment, to the nations that are around you, when I shall execute judgments on you in anger and in serious anger, and in wrathful rebukes — I, Baba God, have spoken it —
when I send on dem the evil arrows of famine that are for destruction, which I go send to destroy you. I go increase the famine on you, and will break una staff of bread.
I go send on you famine and evil animals, and Dem go bereave you. Pestilence and blood will pass through you; and I go bring the sword on you. I, Baba God, have spoken it.’”
Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
“Son of Man, set una face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy to dem,

and say, ‘You mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord Baba God! Thus says the Lord Baba God to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys: “See am, I, even I, will bring a sword on you, and I go destroy una high places.
Una altars will become desolate, and una incense altars Go be broken. I go throw down una slain men before una idols.
I go lay the dead bodies of the pikin dem of Israel before dem idols; and I go scatter una bones around una altars.

In all una dwelling places the cities go be laid waste, and the high places go be desolate; that una altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and una idols may be broken and cease, and una incense altars may be cut down, and una works may be abolished.
The slain shall fall among you, and you shall know that I be Baba God.
“‘“Yet I go leave a remnant, in that You go have some that escape the sword among the nations, when You be scattered through the countries.

Those of you that escape will remember me among the nations where Dem be carried captive, how I Don dey broken with dem lewd heart, which has comot from me, and with dem eyes, which play the prostitute after dem idols. Then Dem go loathe themselves in dem own sight for the evils which dem have committed in all dem abominations.
Dem go know that I be Baba God. I have not talk say in vain that I would do this evil to dem.”’

“Thus says the Lord Baba God: ‘Strike with una hand, and stamp with una foot, and say, “Alas!” Because of all the evil abominations of the house of Israel; for dem shall fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.
Person Wey far off will die of the pestilence. Person Wey near will fall by the sword. Person wey remains and is besieged will die by the famine. Thus I go accomplish my serious anger on dem.

You go know that I be Baba God, when dem slain men are among dem idols around dem altars, on every high hill, on all the tops of the mountains, under every green tree, and under every thick oak, the places where dem offered pleasant aroma to all dem idols.
I go stretch out my hand on dem, and make the land desolate and waste, from the wilderness toward Diblah, throughout all dem habitations: and Dem go know that I be Baba God. ’”
Moreover Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
“You, Son of Man, thus says the Lord Baba God to the land of Israel, ‘An end! The end has come on the four corners of the land.
Now is the end on you, and I go send my anger on you, and will judge you according to una ways. I go bring on you all una abominations.
My eye No go spare you, neither will I have pity; but I go bring una ways on you, and una abominations Go be among you. Then You go know that I be Baba God.’
“Thus says the Lord Baba God: ‘An evil! A unique evil! See am, it comes.
An end has come. The end has come! It awakes against you. See am, it comes.
Una doom has come to you, inhabitant of the land! The time has come! The day is near, a day of tumult, and not of joyful shouting, on the mountains.
Now I go shortly pour out my serious anger on you, and accomplish my anger against you, and will judge you according to una ways. I go bring on you all una abominations.
My eye no go spare, neither will I have pity. I go bring on you according to una ways. Una abominations Go be among you; and You go know that I, Baba God, strike.
“‘See am, the day! See am, it comes! Una doom has gone out. The rod has blossomed. Pride has budded.
Violence has risen up into a rod of wickedness. None of dem will remain, nor of dem plenty people, nor of dem wealth. There go be nothing of value among dem.
The time has come! The day draws near. No let the buyer glad well-well, nor the seller mourn; for serious anger is on all its plenty people.

For the seller no go return to that which is sold, although Dem be still alive; for the vision concerns the whole plenty people of it. None shall return; neither will any strengthen imself in the wickedness of his life.
Dem have blown the trumpet, and have made all ready; but Nobody goes to the battle; for my serious anger is on all its plenty people.
“‘The sword is outside, and the pestilence and the famine within. Person Wey in the field will die by the sword. Person Wey in the city Go be devoured by famine and pestilence.
But those of people wey escape will escape, and Go be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of dem moaning, everyone in his wickedness.
All hands Go be feeble, and all knees Go be weak as water.
Dem go also clothe themselves with sackcloth, and horror will cover dem. Shame Go be on all faces, and baldness on all dem heads.

Dem go throw dem silver in the streets, and dem gold Go be as an unclean thing. Dem silver and dem gold no go be able to deliver dem in the day of Baba God’s serious anger. Dem no go satisfy dem souls, neither fill dem bellies; because it Don dey the stumbling block of dem wickedness.
As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty; but dem made the images of dem abominations and dem detestable things inside am. So I have made it to dem as an unclean thing.
I go give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a plunder; and Dem go profane it.
I go also turn my face from dem, and Dem go profane my secret place. Robbers will enter into it, and profane it.
“‘Make chains; for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.
So I go bring the worst of the nations, and Dem go possess dem houses. I go also make the pride of the strong to cease. Dem holy places Go be profaned.
Destruction comes! Dem go seek peace, and there Go be none.
Mischief will come on mischief, and rumor Go be on rumor. Dem go seek a vision of the prophet; but the law will perish from the priest, and counsel from the elders.

The king will mourn, and the prince Go be clothed with desolation. The hands of the people of the land Go be troubled. I go do to dem after dem way, and according to dem own judgments will I judge dem; and dem shall know that I be Baba God.’”
In the sixth year, in the sixth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I sat in my house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, the Lord Baba God’s hand fell there on me.

Then I see, and see am, a likeness as the appearance of fire; from the appearance of his waist and downward, fire; and from his waist and upward, as the appearance of brightness, as it were glowing metal.

He stretched out the form of a hand, and take me by a lock of my head; and the Spirit lifted me up between earth and the sky, and bring me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the gate of the inner court that looks toward the north; where there was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provokes to jealousy.
See am, the glory of the God of Israel was there, according to the appearance that I see in the plain.

Then he talk say to me, “Son of Man, lift up una eyes now the way toward the north.” So I lifted up my eyes the way toward the north, and see, northward of the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry.

He talk say to me, “Son of Man, do you see Wetin dem do? Even the great abominations that the house of Israel commit here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary? But You go again see yet other great abominations.”
He bring me to the door of the court; and when I looked, see am, a hole in the wall.
Then he talk say to me, “Son of Man, dig now in the wall.” When I had dug in the wall, I see a door.
He talk say to me, “Go in, and see the wicked abominations that dem do here.”
So I go in and looked, and see every form of creeping things, abominable animals, and all the idols of the house of Israel, portrayed around on the wall.

Seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel stood before dem. In the middle of dem Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan stood, every man with his censer in his hand; and the smell of the cloud of incense go up.

Then he talk say to me, “Son of Man, have you seen what the elders of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in his rooms of imagery? For dem say, ‘Baba God no dey see us. Baba God has forsaken the land.’”
He talk say also to me, “You go again see more of the great abominations which dem do.”
Then he bring me to the door of the gate of Baba God’s house which was toward the north; and I see the women sit there weeping for Tammuz.
Then he talk say to me, “Have you seen this, Son of Man? You go again see yet greater abominations than these.”

He bring me into the inner court of Baba God’s house; and I see at the door of Baba God’s temple, between the porch and the altar, were about twenty-five men, with dem backs toward Baba God’s temple, and dem faces toward the east; and dem were worshiping the sun toward the east.

Then he talk say to me, “Have you seen this, Son of Man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that dem commit the abominations which dem commit here? For dem have filled the land with violence, and have turned again to provoke me to anger. See am, dem put the branch to dem nose.
So will I also deal in serious anger. My eye no go spare, neither will I have pity. Though dem cry in my ears with a loud voice, yet I go not hear dem.”
Then he cried in my ears with a loud voice, saying, “Cause people Wey in charge of the city to draw near, each man with his destroying weapon in his hand.”

See am, six men come from the way of the upper gate, which lies toward the north, every man with his slaughter weapon in his hand. One man in the middle of dem was clothed in linen, with a writer’s inkhorn by his side. Dem go in, and stood beside the bronze altar.
The glory of the God of Israel go up from the cherub, whereupon it was, to the threshold of the house; and he call to the man clothed in linen, who had the writer’s inkhorn by his side.

Baba God talk say to him, “Go through the middle of the city, through the middle of Jerusalem, and set a mark on the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry over all the abominations that are done within it.”
To the others he talk say in my hearing, “Go through the city after him, and strike. No let una eye spare, neither have pity.

Kill utterly the old man, the young man, the virgin, little pikin dem and women; but no come near any man on whom is the mark. Begin at my sanctuary.” Then dem began at the old men who were before the house.
E tell dem say, “Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain. Go out!” Dem go out, and struck in the city.

While dem were killing, and I was left, I fell on my face, and cried, and talk say, “Ah Lord Baba God! Will you destroy all the residue of Israel in una pouring out of una serious anger on Jerusalem?”

Then he talk say to me, “The wickedness of the house of Israel and Judah is exceedingly great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of perversion; for dem say, ‘Baba God has forsaken the land, and Baba God no dey see.’
As for me also, my eye no go spare, neither will I have pity, but I go bring dem way on dem head.”
See am, the man clothed in linen, who had the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, “I have done as you have commanded me.”
Then I looked, and see, in the expanse that was over the head of the cherubim there appeared above dem as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.

He spoke to the man clothed in linen, and talk say, “Go in between the whirling wheels, even under the cherub, and fill both una hands with coals of fire from between the cherubim, and scatter dem over the city.” He go in as I watched.
Now the cherubim stood on the right side of the house, when the man go in; and the cloud filled the inner court.
Baba God’s glory mounted up from the cherub, and stood over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of Baba God’s glory.
The sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of God Almighty when he speaks.
E happen say, when he commanded the man clothed in linen, saying, “Take fire from between the whirling wheels, from between the cherubim,” that he go in, and stood beside a wheel.

The cherub stretched out his hand from between the cherubim to the fire that was between the cherubim, and take some of it, and put it into the hands of him who was clothed in linen, who take it and go out.
There appeared in the cherubim the form of a man’s hand under dem wings.
I looked, and see am, four wheels beside the cherubim, one wheel beside one cherub, and another wheel beside another cherub; and the appearance of the wheels was like a beryl stone.
As for dem appearance, the four of dem had one likeness, like a wheel within a wheel.
When dem go, dem go in dem four directions: dem didn’t turn as dem go, but to the place where the head looked dem follow it; dem didn’t turn as dem go.
Dem whole body, and dem backs, and dem hands, and dem wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes all around, even the wheels that the four of dem had.
As for the wheels, dem were call in my hearing, “the whirling wheels”.
Every one dem had four faces. The first face was the face of the cherub. The second face was the face of a man. The third face was the face of a lion. The fourth was the face of an eagle.
The cherubim mounted up: this is the living creature that I see by the river Chebar.
When the cherubim go, the wheels go beside dem; and when the cherubim lifted up dem wings to mount up from the earth, the wheels also didn’t turn from beside dem.
When dem stood, these stood; and when dem mounted up, these mounted up with dem: for the spirit of the living creature was in dem.
Baba God’s glory go out from over the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubim.

The cherubim lifted up dem wings, and mounted up from the earth in my sight when dem go out, and the wheels beside dem: and dem stood at the door of the east gate of Baba God’s house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over dem above.
This is the living creature that I see under the God of Israel by the river Chebar; and I know that dem were cherubim.
Every one had four faces, and every one four wings; and the likeness of the hands of a man was under dem wings.
As for the likeness of dem faces, dem were the faces which I see by the river Chebar, dem appearances and themselves; dem go every one straight forward.

Moreover the Spirit lifted me up, and bring me to the east gate of Baba God’s house, which looks eastward: and see, at the door of the gate twenty-five men; and I see among dem Jaazaniah the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.
He talk say to me, “Son of Man, these are the men who devise wickedness, and who give wicked counsel in this city;
who say, ‘The time No be near to build houses. This is the cauldron, and We be the meat.’
So prophesy against dem, prophesy, Son of Man.”
Baba God’s Spirit fell on me, and he talk say to me, “Speak, ‘Baba God says: “Thus you have talk say, house of Israel; for I know the things that come into una mind.
You have multiplied una slain in this city, and you have filled its streets with the slain.
“‘So thus says the Lord Baba God: “Una slain whom you have laid in the middle of it, Dem be the meat, and this is the cauldron; but You go be bring out of the middle of it.
You have feared the sword; and I go bring the sword on you,” says the Lord Baba God.
“I go bring you out of the middle of it, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.
You go fall by the sword. I go judge you in the border of Israel; and You go know that I be Baba God.
This No go be una cauldron, neither will you be the meat in the middle of it. I go judge you in the border of Israel.
You go know that I be Baba God, for you have not walked in my statutes, neither have you executed my ordinances, but have done after the ordinances of the nations that are around you.”’”
When I prophesied, Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then fell I down on my face, and cried with a loud voice, and talk say, “Ah Lord Baba God! will you make a full end of the remnant of Israel?”
Baba God’s word come to me, saying,

“Son of Man, una brothers, even una brothers, the men of una relatives, and all the house of Israel, all of dem, to whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have talk say, ‘Go far away from Baba God. This land Don dey given to us for a possession.’”

“So say, ‘Thus says the Lord Baba God: “Whereas I have removed dem far off among the nations, and whereas I have scattered dem among the countries, yet I go be to dem a sanctuary for a little while in the countries where dem have come.”’
“So say, ‘Thus says the Lord Baba God: “I go gather you from the peoples, and assemble you out of the countries where you Don dey scattered, and I go give you the land of Israel.”
“‘Dem go come there, and Dem go take away all its detestable things and all its abominations from there.
I go give dem one heart, and I go put a new spirit within you. I go take the stony heart out of dem flesh, and will give dem a heart of flesh;
that dem may walk in my statutes, and keep my ordinances, and do dem. Dem go be my people, and I go be dem God.
But as for dem whose heart walks after the heart of dem detestable things and dem abominations, I go bring dem way on dem own heads,’ says the Lord Baba God.”
Then the cherubim lifted up dem wings, and the wheels were beside dem; and the glory of the God of Israel was over dem above.
Baba God’s glory go up from the middle of the city, and stood on the mountain which is on the east side of the city.
The Spirit lifted me up, and bring me in the vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to dem of the captivity. So the vision that I had seen go up from me.
Then I spoke to dem of the captivity all the things that Baba God had shown me.
Baba God’s word also come to me, saying,
“Son of Man, you live in the middle of the rebellious house, who have eyes to see, and no see, who have ears to hear, and no hear; for Dem be a rebellious house.

“So, you Son of Man, prepare una stuff for moving, and move by day in dem sight. You shall move from una place to another place in dem sight. It may be Dem go consider, though Dem be a rebellious house.
You shall bring out una stuff by day in dem sight, as stuff for moving; and you shall go out yourself at evening in dem sight, as when men go out into exile.
Dig through the wall in dem sight, and carry una stuff out that way.
In dem sight you shall bear it on una shoulder, and carry it out in the dark. You shall cover una face, so that you no see the land, for I have set you for a sign to the house of Israel.”

I did so as I was commanded. I bring out my stuff by day, as stuff for moving, and in the evening I dug through the wall with my hand. I bring it out in the dark, and bore it on my shoulder in dem sight.
In the morning, Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
“Son of Man, hasn’t the house of Israel, the rebellious house, talk say to you, ‘Wetin be you doing?’
“Say to dem, ‘Thus says the Lord Baba God: “This burden concerns the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel among whom Dem be.”’
“Say, ‘I be una sign. As I have done, so will it be done to dem. Dem go go into exile, into captivity.

“‘The prince Wey be among dem will bear on his shoulder in the dark, and will go out. Dem go dig through the wall to carry out that way. He will cover his face, because he No go see the land with his eyes.
I go also spread my net on him, and he Go be taken in my snare. I go bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet he No go see it, though he will die there.
I go scatter toward every wind all Wey be around him to help him, and all his bands. I go draw out the sword after dem.
“‘Dem shall know that I be Baba God, when I shall disperse dem among the nations, and scatter dem through the countries.

But I go leave a few men of dem from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence, that dem may declare all dem abominations among the nations where dem come; and Dem go know that I be Baba God.’”
Moreover Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
“Son of Man, eat una bread with quaking, and drink una water with trembling and with fearfulness.

Tell the people of the land, ‘Thus says the Lord Baba God concerning the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the land of Israel: “Dem go eat dem bread with fearfulness, and drink dem water in dismay, that her land may be desolate, and all that is inside am, because of the violence of all people wey live inside am.
The cities that are inhabited Go be laid waste, and the land Go be a desolation; then You go know that I be Baba God.”’”
Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
“Son of Man, Wetin be this proverb that you have in the land of Israel, saying, ‘The days are prolonged, and every vision fails?’

Tell dem so, ‘Thus says the Lord Baba God: “I go make this proverb to cease, and dem shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel;”’ but tell dem, ‘“The days are at hand, and the fulfillment of every vision.
For there Go be no more any false vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.

For I be Baba God. I go speak, and the word that I speak Go be performed. It Go be no more deferred; for in una days, rebellious house, I go speak the word, and will perform it,” says the Lord Baba God.’”
Again Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
“Son of Man, see am, dem of the house of Israel say, ‘The vision that he sees is for many day to come, and he prophesies of times that are far off.’
“So tell dem, ‘Thus says the Lord Baba God: “None of my words go be deferred any more, but the word which I speak Go be performed,” says the Lord Baba God.’”
Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
“Son of Man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who prophesy, and say to people wey prophesy out of dem own heart, ‘Hear Baba God’s word:
Thus says the Lord Baba God, “Woe to the foolish prophets, who follow dem own spirit, and have seen nothing!
Israel, una prophets Don dey like foxes in the waste places.
You have not gone up into the gaps, neither built up the wall for the house of Israel, to stand in the battle in the day of Baba God.
Dem have seen falsehood and lying divination, who say, ‘Baba God says;’ but Baba God has not sent dem. Dem have made men to hope that the word would be confirmed.
Haven’t you seen a false vision, and haven’t you spoken a lying divination, in that you say, ‘Baba God says;’ but I have not spoken?”
“‘So thus says the Lord Baba God: “Because you have spoken falsehood and seen lies, so, see am, I be against you,” says the Lord Baba God.

“My hand Go be against the prophets who see false visions and who divine lies. Dem go not be in the council of my people, neither will dem be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither will dem enter into the land of Israel. Then You go know that I be the Lord Baba God”
“‘Because, even because dem have seduced my people, saying, “Peace;” and E get no peace. When one builds up a wall, see am, dem plaster it with whitewash.
Tell people wey plaster it with whitewash that it will fall. There Go be an overflowing shower; and you, great hailstones, will fall. A stormy wind will tear it.
See am, when the wall has fallen, no go it be talk say to you, “Where is the plaster with which you have plastered it?”
“‘So thus says the Lord Baba God: “I go even tear it with a stormy wind in my serious anger. There go be an overflowing shower in my anger, and great hailstones in serious anger to consume it.

So will I break down the wall that you have plastered with whitewash, and bring it down to the ground, so that its foundation Go be uncovered. It will fall, and You go be consumed in the middle of it. Then You go know that I be Baba God.
Thus will I accomplish my serious anger on the wall, and on people wey have plastered it with whitewash; and I go tell you, ‘The wall is no more, neither people wey plastered it;
to wit, the prophets of Israel who prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and who see visions of peace for her, and E get no peace,’” says the Lord Baba God.’”
You, Son of Man, set una face against the daughters of una people, who prophesy out of dem own heart; and prophesy against dem,

and say, “Thus says the Lord Baba God: ‘Woe to the women who sew pillows on all elbows, and make kerchiefs for the head of persons of every stature to hunt souls! Will you hunt the souls of my people, and save souls alive for unaself?

You have profaned me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to kill the souls who no suppose die, and to save the souls alive who no suppose live, by una lying to my people who listen to lies.’

“So thus says the Lord Baba God: ‘See am, I be against una pillows, with which you hunt the souls to make dem fly, and I go tear dem from una arms. I go let the souls go, even the souls whom you hunt to make dem fly.
I go also tear una kerchiefs, and deliver my people out of una hand, and Dem go be no more in una hand to be hunted. Then You go know that I be Baba God.
Because with lies you have grieved the heart of the righteous, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he no suppose return from his wicked way, and be saved alive.
So you shall no more see false visions, nor practice divination. I go deliver my people out of una hand. Then You go know that I be Baba God.’”
Then come certain of the elders of Israel to me, and sat before me.
Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
“Son of Man, these men have taken dem idols into dem heart, and put the stumbling block of dem wickedness before dem face. Should I be inquired of at all by dem?

So speak to dem, and tell dem, ‘Thus says the Lord Baba God: “Every man of the house of Israel who takes his idols into his heart, and puts the stumbling block of his wickedness before his face, and comes to the prophet; I Baba God will answer him inside am according to the plenty people of his idols;
that I may take the house of Israel in dem own heart, because Dem be all estranged from me through dem idols.”’
“So tell the house of Israel, ‘Thus says the Lord Baba God: “Return, and turn unaself from una idols! Turn away una faces from all una abominations.

“‘“For everyone of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live in Israel, who separates imself from me, and takes his idols into his heart, and puts the stumbling block of his wickedness before his face, and comes to the prophet to inquire for imself of me; I Baba God will answer him by myself.
I go set my face against that man, and will make him an astonishment, for a sign and a proverb, and I go cut him off from among my people; and You go know that I be Baba God.
“‘“If the prophet is deceived and speaks a word, I, Baba God, have deceived that prophet, and I go stretch out my hand on him, and will destroy him from among my people Israel.
Dem go bear dem wickedness. The wickedness of the prophet Go be even as the wickedness of him who seeks him;
that the house of Israel may go no more astray from me, neither defile themselves any more with all dem wrongdoings; but that dem may be my people, and I may be dem God,” says the Lord Baba God.’”
Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
“Son of Man, when a land sins against me by committing a trespass, and I stretch out my hand on it, and break the staff of its bread, and send famine on it, and cut off from it man and animal;
though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, dem should deliver only dem own souls by dem righteousness,” says the Lord Baba God.
“If I cause evil animals to pass through the land, and dem ravage it, and it is made desolate, so that no man may pass through because of the animals;
though these three men were in it, as I live,” says the Lord Baba God, “dem would deliver neither sons nor daughters. Dem only would be delivered, but the land would be desolate.
“Or if I bring a sword on that land, and say, ‘Sword, go through the land; so that I cut off from it man and animal;’
though these three men were in it, as I live,” says the Lord Baba God, “dem would deliver neither sons nor daughters, but dem only would be delivered themselves.
“Or if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my serious anger on it in blood, to cut off from it man and animal;
though Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, as I live,” says the Lord Baba God, “dem would deliver neither son nor daughter; dem would deliver only dem own souls by dem righteousness.”

For thus says the Lord Baba God: “How much more when I send my four severe judgments on Jerusalem, the sword, and the famine, and the evil animals, and the pestilence, to cut off from it man and animal!

Yet, see am, inside am go be left a remnant that go be carried out, both sons and daughters. See am, dem shall come out to you, and you shall see dem way and dem doings; and you go be comforted concerning the evil that I have bring on Jerusalem, even concerning all that I have bring on it.
Dem go comfort you, when you see dem way and dem doings; and You go know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it,” says the Lord Baba God.
Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
“Son of Man, Wetin be the vine tree more than any tree, the vine-branch which is among the trees of the forest?
Will wood be taken of it to make anything? Will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel on it?
See am, it is throw into the fire for fuel; the fire has devoured both its ends, and the middle of it is burned. Is it profitable for any work?
See am, when it was whole, it was suitable for no work. How much less, when the fire has devoured it, and it is burned, will it yet be suitable for any work?”
So thus says the Lord Baba God: “As the vine tree among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so will I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
I go set my face against dem. Dem go go out from the fire, but the fire will devour dem; and You go know that I be Baba God, when I set my face against dem.
I go make the land desolate, because dem have committed a trespass,” says the Lord Baba God.
Again Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
“Son of Man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations;
and say, ‘Thus says the Lord Baba God to Jerusalem: “Una origin and una birth is of the land of the Canaanite. An Amorite was una father, and una mother was a Hittite.
As for una birth, in the day you were born una navel No be cut, neither were you washed in water to cleanse you. You no be salted at all, nor swaddled at all.
No eye pitied you, to do any of these things to you, to have compassion on you; but you were throw out in the open field, because you were abhorred in the day that you were born.
“‘“When I passed by you, and see you wallowing in una blood, I talk say to you, ‘Though You be in una blood, live!’ Yes, I talk say to you, ‘Though You be in una blood, live!’

I caused you to multiply as that which grows in the field, and you increased and grew great, and you attained to excellent ornament. Una breasts were formed, and una hair grew; yet you were naked and bare.

“‘“Now when I passed by you, and looked at you, see am, una time was the time of love; and I spread my skirt over you, and covered una nakedness: yes, I swore to you, and entered into a covenant with you,” says the Lord Baba God, “and you became mine.
“‘“Then washed I you with water. Yes, I thoroughly washed away una blood from you, and I anointed you with oil.
I clothed you also with embroidered work, and put sealskin shoes on you. I dressed you with fine linen and covered you with silk.
I decked you with ornaments. put bracelets on una hands, and a chain on una neck.
I put a ring on una nose, and earrings in una ears, and a beautiful crown on una head.

Thus you were decked with gold and silver. Una clothing was of fine linen, silk, and embroidered work. You ate fine flour, honey, and oil. You were exceedingly beautiful, and you prospered to royal estate.
Una renown go out among the nations for una beauty; for it was perfect, through my majesty which I had put on you,” says the Lord Baba God.
“‘“But you trusted in una beauty, and played the prostitute because of una renown, and poured out una prostitution on Everybody wey passed by. It was his.
You take some of una garments, and made for unaself high places decked with various colors, and played the prostitute on dem. This no go come, neither shall it be.
You also take una beautiful jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given you, and made for yourself images of men, and played the prostitute with dem.
You take una embroidered garments, covered dem, and set my oil and my incense before dem.
My bread also which I give you, fine flour, oil, and honey, with which I fed you, you even set it before dem for a pleasant aroma; and so it was,” says the Lord Baba God.
“‘“Moreover you have taken una sons and una daughters, whom you have borne to me, and you have sacrificed these to dem to be devoured. Was una prostitution a small matter,
that you have slain my pikin dem, and delivered dem up, in causing dem to pass through the fire to dem?
In all una abominations and una prostitution you have not remember the days of una youth, when you were naked and bare, and were wallowing in una blood.
“‘“It has happened after all una wickedness. Woe, woe to you!” says the Lord Baba God,
“that you have built for unaself a vaulted place, and have made unaself a lofty place in every street.
You have built una lofty place at the head of every way, and have made una beauty an abomination, and have opened una feet to Everybody wey passed by, and multiplied una prostitution.
You have also committed sexual immorality with the Egyptians, una neighbors, great of flesh; and have multiplied una prostitution, to provoke me to anger.
See so, I have stretched out my hand over you, and have diminished una portion, and delivered you to the will of people wey hate you, the daughters of the Philistines, Wey be ashamed of una lewd way.
You have played the prostitute also with the Assyrians, because you were insatiable; yes, you have played the prostitute with dem, and yet you no be satisfied.
You have moreover multiplied una prostitution to the land of merchants, to Chaldea; and yet you no be satisfied with this.
“‘“How weak is una heart,” says the Lord Baba God, “since you do all these things, the work of an impudent prostitute;
in that you build una vaulted place at the head of every way, and make una lofty place in every street, and have not been as a prostitute, in that you scorn pay.
“‘“A wife who commits adultery! Who takes strangers instead of her husband!
People give gifts to all prostitutes; but you give una gifts to all una lovers, and bribe dem, that dem may come to you on every side for una prostitution.
You be different from other women in una prostitution, in that Nobody follows you to play the prostitute; and whereas you give hire, and no hire is given to you, so You be different.”’
“So, prostitute, hear Baba God’s word:

‘Thus says the Lord Baba God, “Because una filthiness was poured out, and una nakedness uncovered through una prostitution with una lovers; and because of all the idols of una abominations, and for the blood of una pikin dem, that you give to dem;

so see, I go gather all una lovers, with whom you have taken pleasure, and all people wey you have love, with all people wey you have hated; I go even gather dem against you on every side, and will uncover una nakedness to dem, that dem may see all una nakedness.
I go judge you, as women who break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I go bring on you the blood of serious anger and jealousy.

I go also give you into dem hand, and Dem go throw down una vaulted place, and break down una lofty places; and Dem go strip you of una clothes, and take una beautiful jewels. Dem go leave you naked and bare.
Dem go also bring up a company against you, and Dem go stone you with stones, and thrust you through with dem swords.
Dem go burn una houses with fire, and execute judgments on you in the sight of many women. I go cause you to cease from playing the prostitute, and You go also give no hire any more.
So will I cause my serious anger toward you to rest, and my jealousy will depart from you. I go be quiet, and Go be no more angry.

“‘“Because you have not remember the days of una youth, but have raged against me in all these things; so, see am, I also will bring una way on una head,” says the Lord Baba God: “and you no go commit this lewdness with all una abominations.
“‘“See am, Everybody wey uses proverbs shall use this proverb against you, saying, ‘As is the mother, so is her daughter.’

You be the daughter of una mother, who loathes her husband and her pikin dem; and You be the sister of una sisters, who loathed dem husbands and dem pikin dem. Una mother was a Hittite, and una father an Amorite.
Una elder sister is Samaria, who dwells at una left hand, she and her daughters; and una younger sister, who dwells at una right hand, is Sodom and her daughters.
Yet you have not walked in dem ways, nor done after dem abominations; but, soon you were more corrupt than dem in all una ways.
As I live,” says the Lord Baba God, “Sodom una sister has not done, she nor her daughters, as you have done, you and una daughters.
“‘“See am, this was the wickedness of una sister Sodom: pride, fullness of bread, and prosperous ease was in her and in her daughters; neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
Dem were haughty, and committed abomination before me. So I take dem away when I see it.
Neither has Samaria committed half of una sins; but you have multiplied una abominations more than dem, and have justified una sisters by all una abominations which you have done.

You also, bear una own shame yourself, in that you have given judgment for una sisters; through una sins that you have committed more abominable than dem, Dem be more righteous that you. Yes, be also confounded, and bear una shame, in that you have justified una sisters.
“‘“I go turn again dem captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, and the captivity of una captives among dem;
that you may bear una own shame, and may be ashamed because of all that you have done, in that You be a comfort to dem.
Una sisters, Sodom and her daughters, will return to dem former estate; and Samaria and her daughters will return to dem former estate; and you and una daughters will return to una former estate.
For una sister Sodom No be mentioned by una mouth in the day of una pride,
before una wickedness was uncovered, as at the time of the reproach of the daughters of Syria, and of all Wey be around her, the daughters of the Philistines, who do despite to you all around.
You have borne una lewdness and una abominations,” says Baba God.
“‘For thus says the Lord Baba God: “I go also deal with you as you have done, who have despised the oath in breaking the covenant.
Nevertheless I go remember my covenant with you in the days of una youth, and I go establish to you an everlasting covenant.
Then You go remember una ways and be ashamed, when you receive una sisters, una elder sisters and una younger; and I go give dem to you for daughters, but not by una covenant.
I go establish my covenant with you; and You go know that I be Baba God;
that you may remember, and be confounded, and never open una mouth any more, because of una shame, when I have forgiven you all that you have done,” says the Lord Baba God.’”
Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
“Son of Man, tell a riddle, and speak a parable to the house of Israel;
and say, ‘Thus says the Lord Baba God: “A great eagle with great wings and long feathers, full of feathers, which had various colors, come to Lebanon, and take the top of the cedar.
He cropped off the topmost of its young twigs, and carried it to a land of traffic. He planted it in a city of merchants.
“‘“He also take some of the seed of the land, and planted it in fruitful soil. He placed it beside many waters. He set it as a willow tree.
It grew, and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and its roots were under him. So it became a vine, produced branches, and shot out sprigs.

“‘“There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers. See am, this vine bent its roots toward him, and shot out its branches toward him, from the beds of its plantation, that he might water it.
It was planted in a good soil by many waters, that it might produce branches, and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a good vine.”’

“Say, ‘Thus says the Lord Baba God: “Will it prosper? No go he pull up its roots, and cut off its fruit, that it may wither; that all its fresh springing leaves may wither? Not by a strong arm or many people can it be raised from its roots.
Yes, see am, being planted, shall it prosper? No go it utterly wither when the east wind touches it? It will wither in the beds where it grew.”’”
Moreover Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
“Say now to the rebellious house, ‘No you know what these things mean?’ Tell dem, ‘See am, the king of Babylon come to Jerusalem, and take its king, and its princes, and bring dem to him to Babylon.
He take some of the royal offspring, and made a covenant with him. He also bring him under an oath, and take away the mighty of the land;
that the kingdom might be bring low, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping his covenant it might stand.

But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that dem might give him horses and many people. Will he prosper? Will person wey does such things escape? Will he break the covenant, and still escape?

“‘As I live,’ says the Lord Baba God, ‘surely in the place where the king dwells who made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he broke, even with him in the middle of Babylon he will die.
Neither shall Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company help him in the war, when dem throw up mounds and build forts, to cut off many persons.
For he has despised the oath by breaking the covenant; and see am, he had given his hand, and yet has done all these things. He no go escape.
“So thus says the Lord Baba God: ‘As I live, surely my oath that he has despised, and my covenant that he has broken, I go even bring it on his own head.
I go spread my net on him, and he go be taken in my snare, and I go bring him to Babylon, and will enter into judgment with him there for his trespass that he has trespassed against me.
All his fugitives in all his bands shall fall by the sword, and people wey remain go be scattered toward every wind: and You go know that I, Baba God, have spoken it.’

“Thus says the Lord Baba God: ‘I go also take some of the lofty top of the cedar, and will plant it. I go crop off from the topmost of its young twigs a tender one, and I go plant it on a high and lofty mountain.
I go plant it in the mountain of the height of Israel; and it will produce boughs, and bear fruit, and be a good cedar. Birds of every kind will live in the shade of its branches.

All the trees of the field will know that I, Baba God, have bring down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish. I, Baba God, have spoken and have done it.’”
Baba God’s word come to me again, saying,
“What do you mean, that you use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, ‘The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the pikin dem’s teeth are set on edge’?
“As I live,” says the Lord Baba God, “you no go use this proverb any more in Israel.
See am, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine: the soul who sins, he shall die.
“But if a man is just, and does that which is lawful and right,
and has not eaten on the mountains, neither has lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, neither has defiled his neighbor’s wife, neither has come near to a woman in her impurity,
and has not wronged any, but has restored to the debtor his pledge, has taken nothing by robbery, has given his bread to the hungry, and has covered the naked with a garment;
person wey has not lent on interest, neither has taken any increase, who has withdrawn his hand from wickedness, has executed true justice between man and man,
has walked in my statutes, and has kept my ordinances, to deal truly; he is just, he shall surely live,” says the Lord Baba God.
“If he fathers a son Wey be a robber who sheds blood, and wey do any one of these things,
or wey No do any of those things, but even has eaten at the mountain shrines, and defiled his neighbor’s wife,
has wronged the poor and needy, has taken by robbery, has not restored the pledge, and has lifted up his eyes to the idols, has committed abomination,
has lent on interest, and has taken increase; shall he then live? He no go live. He has done all these abominations. He shall surely die. His blood go be on him.
“Now, see am, if he fathers a son, wey see all his father’s sins, which he has done, and fears, and No dey such like;
who has not eaten on the mountains, neither has lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, has not defiled his neighbor’s wife,
neither has wronged any, has not taken anything to pledge, neither has taken by robbery, but has given his bread to the hungry, and has covered the naked with a garment;

who has withdrawn his hand from the poor, who has not received interest nor increase, has executed my ordinances, has walked in my statutes; he no go die for the wickedness of his father, he shall surely live.
As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, robbed his brother, and did that which No be good among his people, see am, he shall die in his wickedness.
“Yet you say, ‘Why no dey the son bear the wickedness of the father?’ When the son has done that which is lawful and right, and has kept all my statutes, and has done dem, he shall surely live.

The soul who sins, he shall die. The son no go bear the wickedness of the father, neither shall the father bear the wickedness of the son. The righteousness of the righteous go be on him, and the wickedness of the wicked go be on him.
“But if the wicked turns from all his sins that he has committed, and keeps all my statutes, and does that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live. He no go die.
None of his wrongdoings that he has committed go be remember against him. In his righteousness that he has done, he shall live.
Have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked?” says the Lord Baba God; “and not rather that he should return from his way, and live?

“But when the righteous turns away from his righteousness, and commits wickedness, and does according to all the abominations that the wicked man does, shall he live? None of his righteous deeds that he has done go be remember. In his trespass that he has trespassed, and in his sin that he has sinned, in dem he shall die.
“Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord No be equal.’ Hear now, house of Israel: Is my way not equal? No be una ways unequal?
When the righteous man turns away from his righteousness, and commits wickedness, and dies inside am; in his wickedness that he has done shall he die.
Again, when the wicked man turns away from his wickedness that he has committed, and does that which is lawful and right, he shall save his soul alive.
Because he considers, and turns away from all his wrongdoings that he has committed, he shall surely live. He no go die.
Yet the house of Israel says, ‘The way of the Lord No be fair.’ House of Israel, no be my ways fair? No be una ways unfair?
“So I go judge you, house of Israel, everyone according to his ways,” says the Lord Baba God. “Return, and turn unaself from all una wrongdoings; so wickedness no go be una ruin.
Throw away from you all una wrongdoings, in which you have transgressed; and make yourself a new heart and a new spirit: for why will you die, house of Israel?
For I have no pleasure in the death of him who dies,” says the Lord Baba God. “So turn unaself, and live!
“Moreover, take up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,
and say, ‘What was una mother? A lioness. She couched among lions, in the middle of the young lions she nourished her cubs.
She bring up one of her cubs. He became a young lion, and he learned to catch the prey. He devoured men.
The nations also heard of him. He was taken in dem pit; and dem bring him with hooks to the land of Egypt.
“‘Now when she see that she had waited, and her hope was lost, then she take another of her cubs, and made him a young lion.
He go up and down among the lions; he became a young lion, and he learned to catch the prey. He devoured men.
He know dem palaces, and laid waste dem cities; and the land was desolate, with its fullness, because of the noise of his roaring.
Then the nations set against him on every side from the provinces; and dem spread dem net over him. He was taken in dem pit.
Dem put him in a cage with hooks, and bring him to the king of Babylon. Dem bring him into strongholds, that his voice should no more be heard on the mountains of Israel.
“‘Una mother was like a vine, in una blood, planted by the waters. It was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.
It had strong rods for the scepters of people wey bore rule, and dem stature was exalted among the thick boughs, and dem were seen in dem height with the plenty people of dem branches.
But it was plucked up in fury, it was throw down to the ground, and the east wind dried up its fruit. Its strong rods were broken off and withered. The fire consumed dem.
Now it is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty land.
Fire has gone out of the rods of its branches. It has devoured its fruit, so that E get in it no strong rod to be a scepter to rule.’ This is a lamentation, and go be for a lamentation.”
In the seventh year, in the fifth month, the tenth day of the month, some of the elders of Israel come to inquire of Baba God, and sat before me.
Baba God’s word come to me, saying,

“Son of Man, speak to the elders of Israel, and tell dem, ‘Thus says the Lord Baba God: “Is it to inquire of me that you have come? As I live,” says the Lord Baba God, “I go not be inquired of by you.”’
“Will you judge dem, Son of Man, will you judge dem? Cause dem to know the abominations of dem fathers;

and tell dem, ‘Thus says the Lord Baba God: “In the day when I chose Israel, and swore to the offspring of the house of Jacob, and made myself known to dem in the land of Egypt, when I swore to dem, saying, ‘I be Baba God una God;’
in that day I swore to dem, to bring dem out of the land of Egypt into a land that I had searched out for dem, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands.
I talk say to dem, ‘Each of you throw away the abominations of his eyes, and no defile unaself with the idols of Egypt. I be Baba God una God.’

“‘“But dem rebelled against me, and would not listen to me. Dem didn’t all throw away the abominations of dem eyes, neither did dem forsake the idols of Egypt. Then I talk say I would pour out my serious anger on dem, to accomplish my anger against dem in the middle of the land of Egypt.
But I worked for my name’s sake, that it no suppose be profaned in the sight of the nations, among which dem were, in whose sight I made myself known to dem, in bringing dem out of the land of Egypt.
So I caused dem to go out of the land of Egypt, and bring dem into the wilderness.
I give dem my statutes, and showed dem my ordinances, which if a man does, he shall live in dem.
Moreover also I give dem my Sabbaths, to be a sign between me and dem, that dem might know that I be Baba God who sanctifies dem.

“‘“But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness. Dem didn’t walk in my statutes, and dem rejected my ordinances, which if a man keeps, he shall live in dem. Dem greatly profaned my Sabbaths. Then I talk say I would pour out my serious anger on dem in the wilderness, to consume dem.
But I worked for my name’s sake, that it no suppose be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I bring dem out.
Moreover also I swore to dem in the wilderness, that I would not bring dem into the land which I had given dem, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands;
because dem rejected my ordinances, and didn’t walk in my statutes, and profaned my Sabbaths; for dem heart go after dem idols.
Nevertheless my eye spared dem, and I didn’t destroy dem, neither did I make a full end of dem in the wilderness.
I talk say to dem pikin dem in the wilderness, ‘No walk in the statutes of una fathers, neither observe dem ordinances, nor defile unaself with dem idols.
I be Baba God una God. Walk in my statutes, and keep my ordinances, and do dem;
and make my Sabbaths holy; and dem go be a sign between me and you, that you may know that I be Baba God una God. ’

“‘“But the pikin dem rebelled against me. Dem didn’t walk in my statutes, neither kept my ordinances to do dem, which if a man do, he shall live in dem. Dem profaned my Sabbaths. Then I talk say I would pour out my serious anger on dem, to accomplish my anger against dem in the wilderness.
Nevertheless I withdrew my hand, and worked for my name’s sake, that it no suppose be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I bring dem out.
Moreover I swore to dem in the wilderness, that I would scatter dem among the nations, and disperse dem through the countries;
because dem had not executed my ordinances, but had rejected my statutes, and had profaned my Sabbaths, and dem eyes were after dem fathers’ idols.
Moreover also I give dem statutes that No be good, and ordinances in which dem no suppose live;
and I polluted dem in dem own gifts, in that dem caused all that opens the womb to pass through the fire, that I might make dem desolate, to the end that dem might know that I be Baba God.”’
“So, Son of Man, speak to the house of Israel, and tell dem, ‘Thus says the Lord Baba God: “In this moreover una fathers have blasphemed me, in that dem have committed a trespass against me.

For when I had bring dem into the land, which I swore to give to dem, then dem see every high hill, and every thick tree, and dem offered there dem sacrifices, and there dem presented the provocation of dem offering; there also dem made dem pleasant aroma, and dem poured out there dem drink offerings.
Then I talk say to dem, ‘What does the high place where you go mean?’ So its name is call Bamah to this day. ”’
“So tell the house of Israel, ‘Thus says the Lord Baba God: “Do you pollute unaself in the way of una fathers? Do you play the prostitute after dem abominations?

When you offer una gifts, when you make una sons to pass through the fire, do you pollute unaself with all una idols to this day? Shall I be inquired of by you, house of Israel? As I live, says the Lord Baba God, I go not be inquired of by you!
“‘“That which comes into una mind no go be at all, in that you say, ‘We go be as the nations, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.’
As I live, says the Lord Baba God, surely with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with serious anger poured out, I go be king over you.
I go bring you out from the peoples, and will gather you out of the countries in which You be scattered, with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with serious anger poured out.
I go bring you into the wilderness of the peoples, and there I go enter into judgment with you face to face.
Like as I entered into judgment with una fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so will I enter into judgment with you,” says the Lord Baba God.
“I go cause you to pass under the rod, and I go bring you into the bond of the covenant.

I go purge out from among you the rebels, and people wey disobey against me. I go bring dem out of the land where dem live, but dem no go enter into the land of Israel; and you shall know that I be Baba God.”

“‘As for you, house of Israel, thus says the Lord Baba God: “Go, everyone serve his idols, and hereafter also, if You go not listen to me; but you shall no more profane my holy name with una gifts, and with una idols.

For in my holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Israel,” says the Lord Baba God, “there shall all the house of Israel, all of dem, serve me in the land. There I go accept dem, and there I go require una offerings and the first fruits of una offerings, with all una holy things.

As a pleasant aroma I go accept you, when I bring you out from the peoples, and gather you out of the countries in which you Don dey scattered; and I go be sanctified in you in the sight of the nations.
You shall know that I be Baba God, when I bring you into the land of Israel, into the country which I swore to give to una fathers.
There you shall remember una ways, and all una doings, in which you have polluted unaself; and you shall loathe unaself in una own sight for all una evils that you have committed.
You shall know that I be Baba God, when I have dealt with you for my name’s sake, not according to una evil ways, nor according to una corrupt doings, you house of Israel,” says the Lord Baba God.’”
Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
“Son of Man, set una face toward the south, and preach toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the field in the South;

and tell the forest of the South, ‘Hear Baba God’s word: Thus says the Lord Baba God, “See am, I go kindle a fire in you, and it shall devour every green tree in you, and every dry tree: the flaming flame no go be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north go be burned through am.
All flesh shall see that I, Baba God, have kindled it; it no go be quenched.”’”
Then I talk say, “Ah Lord Baba God! dem say of me, ‘No be he a speaker of parables?’”
Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
“Son of Man, set una face toward Jerusalem, and preach toward the sanctuaries, and prophesy against the land of Israel.
Tell the land of Israel, ‘Baba God says: “See am, I be against you, and will draw my sword out of its sheath, and will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked.
Seeing then that I go cut off from you the righteous and the wicked, so my sword will go out of its sheath against all flesh from the south to the north.
All flesh will know that I, Baba God, have drawn my sword out of its sheath. It No go return any more.”’
“Sigh so, you Son of Man. You shall sigh before dem eyes with a broken heart and with bitterness.

It go be, when dem ask you, ‘Why do you sigh?’ that you shall say, ‘Because of the news, for it comes! Every heart will melt, all hands Go be feeble, every spirit will faint, and all knees Go be weak as water. See am, it comes, and it go be done, says the Lord Baba God.’”
Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
“Son of Man, prophesy, and say, ‘Baba God says: “A sword! A sword! It is sharpened, and also polished.
It is sharpened that it may make a slaughter. It is polished that it may be as lightning. Shall we then make mirth? The rod of my son condemns every tree.
It is given to be polished, that it may be handled. The sword is sharpened. Yes, it is polished, to give it into the hand of the killer.”’
Cry and wail, Son of Man; for it is on my people. It is on all the princes of Israel. Dem be delivered over to the sword with my people. So beat una thigh.
“For E get a trial. What if even the rod that condemns Go be no more?” says the Lord Baba God.

“You so, Son of Man, prophesy, and strike una hands together. Let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the fatally wounded. It is the sword of the great one Wey be fatally wounded, which enters into dem rooms.
I have set the threatening sword against all dem gates, that dem heart may melt, and dem stumblings be multiplied. Ah! It is made as lightning. It is pointed for slaughter.
Gather unaself together. Go to the right. Set unaself in array. Go to the left, Anywhere wey una face is set.
I go also strike my hands together, and I go cause my serious anger to rest. I, Baba God, have spoken it.”
Baba God’s word come to me again, saying,
“Also, you Son of Man, appoint two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come. Dem both shall come out of one land, and mark out a place; mark it out at the head of the way to the city.
You shall appoint a way for the sword to come to Rabbah of the pikin dem of Ammon, and to Judah in Jerusalem the fortified.
For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination. He shook the arrows back and forth. He consulted the teraphim. He looked in the liver.

In his right hand was the lot for Jerusalem, to set battering rams, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to set battering rams against the gates, to throw up mounds, to build forts.
It go be to dem as a false divination in dem sight, who have sworn oaths to dem; but he brings wickedness to memory, that dem may be taken.

“So thus says the Lord Baba God: ‘Because you have made una wickedness to be remember, in that una wrongdoings are uncovered, so that in all una doings una sins appear; because you have come to memory, you go be taken with the hand.
“‘You, deadly wounded wicked one, the prince of Israel, whose day has come, in the time of the wickedness of the end,
thus says the Lord Baba God: “Remove the turban, and take off the crown. This No go be as it was. Exalt that which is low, and abase that which is high.
I go overturn, overturn, overturn it. This also go be no more, until he comes whose right it is; and I go give it.”’

“You, Son of Man, prophesy, and say, ‘Thus says the Lord Baba God concerning the pikin dem of Ammon, and concerning dem reproach: “A sword! A sword is drawn! It is polished for the slaughter, to cause it to devour, that it may be as lightning;
while dem see for you false visions, while dem divine lies to you, to lay you on the necks of the wicked Wey be deadly wounded, whose day has come in the time of the wickedness of the end.
Cause it to return into its sheath. In the place where you were created, in the land of una birth, will I judge you.
I go pour out my indignation on you; I go blow on you with the fire of my serious anger; and I go deliver you into the hand of brutish men, skillful to destroy.
You go be for fuel to the fire. Una blood Go be in the middle of the land. You go be remember no more; for I, Baba God, have spoken it.”’”
Moreover Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
“You, Son of Man, will you judge? Will you judge the bloody city? Then cause her to know all her abominations.
You shall say, ‘Thus says the Lord Baba God: “A city that sheds blood within sheself, that her time may come, and that makes idols against sheself to defile her!

You have become guilty in una blood that you have shed, and are defiled in una idols which you have made! You have caused una days to draw near, and have come even to una years. So I have made you a reproach to the nations, and a mocking to all the countries.
People Wey near, and people Wey far from you, will mock you, you infamous one, full of tumult.
“‘“See am, the princes of Israel, everyone according to his power, Don dey in you to shed blood.
In you have dem treated father and mother with contempt. Among you dem have oppressed the foreigner. In you dem have wronged the fatherless and the widow.
You have despised my holy things, and have profaned my Sabbaths.
Slanderous men Don dey in you to shed blood. In you dem have eaten on the mountains. Dem have committed lewdness among you.
In you have dem uncovered dem fathers’ nakedness. In you have dem humbled her who was unclean in her impurity.
One has committed abomination with his neighbor’s wife; and another has lewdly defiled his daughter-in-law. Another in you has humbled his sister, his father’s daughter.
In you have dem taken bribes to shed blood. You have taken interest and increase, and you have greedily gained of una neighbors by oppression, and have forgotten me,” says the Lord Baba God.
“‘“See am, so I have struck my hand at una dishonest gain which you have made, and at una blood which Don dey within you.
Can una heart endure, or can una hands be strong, in the days that I shall deal with you? I, Baba God, have spoken it, and will do it.
I go scatter you among the nations, and disperse you through the countries. I go consume una filthiness out of you.
You go be profaned in yourself, in the sight of the nations; and you shall know that I be Baba God.”’”
Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
“Son of Man, the house of Israel has become dross to me. All of dem are brass, tin, iron, and lead in the middle of the furnace. Dem be the dross of silver.
So thus says the Lord Baba God: ‘Because you have all become dross, so, see am, I go gather you into the middle of Jerusalem.

As dem gather silver, brass, iron, lead, and tin into the middle of the furnace, to blow the fire on it, to melt it; so will I gather you in my anger and in my serious anger, and I go lay you there, and melt you.
Yes, I go gather you, and blow on you with the fire of my serious anger, and You go be melted in the middle of it.
As silver is melted in the middle of the furnace, so You go be melted in the middle of it; and You go know that I, Baba God, have poured out my serious anger on you.’”
Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
“Son of Man, tell her, ‘You be a land that No be cleansed, nor rained on in the day of indignation.’
E get a conspiracy of her prophets within it, like a roaring lion ravening the prey. Dem have devoured souls. Dem take treasure and precious things. Dem have made her widows many within it.

Her priests have done violence to my law, and have profaned my holy things. Dem have made no distinction between the holy and the common, neither have dem caused men to discern between the unclean and the clean, and have hidden dem eyes from my Sabbaths, and I be profaned among dem.
Her princes within it are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, and to destroy souls, that dem may get dishonest gain.
Her prophets have plastered for dem with whitewash, seeing false visions, and divining lies to dem, saying, ‘Thus says the Lord Baba God,’ when Baba God has not spoken.
The people of the land have used oppression, and exercised robbery. Yes, dem have troubled the poor and needy, and have oppressed the foreigner wrongfully.
“I sought for a man among dem, who should build up the wall, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I no suppose destroy it; but I find Nobody.
So I have poured out my indignation on dem. I have consumed dem with the fire of my serious anger. I have bring dem own way on dem heads,” says the Lord Baba God.
Baba God’s word come again to me, saying,
“Son of Man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother.
Dem played the prostitute in Egypt. Dem played the prostitute in dem youth. Dem breasts were fondled there, and dem youthful nipples were caressed there.
Dem names were Oholah the elder, and Oholibah her sister. Dem became mine, and dem bore sons and daughters. As for dem names, Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem Oholibah.
“Oholah played the prostitute when she was mine. She doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbors,
who were clothed with blue, governors and rulers, all of dem desirable young men, horsemen riding on horses.
She give sheself as a prostitute to dem, the choicest men of Assyria all of dem. She defiled sheself with the idols of Anybody wey she lusted after.
She hasn’t left her prostitution since leaving Egypt; for in her youth dem lay with her. Dem carressed her youthful nipples; and dem poured out dem prostitution on her.
“So I delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians, on whom she doted.
These uncovered her nakedness. Dem take her sons and her daughters; and dem killed her with the sword. She became a byword among women; for dem executed judgments on her.
“Her sister Oholibah see this, yet she was more corrupt in her lusting than she, and in her prostitution which was more depraved than the prostitution of her sister.
She lusted after the Assyrians, governors and rulers, her neighbors, clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding on horses, all of dem desirable young men.
I see that she was defiled. Dem both go the same way.
