“She increased her prostitution; for she see men portrayed on the wall, the images of the Chaldeans portrayed with vermilion,
dressed with girdles on dem waists, with flowing turbans on dem heads, all of dem looking like princes, after the likeness of the Babylonians in Chaldea, the land of dem birth.
As soon as she see dem she lusted after dem, and sent messengers to dem into Chaldea.
The Babylonians come to her into the bed of love, and dem defiled her with dem prostitution. She was polluted with dem, and her soul was alienated from dem.
So she uncovered her prostitution, and uncovered her nakedness. Then my soul was alienated from her, just like my soul was alienated from her sister.
Yet she multiplied her prostitution, remembering the days of her youth, in which she had played the prostitute in the land of Egypt.
She lusted after dem paramours, whose flesh is as the flesh of donkeys, and whose issue is like the issue of horses.
Thus you call to memory the lewdness of una youth, in the caressing of una nipples by the Egyptians because of una youthful breasts.
“So, Oholibah, thus says the Lord Baba God: ‘See am, I go raise up una lovers against you, from whom una soul is alienated, and I go bring dem against you on every side:
the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, Shoa, Koa, and all the Assyrians with dem; desirable young men, governors and rulers all of dem, princes and men of renown, all of dem riding on horses.

Dem go come against you with weapons, chariots, and wagons, and with a company of peoples. Dem go set themselves against you with buckler, shield, and helmet all around. I go commit the judgment to dem, and Dem go judge you according to dem judgments.

I go set my jealousy against you, and Dem go deal with you in fury; Dem go take away una nose and una ears; and una remnant will fall by the sword. Dem go take una sons and una daughters; and una residue Go be devoured by the fire.
Dem go also strip you of una clothes, and take away una beautiful jewels.
Thus I go make una lewdness to cease from you, and remove una prostitution from the land of Egypt; so that You go not lift up una eyes to dem, nor remember Egypt any more.’
“For thus says the Lord Baba God: ‘See am, I go deliver you into the hand of dem whom you hate, into the hand of dem from whom una soul is alienated.
Dem go deal with you in hatred, and will take away all una labor, and shall leave you naked and bare. The nakedness of una prostitution Go be uncovered, both una lewdness and una prostitution.
These things Go be done to you, because you have played the prostitute after the nations, and because You be polluted with dem idols.
You have walked in the way of una sister; so will I give her cup into una hand.’
“Thus says the Lord Baba God: ‘You go drink of una sister’s cup, which is deep and large. You go be ridiculed and held in derision. It contains much.
You go be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of una sister Samaria.
You go even drink it and drain it out. You go gnaw the broken pieces of it, and will tear una breasts; for I have spoken it,’ says the Lord Baba God.
“So thus says the Lord Baba God: ‘Because you have forgotten me, and throw me behind una back, so you also bear una lewdness and una prostitution.’”
Baba God talk say moreover to me: “Son of Man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then declare to dem dem abominations.

For dem have committed adultery, and blood is in dem hands. Dem have committed adultery with dem idols. Dem have also caused dem sons, whom dem bore to me, to pass through the fire to dem to be devoured.
Moreover this dem have done to me: dem have defiled my sanctuary in the same day, and have profaned my Sabbaths.
For when dem had slain dem pikin dem to dem idols, then dem come the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and see am, thus have dem done in the middle of my house.

“Furthermore you sisters have sent for men who come from far away, to whom a messenger was sent, and see am, dem come; for whom you washed yourself, painted una eyes, decorated yourself with ornaments,
and sat on a stately bed, with a table prepared before it, whereupon you set my incense and my oil.
“The voice of a plenty people being at ease was with her. With men of the common sort were bring drunkards from the wilderness; and dem put bracelets on dem hands, and beautiful crowns on dem heads.
Then I talk say of her who was old in adulteries, ‘Now Dem go play the prostitute with her, and she with dem.’
Dem go in to her, as dem go in to a prostitute. So dem go in to Oholah and to Oholibah, the lewd women.
Righteous men will judge dem with the judgment of adulteresses and with the judgment of women who shed blood; because Dem be adulteresses, and blood is in dem hands.
“For thus says the Lord Baba God: ‘I go bring up a company against dem, and will give dem to be tossed back and forth and robbed.
The company will stone dem with stones, and dispatch dem with dem swords. Dem go kill dem sons and dem daughters, and burn up dem houses with fire.
“‘Thus I go cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to be lewd like you.
Dem shall recompense una lewdness on you, and You go bear the sins of una idols; and you shall know that I be the Lord Baba God.’”
Again, in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
Son of Man, write the name of the day, this same day. The king of Babylon drew close to Jerusalem this same day.
Utter a parable to the rebellious house, and tell dem, Thus says the Lord Baba God, Set on the cauldron, set it on, and also pour water into it:
gather its pieces into it, even every good piece, the thigh, and the shoulder; fill it with the choice bones.
Take the choice of the flock, and also a pile of wood for the bones under the cauldron; make it boil well; yes, let its bones be boiled within it.
So thus says the Lord Baba God: Woe to the bloody city, to the cauldron whose rust is inside am, and whose rust No be gone out of it! take out of it piece after piece; No lot is fallen on it.
For her blood is in the middle of her; she set it on the bare rock; she didn’t pour it on the ground, to cover it with dust.
That it may cause serious anger to come up to take vengeance, I have set her blood on the bare rock, that it no suppose be covered.
So thus says the Lord Baba God: Woe to the bloody city! I also will make the pile great.
Heap on the wood, make the fire hot, boil the meat well, and make the broth thick, and let the bones be burned.
Then set it empty on its coals, that it may be hot, and its brass may burn, and that its filthiness may be molten in it, that its rust may be consumed.
She is weary with toil; yet her great rust, rust by fire, no dey leave her.
In una filthiness is lewdness: because I have cleansed you and you no be cleansed, you no go be cleansed from una filthiness any more, until I have caused my serious anger toward you to rest.

I, Baba God, have spoken it: it shall happen, and I go do it: I go not go back, neither will I spare, neither will I repent; according to una ways, and according to una doings, shall dem judge you, says the Lord Baba God.
Also Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
Son of Man, see am, I go take away from you the desire of una eyes with a stroke: yet you shall neither mourn nor weep, neither shall una tears run down.
Sigh, but not aloud, make no mourning for the dead; bind una headdress on you, and put una shoes on una feet, and no cover una lips, and no eat men’s bread.
So I spoke to the people in the morning; and at evening my wife died; and I did in the morning as I was commanded.
The people talk say to me, No go you tell us what these things are to us, that you do so?
Then I talk say to dem, Baba God’s word come to me, saying,

Speak to the house of Israel, Thus says the Lord Baba God: See am, I go profane my sanctuary, the pride of una power, the desire of una eyes, and that which una soul pities; and una sons and una daughters whom you have left behind shall fall by the sword.
You shall do as I have done: you no go cover una lips, nor eat the bread of men.
Una tires go be on una heads, and una shoes on una feet: you no go mourn nor weep; but you shall pine away in una iniquities, and moan one toward another.
Thus Ezekiel go be a sign to you; according to all that he has done, You go do. When this comes, then You go know that I be the Lord Baba God.
You, Son of Man, shall it not be in the day when I take from dem dem strength, the gladness of dem glory, the desire of dem eyes, and that whereupon dem set dem heart, dem sons and dem daughters,
that in that day person wey escapes shall come to you, to cause you to hear it with una ears?
In that day una mouth Go be opened to him who has escaped, and you shall speak, and be no more mute: so You go be a sign to dem; and dem shall know that I be Baba God.
Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
Son of Man, set una face toward the pikin dem of Ammon, and prophesy against dem:

and tell the pikin dem of Ammon, Hear the word of the Lord Baba God: Thus says the Lord Baba God, Because you talk say, Aha, against my sanctuary, when it was profaned; and against the land of Israel, when it was made desolate; and against the house of Judah, when dem go into captivity:

so, see am, I go deliver you to the pikin dem of the east for a possession, and dem shall set dem encampments in you, and make dem dwellings in you; dem shall eat una fruit, and dem shall drink una milk.
I go make Rabbah a stable for camels, and the pikin dem of Ammon a resting place for flocks: and you shall know that I be Baba God.
For thus says the Lord Baba God: Because you have clapped una hands, and stamped with the feet, and rejoiced with all the despite of una soul against the land of Israel;

so, see am, I have stretched out my hand on you, and will deliver you for a plunder to the nations; and I go cut you off from the peoples, and I go cause you to perish out of the countries: I go destroy you; and you shall know that I be Baba God.
Thus says the Lord Baba God: Because Moab and Seir say, See am, the house of Judah is like all the nations;
so, see am, I go open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon, and Kiriathaim,
to the pikin dem of the east, to go against the pikin dem of Ammon; and I go give dem for a possession, that the pikin dem of Ammon may not be remember among the nations.
and I go execute judgments on Moab; and dem shall know that I be Baba God.
Thus says the Lord Baba God: Because Edom has dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and has greatly offended, and revenged imself on dem;
so thus says the Lord Baba God, I go stretch out my hand on Edom, and will cut off man and animal from it; and I go make it desolate from Teman; even to Dedan shall dem fall by the sword.

I go lay my vengeance on Edom by the hand of my people Israel; and dem shall do in Edom according to my anger and according to my serious anger; and dem shall know my vengeance, says the Lord Baba God.
Thus says the Lord Baba God: Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge, and have taken vengeance with despite of soul to destroy with perpetual hostility;
so thus says the Lord Baba God, See am, I go stretch out my hand on the Philistines, and I go cut off the Cherethites, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.
I go execute great vengeance on dem with wrathful rebukes; and dem shall know that I be Baba God, when I shall lay my vengeance on dem.
In the eleventh year, in the first of the month, Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
Son of Man, because Tyre has talk say against Jerusalem, Aha, she is broken: the gate of the peoples; she is turned to me; I go be replenished, now that she is laid waste:
so thus says the Lord Baba God, See am, I be against you, Tyre, and will cause many nations to come up against you, as the sea causes its waves to come up.
Dem shall destroy the walls of Tyre, and break down her towers: I go also scrape her dust from her, and make her a bare rock.
She go be a place for the spreading of nets in the middle of the sea; for I have spoken it, says the Lord Baba God; and she shall become a plunder to the nations.
Her daughters Wey be in the field go be slain with the sword: and dem shall know that I be Baba God.

For thus says the Lord Baba God: See am, I go bring on Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, from the north, with horses, and with chariots, and with horsemen, and a company, and many people.
He shall kill una daughters in the field with the sword; and he shall make forts against you, and throw up a mound against you, and raise up the buckler against you.
He shall set his battering engines against una walls, and with his axes he shall break down una towers.

By reason of the abundance of his horses dem dust shall cover you: una walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen, and of the wagons, and of the chariots, when he shall enter into una gates, as men enter into a city in which is made a breach.
With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all una streets; he shall kill una people with the sword; and the pillars of una strength shall go down to the ground.

Dem shall make a plunder of una riches, and make a prey of una merchandise; and dem shall break down una walls, and destroy una pleasant houses; and dem shall lay una stones and una timber and una dust in the middle of the waters.
I go cause the noise of una songs to cease; and the sound of una harps go be no more heard.
I go make you a bare rock; you go be a place for the spreading of nets; you go be built no more: for I Baba God have spoken it, says the Lord Baba God.
Thus says the Lord Baba God to Tyre: no go the islands shake at the sound of una fall, when the wounded groan, when the slaughter is made within you?

Then all the princes of the sea shall come down from dem thrones, and lay aside dem robes, and strip off dem embroidered garments: dem shall clothe themselves with trembling; dem shall sit on the ground, and shall tremble every moment, and be astonished at you.

Dem shall take up a lamentation over you, and tell you, How You be destroyed, who were inhabited by seafaring men, the renowned city, who was strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, who caused dem terror to be on all who lived there!
Now shall the islands tremble in the day of una fall; yes, the islands that are in the sea go be dismayed at una departure.
For thus says the Lord Baba God: When I shall make you a desolate city, like the cities that No be inhabited; when I shall bring up the deep on you, and the great waters shall cover you;

then I go bring you down with people wey descend into the pit, to the people of old time, and will make you to live in the lower parts of the earth, in the places that are desolate of old, with people wey go down to the pit, that you be not inhabited; and I go set glory in the land of the living:
I go make you a terror, and you shall no more have any being; though You be sought for, yet You go never be find again, says the Lord Baba God.
Baba God’s word come again to me, saying,
You, Son of Man, take up a lamentation over Tyre;
and tell Tyre, you who live at the entry of the sea, Wey be the merchant of the peoples to many islands, thus says the Lord Baba God: You, Tyre, have talk say, I be perfect in beauty.
Una borders are in the heart of the seas; una builders have perfected una beauty.
Dem have made all una planks of cypress trees from Senir; dem have taken a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for you.
Of the oaks of Bashan have dem made una oars; dem have made una benches of ivory inlaid in boxwood, from the islands of Kittim.
Una sail was of fine linen with embroidered work from Egypt, that it might be to you for a banner; blue and purple from the islands of Elishah was una awning.
The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were una rowers: una wise men, Tyre, were in you, dem were una pilots.
The old men of Gebal and its wise men were una repairers of ship seams in you: all the ships of the sea with dem mariners were in you to deal in una merchandise.
Persia and Lud and Put were in una army, una men of war: dem hanged the shield and helmet in you; dem showed una beauty.
The men of Arvad with una army were on una walls all around, and valorous men were in una towers; dem hung dem shields on una walls all around; dem have perfected una beauty.
Tarshish was una merchant by reason of the plenty people of all kinds of riches; with silver, iron, tin, and lead, dem traded for una wares.
Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, dem were una traffickers; dem traded the persons of men and vessels of brass for una merchandise.
Dem of the house of Togarmah traded for una wares with horses and war horses and mules.
The men of Dedan were una traffickers; many islands were the market of una hand: dem bring you in exchange horns of ivory and ebony.
Syria was una merchant by reason of the plenty people of una handiworks: dem traded for una wares with emeralds, purple, and embroidered work, and fine linen, and coral, and rubies.
Judah, and the land of Israel, dem were una traffickers: dem traded for una merchandise wheat of Minnith, and confections, and honey, and oil, and balm.
Damascus was una merchant for the plenty people of una handiworks, by reason of the plenty people of all kinds of riches, with the wine of Helbon, and white wool.
Vedan and Javan traded with yarn for una wares: bright iron, cassia, and calamus, were among una merchandise.
Dedan was una trafficker in precious cloths for riding.
Arabia, and all the princes of Kedar, dem were the merchants of una hand; in lambs, and rams, and goats, in these were dem una merchants.
The traffickers of Sheba and Raamah, dem were una traffickers; dem traded for una wares with the chief of all spices, and with all precious stones, and gold.
Haran and Canneh and Eden, the traffickers of Sheba, Asshur and Chilmad, were una traffickers.
These were una traffickers in choice wares, in wrappings of blue and embroidered work, and in chests of rich clothing, bound with cords and made of cedar, among una merchandise.
The ships of Tarshish were una caravans for una merchandise: and you were replenished, and made very glorious in the heart of the seas.
Una rowers have bring you into great waters: the east wind has broken you in the heart of the seas.

Una riches, and una wares, una merchandise, una mariners, and una pilots, una repairers of ship seams, and the dealers in una merchandise, and all una men of war, Wey be in you, with all una company which is among you, shall fall into the heart of the seas in the day of una ruin.
At the sound of the cry of una pilots the suburbs shall shake.
All who handled the oar, the mariners, and all the pilots of the sea, shall come down from dem ships; dem shall stand on the land,
and shall cause dem voice to be heard over you, and shall cry bitterly, and shall throw up dust on dem heads, dem shall wallow themselves in the ashes:
and dem shall make themselves bald for you, and clothe dem with sackcloth, and dem shall weep for you in bitterness of soul with bitter mourning.
In dem wailing dem shall take up a lamentation for you, and lament over you, saying, Wey be there like Tyre, like her Wey be bring to silence in the middle of the sea?
When una wares go out of the seas, you filled many peoples; you enriched the kings of the earth with the plenty people of una riches and of una merchandise.
In the time that you were broken by the seas in the depths of the waters, una merchandise and all una company fell within you.
All the inhabitants of the islands are astonished at you, and dem kings are horribly afraid; Dem be troubled in dem face.
The merchants among the peoples hiss at you; you have become a terror, and You go be no more.
Baba God’s word come again to me, saying,

Son of Man, tell the prince of Tyre, Thus says the Lord Baba God: Because una heart is lifted up, and you have talk say, I be a god, I sit in the seat of God, in the middle of the seas; yet You be man, and not God, though you set una heart as the heart of God —
see am, You be wiser than Daniel; E get no secret that is hidden from you;
by una wisdom and by una understanding you have gotten yourself riches, and have gotten gold and silver into una treasures;
by una great wisdom and by una traffic you have increased una riches, and una heart is lifted up because of una riches —
so thus says the Lord Baba God: Because you have set una heart as the heart of God,
so, see am, I go bring strangers on you, the terrible of the nations; and dem shall draw dem swords against the beauty of una wisdom, and dem shall defile una brightness.
Dem shall bring you down to the pit; and you shall die the death of people Wey slain, in the heart of the seas.
Will you yet say before him who kills you, I be God? but You be man, and not God, in the hand of him who wounds you.
You shall die the death of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers: for I have spoken it, says the Lord Baba God.
Moreover Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
Son of Man, take up a lamentation over the king of Tyre, and tell him, Thus says the Lord Baba God: You were the seal of full measure, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.

You were in Eden, the garden of God; every precious stone adorned you: ruby, topaz, emerald, chrysolite, onyx, jasper, sapphire, turquoise, and beryl. Gold work of tambourines and of pipes was in you. In the day that you were created dem were prepared.
You were the anointed cherub who covers: and I set you, so that you were on the holy mountain of God; you have walked up and down in the middle of the stones of fire.
You were perfect in una ways from the day that you were created, until unrighteousness was find in you.

By the abundance of una traffic dem filled una insides with violence, and you have sinned: so I have throw you as profane out of the mountain of God; and I have destroyed you, covering cherub, from the middle of the stones of fire.
Una heart was lifted up because of una beauty; you have corrupted una wisdom by reason of una brightness: I have throw you to the ground; I have laid you before kings, that dem may see you.

By the plenty people of una iniquities, in the unrighteousness of una traffic, you have profaned una sanctuaries; so I have bring out a fire from the middle of you; it has devoured you, and I have turned you to ashes on the earth in the sight of all people wey see you.
All people wey know you among the peoples go be astonished at you: you have become a terror, and you shall exist no more.
Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
Son of Man, set una face toward Sidon, and prophesy against it,

and say, Thus says the Lord Baba God: See am, I be against you, Sidon; and I go be glorified among you; and dem shall know that I be Baba God, when I go get executed judgments in her, and go be sanctified in her.
For I go send pestilence into her, and blood into her streets; and the wounded shall fall within her, with the sword on her on every side; and dem shall know that I be Baba God.
There go be no more a pricking brier to the house of Israel, nor a hurting thorn of any that are around dem, that scorned dem; and dem shall know that I be the Lord Baba God.

Thus says the Lord Baba God: When I go get gathered the house of Israel from the peoples among whom Dem be scattered, and go be sanctified in dem in the sight of the nations, then shall dem live in dem own land which I give to my worker Jacob.

Dem shall live securely inside am; yes, dem shall build houses, and plant vineyards, and shall live securely, when I have executed judgments on all people wey do dem despite all around dem; and dem shall know that I be Baba God dem God.
In the tenth year, in the tenth month, on the twelfth day of the month, Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
“Son of Man, set una face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him and against all Egypt.

Speak and say, ‘Thus says the Lord Baba God: “See am, I be against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great monster that lies in the middle of his rivers, that has talk say, ‘My river is my own, and I have made it for myself.’
I go put hooks in una jaws, and I go make the fish of una rivers stick to una scales; and I go bring you up out of the middle of una rivers, with all the fish of una rivers which stick to una scales.

I’ll throw you out into the wilderness, you and all the fish of una rivers. You’ll fall on the open field. You no go be bring together, nor gathered. I have given you for chop to the animals of the earth and to the birds of the sky.
All the inhabitants of Egypt will know that I be Baba God, because dem Don dey a staff of reed to the house of Israel.
When dem take hold of you by una hand, you broke, and tore all dem shoulders; and when dem leaned on you, you broke, and paralyzed all of dem thighs.”
So thus says the Lord Baba God: “See am, I go bring a sword on you, and will cut off man and animal from you.
The land of Egypt go be a desolation and a waste; and dem shall know that I be Baba God. Because he has talk say, ‘The river is mine, and I have made it;’
so, see am, I be against you, and against una rivers, and I go make the land of Egypt an utter waste and desolation, from the tower of Seveneh even to the border of Ethiopia.
No foot of man shall pass through it, nor foot of animal shall pass through it, neither shall it be inhabited forty years.

I go make the land of Egypt a desolation in the middle of the countries that are desolate; and her cities among the cities that are laid waste go be a desolation forty years; and I go scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse dem through the countries.”
For thus says the Lord Baba God: “At the end of forty years will I gather the Egyptians from the peoples where dem were scattered;
and I go bring back the captivity of Egypt, and will cause dem to return into the land of Pathros, into the land of dem birth; and dem go be there a base kingdom.
It go be the base of the kingdoms; neither shall it any more lift itself up above the nations: and I go diminish dem, that dem shall no more rule over the nations.
It go be no more the confidence of the house of Israel, bringing wickedness to memory, when dem turn to look after dem: and dem shall know that I be the Lord Baba God.”’”
E happen say in the seven and twentieth year, in the first month, in the first day of the month, Baba God’s word come to me, saying,

Son of Man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyre: every head was made bald, and every shoulder was worn; yet had he no wages, nor his army, from Tyre, for the service that he had served against it.

So thus says the Lord Baba God: See am, I go give the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and he shall carry off her plenty people, and take her plunder, and take her prey; and it go be the wages for his army.
I have given him the land of Egypt as his recompense for which he served, because dem worked for me, says the Lord Baba God.
In that day will I cause a horn to sprout for the house of Israel, and I go give you the opening of the mouth among dem; and dem shall know that I be Baba God.
Baba God’s word come again to me, saying,
Son of Man, prophesy, and say, Thus says the Lord Baba God: Wail, Alas for the day!
For the day is near, even the day of Baba God is near; it go be a day of clouds, a time of the nations.
A sword shall come on Egypt, and anguish go be in Ethiopia, when the slain shall fall in Egypt; and dem shall take away her plenty people, and her foundations go be broken down.
Ethiopia, and Put, and Lud, and all the mixed people, and Cub, and the pikin dem of the land that is allied with dem, shall fall with dem by the sword.
Baba God says: Dem also who uphold Egypt shall fall; and the pride of her power shall come down: dem shall fall by the sword in it from the tower of Seveneh, says the Lord Baba God.
Dem go be desolate in the middle of the countries that are desolate; and her cities go be in the middle of the cities that are wasted.
Dem shall know that I be Baba God, when I have set a fire in Egypt, and all her helpers are destroyed.
In that day messengers will go out from before me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid; and there go be anguish on dem, as in the day of Egypt; for, see am, it comes.
Thus says the Lord Baba God: I go also make the plenty people of Egypt to cease, by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
He and his people with him, the terrible of the nations, go be bring in to destroy the land; and dem shall draw dem swords against Egypt, and fill the land with the slain.
I go make the rivers dry, and will sell the land into the hand of evil men; and I go make the land desolate, and all that is inside am, by the hand of strangers: I, Baba God, have spoken it.

Thus says the Lord Baba God: I go also destroy the idols, and I go cause the images to cease from Memphis; and there go be no more a prince from the land of Egypt: and I go put a fear in the land of Egypt.
I go make Pathros desolate, and will set a fire in Zoan, and will execute judgments on No.
I go pour my serious anger on Sin, the stronghold of Egypt; and I go cut off the plenty people of No.
I go set a fire in Egypt: Sin go be in great anguish, and No go be broken up; and Memphis go get adversaries in the daytime.
The young men of Aven and of Pibeseth shall fall by the sword; and dem shall go into captivity.

At Tehaphnehes also the day shall withdraw itself, when I shall break there the yokes of Egypt, and the pride of her power shall cease in her: as for her, a cloud shall cover her, and her daughters shall go into captivity.
Thus will I execute judgments on Egypt; and dem shall know that I be Baba God.
In the eleventh year, in the first month, in the seventh day of the month, Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
Son of Man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and see am, it has not been bound up, to apply medicines, to put a bandage to bind it, that it be strong to hold the sword.
So thus says the Lord Baba God: See am, I be against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, the strong arm, and that which was broken; and I go cause the sword to fall out of his hand.
I go scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse dem through the countries.
I go strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put my sword in his hand: but I go break the arms of Pharaoh, and he shall groan before him with the groaning of a mortally wounded man.

I go hold up the arms of the king of Babylon; and the arms of Pharaoh shall fall down; and dem shall know that I be Baba God, when I shall put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall stretch it out on the land of Egypt.
I go scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and disperse dem through the countries; and dem shall know that I be Baba God.
In the eleventh year, in the third month, in the first day of the month, Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
Son of Man, tell Pharaoh king of Egypt, and to his plenty people: Whom are you like in una greatness?
See am, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with beautiful branches, and with a forest-like shade, and of high stature; and its top was among the thick boughs.
The waters nourished it, the deep made it to grow: its rivers ran all around its plantation; and it sent out its channels to all the trees of the field.
So its stature was exalted above all the trees of the field; and its boughs were multiplied, and its branches became long by reason of many waters, when it spread dem out.
All the birds of the sky made dem nests in its boughs; and under its branches all the animals of the field give birth to dem young; and all great nations lived under its shadow.
Thus was it beautiful in its greatness, in the length of its branches; for its root was by many waters.

The cedars in the garden of God could not hide it; the cypress trees No be like its boughs, and the pine trees were No be like its branches; nor was any tree in the garden of God like it in its beauty.
I made it beautiful by the plenty people of its branches, so that all the trees of Eden, that were in the garden of God, envied it.
So thus talk say the Lord Baba God: Because You be exalted in stature, and he has set his top among the thick boughs, and his heart is lifted up in his height;
I go even deliver him into the hand of the mighty one of the nations; he shall surely deal with him; I have driven him out for his wickedness.

Strangers, the terrible of the nations, have cut him off, and have left him: on the mountains and in all the valleys his branches are fallen, and his boughs are broken by all the watercourses of the land; and all the peoples of the earth are gone down from his shadow, and have left him.
On his ruin all the birds of the sky shall live, and all the animals of the field go be on his branches;

to the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves in dem stature, neither set dem top among the thick boughs, nor that dem mighty ones stand up on dem height, even all who drink water: for Dem be all delivered to death, to the lower parts of the earth, among the pikin dem of men, with people wey go down to the pit.

Thus says the Lord Baba God: In the day when he go down to Sheol I caused a mourning: I covered the deep for him, and I restrained its rivers; and the great waters were stayed; and I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.

I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I throw him down to Sheol with people wey descend into the pit; and all the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, were comforted in the lower parts of the earth.
Dem also go down into Sheol with him to people Wey slain by the sword; yes, people wey were his arm, who lived under his shadow in the middle of the nations.

To whom are you thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? yet You go be bring down with the trees of Eden to the lower parts of the earth: you shall lie in the middle of the uncircumcised, with people Wey slain by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his plenty people, says the Lord Baba God.
In the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, in the first day of the month, Baba God’s word come to me, saying,

Son of Man, take up a lamentation over Pharaoh king of Egypt, and tell him, You were likened to a young lion of the nations: yet You be as a monster in the seas; and you broke out with una rivers, and troubled the waters with una feet, and fouled dem rivers.
Thus says the Lord Baba God: I go spread out my net on you with a company of many peoples; and dem shall bring you up in my net.
I go leave you on the land, I go throw you out on the open field, and will cause all the birds of the sky to settle on you, and I go satisfy the animals of the whole earth with you.
I go lay una flesh on the mountains, and fill the valleys with una height.
I go also water with una blood the land in which you swim, even to the mountains; and the watercourses go be full of you.
When I shall extinguish you, I go cover the heavens, and make its stars dark; I go cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon no go give its light.
I go make all the bright lights of the sky dark over you, and set darkness on una land, says the Lord Baba God.
I go also trouble the hearts of many peoples, when I shall bring una destruction among the nations, into the countries which you have not known.

Yes, I go make many peoples amazed at you, and dem kings go be horribly afraid for you, when I shall brandish my sword before dem; and dem shall tremble at every moment, every man for his own life, in the day of una fall.
For thus says the Lord Baba God: The sword of the king of Babylon shall come on you.

By the swords of the mighty will I cause una plenty people to fall; Dem be all the ruthless of the nations: and dem shall bring to nothing the pride of Egypt, and all its plenty people go be destroyed.
I go destroy also all its animals from beside many waters; neither shall the foot of man trouble dem any more, nor the hoofs of animals trouble dem.
Then will I make dem waters clear, and cause dem rivers to run like oil, says the Lord Baba God.
When I shall make the land of Egypt desolate and waste, a land destitute of that of which it was full, when I shall strike all people wey live inside am, then shall dem know that I be Baba God.

This is the lamentation with which dem shall lament; the daughters of the nations shall lament therewith; over Egypt, and over all her plenty people, shall dem lament therewith, says the Lord Baba God.
Also in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth day of the month, Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
Son of Man, wail for the plenty people of Egypt, and throw dem down, even her, and the daughters of the famous nations, to the lower parts of the earth, with people wey go down into the pit.
Whom do you pass in beauty? Go down, and be laid with the uncircumcised.
Dem shall fall among people Wey slain by the sword: she is delivered to the sword; draw her away and all her plenty people.
The strong among the mighty shall speak to him out of the middle of Sheol with people wey help him: Dem be gone down, dem lie still, even the uncircumcised, slain by the sword.
Asshur is there and all her company; her graves are all around her; all of dem slain, fallen by the sword;
whose graves are set in the uttermost parts of the pit, and her company is around her grave; all of dem slain, fallen by the sword, who caused terror in the land of the living.

E get Elam and all her plenty people around her grave; all of dem slain, fallen by the sword, Wey be gone down uncircumcised into the lower parts of the earth, who caused dem terror in the land of the living, and have borne dem shame with people wey go down to the pit.

Dem have set her a bed among the slain with all her plenty people; her graves are around her; all of dem uncircumcised, slain by the sword; for dem terror was caused in the land of the living, and dem have borne dem shame with people wey go down to the pit: he is put among people Wey slain.
E get Meshech, Tubal, and all dem plenty people; dem graves are around dem; all of dem uncircumcised, slain by the sword; for dem caused dem terror in the land of the living.

Dem no go lie with the mighty Wey be fallen of the uncircumcised, who have gone down to Sheol with dem weapons of war, and have laid dem swords under dem heads, and dem iniquities are on dem bones; for dem were the terror of the mighty in the land of the living.
But you go be broken among the uncircumcised, and shall lie with people Wey slain by the sword.
E get Edom, her kings and all her princes, who in dem might are laid with people Wey slain by the sword: dem shall lie with the uncircumcised, and with people wey go down to the pit.

E get the princes of the north, all of dem, and all the Sidonians, Wey be gone down with the slain; in the terror which dem caused by dem might Dem be put to shame; and dem lie uncircumcised with people Wey slain by the sword, and bear dem shame with people wey go down to the pit.
Pharaoh shall see dem, and go be comforted over all his plenty people, even Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword, says the Lord Baba God.
For I have put his terror in the land of the living; and he go be laid among the uncircumcised, with people Wey slain by the sword, even Pharaoh and all his plenty people, says the Lord Baba God.
Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
Son of Man, speak to the pikin dem of una people, and tell dem, When I bring the sword on a land, and the people of the land take a man from among dem, and set him for dem watchman;
if, when he sees the sword come on the land, he blow the trumpet, and warn the people;
then Anybody wey hears the sound of the trumpet, and no dey take warning, if the sword come, and take him away, his blood go be on his own head.
He heard the sound of the trumpet, and didn’t take warning; his blood go be on him; whereas if he had taken warning, he would have delivered his soul.

But if the watchman sees the sword come, and no dey blow the trumpet, and the people no be warned, and the sword comes, and take any person from among dem; he is taken away in his wickedness, but his blood will I require at the watchman’s hand.
So you, Son of Man, I have set you a watchman to the house of Israel; so hear the word at my mouth, and give dem warning from me.
When I tell the wicked, O wicked man, you shall surely die, and you no speak to warn the wicked from his way; that wicked man shall die in his wickedness, but his blood will I require at una hand.
Nevertheless, if you warn the wicked of his way to turn from it, and he no dey turn from his way; he shall die in his wickedness, but you have delivered una soul.
You, Son of Man, tell the house of Israel: Thus you speak, saying, Our wrongdoings and our sins are on us, and we pine away in dem; how then can we live?

Tell dem, As I live, says the Lord Baba God, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked turn from his way and live: turn, turn from una evil ways; for why will you die, house of Israel?

You, Son of Man, tell the pikin dem of una people, The righteousness of the righteous no go deliver him in the day of his disobedience; and as for the wickedness of the wicked, he no go fall through am in the day that he turns from his wickedness; neither shall person Wey righteous be able to live through am in the day that he sins.

When I tell the righteous, that he shall surely live; if he trust to his righteousness, and commit wickedness, none of his righteous deeds go be remember; but in his wickedness that he has committed, inside am shall he die.
Again, when I say to the wicked, You shall surely die; if he turn from his sin, and do that which is lawful and right;
if the wicked restore the pledge, give again that which he had taken by robbery, walk in the statutes of life, committing no wickedness; he shall surely live, he no go die.
None of his sins that he has committed go be remember against him: he has done that which is lawful and right; he shall surely live.
Yet the pikin dem of una people say, The way of the Lord No be equal: but as for dem, dem way No be equal.
When the righteous turns from his righteousness, and commits wickedness, he shall even die inside am.
When the wicked turns from his wickedness, and does that which is lawful and right, he shall live through am.
Yet you say, The way of the Lord No be equal. House of Israel, I go judge every one of you after his ways.
In the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth month, in the fifth day of the month, one who had escaped out of Jerusalem come to me, saying, The city Don dey struck.
Now Baba God’s hand Bin dey on me in the evening, before person wey was escaped come; and he had opened my mouth, until he come to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no more mute.
Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
Son of Man, dem who inhabit those waste places in the land of Israel speak, saying, Abraham was one, and he inherited the land: but We be many; the land is given us for inheritance.
So tell dem, Thus says the Lord Baba God: You eat with the blood, and lift up una eyes to una idols, and shed blood: and shall you possess the land?
You stand on una sword, you work abomination, and every one of you defiles his neighbor’s wife: and shall you possess the land?

You shall tell dem, Thus says the Lord Baba God: As I live, surely people Wey in the waste places shall fall by the sword; and him Wey be in the open field will I give to the animals to be devoured; and people Wey in the strongholds and in the caves shall die of the pestilence.
I go make the land a desolation and an astonishment; and the pride of her power shall cease; and the mountains of Israel go be desolate, so that Nobody shall pass through.
Then shall dem know that I be Baba God, when I have made the land a desolation and an astonishment, because of all dem abominations which dem have committed.

As for you, Son of Man, the pikin dem of una people talk of you by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak to each other, everyone to his brother, saying, Please come and hear Wetin be the word that comes out from Baba God.
Dem come to you as the people come, and dem sit before you as my people, and dem hear una words, but no do dem; for with dem mouth dem show much love, but dem heart goes after dem gain.
See am, You be to dem as a very lovely song of one who has a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument; for dem hear una words, but dem no do dem.
When this comes to pass, (see am, it comes), then shall dem know that a prophet Don dey among dem.
Baba God’s word come to me, saying,

Son of Man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel, prophesy, and tell dem, even to the shepherds, Thus says the Lord Baba God: Woe to the shepherds of Israel who feed themselves! Shouldn’t the shepherds feed the sheep?
You eat the fat, and you clothe yourself with the wool, you kill the fatlings; but you no feed the sheep.

You haven’t strengthened the diseased, neither have you healed that which was sick, neither have you bound up that which was broken, neither have you bring back that which was driven away, neither have you sought that which was lost; but with force and with rigor you have ruled over dem.
Dem were scattered, because there was no shepherd; and dem became chop to all the animals of the field, and were scattered.
My sheep wandered through all the mountains, and on every high hill: yes, my sheep were scattered on all the surface of the earth; and there was Nobody who searched or sought.
So, you shepherds, hear Baba God’s word:

As I live, says the Lord Baba God, surely because my sheep became a prey, and my sheep became chop to all the animals of the field, because there was no shepherd, neither did my shepherds search for my sheep, but the shepherds fed themselves, and didn’t feed my sheep;
so, you shepherds, hear Baba God’s word:

Thus says the Lord Baba God: See am, I be against the shepherds; and I go require my sheep at dem hand, and cause dem to cease from feeding the sheep; neither shall the shepherds feed themselves any more; and I go deliver my sheep from dem mouth, that dem may not be chop for dem.
For thus says the Lord Baba God: See am, I myself, even I, will search for my sheep, and will seek dem out.

As a shepherd seeks out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered abroad, so will I seek out my sheep; and I go deliver dem out of all places where dem Don dey scattered in the cloudy and dark day.

I go bring dem out from the peoples, and gather dem from the countries, and will bring dem into dem own land; and I go feed dem on the mountains of Israel, by the watercourses, and in all the inhabited places of the country.
I go feed dem with good pasture; and on the mountains of the height of Israel shall dem fold be: there shall dem lie down in a good fold; and on fat pasture shall dem feed on the mountains of Israel.
I myself Go be the shepherd of my sheep, and I go cause dem to lie down, says the Lord Baba God.

I go seek that which was lost, and will bring back that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick: but the fat and the strong I go destroy; I go feed dem in justice.
As for you, O my flock, thus says the Lord Baba God: See am, I judge between sheep and sheep, the rams and the male goats.

Does it seem a small thing to you to have fed on the good pasture, but you must tread down with una feet the residue of una pasture? and to have drunk of the clear waters, but you must foul the residue with una feet?
As for my sheep, dem eat that which you have trodden with una feet, and dem drink that which you have fouled with una feet.
So thus says the Lord Baba God to dem: See am, I, even I, will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.
Because you thrust with side and with shoulder, and push all the diseased with una horns, until you have scattered dem abroad;
so will I save my flock, and dem shall no more be a prey; and I go judge between sheep and sheep.
I go set up one shepherd over dem, and he shall feed dem, even my worker David; he shall feed dem, and he go be dem shepherd.
I, Baba God, Go be dem God, and my worker David prince among dem; I, Baba God, have spoken it.
I go make with dem a covenant of peace, and will cause evil animals to cease out of the land; and dem shall live securely in the wilderness, and sleep in the woods.
I go make dem and the places around my hill a blessing; and I go cause the shower to come down in its season; there go be showers of blessing.

The tree of the field shall yield its fruit, and the earth shall yield its increase, and dem go be secure in dem land; and dem shall know that I be Baba God, when I have broken the bars of dem yoke, and have delivered dem out of the hand of people wey made slaves of dem.
Dem shall no more be a prey to the nations, neither shall the animals of the earth devour dem; but dem shall live securely, and Nobody shall make dem afraid.
I go raise up to dem a plantation for renown, and dem go be no more consumed with famine in the land, neither bear the shame of the nations any more.
Dem shall know that I, Baba God, dem God am with dem, and that dem, the house of Israel, are my people, says the Lord Baba God.
You my sheep, the sheep of my pasture, are men, and I be una God, says the Lord Baba God.
Moreover Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
Son of Man, set una face against Mount Seir, and prophesy against it,
and tell it, Thus says the Lord Baba God: See am, I be against you, Mount Seir, and I go stretch out my hand against you, and I go make you a desolation and an astonishment.
I go lay una cities waste, and you go be desolate; and you shall know that I be Baba God.
Because you have had a perpetual hostility, and have given over the pikin dem of Israel to the power of the sword in the time of dem calamity, in the time of the wickedness of the end;
so, as I live, says the Lord Baba God, I go prepare you for blood, and blood shall pursue you: since you have not hated blood, so blood shall pursue you.
Thus will I make Mount Seir an astonishment and a desolation; and I go cut off from it him who passes through and him who returns.
I go fill its mountains with its slain: in una hills and in una valleys and in all una watercourses shall dem fall Wey be slain with the sword.
I go make you a perpetual desolation, and una cities no go be inhabited; and you shall know that I be Baba God.
Because you have talk say, These two nations and these two countries go be mine, and We go possess it; whereas Baba God was there:

so, as I live, says the Lord Baba God, I go do according to una anger, and according to una envy which you have shown out of una hatred against dem; and I go make myself known among dem, when I shall judge you.
You shall know that I, Baba God, have heard all una insults which you have spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, Dem be laid desolate, dem Don dey given us to devour.
You have magnified unaself against me with una mouth, and have multiplied una words against me: I have heard it.
Thus says the Lord Baba God: When the whole earth rejoices, I go make you desolate.

As you rejoiced over the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate, so will I do to you: you go be desolate, Mount Seir, and all Edom, even all of it; and dem shall know that I be Baba God.
You, Son of Man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel, and say, You mountains of Israel, hear Baba God’s word.
Thus says the Lord Baba God: Because the enemy has talk say against you, Aha! and, The ancient high places are ours in possession;

so prophesy, and say, Thus says the Lord Baba God: Because, even because dem have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that you might be a possession to the residue of the nations, and You be taken up in the lips of talkers, and the evil report of the people;

so, you mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord Baba God: Thus says the Lord Baba God to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes and to the cities that are forsaken, which are become a prey and derision to the residue of the nations that are all around;

so thus says the Lord Baba God: Surely in the fire of my jealousy I have spoken against the residue of the nations, and against all Edom, that have appointed my land to themselves for a possession with the gladness of all dem heart, with despite of soul, to throw it out for a prey.

So prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and tell the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys, Thus says the Lord Baba God: See am, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my serious anger, because you have borne the shame of the nations:
so thus says the Lord Baba God: I have sworn, Surely the nations that are around you, dem shall bear dem shame.
But you, mountains of Israel, you shall shoot out una branches, and yield una fruit to my people Israel; for Dem be at hand to come.
For, see am, I be for you, and I go turn into you, and you go be tilled and sown;
and I go multiply men on you, all the house of Israel, even all of it; and the cities go be inhabited, and the waste places go be built;

and I go multiply on you man and animal; and dem shall increase and be fruitful; and I go cause you to be inhabited after una former estate, and You go do better than at una beginnings: and you shall know that I be Baba God.
Yes, I go cause men to walk on you, even my people Israel; and dem shall possess you, and you go be dem inheritance, and you shall no more from now bereave dem of pikin dem.
Thus says the Lord Baba God: Because dem say to you, You be a devourer of men, and Don dey a bereaver of una nation;
so you shall devour men no more, neither bereave una nation any more, says the Lord Baba God;

neither will I let you hear any more the shame of the nations, neither shall you bear the reproach of the peoples any more, neither shall you cause una nation to stumble any more, says the Lord Baba God.
Moreover Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
Son of Man, when the house of Israel lived in dem own land, dem defiled it by dem way and by dem doings: dem way before me was as the uncleanness of a woman in her impurity.
So I poured out my serious anger on dem for the blood which dem had poured out on the land, and because dem had defiled it with dem idols;
and I scattered dem among the nations, and dem were dispersed through the countries: according to dem way and according to dem doings I judged dem.
When dem come to the nations, where dem go, dem profaned my holy name; in that men talk say of dem, These are the people of Baba God, and are gone out of his land.
But I had respect for my holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations, where dem go.
So tell the house of Israel, Thus says the Lord Baba God: I no do this for una sake, house of Israel, but for my holy name, which you have profaned among the nations, where you go.

I go sanctify my great name, which Don dey profaned among the nations, which you have profaned among dem; and the nations shall know that I be Baba God, says the Lord Baba God, when I go be sanctified in you before dem eyes.
For I go take you from among the nations, and gather you out of all the countries, and will bring you into una own land.
I go sprinkle clean water on you, and you go be clean: from all una filthiness, and from all una idols, will I cleanse you.
I go also give you a new heart, and I go put a new spirit within you; and I go take away the stony heart out of una flesh, and I go give you a heart of flesh.
I go put my Spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes, and you shall keep my ordinances, and do dem.
You shall live in the land that I give to una fathers; and you go be my people, and I go be una God.
I go save you from all una uncleanness: and I go call for the grain, and will multiply it, and lay no famine on you.
I go multiply the fruit of the tree, and the increase of the field, that you may receive no more the reproach of famine among the nations.
Then you shall remember una evil ways, and una doings that No be good; and you shall loathe unaself in una own sight for una iniquities and for una abominations.
Nor for una sake do I this, says the Lord Baba God, be it known to you: be ashamed and confounded for una ways, house of Israel.
Thus says the Lord Baba God: In the day that I cleanse you from all una iniquities, I go cause the cities to be inhabited, and the waste places go be built.
The land that was desolate go be tilled, whereas it was a desolation in the sight of all who passed by.
Dem shall say, This land that was desolate has become like the garden of Eden; and the waste and desolate and ruined cities are fortified and inhabited.
Then the nations that are left around you shall know that I, Baba God, have built the ruined places, and planted that which was desolate: I, Baba God, have spoken it, and I go do it.
Thus says the Lord Baba God: For this, moreover, will I be inquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for dem: I go increase dem with men like a flock.
As the flock for sacrifice, as the flock of Jerusalem in her appointed feasts, so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men; and dem shall know that I be Baba God.
Baba God’s hand was on me, and he bring me out in Baba God’s Spirit, and set me down in the middle of the valley; and it was full of bones.
He caused me to pass by dem all around: and see am, there were very many in the open valley; and see am, dem were very dry.
He talk say to me, Son of Man, can these bones live? I answer, Lord Baba God, you know.
Again he talk say to me, Prophesy over these bones, and tell dem, you dry bones, hear Baba God’s word.
Thus says the Lord Baba God to these bones: See am, I go cause breath to enter into you, and you shall live.
I go lay sinews on you, and will bring up flesh on you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and you shall live; and you shall know that I be Baba God.
So I prophesied as I was commanded: and as I prophesied, there was a noise, and see am, an earthquake; and the bones come together, bone to its bone.
I see, and, see am, there were sinews on dem, and flesh come up, and skin covered dem above; but there was no breath in dem.
Then he talk say to me, Prophesy to the wind, prophesy, Son of Man, and tell the wind, Thus says the Lord Baba God: Come from the four winds, breath, and breathe on these slain, that dem may live.
So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath come into dem, and dem lived, and stood up on dem feet, an exceedingly great army.
Then he talk say to me, Son of Man, these bones are the whole house of Israel: see am, dem say, Our bones are dried up, and our hope is lost; We be clean cut off.
So prophesy, and tell dem, Thus says the Lord Baba God: See am, I go open una graves, and cause you to come up out of una graves, my people; and I go bring you into the land of Israel.
You shall know that I be Baba God, when I have opened una graves, and caused you to come up out of una graves, my people.
I go put my Spirit in you, and you shall live, and I go place you in una own land: and you shall know that I, Baba God, have spoken it and performed it, says Baba God.
Baba God’s word come again to me, saying,

You, Son of Man, take one stick, and write on it, For Judah, and for the pikin dem of Israel his companions: then take another stick, and write on it, For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and for all the house of Israel his companions:
and join dem for you to each other into one stick, that dem may become one in una hand.
When the pikin dem of una people shall speak to you, saying, Will you not show us Wetin you mean by these?

tell dem, Thus says the Lord Baba God: See am, I go take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his companions; and I go put dem with it, with the stick of Judah, and make dem one stick, and dem go be one in my hand.
The sticks whereon you write go be in una hand before dem eyes.
Say to dem, Thus says the Lord Baba God: See am, I go take the pikin dem of Israel from among the nations, where Dem be gone, and will gather dem on every side, and bring dem into dem own land:

and I go make dem one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel; and one king go be king to dem all; and dem go be no more two nations, neither shall dem be divided into two kingdoms any more at all;

neither shall dem defile themselves any more with dem idols, nor with dem detestable things, nor with any of dem wrongdoings; but I go save dem out of all dem dwelling places, in which dem have sinned, and will cleanse dem: so shall dem be my people, and I go be dem God.
My worker David go be king over dem; and dem all go get one shepherd: dem shall also walk in my ordinances, and observe my statutes, and do dem.

Dem shall live in the land that I have given to Jacob my worker, in which una fathers lived; and dem shall live inside am, dem, and dem pikin dem, and dem pikin dem’s pikin dem, forever: and David my worker go be dem prince for ever.
Moreover I go make a covenant of peace with dem; it go be an everlasting covenant with dem; and I go place dem, and multiply dem, and will set my sanctuary among dem forever more.
My tent also go be with dem; and I go be dem God, and dem go be my people.
The nations shall know that I be Baba God who sanctifies Israel, when my sanctuary go be among dem forever more.
Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
Son of Man, set una face toward Gog, of the land of Magog, the prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal, and prophesy against him,
and say, Thus says the Lord Baba God: See am, I be against you, Gog, prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal:

and I go turn you around, and put hooks into una jaws, and I go bring you out, with all una army, horses and horsemen, all of dem clothed in full armor, a great company with buckler and shield, all of dem handling swords;
Persia, Cush, and Put with dem, all of dem with shield and helmet;
Gomer, and all his hordes; the house of Togarmah in the uttermost parts of the north, and all his hordes; even many peoples with you.
Be prepared, yes, prepare yourself, you, and all una companies Wey be assembled to you, and be a guard to dem.

After many days you go be visited: in the latter years you shall come into the land that is bring back from the sword, that is gathered out of many peoples, on the mountains of Israel, which Don dey a continual waste; but it is bring out of the peoples, and dem shall live securely, all of dem.
You shall ascend, you shall come like a storm, you go be like a cloud to cover the land, you, and all una hordes, and many peoples with you.
Thus says the Lord Baba God: It shall happen in that day, that things shall come into una mind, and you shall devise an evil device:
and you shall say, I go go up to the land of unwalled villages; I go go to people Wey at rest, who live securely, all of dem dwelling without walls, and having neither bars nor gates;

to take the plunder and to take the prey; to turn una hand against the waste places that are inhabited, and against the people Wey be gathered out of the nations, who have gotten livestock and goods, who live in the middle of the earth.

Sheba, and Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish, with all the young lions of it, shall tell you, Have you come to take the plunder? have you assembled una company to take the prey? to carry away silver and gold, to take away livestock and goods, to take great plunder?
So, Son of Man, prophesy, and tell Gog, Thus says the Lord Baba God: In that day when my people Israel dwells securely, shall you not know it?
You shall come from una place out of the uttermost parts of the north, you, and many peoples with you, all of dem riding on horses, a great company and a mighty army;

and you shall come up against my people Israel, as a cloud to cover the land: it shall happen in the latter days, that I go bring you against my land, that the nations may know me, when I go be sanctified in you, Gog, before dem eyes.
Thus says the Lord Baba God: Are you he of whom I spoke in old time by my workers the prophets of Israel, who prophesied in those days for years that I would bring you against dem?
It shall happen in that day, when Gog shall come against the land of Israel, says the Lord Baba God, that my serious anger shall come up into my nostrils.
For in my jealousy and in the fire of my serious anger I have spoken, Surely in that day there go be a great shaking in the land of Israel;

so that the fish of the sea, and the birds of the sky, and the animals of the field, and all creeping things who creep on the earth, and all the men Wey be on the surface of the earth, shall shake at my presence, and the mountains go be thrown down, and the steep places shall fall, and every wall shall fall to the ground.
I go call for a sword against him to all my mountains, says the Lord Baba God: every man’s sword go be against his brother.

With pestilence and with blood will I enter into judgment with him; and I go rain on him, and on his hordes, and on the many peoples Wey be with him, an overflowing shower, and great hailstones, fire, and sulfur.
I go magnify myself, and sanctify myself, and I go make myself known in the eyes of many nations; and dem shall know that I be Baba God.
You, Son of Man, prophesy against Gog, and say, Thus says the Lord Baba God: See am, I be against you, Gog, prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal:
and I go turn you around, and will lead you on, and will cause you to come up from the uttermost parts of the north; and I go bring you on the mountains of Israel;
and I go strike una bow out of una left hand, and will cause una arrows to fall out of una right hand.
You shall fall on the mountains of Israel, you, and all una hordes, and the peoples Wey be with you: I go give you to the ravenous birds of every sort, and to the animals of the field to be devoured.
You shall fall on the open field; for I have spoken it, says the Lord Baba God.
I go send a fire on Magog, and on people wey live securely in the islands; and dem shall know that I be Baba God.
My holy name will I make known among my people Israel; neither will I allow my holy name to be profaned any more: and the nations shall know that I be Baba God, the Holy One in Israel.
See am, it comes, and it go be done, says the Lord Baba God; this is the day about which I have spoken.

People wey live in the cities of Israel shall go out, and shall make fires of the weapons and burn dem, both the shields and the bucklers, the bows and the arrows, and the war clubs, and the spears, and dem shall make fires of dem seven years;

so that dem shall take no wood out of the field, neither cut down any out of the forests; for dem shall make fires of the weapons; and dem shall plunder people wey plundered dem, and rob people wey robbed dem, says the Lord Baba God.

It shall happen in that day, that I go give to Gog a place for burial in Israel, the valley of people wey pass through on the east of the sea; and it shall stop people wey pass through: and there shall dem bury Gog and all his plenty people; and dem shall call it The valley of Hamon Gog.
Seven months shall the house of Israel be burying dem, that dem may cleanse the land.
Yes, all the people of the land shall bury dem; and it go be to dem a renown in the day that I go be glorified, says the Lord Baba God.

Dem shall set apart men of continual employment, who shall pass through the land, and, with people wey pass through, people wey bury people wey remain on the surface of the land, to cleanse it: after the end of seven months shall dem search.
People wey pass through the land shall pass through; and when any sees a man’s bone, then shall he set up a sign by it, until the undertakers have buried it in the valley of Hamon Gog.
Hamonah shall also be the name of a city. Thus shall dem cleanse the land.

You, Son of Man, thus says the Lord Baba God: Speak to the birds of every sort, and to every animal of the field, Assemble unaself, and come; gather unaself on every side to my sacrifice that I do sacrifice for you, even a great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel, that you may eat meat and drink blood.
You shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams, of lambs, and of goats, of bulls, all of dem fatlings of Bashan.
You shall eat fat until you be full, and drink blood until You be drunk, of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.
You go be filled at my table with horses and chariots, with mighty men, and with all men of war, says the Lord Baba God.
I go set my glory among the nations; and all the nations shall see my judgment that I have executed, and my hand that I have laid on dem.
So the house of Israel shall know that I be Baba God dem God, from that day and forward.

The nations shall know that the house of Israel go into captivity for dem wickedness; because dem trespassed against me, and I hid my face from dem: so I give dem into the hand of dem adversaries, and dem fell all of dem by the sword.
According to dem uncleanness and according to dem wrongdoings did I to dem; and I hid my face from dem.
So thus says the Lord Baba God: Now will I bring back the captivity of Jacob, and have mercy on the whole house of Israel; and I go be jealous for my holy name.
Dem shall bear dem shame, and all dem trespasses by which dem have trespassed against me, when dem shall live securely in dem land, and Nobody shall make dem afraid;
when I have bring dem back from the peoples, and gathered dem out of dem enemies’ lands, and am sanctified in dem in the sight of many nations.
Dem shall know that I be Baba God dem God, in that I caused dem to go into captivity among the nations, and have gathered dem to dem own land; and I go leave none of dem any more there;
neither will I hide my face any more from dem; for I have poured out my Spirit on the house of Israel, says the Lord Baba God.

In the twenty-fifth year of our captivity, For the beginning of the year, in the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after that the city was struck, in the same day, Baba God’s hand was on me, and he bring me there.
In the visions of God bring he me into the land of Israel, and set me down on a very high mountain, whereon was as it were the frame of a city on the south.
He bring me there; and, see am, there was a man, whose appearance was like the appearance of brass, with a line of flax in his hand, and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.

The man talk say to me, Son of Man, see with una eyes, and hear with una ears, and set una heart on all that I shall show you; for, to the intent that I may show dem to you, You be bring here: declare all that you see to the house of Israel.

See am, a wall on the outside of the house all around, and in the man’s hand a measuring reed six cubits long, of a cubit and a hand width each: so he measured the thickness of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.
Then come he to the gate which looks toward the east, and go up its steps: and he measured the threshold of the gate, one reed wide; and the other threshold, one reed wide.
Every lodge was one reed long, and one reed wide; and between the lodges was five cubits; and the threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate toward the house was one reed.
He measured also the porch of the gate toward the house, one reed.
Then measured he the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and its posts, two cubits; and the porch of the gate was toward the house.
The lodges of the gate eastward were three on this side, and three on that side; dem three were of one measure: and the posts had one measure on this side and on that side.
He measured the width of the opening of the gate, ten cubits; and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits;
and a border before the lodges, one cubit on this side, and a border, one cubit on that side; and the lodges, six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.
He measured the gate from the roof of the one lodge to the roof of the other, a width of twenty-five cubits; door against door.
He made also posts, sixty cubits; and the court reached to the posts, around the gate.
From the forefront of the gate at the entrance to the forefront of the inner porch of the gate were fifty cubits.
There were closed windows to the lodges, and to dem posts within the gate all around, and likewise to the arches; and windows were around inward; and on each post were palm trees.
Then bring he me into the outer court; and see am, there were rooms and a pavement, made for the court all around: thirty rooms were on the pavement.
The pavement was by the side of the gates, answerable to the length of the gates, even the lower pavement.
Then he measured the width from the forefront of the lower gate to the forefront of the inner court outside, one hundred cubits, both on the east and on the north.
The gate of the outer court whose prospect is toward the north, he measured its length and its width.
The lodges of it were three on this side and three on that side; and its posts and its arches were after the measure of the first gate: its length was fifty cubits, and the width twenty-five cubits.
The windows of it, and its arches, and the palm trees of it, were after the measure of the gate whose prospect is toward the east; and dem go up to it by seven steps; and its arches were before dem.
There was a gate to the inner court facing the other gate, on the north and on the east; and he measured from gate to gate one hundred cubits.
He led me toward the south; and see am, a gate toward the south: and he measured its posts and its arches according to these measurements.
There were windows in it and in its arches all around, like those windows: the length was fifty cubits, and the width twenty-five cubits.
There were seven steps to go up to it, and its arches were before dem; and it had palm trees, one on this side, and another on that side, on its posts.
There was a gate to the inner court toward the south: and he measured from gate to gate toward the south a hundred cubits.
Then he bring me to the inner court by the south gate: and he measured the south gate according to these measurements;
and its lodges, and its posts, and its arches, according to these measurements: and there were windows in it and in its arches all around; it was fifty cubits long, and twenty-five cubits wide.
There were arches all around, twenty-five cubits long, and five cubits wide.
The arches of it were toward the outer court; and palm trees were on its posts: and the ascent to it had eight steps.
He bring me into the inner court toward the east: and he measured the gate according to these measurements;
and its lodges, and its posts, and its arches, according to these measurements: and there were windows inside am and in its arches all around; it was fifty cubits long, and twenty-five cubits wide.
The arches of it were toward the outer court; and palm trees were on its posts, on this side, and on that side: and the ascent to it had eight steps.
He bring me to the north gate: and he measured it according to these measurements;
its lodges, its posts, and its arches: and there were windows inside am all around; the length was fifty cubits, and the width twenty-five cubits.
The posts of it were toward the outer court; and palm trees were on its posts, on this side, and on that side: and the ascent to it had eight steps.
A room with its door was by the posts at the gates; there dem washed the burnt offering.
In the porch of the gate were two tables on this side, and two tables on that side, on which to kill the burnt offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering.
On the one side outside, as one goes up to the entry of the gate toward the north, were two tables; and on the other side, which belonged to the porch of the gate, were two tables.
Four tables were on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate; eight tables, whereupon dem killed the sacrifices.

There were four tables for the burnt offering, of cut stone, a cubit and a half long, and a cubit and a half wide, and one cubit high; whereupon dem laid the instruments with which dem killed the burnt offering and the sacrifice.
The hooks, a hand width long, were fastened within all around: and on the tables was the meat of the offering.

Outside of the inner gate were rooms for the singers in the inner court, which was at the side of the north gate; and dem prospect was toward the south; one at the side of the east gate having the prospect toward the north.
He talk say to me, This room, whose prospect is toward the south, is for the priests, the keepers of the duty of the house;

and the room whose prospect is toward the north is for the priests, the keepers of the duty of the altar: these are the sons of Zadok, who from among the sons of Levi come near to Baba God to minister to him.
He measured the court, one hundred cubits long, and a hundred cubits wide, square; and the altar was before the house.

Then he bring me to the porch of the house, and measured each post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side: and the width of the gate was three cubits on this side, and three cubits on that side.
The length of the porch was twenty cubits, and the width eleven cubits; even by the steps by which dem go up to it: and there were pillars by the posts, one on this side, and another on that side.
He bring me to the temple, and measured the posts, six cubits wide on the one side, and six cubits wide on the other side, which was the width of the tent.

The width of the entrance was ten cubits; and the sides of the entrance were five cubits on the one side, and five cubits on the other side: and he measured its length, forty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits.
Then go he inward, and measured each post of the entrance, two cubits; and the entrance, six cubits; and the width of the entrance, seven cubits.
He measured its length, twenty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits, before the temple: and he talk say to me, This is the most holy place.
Then he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the width of every side room, four cubits, all around the house on every side.

The side rooms were in three stories, one over another, and thirty in order; and dem entered into the wall which belonged to the house for the side rooms all around, that dem might be supported, and not penetrate the wall of the house.

The side rooms were wider on the higher levels, because the walls were narrower at the higher levels. So the width of the house increased upward; and so one go up from the lowest level to the highest through the middle level.
I see also that the house had a raised base all around: the foundations of the side rooms were a full reed of six great cubits.
The thickness of the wall, which was for the side rooms, on the outside, was five cubits: and that which was left was the place of the side rooms that belonged to the house.
Between the rooms was a width of twenty cubits around the house on every side.
The doors of the side rooms were toward an open area that was left, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south. The width of the open area was five cubits all around.
The building that was before the separate place at the side toward the west was seventy cubits wide; and the wall of the building was five cubits thick all around, and its length ninety cubits.
