For, see am, Baba God comes out of his place, and will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.
The mountains melt under him, and the valleys split apart, like wax before the fire, like waters that are poured down a steep place.
“All this is for the disobedience of Jacob, and for the sins of the house of Israel. Wetin be the disobedience of Jacob? No be it Samaria? And Wetin be the high places of Judah? No be dem Jerusalem?
So I go make Samaria like a rubble heap of the field, like places for planting vineyards; and I go pour down its stones into the valley, and I go uncover its foundations.

All her idols Go be beaten to pieces, and all her temple gifts Go be burned with fire, and all her images I go destroy; for of the hire of a prostitute has she gathered dem, and to the hire of a prostitute shall dem return.”
For this I go lament and wail; I go go stripped and naked; I go howl like the jackals, and moan like the daughters of owls.
For her wounds are incurable; for it has come even to Judah. It reaches to the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.
No tell it in Gath. No weep at all. At Beth Ophrah I have rolled myself in the dust.
Pass on, inhabitant of Shaphir, in nakedness and shame. The inhabitant of Zaanan no go come out. The wailing of Beth Ezel will take from you his protection.
For the inhabitant of Maroth waits anxiously for good, because evil has come down from Baba God to the gate of Jerusalem.
Harness the chariot to the swift steed, inhabitant of Lachish. She was the beginning of sin to the daughter of Zion; For the wrongdoings of Israel were find in you.
So You go give a parting gift to Moresheth Gath. The houses of Achzib Go be a deceitful thing to the kings of Israel.
I go yet bring to you, inhabitant of Mareshah. Person Wey the glory of Israel will come to Adullam.
Shave una heads, and cut off una hair for the pikin dem of una delight. Enlarge una baldness like the vulture; for dem have gone into captivity from you!
Woe to people wey devise wickedness and work evil on dem beds! When the morning is light, dem practice it, because it is in the power of dem hand.
Dem covet fields, and seize dem; and houses, and take dem away: and dem oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.
So Baba God says: “See am, I be planning against these people a disaster, from which You go not remove una necks, neither will you walk haughtily; for it is an evil time.

In that day Dem go take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, saying, ‘We be utterly ruined! My people’s possession is divided up. Indeed he takes it from me and assigns our fields to traitors!’”
So You go have Nobody who divides the land by lot in Baba God’s assembly.
“No prophesy!” Dem prophesy. “No prophesy about these things. Disgrace no go overtake us.”
Shall it be talk say, O house of Jacob: “Is Baba God’s Spirit angry? Are these his doings? No my words do good to him who walks blamelessly?”
But lately my people have risen up as an enemy. You strip the robe and clothing from people wey pass by without a care, returning from battle.
You drive the women of my people out from dem pleasant houses; from dem young pikin dem you take away my blessing forever.
Arise, and depart! For this No be una resting place, because of uncleanness that destroys, even with a grievous destruction.
If a man walking in a spirit of falsehood lies: “I go prophesy to you of wine and of strong drink”; he would be the prophet of this people.
I go surely assemble, Jacob, all of you; I go surely gather the remnant of Israel; I go put dem together as the sheep of Bozrah, as a flock in the middle of dem pasture; Dem go swarm with people.
Person wey breaks open the way goes up before dem. Dem break through the gate, and go out. And dem king passes on before dem, with Baba God at dem head.
I talk say, “Please listen, you heads of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel: No be it for you to know justice?
You who hate the good, and love the evil; who tear off dem skin, and dem flesh from off dem bones;
who also eat the flesh of my people, and flay dem skin from off dem, and break dem bones, and chop dem in pieces, as for the pot, and as meat within the cauldron.
Then Dem go cry to Baba God, but he No go answer dem. Yes, he will hide his face from dem at that time, because dem made dem deeds evil.”
Baba God says concerning the prophets who lead my people astray; for people wey feed dem teeth, dem proclaim, “Peace!” and Anybody wey no dey provide for dem mouths, dem prepare war against him:
“So night is over you, with no vision, and it is dark to you, that you may not divine; and the sun will go down on the prophets, and the day Go be black over dem.
The seers go be disappointed, and the diviners confounded. Yes, dem shall all cover dem lips; for E get no answer from God.”
But as for me, I be full of power by Baba God’s Spirit, and of judgment, and of might, to declare to Jacob his disobedience, and to Israel his sin.
Please listen to this, you heads of the house of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel, who abhor justice, and pervert all equity.
Dem build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with wickedness.

Her leaders judge for bribes, and her priests teach for a price, and her prophets of it tell fortunes for money: yet dem lean on Baba God, and say, “No be Baba God among us? No disaster will come on us.”
So Zion for una sake Go be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem will become heaps of rubble, and the mountain of the temple like the high places of a forest.
But in the latter days, it will happen that the mountain of Baba God’s temple Go be established on the top of the mountains, and it Go be exalted above the hills; and peoples will stream to it.

Many nations will go and say, “Come, and Make we go up to the mountain of Baba God, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and We go walk in his paths.” For the law will go out of Zion, and Baba God’s word from Jerusalem;

and he will judge between many peoples, and will decide concerning strong nations far away off. Dem go beat dem swords into plowshares, and dem spears into pruning hooks. Nation No go lift up sword against nation, neither will dem learn war any more.
But Dem go sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree; and Nobody will make dem afraid: For the mouth of Baba God of Armies has spoken.
Indeed all the nations may walk in the name of dem gods; but We go walk in the name of Baba God our God forever and ever.
“In that day,” says Baba God, “I go assemble that which is lame, and I go gather that which is driven away, and that which I have afflicted;
and I go make that which was lame a remnant, and that which was throw far off a strong nation: and Baba God will reign over dem on Mount Zion from then on, even forever.”
You, tower of the flock, the hill of the daughter of Zion, to you it will come, yes, the former dominion will come, the kingdom of the daughter of Jerusalem.
Now why do you cry out aloud? Is there no king in you? Has una counselor perished, that pains have taken hold of you as of a woman in travail?

Be in pain, and labor to give birth, daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail; for now You go go out of the city, and will live in the field, and will come even to Babylon. There You go be rescued. There Baba God will redeem you from the hand of una enemies.
Now many nations have assembled against you, that say, “Make she be defiled, and let our eye gloat over Zion.”
But dem no know the thoughts of Baba God, neither do dem understand his counsel; for he has gathered dem like the sheaves to the threshing floor.

Arise and thresh, daughter of Zion; for I go make una horn iron, and I go make una hoofs brass; and You go beat in pieces many peoples: and I go devote dem gain to Baba God, and dem substance to the Lord of the whole earth.
Now you shall gather yourself in troops, daughter of troops. He has laid siege against us. Dem go strike the judge of Israel with a rod on the cheek.
But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come out to me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings out are from of old, from ancient times.
So he will abandon dem until the time that person Wey in labor gives birth. Then the rest of his brothers will return to the pikin dem of Israel.
He shall stand, and shall shepherd in the strength of Baba God, in the majesty of the name of Baba God his God: and Dem go live, for then he Go be great to every corner of the world.
He Go be our peace when Assyria invades our land, and when he marches through our fortresses, then We go raise against him seven shepherds, and eight leaders of men.
Dem go rule the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in its gates. He will deliver us from the Assyrian, when he invades our land, and when he marches within our border.
The remnant of Jacob Go be among many peoples, like dew from Baba God, like showers on the grass, that no wait for man, nor wait for the sons of men.

The remnant of Jacob Go be among the nations, among many peoples, like a lion among the animals of the forest, like a young lion among the flocks of sheep; who, if he goes through, treads down and tears in pieces, and E get Nobody to deliver.
Let una hand be lifted up above una adversaries, and let all of una enemies be cut off.
“It will happen in that day”, says Baba God, “that I go cut off una horses out from among you, and will destroy una chariots.
I go cut off the cities of una land, and will tear down all una strongholds.
I go destroy witchcraft from una hand; and you go get no soothsayers.
I go cut off una engraved images and una pillars out from among you; and you shall no more worship the work of una hands.
I go uproot una Asherah poles out from among you; and I go destroy una cities.
I go execute vengeance in anger, and serious anger on the nations that didn’t listen.”
Listen now to what Baba God says: “Arise, plead una case before the mountains, and let the hills hear Wetin you have to say.
Hear, you mountains, Baba God’s controversy, and you enduring foundations of the earth; for Baba God has a controversy with his people, and he will contend with Israel.
My people, what have I done to you? How have I burdened you? Answer me!
For I bring you up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage. I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
My people, remember now what Balak king of Moab devised, and what Balaam the son of Beor answer him from Shittim to Gilgal, that you may know the righteous acts of Baba God.”
How shall I come before Baba God, and bow myself before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old?
Will Baba God be pleased with thousands of rams? With tens of thousands of rivers of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for my disobedience? The fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
He has shown you, O man, Wetin be good. What does Baba God require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with una God?
Baba God’s voice calls to the city, and wisdom sees una name: “Listen to the rod, and person wey appointed it.
Are there yet treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and a short ephah that is accursed?
Shall I be pure with dishonest scales, and with a bag of deceitful weights?
Her rich men are full of violence, her inhabitants speak lies, and dem tongue is deceitful in dem speech.
So I also have struck you with a grievous wound. I have made you desolate because of una sins.
You shall eat, but not be satisfied. Una humiliation Go be within you. You go store up, but not save; and that which you save I go give up to the sword.
You go sow, but no go reap. You go tread the olives, but no go anoint yourself with oil; and crush grapes, but no go drink the wine.
For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of Ahab’s house. You walk in dem counsels, that I may make you a ruin, and her inhabitants a hissing; And You go bear the reproach of my people.”
Misery is mine! Indeed, I be like one who gathers the summer fruits, as gleanings of the vineyard: E get no cluster of grapes to eat. My soul desires to eat the early fig.
The godly man has perished out of the earth, and E get Nobody upright among men. Dem all lie in wait for blood; every man hunts his brother with a net.
Dem hands are on that which is evil to do it diligently. The ruler and judge ask for a bribe; and the powerful man dictates the evil desire of his soul. Thus dem conspire together.
The best of dem is like a brier. The most upright is worse than a thorn hedge. The day of una watchmen, even una visitation, has come; now is the time of dem confusion.
No trust in a neighbor. No put confidence in a friend. With the woman lying in una embrace, be careful of the words of una mouth!
For the son dishonors the father, the daughter rises up against her mother, the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; a man’s enemies are the men of his own house.
But as for me, I go look to Baba God. I go wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
No glad well-well against me, my enemy. When I fall, I go arise. When I sit in darkness, Baba God Go be a light to me.
I go bear the indignation of Baba God, because I have sinned against him, until he pleads my case, and executes judgment for me. He will bring me out to the light. I go see his righteousness.

Then my enemy will see it, and shame will cover her who talk say to me, where is Baba God una God? Then my enemy will see me and will cover her shame. Now she Go be trodden down like the mire of the streets.
A day to build una walls — In that day, he will extend una boundary.
In that day Dem go come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, and from Egypt even to the River, and from sea to sea, and mountain to mountain.
Yet the land Go be desolate because of people wey live inside am, for the fruit of dem doings.
Shepherd una people with una staff, the flock of una heritage, who live by themselves in a forest, in the middle of fertile pasture land, Make dem feed; in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.
“As in the days of una coming out of the land of Egypt, I go show dem marvelous things.”
The nations will see and be ashamed of all dem might. Dem go lay dem hand on dem mouth. Dem ears Go be deaf.
Dem go lick the dust like a serpent. Like crawling things of the earth dem shall come trembling out of dem dens. Dem go come with fear to Baba God our God, and Go be afraid because of you.
Wey be a God like you, who pardons wickedness, and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage? He no dey retain his anger forever, because he delights in loving kindness.
He will again have compassion on us. He will tread our iniquities under foot; and You go throw all dem sins into the depths of the sea.
You go give truth to Jacob, and mercy to Abraham, as you have sworn to our fathers from the days of old.
A revelation about Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
Baba God is a jealous God and avenges. Baba God avenges and is full of serious anger. Baba God takes vengeance on his adversaries, and he maintains serious anger against his enemies.
Baba God is slow to anger, and great in power, and will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. Baba God has his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.
He rebukes the sea, and makes it dry, and dries up all the rivers. Bashan languishes, and Carmel; and the flower of Lebanon languishes.
The mountains quake before him, and the hills melt away. The earth trembles at his presence, yes, the world, and all who live in it.
Who can stand before his indignation? Who can endure the fierceness of his anger? His serious anger is poured out like fire, and the rocks are broken apart by him.
Baba God is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows people wey take refuge in him.
But with an overflowing flood, he will make a full end of her place, and will pursue his enemies into darkness.
What do you plot against Baba God? He will make a full end. Suffering no go rise up the second time.
For entangled like thorns, and drunken as with dem drink, Dem be consumed utterly like dry stubble.
E get one gone out of you, who devises evil against Baba God, who counsels wickedness.
Baba God says: “Though dem be in full strength, and likewise many, even so Dem go be cut down, and he shall pass away. Though I have afflicted you, I go afflict you no more.
Now will I break his yoke from off you, and will burst una bonds apart.”

Baba God has commanded concerning you: “No more descendants will bear una name. Out of the house of una gods, will I cut off the engraved image and the molten image. I go make una grave, for You be vile.”

See am, on the mountains the feet of him who brings better news, who publishes peace! Keep una feasts, Judah! Perform una vows, for the wicked one will no more pass through you. He is utterly cut off.
Person wey dashes in pieces has come up against you. Keep the fortress! Watch the way! Strengthen una waist! Fortify una power mightily!
For Baba God restores the excellency of Jacob, as the excellency of Israel; for the destroyers have destroyed dem, and ruined dem vine branches.
The shield of his mighty men is made red. The valiant men are in scarlet. The chariots flash with steel in the day of his preparation, and the pine spears are brandished.
The chariots rage in the streets. Dem rush back and forth in the wide ways. Dem appearance is like torches. Dem run like the lightnings.
He summons his picked troops. Dem stumble on dem way. Dem dash to its wall, and the protective shield is put in place.
The gates of the rivers are opened, and the palace is dissolved.
It is decreed: she is uncovered, she is carried away; and her workers moan as with the voice of doves, beating on dem breasts.
But Nineveh Don dey from of old like a pool of water, yet dem flee away. “Stop! Stop!” dem cry, but Nobody looks back.
Take the plunder of silver. Take the plunder of gold, for E get no end of the store, the glory of all goodly furniture.
She is empty, void, and waste. The heart melts, the knees knock together, dem bodies and faces have grown pale.
Where is the den of the lions, and the feeding place of the young lions, where the lion and the lioness walked, the lion’s cubs, and Nobody made dem afraid?
The lion tore in pieces enough for his cubs, and strangled for his lionesses, and filled his caves with the kill, and his dens with prey.

“See am, I be against you,” says Baba God of Armies, “and I go burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword will devour una young lions; and I go cut off una prey from the earth, and the voice of una messengers will no longer be heard.”
Woe to the bloody city! It is all full of lies and robbery. The prey no dey depart.
The noise of the whip, the noise of the rattling of wheels, prancing horses, and bounding chariots,
the horseman mounting, and the flashing sword, the glittering spear, and a plenty people of slain, and a great heap of corpses, and E get no end of the bodies. Dem stumble on dem bodies,
because of the plenty people of the prostitution of the alluring prostitute, the mistress of witchcraft, who sells nations through her prostitution, and families through her witchcraft.
“See am, I be against you,” says Baba God of Armies, “and I go lift una skirts over una face. I go show the nations una nakedness, and the kingdoms una shame.
I go throw abominable filth on you, and make you vile, and will set you a spectacle.
It will happen that all people wey look at You go flee from you, and say, ‘Nineveh is laid waste! Who will mourn for her?’ Where will I seek comforters for you?”
Are you better than No-Amon, who was situated among the rivers, who had the waters around her; whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was of the sea?
Cush and Egypt were her boundless strength. Put and Libya were her helpers.

Yet was she carried away. She go into captivity. Her young pikin dem also were dashed in pieces at the head of all the streets, and dem throw lots for her honorable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.
You also Go be drunken. You go be hidden. You also will seek a stronghold because of the enemy.
All una fortresses Go be like fig trees with the first-ripe figs: if Dem be shaken, dem fall into the mouth of the eater.
See am, una troops among You be women. The gates of una land are set wide open to una enemies. The fire has devoured una bars.
Draw water for the siege. Strengthen una fortresses. Go into the clay, and tread the mortar. Make the brick kiln strong.
There the fire will devour you. The sword will cut you off. It will devour you like the grasshopper. Multiply like grasshoppers. Multiply like the locust.
You have increased una merchants more than the stars of the skies. The grasshopper strips, and flees away.

Una guards are like the locusts, and una officials like the swarms of locusts, which settle on the walls on a cold day, but when the sun appears, dem flee away, and dem place No be known where Dem be.
Una shepherds slumber, king of Assyria. Una nobles lie down. Una people are scattered on the mountains, and E get Nobody to gather dem.
E get no healing una wound, for una injury is fatal. All who hear the report of you clap dem hands over you; for who hasn’t felt una endless cruelty?
The revelation which Habakkuk the prophet see.
Baba God, how long will I cry, and You go not hear? I cry out to you “Violence!” and will you not save?
Why do you show me wickedness, and look at perversity? For destruction and violence are before me. E get strife, and contention rises up.
So the law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails; for the wicked surround the righteous; so justice comes out perverted.
“Look among the nations, watch, and wonder marvelously; for I be working a work in una days, which You go not believe though it is told you.
For, see am, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, that march through the width of the earth, to possess dwelling places that No be dem own.
Dem be feared and dreaded. Dem judgment and dem dignity proceed from themselves.

Dem horses also are swifter than leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves. Dem horsemen press proudly on. Yes, dem horsemen come from far away. Dem fly as an eagle that hurries to devour.
All of dem come for violence. Dem hordes face the desert. He gathers prisoners like sand.
Yes, he scoffs at kings, and princes are a derision to him. He laughs at every stronghold, for he builds up an earthen ramp, and takes it.
Then he sweeps by like the wind, and goes on. He is indeed guilty, whose strength is his god.”
No be you from everlasting, Baba God my God, my Holy One? We go not die. Baba God, you have appointed him for judgment. You, Rock, have established him to punish.

You who have purer eyes than to see evil, and who cannot look on perversity, why do you tolerate people wey deal treacherously, and keep silent when the wicked swallows up the man Wey be more righteous than he,
and make men like the fish of the sea, like the creeping things, that have no ruler over dem?
He takes up all of dem with the hook. He catches dem in his net, and gathers dem in his dragnet. So he rejoices and is glad.
So he sacrifices to his net, and burns incense to his dragnet, because by dem his life is luxurious, and his chop is good.
Will he so continually empty his net, and kill the nations without mercy?
I go stand at my watch, and set myself on the ramparts, and will look out to see what he will say to me, and what I go answer concerning my complaint.
Baba God answer me, “Write the vision, and make it plain on tablets, that person wey runs may read it.
For the vision is yet for the appointed time, and it hurries toward the end, and no go prove false. Though it takes time, wait for it; because it will surely come. It no go delay.
See am, his soul is puffed up. It No be upright in him, but the righteous will live by his faith.

Yes, moreover, wine is treacherous. A haughty man who no dey stay at home, who enlarges his desire as Sheol, and he is like death, and no fit be satisfied, but gathers to imself people for everywhere, and heaps to imself all peoples.
No go all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, ‘Woe to him who increases that which No be his, and who enriches imself by extortion! How long?’
No go una debtors rise up suddenly, and wake up people wey make you tremble, and You go be dem victim?
Because you have plundered many nations, all the remnant of the peoples will plunder you, because of men’s blood, and for the violence done to the land, to the city and to all who live in it.
Woe to him who gets an evil gain for his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the hand of evil!
You have devised shame to una house, by cutting off many peoples, and have sinned against una soul.
For the stone will cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the woodwork will answer it.
Woe to him who builds a town with blood, and establishes a city by wickedness!
See am, no be it of Baba God of Armies that the peoples labor for the fire, and the nations weary themselves for vanity?
For the earth Go be filled with the knowledge of Baba God’s glory, as the waters cover the sea.
“Woe to him wey dey give his neighbor drink, pouring una inflaming wine until Dem be drunk, so that you may gaze at dem naked bodies!
You be filled with shame, and not glory. You go also drink, and be exposed! The cup of Baba God’s right hand will come around to you, and disgrace will cover una glory.

For the violence done to Lebanon will overwhelm you, and the destruction of the animals, which made dem afraid; because of men’s blood, and for the violence done to the land, to every city and to people wey live in dem.
“What value does the engraved image have, that its maker has engraved it; the molten image, even the teacher of lies, that person wey fashions its form trusts in it, to make mute idols?
Woe to him who says to the wood, ‘Awake!’ or to the mute stone, ‘Arise!’ Shall this teach? See am, it is overlaid with gold and silver, and E get no breath at all within it.
But Baba God is in his holy temple. Let all the earth be silent before him!”
A prayer of Habakkuk, the prophet, set to victorious music.
Baba God, I have heard of una fame. I stand in awe of una deeds, Baba God. Renew una work in the middle of the years. In the middle of the years make it known. In serious anger, you remember mercy.
God come from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and his praise filled the earth.
His splendor is like the sunrise. Rays shine from his hand, where his power is hidden.
Plague go before him, and pestilence follow his feet.
He stood, and shook the earth. He looked, and made the nations tremble. The ancient mountains were crumbled. The age-old hills collapsed. His ways are eternal.
I see the tents of Cushan in suffering. The dwellings of the land of Midian trembled.
Was Baba God displeased with the rivers? Was una anger against the rivers, or una serious anger against the sea, that you rode on una horses, on una chariots of salvation?
You uncovered una bow. You call for una sworn arrows. Selah. You split the earth with rivers.
The mountains see you, and were afraid. The storm of waters passed by. The deep roared and lifted up its hands on high.
The sun and moon stood still in the sky, at the light of una arrows as dem go, at the shining of una glittering spear.
You marched through the land in serious anger. You threshed the nations in anger.
You go out for the salvation of una people, for the salvation of una anointed. You crushed the head of the land of wickedness. You stripped dem head to foot. Selah.
You pierced the heads of his warriors with dem own spears. Dem come as a whirlwind to scatter me, gloating as if to devour the wretched in secret.
You trampled the sea with una horses, churning mighty waters.

I heard, and my body trembled. My lips quivered at the voice. Rottenness enters into my bones, and I tremble in my place, because I must wait quietly for the day of trouble, for the coming up of the people who invade us.
For though the fig tree no dey flourish, nor fruit be in the vines; the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no chop; the flocks are cut off from the fold, and E get no herd in the stalls:
yet I go glad well-well in Baba God. I go be joyful in the God of my salvation!
Baba God, the Lord, is my strength. He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and enables me to go in high places. For the music director, on my stringed instruments.
Baba God’s word which come to Zephaniah, the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah, the son of Amon, king of Judah.
I go utterly sweep away everything off of the surface of the earth, says Baba God.
I go sweep away man and animal. I go sweep away the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and the heaps of rubble with the wicked. I go cut off man from the surface of the earth, says Baba God.
I go stretch out my hand against Judah, and against all the inhabitants of Jerusalem. I go cut off the remnant of Baal from this place: the name of the idolatrous and pagan priests,
people wey worship the army of the sky on the housetops, people wey worship and swear by Baba God and also swear by Malcam,
people wey have turned back from following Baba God, and people wey haven’t sought Baba God nor inquired after him.
Be silent at the presence of the Lord Baba God, for the day of Baba God is at hand. For Baba God has prepared a sacrifice. He has consecrated his guests.
It will happen in the day of Baba God’s sacrifice, that I go punish the princes, the king’s sons, and all people Wey clothed with foreign clothing.
In that day, I go punish all people wey leap over the threshold, who fill dem master’s house with violence and deceit.
In that day, says Baba God, there Go be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, a wailing from the second quarter, and a great crashing from the hills.
Wail, you inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the people of Canaan are undone! All people wey were loaded with silver are cut off.
It will happen at that time, that I go search Jerusalem with lamps, and I go punish the men Wey be settled on dem dregs, who say in dem heart, “Baba God No go do good, neither will he do evil.”
Dem wealth will become a plunder, and dem houses a desolation. Yes, Dem go build houses, but no go inhabit dem. Dem go plant vineyards, but no go drink dem wine.
The great day of Baba God is near. It is near, and hurries greatly, the voice of the day of Baba God. The mighty man cries there bitterly.
That day is a day of serious anger, a day of distress and anguish, a day of trouble and ruin, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness,
a day of the trumpet and alarm, against the fortified cities, and against the high battlements.
I go bring distress on men, that Dem go walk like blind men, because dem have sinned against Baba God, and dem blood Go be poured out like dust, and dem flesh like dung.

Neither dem silver nor dem gold Go be able to deliver dem in the day of Baba God’s serious anger, but the whole land Go be devoured by the fire of his jealousy; for he will make an end, yes, a terrible end, of all people wey live in the land.
Gather unaself together, yes, gather together, you nation that has no shame,
before the appointed time when the day passes as the chaff, before the fierce anger of Baba God comes on you, before the day of Baba God’s anger comes on you.
Seek Baba God, all you humble of the land, who have kept his ordinances. Seek righteousness. Seek humility. It may be that You go be hidden in the day of Baba God’s anger.
For Gaza Go be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation. Dem go drive out Ashdod at noonday, and Ekron Go be rooted up.
Woe to the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites! Baba God’s word is against you, Canaan, the land of the Philistines. I go destroy you, that there Go be no inhabitant.
The sea coast Go be pastures, with cottages for shepherds and folds for flocks.
The coast Go be for the remnant of the house of Judah. Dem go find pasture. In the houses of Ashkelon, Dem go lie down in the evening, for Baba God, dem God, will visit dem, and restore dem.
I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the insults of the pikin dem of Ammon, with which dem have reproached my people, and magnified themselves against dem border.

So as I live, says Baba God of Armies, the God of Israel, surely Moab Go be as Sodom, and the pikin dem of Ammon as Gomorrah, a possession of nettles, and salt pits, and a perpetual desolation. The remnant of my people will plunder dem, and the survivors of my nation will inherit dem.
This Dem go have for dem pride, because dem have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of Baba God of Armies.
Baba God Go be awesome to dem, for he will famish all the gods of the land. Men will worship him, everyone from his place, even all the shores of the nations.
You Cushites also, You go be killed by my sword.
He will stretch out his hand against the north, destroy Assyria, and will make Nineveh a desolation, as dry as the wilderness.

Herds will lie down in the middle of her, all the animals of the nations. Both the pelican and the porcupine will lodge in its capitals. Dem calls will echo through the windows. Desolation Go be in the thresholds, for he has laid bare the cedar beams.

This is the joyous city that lived carelessly, that talk say in her heart, “I be, and E get Nobody besides me.” How she has become a desolation, a place for animals to lie down in! Everybody wey passes by her will hiss, and shake dem fists.
Woe to her Wey be rebellious and polluted, the oppressing city!
She didn’t obey the voice. She didn’t receive correction. She didn’t trust in Baba God. She didn’t draw near to her God.
Her princes within her are roaring lions. Her judges are evening wolves. Dem leave nothing until the next day.
Her prophets are arrogant and treacherous people. Her priests have profaned the sanctuary. Dem have done violence to the law.
Baba God, within her, is righteous. He will do no wrong. Every morning he brings his justice to light. He no dey fail, but the unjust know no shame.
I have cut off nations. Dem battlements are desolate. I have made dem streets waste, so that Nobody passes by. Dem cities are destroyed, so that E get no man, so that E get no inhabitant.
I talk say, “Just fear me. Receive correction, so that her dwelling no go be cut off, according to all that I have appointed concerning her.” But dem rose early and corrupted all dem doings.

“So wait for me”, says Baba God, “until the day that I rise up to the prey, for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms, to pour on dem my indignation, even all my fierce anger, for all the earth Go be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.
For then I go purify the lips of the peoples, that dem may all call on Baba God’s name, to serve him shoulder to shoulder.
From beyond the rivers of Cush, my worshipers, even the daughter of my dispersed people, will bring my offering.

In that day You go not be disappointed for all una doings, in which you have transgressed against me; for then I go take away out from among you una proudly exulting ones, and You go no more be haughty in my holy mountain.
But I go leave among you an afflicted and poor people, and Dem go take refuge in Baba God’s name.
The remnant of Israel No go do wickedness, nor speak lies, neither will a deceitful tongue be find in dem mouth, for Dem go feed and lie down, and Nobody will make dem afraid.”
Sing, daughter of Zion! Shout, Israel! Be glad and glad well-well with all una heart, daughter of Jerusalem.
Baba God has taken away una judgments. He has thrown out una enemy. The King of Israel, Baba God, is among you. You go not be afraid of evil any more.
In that day, it Go be talk say to Jerusalem, “No fear, Zion. No let una hands be weak.”
Baba God, una God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will glad well-well over you with gladness. He will calm you in his love. He will glad well-well over you with singing.
I go remove people wey grieve about the appointed feasts from you. Dem be a burden and a reproach to you.

See am, at that time I go deal with all people wey afflict you, and I go save people Wey lame, and gather people wey were driven away. I go give dem praise and honor, whose shame Don dey in all the earth.

At that time will I bring you in, and at that time will I gather you; for I go give you honor and praise among all the peoples of the earth, when I restore una fortunes before una eyes, says Baba God.

In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, Baba God’s word come by Haggai, the prophet, to Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua, the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, saying,
“This is what Baba God of Armies says: These people say, ‘The time hasn’t yet come, the time for Baba God’s house to be built.’”
Then Baba God’s word come by Haggai, the prophet, saying,
“Is it a time for you unaself to live in una paneled houses, while this house lies waste?
Now so this is what Baba God of Armies says: Consider una ways.

You have sown much, and bring in little. You eat, but you no have enough. You drink, but you no be filled with drink. You clothe unaself, but Nobody is warm, and person wey earns wages earns wages to put dem into a bag with holes in it.”
This is what Baba God of Armies says: “Consider una ways.
Go up to the mountain, bring wood, and build the house. I go take pleasure in it, and I go be glorified,” says Baba God.

“You looked for much, and, see am, it come to little; and when you bring it home, I blew it away. Why?” says Baba God of Armies, “Because of my house that lies waste, while each of you is busy with his own house.
So for una sake the heavens withhold the dew, and the earth withholds its fruit.
I call for a drought on the land, on the mountains, on the grain, on the new wine, on the oil, on that which the ground produces, on men, on livestock, and on all the labor of the hands.”

Then Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, and Joshua, the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed Baba God, dem God’s voice, and the words of Haggai, the prophet, as Baba God, dem God, had sent him; and the people feared Baba God.
Then Haggai, Baba God’s messenger, spoke Baba God’s message to the people, saying, “I be with you,” says Baba God.

Baba God stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua, the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and dem come and worked on the house of Baba God of Armies, dem God,
in the twenty-fourth day of the month, in the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.
In the seventh month, in the twenty-first day of the month, Baba God’s word come by Haggai the prophet, saying,
“Speak now to Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua, the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people, saying,
‘Wey be left among you who see this house in its former glory? How do you see it now? No be it in una eyes as nothing?

Yet now be strong, Zerubbabel,’ says Baba God. ‘Be strong, Joshua, son of Jehozadak, the high priest. Be strong, all you people of the land,’ says Baba God, ‘and work, for I be with you,’ says Baba God of Armies.
This is the word that I covenanted with you when you come out of Egypt, and my Spirit lived among you. ‘No fear.’
For this is what Baba God of Armies says: ‘Yet once, it is a little while, and I go shake the heavens, the earth, the sea, and the dry land;
and I go shake people for everywhere. The precious things of people for everywhere will come, and I go fill this house with glory, says Baba God of Armies.
The silver is mine, and the gold is mine,’ says Baba God of Armies.
‘The latter glory of this house Go be greater than the former,’ says Baba God of Armies; ‘and in this place will I give peace,’ says Baba God of Armies.”
In the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, Baba God’s word come by Haggai the prophet, saying,
“Baba God of Armies says: Ask now the priests concerning the law, saying,
‘If someone carries holy meat in the fold of his garment, and with his fold touches bread, stew, wine, oil, or any chop, will it become holy?’” The priests answer, “No.”
Then Haggai talk say, “If one Wey be unclean by reason of a dead body touch any of these, will it be unclean?” The priests answer, “It Go be unclean.”
Then Haggai answer, “‘So is this people, and so is this nation before me,’ says Baba God; ‘and so is every work of dem hands. That which dem offer E get unclean.
Now, please consider from this day and backward, before a stone was laid on a stone in Baba God’s temple.
Through all that time, when one come to a heap of twenty measures, there were only ten. When one come to the wine vat to draw out fifty, there were only twenty.
I struck you with blight, mildew, and hail in all the work of una hands; yet you didn’t turn to me,’ says Baba God.
‘Consider, please, from this day and backward, from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, since the day that the foundation of Baba God’s temple was laid, consider it.
Is the seed yet in the barn? Yes, the vine, the fig tree, the pomegranate, and the olive tree haven’t produced. From today I go bless you.’”
Baba God’s word come the second time to Haggai in the twenty-fourth day of the month, saying,
“Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, ‘I go shake the heavens and the earth.

I go overthrow the throne of kingdoms. I go destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the nations. I go overthrow the chariots, and people wey ride in dem. The horses and dem riders will come down, everyone by the sword of his brother.
In that day, says Baba God of Armies, will I take you, Zerubbabel, my worker, the son of Shealtiel,’ says Baba God, ‘and will make you as a signet, for I have chosen you,’ says Baba God of Armies.”
In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, Baba God’s word come to Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, the prophet, saying,
“Baba God was very displeased with una fathers.
So tell dem: Baba God of Armies says: ‘Return to me,’ says Baba God of Armies, ‘and I go return to you,’ says Baba God of Armies.

No you be like una fathers, to whom the former prophets proclaimed, saying: Baba God of Armies says, ‘Return now from una evil ways, and from una evil doings;’ but dem No hear, nor listen to me, says Baba God.
Una fathers, where are dem? And the prophets, do dem live forever?

But my words and my decrees, which I commanded my workers the prophets, didn’t dem overtake una fathers? “Then dem repented and talk say, ‘Just as Baba God of Armies determined to do to us, according to our ways, and according to our practices, so he has dealt with us.’”
On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, which is the month Shebat, in the second year of Darius, Baba God’s word come to Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, the prophet, saying,
“I had a vision in the night, and see am, a man riding on a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle trees that were in a ravine; and behind him there were red, brown, and white horses.
Then I ask, ‘My lord, Wetin be these?’” The angel who talked with me talk say to me, “I go show you what these are.”
The man who stood among the myrtle trees answer, “Dem be the ones Baba God has sent to go back and forth through the earth.”
Dem reported to Baba God’s angel who stood among the myrtle trees, and talk say, “We have walked back and forth through the earth, and see am, all the earth is at rest and in peace.”
Then Baba God’s angel replied, “O Baba God of Armies, how long will you not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah, against which you have had indignation these seventy years?”
Baba God answer the angel who talked with me with kind and comforting words.
So the angel who talked with me talk say to me, “Proclaim, saying, ‘Baba God of Armies says: “I be jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy.
I be very angry with the nations that are at ease; for I was but a little displeased, but dem added to the calamity.”
So Baba God says: “I have come back to Jerusalem with mercy. My house go be built in it,” says Baba God of Armies, “and a line go be stretched out over Jerusalem.”’
“Proclaim further, saying, ‘Baba God of Armies says: “My cities will again overflow with prosperity, and Baba God will again comfort Zion, and will again choose Jerusalem.”’”
I lifted up my eyes, and see, and see am, four horns.
I ask the angel who talked with me, “Wetin be these?” He answer me, “These are the horns which have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.”
Baba God showed me four craftsmen.

Then I ask, “Wetin be these coming to do?” He talk say, “These are the horns which scattered Judah, so that no man lifted up his head; but these have come to terrify dem, to throw down the horns of the nations, which lifted up dem horn against the land of Judah to scatter it.”
I lifted up my eyes, and see, and see am, a man with a measuring line in his hand.
Then I ask, “Where are you going?” He talk say to me, “To measure Jerusalem, to see Wetin be its width and Wetin be its length.”
See am, the angel who talked with me go out, and another angel go out to meet him,
and talk say to him, “Run, speak to this young man, saying, ‘Jerusalem Go be inhabited as villages without walls, because of the plenty people of men and livestock in it.
For I,’ says Baba God, ‘Go be to her a wall of fire around it, and I go be the glory in the middle of her.
Come! Come! Flee from the land of the north,’ says Baba God; ‘for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the sky,’ says Baba God.
‘Come, Zion! Escape, you who live with the daughter of Babylon.’
For Baba God of Armies says: ‘For honor he has sent me to the nations which plundered you; for person wey touches you touches the apple of his eye.
For, see am, I go shake my hand over dem, and Dem go be a plunder to people wey served dem; and You go know that Baba God of Armies has sent me.
Sing and glad well-well, daughter of Zion; for, see am, I come, and I go live within you,’ says Baba God.
Many nations shall join themselves to Baba God in that day, and go be my people; and I go live among you, and you shall know that Baba God of Armies has sent me to you.
Baba God will inherit Judah as his portion in the holy land, and will again choose Jerusalem.
Be silent, all flesh, before Baba God; for he has roused imself from his holy habitation!”
He showed me Joshua the high priest standing before Baba God’s angel, and Satan standing at his right hand to be his adversary.
Baba God talk say to Satan, “Baba God rebuke you, Satan! Yes, Baba God who has chosen Jerusalem rebuke you! No be this a burning stick plucked out of the fire?”
Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and was standing before the angel.

He answer and spoke to people wey stood before him, saying, “Take the filthy garments off of him.” To him he talk say, “See am, I have caused una wickedness to pass from you, and I go clothe you with rich clothing.”
I talk say, “Make dem set a clean turban on his head.” So dem set a clean turban on his head, and clothed him; and Baba God’s angel was standing by.
Baba God’s angel protested to Joshua, saying,

“Baba God of Armies says: ‘If You go walk in my ways, and if You go follow my instructions, then you also shall judge my house, and shall also keep my courts, and I go give you a place of access among these who stand by.
Hear now, Joshua the high priest, you and una fellows who sit before you; for Dem be men Wey be a sign: for, see am, I go bring out my worker, the Branch.

For, see am, the stone that I have set before Joshua; on one stone are seven eyes: see am, I go engrave its engraving,’ says Baba God of Armies, ‘and I go remove the wickedness of that land in one day.
In that day,’ says Baba God of Armies, ‘You go invite every man his neighbor under the vine and under the fig tree.’”
The angel who talked with me come again, and wakened me, as a man Wey be wakened out of his sleep.

He talk say to me, “What do you see?” I talk say, “I have seen, and see am, a lamp stand all of gold, with its bowl on the top of it, and its seven lamps on it; E get seven pipes to each of the lamps, which are on the top of it;
and two olive trees by it, one on the right side of the bowl, and the other on the left side of it.”
I answer and spoke to the angel who talked with me, saying, “Wetin be these, my lord?”
Then the angel who talked with me answer me, “No you know what these are?” I talk say, “No, my lord.”
Then he answer and spoke to me, saying, “This is Baba God’s word to Zerubbabel, saying, ‘Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit,’ says Baba God of Armies.
Wey be you, great mountain? Before Zerubbabel You be a plain; and he will bring out the capstone with shouts of ‘Grace, grace, to it!’”
Moreover Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
“The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house. His hands shall also finish it; and You go know that Baba God of Armies has sent me to you.

Indeed, who despises the day of small things? For these seven shall glad well-well, and shall see the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel. These are Baba God’s eyes, which run back and forth through the whole earth.”
Then I ask him, “Wetin be these two olive trees on the right side of the lamp stand and on the left side of it?”
I ask him the second time, “Wetin be these two olive branches, which are beside the two golden spouts, that pour the golden oil out of themselves?”
He answer me, “No you know what these are?” I talk say, “No, my lord.”
Then he talk say, “These are the two anointed ones who stand by the Lord of the whole earth.”
Then again I lifted up my eyes, and see, and see am, a flying scroll.
He talk say to me, “What do you see?” I answer, “I see a flying scroll; its length is twenty cubits, and its width ten cubits.”

Then he talk say to me, “This is the curse that goes out over the surface of the whole land; for Everybody wey steals go be cut off according to it on the one side; and Everybody wey swears falsely go be cut off according to it on the other side.

I go cause it to go out,” says Baba God of Armies, “and it will enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him who swears falsely by my name; and it will remain in the middle of his house, and will destroy it with its timber and its stones.”
Then the angel who talked with me come forward, and talk say to me, “Lift up now una eyes, and see Wetin be this that is appearing.”
I talk say, “Wetin be it?” He talk say, “This is the ephah basket that is appearing.” He talk say moreover, “This is dem appearance in all the land
(and see am, a talent of lead was lifted up); and this is a woman sitting in the middle of the ephah basket.”
He talk say, “This is Wickedness”; and he threw her down into the middle of the ephah basket; and he threw the weight of lead on its mouth.

Then lifted I up my eyes, and see, and see am, there were two women, and the wind was in dem wings. Now dem had wings like the wings of a stork, and dem lifted up the ephah basket between earth and the sky.
Then I talk say to the angel who talked with me, “Where are these carrying the ephah basket?”
He talk say to me, “To build her a house in the land of Shinar. When it is prepared, she Go be set there in her own place.”
Again I lifted up my eyes, and see, and see am, four chariots come out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of brass.
In the first chariot were red horses; in the second chariot black horses;
in the third chariot white horses; and in the fourth chariot dappled horses, all of dem powerful.
Then I ask the angel who talked with me, “Wetin be these, my lord?”
The angel answer me, “These are the four winds of the sky, which go out from standing before the Lord of all the earth.
The one with the black horses goes out toward the north country; and the white go out after dem; and the dappled go out toward the south country.”
The strong go out, and sought to go that dem might walk back and forth through the earth: and he talk say, “Go around and through the earth!” So dem walked back and forth through the earth.
Then he call to me, and spoke to me, saying, “See am, people wey go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.”
Baba God’s word come to me, saying,
“Take of dem of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah; and come the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah, where dem have come from Babylon.
Yes, take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set dem on the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest;
and speak to him, saying, ‘Baba God of Armies says, “See am, the man whose name is the Branch: and he shall grow up out of his place; and he shall build Baba God’s temple;
even he shall build Baba God’s temple; and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule on his throne; and he go be a priest on his throne; and the counsel of peace go be between dem both.
The crowns go be to Helem, and to Tobijah, and to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in Baba God’s temple.
People Wey far off shall come and build in Baba God’s temple; and you shall know that Baba God of Armies has sent me to you. This will happen, if You go diligently obey Baba God una God’s voice.”’”
In the fourth year of king Darius, Baba God’s word come to Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Chislev.
The people of Bethel sent Sharezer and Regem Melech, and dem men, to entreat Baba God’s favor,
and to speak to the priests of the house of Baba God of Armies, and to the prophets, saying, “Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?”
Then the word of Baba God of Armies come to me, saying,
“Speak to all the people of the land, and to the priests, saying, ‘When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and in the seventh month for these seventy years, did you at all fast to me, really to me?
When you eat, and when you drink, no you eat for unaself, and drink for unaself?
No be these the words which Baba God proclaimed by the former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and its cities around her, and the South and the lowland were inhabited?’”
Baba God’s word come to Zechariah, saying,
“Thus has Baba God of Armies spoken, saying, ‘Execute true judgment, and show kindness and compassion every man to his brother.
No oppress the widow, nor the fatherless, the foreigner, nor the poor; and let none of you devise evil against his brother in una heart.’
But dem refused to listen, and turned dem backs, and stopped dem ears, that dem might not hear.

Yes, dem made dem hearts as hard as flint, lest dem might hear the law, and the words which Baba God of Armies had sent by his Spirit by the former prophets. So great serious anger come from Baba God of Armies.
It has come to pass that, as he call, and dem refused to listen, so Dem go call, and I go not listen,” talk say Baba God of Armies;

“but I go scatter dem with a whirlwind among all the nations which dem have not known. Thus the land was desolate after dem, so that no man passed through nor come back: for dem made the pleasant land desolate.”
The word of Baba God of Armies come to me.
Baba God of Armies says: “I be jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I be jealous for her with great serious anger.”
Baba God says: “I have come back to Zion, and will live in the middle of Jerusalem. Jerusalem go be call ‘The City of Truth;’ and the mountain of Baba God of Armies, ‘The Holy Mountain.’”
Baba God of Armies says: “Old men and old women will again live in the streets of Jerusalem, every man with his staff in his hand for very age.
The streets of the city Go be full of boys and girls playing in its streets.”
Baba God of Armies says: “If it is marvelous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in those days, should it also be marvelous in my eyes?” says Baba God of Armies.
Baba God of Armies says: “See am, I go save my people from the east country, and from the west country;
and I go bring dem, and Dem go live within Jerusalem; and Dem go be my people, and I go be dem God, in truth and in righteousness.”

Baba God of Armies says: “Let una hands be strong, you who hear in these days these words from the mouth of the prophets who were in the day that the foundation of the house of Baba God of Armies was laid, even the temple, that it might be built.

For before those days there was no wages for man, nor any wages for an animal; neither was there any peace to him who go out or come in, because of the adversary. For I set all men everyone against his neighbor.
But now I go not be to the remnant of this people as in the former days,” says Baba God of Armies.

“For the seed of peace and the vine will yield its fruit, and the ground will give its increase, and the heavens will give dem dew; and I go cause the remnant of this people to inherit all these things.
It shall come to pass that, as you were a curse among the nations, house of Judah and house of Israel, so will I save you, and you go be a blessing. No fear. Let una hands be strong.”
For Baba God of Armies says: “As I thought to do evil to you, when una fathers provoked me to serious anger,” says Baba God of Armies, “and I didn’t repent;
so again I have thought in these days to do good to Jerusalem and to the house of Judah. No fear.
These are the things that you shall do: speak every man the truth with his neighbor. Execute the judgment of truth and peace in una gates,
and let none of you devise evil in una hearts against his neighbor, and love no false oath: for all these are things that I hate,” says Baba God.
The word of Baba God of Armies come to me.
Baba God of Armies says: “The fasts of the fourth fifth, seventh, and tenth months go be for the house of Judah gladness and gladness, and cheerful feasts. So love truth and peace.”
Baba God of Armies says: “Many peoples, and the inhabitants of many cities will yet come;
and the inhabitants of one shall go to another, saying, ‘Make we go speedily to entreat the favor of Baba God, and to seek Baba God of Armies. I go go also.’
Yes, many peoples and strong nations will come to seek Baba God of Armies in Jerusalem, and to entreat the favor of Baba God.”

Baba God of Armies says: “In those days, ten men will take hold, out of all the languages of the nations, Dem go take hold of the skirt of him Wey be a Jew, saying, ‘We go go with you, for we have heard that God is with you.’”
A revelation. Baba God’s word is against the land of Hadrach, and will rest upon Damascus; for the eye of man and of all the tribes of Israel is toward Baba God;
and Hamath, also, which borders on it; Tyre and Sidon, because Dem be very wise.
Tyre built sheself a stronghold, and heaped up silver like the dust, and fine gold like the mire of the streets.
See am, the Lord will dispossess her, and he will strike her power in the sea; and she Go be devoured with fire.
Ashkelon will see it, and fear; Gaza also, and will writhe in agony; as will Ekron, for her expectation Go be disappointed; and the king will perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon No go be inhabited.
Foreigners will live in Ashdod, and I go cut off the pride of the Philistines.
I go take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth; and he also Go be a remnant for our God; and he Go be as a chieftain in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.
I go encamp around my house against the army, that Nobody pass through or return; and no oppressor will pass through dem any more: for now I have seen with my eyes.

Glad well-well greatly, daughter of Zion! Shout, daughter of Jerusalem! See am, una King comes to you! He is righteous, and having salvation; lowly, and riding on a donkey, even on a colt, the foal of a donkey.

I go cut off the chariot from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem; and the battle bow Go be cut off; and he will speak peace to the nations: and his dominion Go be from sea to sea, and from the River to every corner of the world.
As for you also, because of the blood of una covenant, I have set free una prisoners from the pit in which is no water.
Turn to the stronghold, you prisoners of hope! Even today I declare that I go restore double to you.
For indeed I bend Judah as a bow for me. I have filled the bow with Ephraim; and I go stir up una sons, Zion, against una sons, Greece, and will make you like the sword of a mighty man.
Baba God Go be seen over dem; and his arrow will go flash like lightning; and the Lord Baba God will blow the trumpet, and will go with whirlwinds of the south.
Baba God of Armies will defend dem; and Dem go destroy and overcome with sling stones; and Dem go drink, and roar as through wine; and Dem go be filled like bowls, like the corners of the altar.
Baba God dem God will save dem in that day as the flock of his people; for Dem be like the jewels of a crown, lifted on high over his land.
For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! Grain will make the young men flourish, and new wine the virgins.
Ask of Baba God rain in the spring time, Baba God who makes storm clouds, and he gives rain showers to everyone for the plants in the field.
For the teraphim have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie; and dem have told false dreams. Dem comfort in vain. So dem go dem way like sheep. Dem be oppressed, because E get no shepherd.
My anger is kindled against the shepherds, and I go punish the male goats; For Baba God of Armies has visited his flock, the house of Judah, and will make dem as his majestic horse in the battle.
From him will come the cornerstone, from him the nail, from him the battle bow, from him every ruler together.
Dem go be as mighty men, treading down muddy streets in the battle; and dem shall fight, because Baba God is with dem; and the riders on horses Go be confounded.

“I go strengthen the house of Judah, and I go save the house of Joseph, and I go bring dem back; for I have mercy on dem; and Dem go be as though I had not throw dem off: for I be Baba God dem God, and I go hear dem.
Ephraim Go be like a mighty man, and dem heart will glad well-well as through wine; yes, dem pikin dem will see it, and glad well-well. Dem heart Go be glad in Baba God.
I go signal for dem, and gather dem; for I have redeemed dem; and Dem go increase as dem have increased.
I go sow dem among the peoples; and Dem go remember me in far countries; and Dem go live with dem pikin dem, and will return.
I go bring dem again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather dem out of Assyria; and I go bring dem into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and there no go be room enough for dem.

He will pass through the sea of suffering, and will strike the waves in the sea, and all the depths of the Nile will dry up; and the pride of Assyria Go be bring down, and the scepter of Egypt will depart.
I go strengthen dem in Baba God; and Dem go walk up and down in his name,” says Baba God.
Open una doors, Lebanon, that the fire may devour una cedars.
Wail, cypress tree, for the cedar has fallen, because the stately ones are destroyed. Wail, you oaks of Bashan, for the strong forest has come down.
A voice of the wailing of the shepherds! For dem glory is destroyed: a voice of the roaring of young lions! For the pride of the Jordan is ruined.
Baba God my God says: “Feed the flock of slaughter.
Dem buyers slaughter dem, and go unpunished. People wey sell dem say, ‘Blessed be Baba God, for I be rich;’ and dem own shepherds no pity dem.

For I go no more pity the inhabitants of the land,” says Baba God; “but, see am, I go deliver the men everyone into his neighbor’s hand, and into the hand of his king. Dem go strike the land, and out of dem hand I go not deliver dem.”
So I fed the flock of slaughter, especially the oppressed of the flock. I take for myself two staffs. The one I call “Favor”, and the other I call “Union”, and I fed the flock.
I cut off the three shepherds in one month; for my soul was weary of dem, and dem soul also loathed me.
Then I talk say, “I go not feed you. That which dies, let it die; and that which is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let people Wey left eat each other’s flesh.”
I take my staff Favor, and cut it apart, that I might break my covenant that I had made with all the peoples.
It was broken in that day; and thus the poor of the flock that listened to me know that it was Baba God’s word.
I talk say to dem, “If you think it best, give me my wages; and if not, keep dem.” So dem weighed for my wages thirty pieces of silver.
Baba God talk say to me, “Throw it to the potter, the handsome price that I was valued at by dem!” I take the thirty pieces of silver, and threw dem to the potter, in Baba God’s house.
Then I cut apart my other staff, even Union, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.
Baba God talk say to me, “Take for yourself yet again the equipment of a foolish shepherd.

For, see am, I go raise up a shepherd in the land, who No go visit people Wey cut off, neither will seek people Wey scattered, nor heal that which is broken, nor feed that which is sound; but he will eat the meat of the fat sheep, and will tear dem hoofs in pieces.
Woe to the worthless shepherd who leaves the flock! The sword Go be on his arm, and on his right eye. His arm Go be completely withered, and his right eye Go be totally blinded!”
A revelation, Baba God’s word concerning Israel. Baba God, who stretches out the heavens, and lays the foundation of the earth, and forms the spirit of man within him says:
“See am, I go make Jerusalem a cup of reeling to all the surrounding peoples, and it will also be on Judah in the siege against Jerusalem.

It will happen in that day, that I go make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all the peoples. All who burden themselves with it Go be severely wounded, and all the nations of the earth Go be gathered together against it.
In that day,” says Baba God, “I go strike every horse with terror, and his rider with madness; and I go open my eyes on the house of Judah, and will strike every horse of the peoples with blindness.
The chieftains of Judah will say in dem heart, ‘The inhabitants of Jerusalem are my strength in Baba God of Armies dem God.’

In that day I go make the chieftains of Judah like a pan of fire among wood, and like a flaming torch among sheaves; and Dem go devour all the surrounding peoples, on the right hand and on the left; and Jerusalem will yet again live in dem own place, even in Jerusalem.
Baba God also will save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of David’s house and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem not be magnified above Judah.
In that day Baba God will defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem. Person Wey feeble among dem at that day Go be like David, and David’s house Go be like God, like Baba God’s angel before dem.
It will happen in that day, that I go seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.

I go pour on David’s house, and on the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of supplication; and Dem go look to me whom dem have pierced; and dem shall mourn for him, as one mourns for his only son, and will grieve bitterly for him, as one grieves for his firstborn.
In that day there Go be a great mourning in Jerusalem, like the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddon.
The land will mourn, every family apart; the family of David’s house apart, and dem wives apart; the family of the house of Nathan apart, and dem wives apart;
the family of the house of Levi apart, and dem wives apart; the family of the Shimeites apart, and dem wives apart;
all the families who remain, every family apart, and dem wives apart.
“In that day there Go be a spring opened to David’s house and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, for sin and for uncleanness.

It will come to pass in that day, says Baba God of Armies, that I go cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and Dem go be remember no more. I go also cause the prophets and the spirit of impurity to pass out of the land.

It will happen that, when anyone still prophesies, then his father and his mother who bore him will tell him, ‘You must die, because you speak lies in Baba God’s name;’ and his father and his mother who bore him will stab him when he prophesies.
It will happen in that day, that the prophets will each be ashamed of his vision, when he prophesies; neither will dem wear a hairy mantle to deceive:
but he will say, ‘I be no prophet, I be a tiller of the ground; for I Don dey made a bondservant from my youth.’
One will say to him, ‘Wetin be these wounds between una arms?’ Then he will answer, ‘Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.’

“Awake, sword, against my shepherd, and against the man Wey be close to me,” says Baba God of Armies. “Strike the shepherd, and the sheep Go be scattered; and I go turn my hand against the little ones.
It shall happen that in all the land,” says Baba God, “two parts in it Go be cut off and die; but the third Go be left in it.

I go bring the third part into the fire, and will refine dem as silver is refined, and will test dem like gold is tested. Dem go call on my name, and I go hear dem. I go say, ‘It is my people;’ and Dem go say, ‘Baba God is my God.’”
See am, a day of Baba God comes, when una plunder Go be divided within you.

For I go gather people for everywhere against Jerusalem to battle; and the city Go be taken, the houses rifled, and the women ravished. Half of the city will go out into captivity, and the rest of the people No go be cut off from the city.
Then Baba God will go out and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.

His feet will stand in that day on the Mount of Olives, which is before Jerusalem on the east; and the Mount of Olives Go be split in two, from east to west, making a plenty well-well valley. Half of the mountain will move toward the north, and half of it toward the south.

You shall flee by the valley of my mountains; for the valley of the mountains shall reach to Azel; yes, you shall flee, just like you fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah. Baba God my God will come, and all the holy ones with you.
It will happen in that day, that there No go be light, cold, or frost.
It Go be a unique day which is known to Baba God; not day, and not night; but it will come to pass, that at evening time there Go be light.
It will happen in that day, that living waters will go out from Jerusalem; half of dem toward the eastern sea, and half of dem toward the western sea; in summer and in winter will it be.
Baba God Go be King over all the earth. In that day Baba God Go be one, and his name one.

All the land Go be made like the Arabah, from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem; and she Go be lifted up, and will live in her place, from Benjamin’s gate to the place of the first gate, to the corner gate, and from the tower of Hananel to the king’s wine presses.
Men will live inside am, and there Go be no more curse; but Jerusalem will live safely.

This Go be the plague with which Baba God will strike all the peoples who have fought against Jerusalem: dem flesh will consume away while dem stand on dem feet, and dem eyes will consume away in dem sockets, and dem tongue will consume away in dem mouth.
It will happen in that day, that a great panic from Baba God Go be among dem; and Dem go lay hold everyone on the hand of his neighbor, and his hand will rise up against the hand of his neighbor.
Judah also will fight at Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the surrounding nations Go be gathered together: gold, and silver, and clothing, in great abundance.
So Go be the plague of the horse, of the mule, of the camel, and of the donkey, and of all the animals that Go be in those camps, as that plague.
It will happen that everyone Wey be left of all the nations that come against Jerusalem will go up from year to year to worship the King, Baba God of Armies, and to keep the feast of tents.
It Go be, that Anybody wey of all the families of the earth no dey go up to Jerusalem to worship the King, Baba God of Armies, on dem there Go be no rain.
If the family of Egypt no dey go up, and no dey come, neither will it rain on dem. This Go be the plague with which Baba God will strike the nations that no go up to keep the feast of tents.
This Go be the punishment of Egypt, and the punishment of all the nations that no go up to keep the feast of tents.
In that day there Go be on the bells of the horses, “HOLY TO Baba God”; and the pots in Baba God’s house Go be like the bowls before the altar.

Yes, every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah Go be holy to Baba God of Armies; and all people wey sacrifice will come and take of dem, and cook in dem. In that day there will no longer be a Canaanite in the house of Baba God of Armies.
A revelation, Baba God’s word to Israel by Malachi.
“I have love you,” says Baba God. Yet you say, “How have you love us?” “No be Esau Jacob’s brother?” says Baba God, “Yet I love Jacob;
but Esau I hated, and made his mountains a desolation, and give his heritage to the jackals of the wilderness.”

Whereas Edom says, “We be beaten down, but We go return and build the waste places”; Baba God of Armies says, “Dem shall build, but I go throw down; and men will call dem ‘The Wicked Land,’ even the people against whom Baba God shows serious anger forever.”
Una eyes will see, and You go say, “Baba God is great — even beyond the border of Israel!”

“A son honors his father, and a worker his master. If I be a father, then where is my honor? And if I be a master, where is the respect due me? Says Baba God of Armies to you, priests, who despise my name. You say, ‘How have we despised una name?’
You offer polluted bread on my altar. You say, ‘How have we polluted you?’ In that you say, ‘Baba God’s table is contemptible.’

When you offer the blind for sacrifice, no be that evil? And when you offer the lame and sick, no be that evil? Present it now to una governor! Will he be pleased with you? Or will he accept una person?” says Baba God of Armies.
“Now, please entreat the favor of God, that he may be gracious to us. With this, will he accept any of you?” says Baba God of Armies.

“Oh that there were one among you who would shut the doors, that you might not kindle fire on my altar in vain! I have no pleasure in you,” says Baba God of Armies, “neither will I accept an offering at una hand.

For from the rising of the sun even to the going down of the same, my name is great among the nations, and in every place incense Go be offered to my name, and a pure offering: for my name is great among the nations,” says Baba God of Armies.
“But you profane it, in that you say, ‘Baba God’s table is polluted, and its fruit, even its chop, is contemptible.’

You say also, ‘See am, what a weariness it is!’ and you have sniffed at it”, says Baba God of Armies; “and you have bring that which was taken by violence, the lame, and the sick; thus you bring the offering. Should I accept this at una hand?” says Baba God.

“But the deceiver is cursed, who has in his flock a male, and vows, and sacrifices to the Lord a defective thing; for I be a great King,” says Baba God of Armies, “and my name is awesome among the nations.”
“Now, you priests, this commandment is for you.

If You go not listen, and if You go not lay it to heart, to give glory to my name,” says Baba God of Armies, “then will I send the curse on you, and I go curse una blessings. Indeed, I have cursed dem already, because you No lay it to heart.
See am, I go rebuke una offspring, and will spread dung on una faces, even the dung of una feasts; and You go be taken away with it.
You go know that I have sent this commandment to you, that my covenant may be with Levi,” says Baba God of Armies.
“My covenant was with him of life and peace; and I give dem to him that he might be reverent toward me; and he was reverent toward me, and stood in awe of my name.
The law of truth was in his mouth, and unrighteousness No be find in his lips. He walked with me in peace and uprightness, and turned many away from wickedness.
For the priest’s lips should keep knowledge, and dem should seek the law at his mouth; for he is the messenger of Baba God of Armies.
But you have turned aside out of the way. You have caused many to stumble in the law. You have corrupted the covenant of Levi,” says Baba God of Armies.
“So I have also made you contemptible and base before all the people, according to the way you have not kept my ways, but have had respect for persons in the law.
No we all have one father? Hasn’t one God created us? Why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother, profaning the covenant of our fathers?

Judah has dealt treacherously, and an abomination is committed in Israel and in Jerusalem; for Judah has profaned the holiness of Baba God which he loves, and has married the daughter of a foreign god.
Baba God will cut off, to the man wey do this, him who wakes and him who answers, out of the tents of Jacob, and him who offers an offering to Baba God of Armies.
This again you do: you cover Baba God’s altar with tears, with weeping, and with sighing, because he no dey regard the offering any more, neither receives it with good will at una hand.
Yet you say, ‘Why?’ Because Baba God Don dey witness between you and the wife of una youth, against whom you have dealt treacherously, though she is una companion, and the wife of una covenant.
Did he not make you one, although he had the residue of the Spirit? Why one? He sought godly offspring. So take heed to una spirit, and let Nobody deal treacherously against the wife of his youth.
For I hate divorce”, says Baba God, the God of Israel, “and him who covers his garment with violence!” says Baba God of Armies. “So take heed to una spirit, that you no deal treacherously.

You have wearied Baba God with una words. Yet you say, ‘How have we wearied him?’ In that you say, ‘Everyone wey do evil is good in Baba God’s sight, and he delights in dem;’ or ‘Where is the God of justice?’

“See am, I send my messenger, and he will prepare the way before me; and the Lord, whom you seek, will suddenly come to his temple; and the messenger of the covenant, whom you desire, see am, he comes!” says Baba God of Armies.
“But who can endure the day of his coming? And who will stand when he appears? For he is like a refiner’s fire, and like launderer’s soap;
and he will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver, and he will purify the sons of Levi, and refine dem as gold and silver; and dem shall offer to Baba God offerings in righteousness.
Then the offering of Judah and Jerusalem Go be pleasant to Baba God, as in the days of old, and as in ancient years.

I go come near to you to judgment; and I go be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers, and against the perjurers, and against people wey oppress the hireling in his wages, the widow, and the fatherless, and who deprive the foreigner of justice, and no fear me,” says Baba God of Armies.
“For I, Baba God, no change; so you, sons of Jacob, No be consumed.
From the days of una fathers you have turned aside from my ordinances, and have not kept dem. Return to me, and I go return to you,” says Baba God of Armies. “But you say, ‘How shall we return?’
