come back from the tomb, and told all these things to the eleven, and to all the rest.
Now dem were Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and Mary the mother of James. The other women with dem told these things to the apostles.
These words seemed to dem to be nonsense, and dem didn’t believe dem.
But Peter got up and ran to the tomb. Stooping and looking in, he see the strips of linen lying by themselves, and he comot to his home, wondering what had happened.
See am, two of dem were going that very day to a village named Emmaus, which was sixty stadia from Jerusalem.
Dem talked with each other about all of these things which had happened.
While dem talked and questioned together, Jesus imself come near, and go with dem.
But dem eyes were kept from recognizing him.
E tell dem say, “Wetin be you talking about as you walk, and are sad?”
One of dem, named Cleopas, answer him, “Are you the only stranger in Jerusalem who no dey know the things which have happened there in these days?”
E tell dem say, “What things?” Dem tell am say, “The things concerning Jesus, the Nazarene, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people;
and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him up to be condemned to death, and crucified him.
But we were hoping that it was person wey would redeem Israel. Yes, and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things happened.
Also, certain women of our company amazed us, having arrived early at the tomb;
and when dem didn’t find his body, dem come saying that dem had also seen a vision of angels, who talk say that he was alive.
Some of us go to the tomb, and find it just like the women had talk say, but dem didn’t see him.”
E tell dem say, “Foolish men, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!
Didn’t the Christ have to suffer these things and to enter into his glory?”
Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he explained to dem in all the Scriptures the things concerning imself.
Dem come near to the village, where dem were going, and he acted like he would go further.
Dem urged him, saying, “Stay with us, for it is almost evening, and the day is almost over.” He go in to stay with dem.
When he had sat down at the table with dem, he take the bread and Thank God. Breaking it, he give to dem.
Dem eyes were opened, and dem recognized him, and he vanished out of dem sight.
Dem talk say to each other, “No be our hearts burning within us, while he spoke to us along the way, and while he opened the Scriptures to us?”
Dem rose up that very hour, come back to Jerusalem, and find the eleven gathered together, and people wey were with dem,
saying, “The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!”
Dem related the things that happened along the way, and how he was recognized by dem in the breaking of the bread.
As dem talk say these things, Jesus imself stood among dem, and talk say to dem, “Peace be to you.”
But dem were terrified and filled with fear, and supposed that dem had seen a spirit.
E tell dem say, “Why are you troubled? Why do doubts arise in una hearts?
See my hands and my feet, that it is truly me. Touch me and see, for a spirit no dey have flesh and bones, as you see that I have.”
When he had talk say this, he showed dem his hands and his feet.
While dem still didn’t believe for gladness, and wondered, E tell dem say, “Do you have anything here to eat?”
Dem give him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb.
He take dem, and ate in front of dem.
E tell dem say, “This is what I told you, while I was still with you, that all things which are written in the law of Moses, the prophets, and the psalms, concerning me must be fulfilled.”
Then he opened dem minds, that dem might understand the Scriptures.
E tell dem say, “Thus it is written, and thus it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the third day,
and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name to all the nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
You be witnesses of these things.
See am, I send out the promise of my Father on you. But wait in the city of Jerusalem until You be clothed with power from on high.”
He led dem out as far as Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed dem.
While he blessed dem, he withdrew from dem, and was carried up into heaven.
Dem worshiped him, and come back to Jerusalem with great gladness,
and were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.
For the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
The same was For the beginning with God.
All things were made through him. Without him No be anything made that Don dey made.
In him was life, and the life was the light of men.
The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.
There come a man, sent from God, whose name was John.
The same come as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.
He No be the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.
The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.
He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn’t recognize him.
He come to his own, and people wey were his own didn’t receive him.
But as many as received him, to dem he give the right to become God’s pikin dem, to people wey believe in his name:
who were born not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
The Word became flesh, and lived among us. We see his glory, such glory as of the one and only Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.
John testified about him. He cried out, saying, “This was he of whom I talk say, ‘Person wey comes after me has surpassed me, for he was before me.’”
From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.
For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.
Nobody has seen God at any time. The one and only Son, Wey be in the bosom of the Father, he has declared him.
This is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Wey be you?”
He declared, and didn’t deny, but he declared, “I be not the Christ.”
Dem ask him, “What then? Are you Elijah?” He talk say, “I be not.” “Are you the prophet?” He answer, “No.”
Dem talk say so to him, “Wey be you? Give us an answer to take back to people wey sent us. What do you say about yourself?”
He talk say, “I be the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ as Isaiah the prophet talk say.”
The ones who Bin dey sent were from the Pharisees.
Dem ask him, “Why then do you baptize, if you No be the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”
John answer dem, “I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you no know.
He is the one who comes after me, Wey be preferred before me, whose sandal strap I’m not worthy to loosen.”
These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
The next day, he see Jesus coming to him, and talk say, “See am, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
This is he of whom I talk say, ‘After me comes a man Wey be preferred before me, for he was before me.’
I didn’t know him, but for this reason I come baptizing in water: that he would be revealed to Israel.”
John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remain on him.

I didn’t recognize him, but person wey sent me to baptize in water, he talk say to me, ‘On whomever You go see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is person wey baptizes in the Holy Spirit.’
I have seen, and have testified that this is the Son of God.”
Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,
and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and talk say, “See am, the Lamb of God!”
The two disciples heard him speak, and dem follow Jesus.
Jesus turned, and see dem following, and talk say to dem, “Wetin be you looking for?” Dem tell am say, “Rabbi” (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), “where are you staying?”
E tell dem say, “Come, and see.” Dem come and see where he was staying, and dem stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.
One of the two who heard John, and follow him, was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.
He first find his own brother, Simon, and talk say to him, “We have find the Messiah!” (which is, being interpreted, Christ ).
He bring him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him, and talk say, “You be Simon the son of Jonah. You go be call Cephas” (which is by interpretation, Peter).
On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he find Philip. Jesus tell am say, “Follow me.”
Now Philip was from Bethsaida, of the city of Andrew and Peter.
Philip find Nathanael, and talk say to him, “We have find him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”
Nathanael talk say to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?” Philip talk say to him, “Come and see.”
Jesus see Nathanael coming to him, and talk say about him, “See am, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”
Nathanael talk say to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answer him, “Before Philip call you, when you were under the fig tree, I see you.”
Nathanael answer him, “Rabbi, You be the Son of God! You be King of Israel!”
Jesus answer him, “Because I told you, ‘I see you underneath the fig tree,’ do you believe? You go see greater things than these!”
E tell am say, “Most certainly, I tell una, hereafter You go see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”
The third day, there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there.
Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the marriage.
When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother talk say to him, “Dem have no wine.”
Jesus tell am say, “Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come.”
His mother talk say to the workers, “Anything wey he says to you, do it.”
Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews’ way of purifying, containing two or three metretes apiece.
Jesus tell dem say, “Fill the water pots with water.” Dem filled dem up to the brim.
E tell dem say, “Now draw some out, and take it to the ruler of the feast.” So dem take it.
When the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and didn’t know where it come from (but the workers who had drawn the water know), the ruler of the feast call the bridegroom,
and talk say to him, “Everyone serves the good wine first, and when the guests have drunk freely, then that which is worse. You have kept the good wine until now!”
This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believe in him.
After this, he go down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, his brothers, and his disciples; and dem stayed there a few days.
The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus go up to Jerusalem.
He find in the temple people wey sold oxen, sheep, and doves, and the changers of money sitting.
He made a whip of cords, and threw all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers’ money, and overthrew dem tables.
To people wey sold the doves, he talk say, “Take these things out of here! No make my Father’s house a marketplace!”
His disciples remember that it was written, “Zeal for una house will eat me up.”
The Jews so answer him, “What sign do you show us, seeing that you do these things?”
Jesus answer dem, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I go raise it up.”
The Jews so talk say, “It take forty-six years to build this temple! Will you raise it up in three days?”
But he spoke of the temple of his body.
When so he was raised from the dead, his disciples remember that he talk say this, and dem believe the Scripture, and the word which Jesus had talk say.
Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believe in his name, observing his signs which he did.
But Jesus didn’t trust imself to dem, because he know everyone,
and because he didn’t need for anyone to testify concerning man; for he imself know what was in man.
Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.
The same come to him by night, and talk say to him, “Rabbi, we know that You be a teacher come from God, for Nobody can do these signs that you do, unless God is with him.”
Jesus answer him, “Most certainly, I tell una, unless one is born anew, he no fit see God’s Kingdom.”
Nicodemus talk say to him, “How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb, and be born?”
Jesus answer, “True true, I tell una, unless one is born of water and spirit, he no fit enter into God’s Kingdom.
That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
No marvel that I talk say to you, ‘You must be born anew.’
The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but no know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone Wey be born of the Spirit.”
Nicodemus answer him, “How can these things be?”
Jesus answer him, “Are you the teacher of Israel, and no understand these things?
True true, I tell una, we speak that which we know, and testify of that which we have seen, and you no receive our witness.
If I told you earthly things and you no believe, how will you believe if I tell una heavenly things?
Nobody has ascended into heaven, but person wey descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, Wey be in heaven.
As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,
that Anybody wey believe in him no suppose perish, but have life wey no dey end.
For God so love the world, that he give his one and only Son, that Anybody wey believe in him no suppose perish, but have life wey no dey end.
For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.
Person wey believe in him No be judged. Person wey no dey believe Don dey judged already, because he has not believe in the name of the one and only Son of God.
This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men love the darkness rather than the light; for dem works were evil.
For everyone wey do evil hates the light, and no dey come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.
But person wey does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that dem Don dey done in God.”
After these things, Jesus come with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with dem, and baptized.
John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. Dem come, and were baptized.
For John No be yet thrown into prison.
There arose so a questioning on the part of John’s disciples with some Jews about purification.
Dem come to John, and talk say to him, “Rabbi, person wey was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, see am, the same baptizes, and everyone is coming to him.”
John answer, “A man can receive nothing, unless it Don dey given him from heaven.
You unaself testify that I talk say, ‘I be not the Christ,’ but, ‘I Don dey sent before him.’
Person wey has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice. This, my gladness, so is made full.
He must increase, but I must decrease.
Person wey comes from above is above all. Person Wey from the earth belongs to the earth, and speaks of the earth. Person wey comes from heaven is above all.
What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and Nobody receives his witness.
Person wey has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.
For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.
The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.
One wey believe in the Son has life wey no dey end, but one who disobeys the Son no go see life, but the serious anger of God remains on him.”
So when the Lord know that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John
(although Jesus imself didn’t baptize, but his disciples),
he left Judea, and comot into Galilee.
He needed to pass through Samaria.
So he come to a city of Samaria, call Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob give to his son, Joseph.
Jacob’s well was there. Jesus so, being tired from his journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.
A woman of Samaria come to draw water. Jesus tell am say, “Give me a drink.”
For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy chop.
The Samaritan woman so talk say to him, “How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)
Jesus answer her, “If you know the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have ask him, and he would have given you living water.”
The woman talk say to him, “Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. So where do you get that living water?
Are you greater than our father, Jacob, who give us the well, and drank of it imself, as did his pikin dem, and his livestock?”
Jesus answer her, “Everybody wey drinks of this water will thirst again,
but Anybody wey drinks of the water that I go give him will never thirst again; but the water that I go give him will become in him a well of water springing up to life wey no dey end.”
The woman talk say to him, “Sir, give me this water, so that I no get thirsty, neither come all the way here to draw.”
Jesus tell am say, “Go, call una husband, and come here.”
The woman answer, “I have no husband.” Jesus tell am say, “You talk say well, ‘I have no husband,’
for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have No be una husband. This you have talk say truly.”
The woman talk say to him, “Sir, I perceive that You be a prophet.
Our fathers worshiped in this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship.”
Jesus tell am say, “Woman, believe me, the hour comes, when neither in this mountain, nor in Jerusalem, will you worship the Father.
You worship that which you no know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.
But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers.
God is spirit, and people wey worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”
The woman talk say to him, “I know that Messiah comes, person Wey call Christ. When he has come, he will declare to us all things.”
Jesus tell am say, “I be he, the one who speaks to you.”
At this, his disciples come. Dem surprise well-well that he was speaking with a woman; yet Nobody talk say, “Wetin be you looking for?” or, “Why do you speak with her?”
So the woman left her water pot, and go away into the city, and talk say to the people,
“Come, see a man who told me everything that I did. Can this be the Christ?”
Dem go out of the city, and were coming to him.
In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”
But E tell dem say, “I have chop to eat that you no know about.”
The disciples so talk say to each other, “Has anyone bring him something to eat?”
Jesus tell dem say, “My chop is to do the will of him who sent me, and to accomplish his work.
No you say, ‘E get yet four months until the harvest?’ See am, I tell una, lift up una eyes, and look at the fields, that Dem be white for harvest already.
Person wey reaps receives wages, and gathers fruit to life wey no dey end; that both person wey sows and person wey reaps may glad well-well together.
For in this the saying is true, ‘One sows, and another reaps.’
I sent you to reap that for which you haven’t labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into dem labor.”
From that city many of the Samaritans believe in him because of the word of the woman, who testified, “He told me everything that I did.”
So when the Samaritans come to him, dem begged him to stay with dem. He stayed there two days.
Many more believe because of his word.
Dem talk say to the woman, “Now we believe, not because of una speaking; for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world.”
After the two days he go out from there and go into Galilee.
For Jesus imself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.
So when he come into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast, for dem also go to the feast.
Jesus come so again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water into wine. There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.
When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he go to him, and begged him that he would come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.
Jesus so talk say to him, “Unless you see signs and wonders, You go in no way believe.”
The nobleman talk say to him, “Sir, come down before my pikin dies.”
Jesus tell am say, “Go una way. Una son lives.” The man believe the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he go his way.
As he was now going down, his workers met him and reported, saying “Una pikin lives!”
So he inquired of dem the hour when he began to get better. Dem talk say so to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him.”
So the father know that it was at that hour in which Jesus tell am say, “Una son lives.” He believe, as did his whole house.
This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.
After these things, there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus go up to Jerusalem.
Now in Jerusalem by the sheep gate, E get a pool, which is call in Hebrew, “Bethesda”, having five porches.
In these lay Plenty people of people wey were sick, blind, lame, or paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water;
for an angel go down at certain times into the pool, and stirred up the water. Anybody wey stepped in first after the stirring of the water was healed of Anything wey disease he had.
A certain man was there, who Bin dey sick for thirty-eight years.
When Jesus see him lying there, and know that he Bin dey sick for a long time, he ask him, “Do you want to be made well?”
The sick man answer him, “Sir, I have Nobody to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I’m coming, another steps down before me.”
Jesus tell am say, “Arise, take up una mat, and walk.”
Sharp-sharp, the man was made well, and take up his mat and walked. Now it was the Sabbath on that day.
So the Jews talk say to him who was cured, “It is the Sabbath. It No be lawful for you to carry the mat.”
He answer dem, “Person wey made me well, the same talk say to me, ‘Take up una mat, and walk.’”
Then dem ask him, “Wey be the man who talk say to you, ‘Take up una mat, and walk’?”
But person wey was healed didn’t know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a crowd being in the place.
Afterward Jesus find him in the temple, and talk say to him, “See am, You be made well. Sin no more, so that nothing worse happens to you.”
The man go away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.
For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus, and sought to kill him, because he did these things on the Sabbath.
But Jesus answer dem, “My Father is still working, so I be working, too.”
For this cause so the Jews sought all the more to kill him, because he not only broke the Sabbath, but also call God his own Father, making imself equal with God.
Jesus so answer dem, “Most certainly, I tell una, the Son can do nothing of imself, but what he sees the Father doing. For Anything wey things he does, these the Son also does likewise.
For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he imself does. He will show him greater works than these, that you may marvel.
For as the Father raises the dead and gives dem life, even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires.
For the Father judges Nobody, but he has given all judgment to the Son,
that all may honor the Son, even as dem honor the Father. Person wey no dey honor the Son no dey honor the Father who sent him.
“True true, I tell una, person wey hears my word, and believe him who sent me, has life wey no dey end, and no dey come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.
Most certainly, I tell una, the hour comes, and now is, when the dead will hear the Son of God’s voice; and people wey hear will live.
For as the Father has life in imself, even so he give to the Son also to have life in imself.
He also give him authority to execute judgment, because he is a Son of Man.
No marvel at this, for the hour comes, in which all that are in the tombs will hear his voice,
and will come out; people wey have done good, to the resurrection of life; and people wey have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.
I can of myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge, and my judgment is righteous; because I no seek my own will, but the will of my Father who sent me.
“If I testify about myself, my witness No be valid.
It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.
You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.
But the testimony which I receive No be from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.
He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to glad well-well for a while in his light.
But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John, for the works which the Father give me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.
The Father imself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.
You no have his word living in you; because you no believe him whom he sent.
“You search the Scriptures, because you think that in dem you have life wey no dey end; and these are dem which testify about me.
Yet You go not come to me, that you may have life.
I no receive glory from men.
But I know you, that you no have God’s love in unaself.
I have come in my Father’s name, and you no receive me. If another comes in his own name, You go receive him.
How can you believe, who receive glory from each other, and you no seek the glory that comes from the only God?
“No think that I go accuse you to the Father. E get one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set una hope.
For if you believe Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.
But if you no believe his writings, how will you believe my words?”
After these things, Jesus go away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is also call the Sea of Tiberias.
Plenty people follow him, because dem see his signs which he did on people wey were sick.
Jesus go up into the mountain, and he sat there with his disciples.
Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.
Jesus so lifting up his eyes, and seeing that Plenty people was coming to him, talk say to Philip, “Where are we to buy bread, that these may eat?”
This he talk say to test him, for he imself know what he would do.
Philip answer him, “Two hundred denarii worth of bread No be sufficient for dem, that everyone of dem may receive a little.”
One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, talk say to him,
“E get a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but Wetin be these among so many?”
Jesus talk say, “Have the people sit down.” Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
Jesus take the loaves; and having given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to people wey were sitting down; likewise also of the fish as much as dem desired.
When dem were filled, he talk say to his disciples, “Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost.”
So dem gathered dem up, and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves, which were left over by people wey had eaten.
When so the people see the sign which Jesus did, dem talk say, “This is truly the prophet who comes into the world.”
Jesus so, perceiving that dem were about to come and take him by force, to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain by imself.
When evening come, his disciples go down to the sea,
and dem entered into the boat, and were going over the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not come to dem.
The sea was tossed by a great wind blowing.
When so dem had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia, dem see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing near to the boat; and dem were afraid.
But E tell dem say, “It is I. No fear.”
Dem were willing so to receive him into the boat. Sharp-sharp the boat was at the land where dem were going.

On the next day, the plenty people that stood on the other side of the sea see that there was no other boat there, except the one in which his disciples had embarked, and that Jesus hadn’t entered with his disciples into the boat, but his disciples had gone away alone.
However boats from Tiberias come near to the place where dem ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.
When the plenty people so see that Jesus no be there, nor his disciples, dem themselves got into the boats, and come to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.
When dem find him on the other side of the sea, dem ask him, “Rabbi, when did you come here?”
Jesus answer dem, “True true, I tell una, you seek me, not because you see signs, but because you ate of the loaves, and were filled.
No work for the chop which perishes, but for the chop which remains to life wey no dey end, which the Son of Man will give to you. For God the Father has sealed him.”
Dem talk say so to him, “What must we do, that we may work the works of God?”
Jesus answer dem, “This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.”
Dem talk say so to him, “What then do you do for a sign, that we may see, and believe you? What work do you do?
Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness. As it is written, ‘He give dem bread out of heaven to eat.’”
Jesus so talk say to dem, “Most certainly, I tell una, it no be Moses who give you the bread out of heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread out of heaven.
For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven, and gives life to the world.”
Dem talk say so to him, “Lord, always give us this bread.”
Jesus tell dem say, “I be the bread of life. Person wey comes to me No go be hungry, and person wey believe in me will never be thirsty.
But I told you that you have seen me, and yet you no believe.
All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. Person wey comes to me I go in no way throw out.
For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.
This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day.
This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone wey see the Son, and believe in him, should have life wey no dey end; and I go raise him up at the last day.”
The Jews so murmured concerning him, because he talk say, “I be the bread which come down out of heaven.”
Dem talk say, “No be this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then does he say, ‘I have come down out of heaven?’”
So Jesus answer dem, “No murmur among unaself.
Nobody can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him, and I go raise him up in the last day.
It is written in the prophets, ‘Dem go all be taught by God.’ So everyone wey hear from the Father, and has learned, comes to me.
Not that anyone has seen the Father, except person Wey from God. He has seen the Father.
Most certainly, I tell una, person wey believe in me has life wey no dey end.
I be the bread of life.
Una fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, and dem died.
This is the bread which comes down out of heaven, that anyone may eat of it and not die.
I be the living bread which come down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread which I go give for the life of the world is my flesh.”
The Jews so contended with each other, saying, “How can this man give us his flesh to eat?”
Jesus so talk say to dem, “True true, I tell una, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you no have life in unaself.
Person wey eats my flesh and drinks my blood has life wey no dey end, and I go raise him up at the last day.
For my flesh is chop indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
Person wey eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.
As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father; so person wey feeds on me, he will also live because of me.
This is the bread which come down out of heaven — No be like our fathers ate the manna, and died. Person wey eats this bread will live forever.”
He talk say these things in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
So many of his disciples, when dem heard this, talk say, “This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?”
But Jesus knowing in imself that his disciples murmured at this, talk say to dem, “Does this cause you to stumble?
Then what if you would see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?
It is the spirit wey dey give life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to You be spirit, and are life.
But E get some of you who no believe.” For Jesus know from the beginning who dem were who didn’t believe, and who it was who would betray him.
He talk say, “For this cause I have talk say to you that Nobody can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.”
At this, many of his disciples go back, and walked no more with him.
Jesus talk say so to the twelve, “You no also want to go away, do you?”
Simon Peter answer him, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of life wey no dey end.
We have come to believe and know that You be the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
Jesus answer dem, “Didn’t I choose you, the twelve, and one of you is a devil?”
Now he spoke of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, for it was person wey would betray him, being one of the twelve.
After these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn’t walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.
Now the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was at hand.
His brothers so talk say to him, “Depart from here, and go into Judea, that una disciples also may see una works which you do.
For Nobody does anything in secret, and imself seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, reveal yourself to the world.”
For even his brothers didn’t believe in him.
Jesus so talk say to dem, “My time has not yet come, but una time is always ready.
The world no fit hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.
You go up to the feast. I be not yet going up to this feast, because my time No be yet fulfilled.”
Having talk say these things to dem, he stayed in Galilee.
But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also go up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.
The Jews so sought him at the feast, and talk say, “Where is he?”
There was much murmuring among the plenty people concerning him. Some talk say, “He is a good man.” Others talk say, “Not so, but he leads the plenty people astray.”
Yet Nobody spoke openly of him for fear of the Jews.
But when it was now the middle of the feast, Jesus go up into the temple and taught.
The Jews so surprise well-well, saying, “How does this man know letters, having never been educated?”
Jesus so answer dem, “My teaching No be mine, but his who sent me.
If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God, or if I be speaking from myself.
Person wey speaks from imself seeks his own glory, but person wey seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
Didn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”
The plenty people answer, “You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?”
Jesus answer dem, “I did one work, and you all marvel because of it.
Moses has given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers), and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy.
If a boy receives circumcision on the Sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me, because I made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath?
No judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.”
So some of dem of Jerusalem talk say, “No be this he whom dem seek to kill?
See am, he speaks openly, and dem say nothing to him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is truly the Christ?
However we know where this man comes from, but when the Christ comes, Nobody will know where he comes from.”
Jesus so cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, “You both know me, and know where I be from. I have not come of myself, but person wey sent me is true, whom you no know.
I know him, because I be from him, and he sent me.”
Dem sought so to take him; but Nobody laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.
But of the plenty people, many believe in him. Dem talk say, “When the Christ comes, he no go do more signs than those which this man has done, will he?”
The Pharisees heard the plenty people murmuring these things concerning him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.
Then Jesus talk say, “I go be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.
You go seek me, and no go find me; and where I be, you no fit come.”
The Jews so talk say among themselves, “Where will this man go that we no go find him? Will he go to the Dispersion among the Greeks, and teach the Greeks?
Wetin be this word that he talk say, ‘You go seek me, and no go find me; and where I be, you no fit come’?”
Now on the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, “If anyone is thirsty, Make e come to me and drink!
Person wey believe in me, as the Scripture has talk say, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”
But he talk say this about the Spirit, which those believing in him were to receive. For the Holy Spirit No be yet given, because Jesus no be yet glorified.
Many of the plenty people so, when dem heard these words, talk say, “This is truly the prophet.”
Others talk say, “This is the Christ.” But some talk say, “What, does the Christ come out of Galilee?
Hasn’t the Scripture talk say that the Christ comes of the offspring of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?”
So there arose a division in the plenty people because of him.
Some of dem would have arrested him, but Nobody laid hands on him.
The officers so come to the chief priests and Pharisees, and Dem tell dem say, “Why didn’t you bring him?”
The officers answer, “No man ever spoke like this man!”
The Pharisees so answer dem, “You no be also led astray, are you?
Have any of the rulers believe in him, or of the Pharisees?
But this plenty people that no dey know the law is accursed.”
Nicodemus (person wey come to him by night, being one of dem) talk say to dem,
“Does our law judge a man, unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?”
Dem answer him, “Are you also from Galilee? Search, and see that no prophet has arisen out of Galilee.”
Everyone go to his own house,
but Jesus go to the Mount of Olives.
Now very early in the morning, he come again into the temple, and all the people come to him. He sat down, and taught dem.
The scribes and the Pharisees bring a woman taken in adultery. Having set her in the middle,
dem told him, “Teacher, we find this woman in adultery, in the very act.
Now in our law, Moses commanded us to stone such women. What then do you say about her?”
Dem talk say this testing him, that dem might have something to accuse him of. But Jesus stooped down, and wrote on the ground with his finger.
But when dem continued asking him, he looked up and talk say to dem, “Person Wey without sin among you, Make e throw the first stone at her.”
Again he stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground.
Dem, when dem heard it, being convicted by dem conscience, go out one by one, beginning from the oldest, even to the last. Jesus was left alone with the woman where she was, in the middle.
Jesus, standing up, see her and talk say, “Woman, where are una accusers? Did Nobody condemn you?”
She talk say, “Nobody, Lord.” Jesus talk say, “Neither do I condemn you. Go una way. From now on, sin no more.”
Again, so, Jesus spoke to dem, saying, “I be the light of the world. Person wey follows me No go walk in the darkness, but Go get the light of life.”
The Pharisees so talk say to him, “You testify about yourself. Una testimony No be valid.”
Jesus answer dem, “Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is true, for I know where I come from, and where I be going; but you no know where I come from, or where I be going.
You judge according to the flesh. I judge Nobody.
Even if I do judge, my judgment is true, for I be not alone, but I be with the Father who sent me.
It’s also written in una law that the testimony of two people is valid.
I be one who testifies about myself, and the Father who sent me testifies about me.”
Dem talk say so to him, “Where is una Father?” Jesus answer, “You know neither me, nor my Father. If you know me, you would know my Father also.”
Jesus spoke these words in the treasury, as he taught in the temple. Yet Nobody arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.
Jesus talk say so again to dem, “I be going away, and You go seek me, and You go die in una sins. Where I go, you no fit come.”
The Jews so talk say, “Will he kill imself, that he says, ‘Where I be going, you no fit come’?”
E tell dem say, “You be from beneath. I be from above. You be of this world. I be not of this world.
I talk say so to you that You go die in una sins; for unless you believe that I be he, You go die in una sins.”
Dem talk say so to him, “Wey be you?” Jesus tell dem say, “Just what I Don dey saying to you from the beginning.
I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However person wey sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these I say to the world.”
Dem didn’t understand that he spoke to dem about the Father.
Jesus so talk say to dem, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then You go know that I be he, and I do nothing of myself, but as my Father taught me, I say these things.
Person wey sent me is with me. The Father hasn’t left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him.”
As he spoke these things, many believe in him.
Jesus so talk say to those Jews who had believe him, “If you remain in my word, then You be truly my disciples.
You go know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”
Dem answer him, “We be Abraham’s offspring, and have never been in bondage to anyone. How do you say, ‘You go be made free’?”
Jesus answer dem, “True true, I tell una, Everybody wey commits sin is the bondservant of sin.
A bondservant no dey live in the house forever. A son remains forever.
If so the Son makes you free, You go be free indeed.
I know that You be Abraham’s offspring, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.
I say the things which I have seen with my Father; and you also do the things which you have seen with una father.”
Dem answer him, “Our father is Abraham.” Jesus tell dem say, “If you were Abraham’s pikin dem, you would do the works of Abraham.
But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth, which I heard from God. Abraham didn’t do this.
You do the works of una father.” Dem tell am say, “We No be born of sexual immorality. We have one Father, God.”
So Jesus tell dem say, “If God were una father, you would love me, for I come out and have come from God. For I haven’t come of myself, but he sent me.
Why no you understand my speech? Because you no fit hear my word.

You be of una father, the devil, and you want to do the desires of una father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and no dey stand in the truth, because E get no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks on his own; for he is a liar, and its father.
But because I tell the truth, you no believe me.
Which of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?
Person Wey of God hears the words of God. For this cause you no hear, because you No be of God.”
Then the Jews answer him, “No we say well that You be a Samaritan, and have a demon?”
Jesus answer, “I no have a demon, but I honor my Father, and you dishonor me.
But I no seek my own glory. E get one who seeks and judges.
Most certainly, I tell una, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death.”
Then the Jews talk say to him, “Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, and the prophets; and you say, ‘If a man keeps my word, he will never taste of death.’
Are you greater than our father, Abraham, who died? The prophets died. Who do you make yourself out to be?”
Jesus answer, “If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say that he is our God.
You have not known him, but I know him. If I talk say, ‘I no know him,’ I would be like you, a liar. But I know him, and keep his word.
Una father Abraham rejoiced to see my day. He see it, and was glad.”
The Jews so talk say to him, “You No be yet fifty years old, and have you seen Abraham?”
Jesus tell dem say, “Most certainly, I tell una, before Abraham come into existence, I be. ”
So dem take up stones to throw at him, but Jesus was hidden, and go out of the temple, having gone through the middle of dem, and so passed by.
As he passed by, he see a man blind from birth.
His disciples ask him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”
Jesus answer, “Neither did this man sin, nor his parents; but, that the works of God might be revealed in him.
I must work the works of him who sent me, while it is day. The night is coming, when Nobody can work.
While I be in the world, I be the light of the world.”
When he had talk say this, he spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, anointed the blind man’s eyes with the mud,
and talk say to him, “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So he go away, washed, and come back seeing.
The neighbors so, and people wey see that he was blind before, talk say, “No be this person wey sat and begged?”
Others were saying, “It is he.” Still others were saying, “He looks like him.” He talk say, “I be he.”
Dem so were asking him, “How were una eyes opened?”
He answer, “A man call Jesus made mud, anointed my eyes, and talk say to me, ‘Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash.’ So I go away and washed, and I received sight.”
Then dem ask him, “Where is he?” He talk say, “I no know.”
Dem bring him who Bin dey blind to the Pharisees.
It was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.
Again so the Pharisees also ask him how he received his sight. E tell dem say, “He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and I see.”
Some so of the Pharisees talk say, “This man No be from God, because he no dey keep the Sabbath.” Others talk say, “How can a man Wey be a sinner do such signs?” There was division among dem.
So dem ask the blind man again, “What do you say about him, because he opened una eyes?” He talk say, “He is a prophet.”
The Jews so No believe concerning him, that he Bin dey blind, and had received his sight, until dem call the parents of him who had received his sight,
and ask dem, “Is this una son, whom you say was born blind? How then does he now see?”
His parents answer dem, “We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;
but how he now sees, we no know; or who opened his eyes, we no know. He is of age. Ask him. He will speak for imself.”
His parents talk say these things because dem feared the Jews; for the Jews had already agreed that if any man would confess him as Christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.
So his parents talk say, “He is of age. Ask him.”
So dem call the man who was blind a second time, and talk say to him, “Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner.”
He so answer, “I no know if he is a sinner. One thing I do know: that though I was blind, now I see.”
Dem tell am say again, “What did he do to you? How did he open una eyes?”
He answer dem, “I told you already, and you didn’t listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You no also want to become his disciples, do you?”
Dem insulted him and talk say, “You be his disciple, but We be disciples of Moses.
We know that God has spoken to Moses. But as for this man, we no know where he comes from.”
The man answer dem, “How amazing! You no know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.
We know that God no dey listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshiper of God, and does his will, he listens to him.
Since the world began it has never been heard of that anyone opened the eyes of someone born blind.
If this man No be from God, he could do nothing.”
Dem answer him, “You were altogether born in sins, and do you teach us?” Dem threw him out.
Jesus heard that dem had thrown him out, and finding him, he talk say, “Do you believe in the Son of God?”
He answer, “Wey be he, Lord, that I may believe in him?”
Jesus tell am say, “You have both seen him, and it is person wey speaks with you.”
He talk say, “Lord, I believe!” and he worshiped him.
Jesus talk say, “I come into this world for judgment, that people wey no see may see; and that people wey see may become blind.”
Those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things, and talk say to him, “Are we also blind?”
Jesus tell dem say, “If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, ‘We see.’ So una sin remains.
“Most certainly, I tell una, one who no dey enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.
But one who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name, and leads dem out.
Whenever he brings out his own sheep, he goes before dem, and the sheep follow him, for dem know his voice.
Dem go by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him; for dem no know the voice of strangers.”
Jesus spoke this parable to dem, but dem didn’t understand what he was telling dem.
Jesus so talk say to dem again, “Most certainly, I tell una, I be the sheep’s door.
All who come before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn’t listen to dem.
I be the door. If anyone enters in by me, he Go be saved, and will go in and go out, and will find pasture.
The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I come that dem may have life, and may have it abundantly.
I be the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
Person Wey a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who no dey own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. The wolf snatches the sheep, and scatters dem.
The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand, and no dey care for the sheep.
I be the good shepherd. I know my own, and I’m known by my own;
even as the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.
I have other sheep, which No be of this fold. I must bring dem also, and Dem go hear my voice. Dem go become one flock with one shepherd.
So the Father loves me, because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.
Nobody takes it away from me, but I lay it down by myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. I received this commandment from my Father.”
So a division arose again among the Jews because of these words.
Many of dem talk say, “He has a demon, and is insane! Why do you listen to him?”
Others talk say, “These No be the sayings of one possessed by a demon. It no be possible for a demon to open the eyes of the blind, is it?”
It was the Feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem.
It was winter, and Jesus was walking in the temple, in Solomon’s porch.
The Jews so come around him and talk say to him, “How long will you hold us in suspense? If You be the Christ, tell us plainly.”
Jesus answer dem, “I told you, and you no believe. The works that I do in my Father’s name, these testify about me.
But you no believe, because you No be of my sheep, as I told you.
My sheep hear my voice, and I know dem, and dem follow me.
I give life wey no dey end to dem. Dem go never perish, and Nobody will snatch dem out of my hand.
My Father, who has given dem to me, is greater than all. Nobody is able to snatch dem out of my Father’s hand.
I and the Father are one.”
So Jews take up stones again to stone him.
Jesus answer dem, “I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?”
The Jews answer him, “We no stone you for a good work, but for blasphemy: because you, being a man, make yourself God.”
Jesus answer dem, “No be it written in una law, ‘I talk say, You be gods?’
If he call dem gods, to whom the word of God come (and the Scripture no fit be broken),
do you say of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘You blaspheme,’ because I talk say, ‘I be the Son of God?’
If I no do the works of my Father, no believe me.
But if I do dem, though you no believe me, believe the works; that you may know and believe that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.”
Dem sought again to seize him, and he go out of dem hand.
He go away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first, and there he stayed.
Many come to him. Dem talk say, “John indeed did no sign, but everything that John talk say about this man is true.”
Many believe in him there.
Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus from Bethany, of the village of Mary and her sister, Martha.
It was that Mary who had anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother, Lazarus, was sick.
The sisters so sent to him, saying, “Lord, see am, he for whom you have great affection is sick.”
But when Jesus heard it, he talk say, “This sickness No be to death, but for the glory of God, that God’s Son may be glorified by it.”
Now Jesus love Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.
When so he heard that he was sick, he stayed two days in the place where he was.
Then after this he talk say to the disciples, “Let’s go into Judea again.”
The disciples told him, “Rabbi, the Jews were just trying to stone you, and are you going there again?”
Jesus answer, “No be there twelve hours of daylight? If a man walks in the day, he no dey stumble, because he sees the light of this world.
But if a man walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light no be in him.”
He talk say these things, and after that, E tell dem say, “Our friend, Lazarus, has fallen asleep, but I be going so that I may awake him out of sleep.”
The disciples so talk say, “Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will recover.”
Now Jesus had spoken of his death, but dem thought that he spoke of taking rest in sleep.
So Jesus tell dem say plainly then, “Lazarus is dead.
I be glad for una sakes that I No be there, so that you may believe. Nevertheless, let’s go to him.”
Thomas so, Wey be call Didymus, talk say to his fellow disciples, “Let’s go also, that we may die with him.”
So when Jesus come, he find that he Bin dey in the tomb four days already.
Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away.
Many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary, to console dem concerning dem brother.
Then when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she go and met him, but Mary stayed in the house.
So Martha talk say to Jesus, “Lord, if you would Don dey here, my brother wouldn’t have died.
Even now I know that, Anything wey you ask of God, God will give you.”
Jesus tell am say, “Una brother will rise again.”
Martha talk say to him, “I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”
Jesus tell am say, “I be the resurrection and the life. Person wey believe in me will still live, even if he dies.
Anybody wey lives and believe in me will never die. Do you believe this?”
She talk say to him, “Yes, Lord. I have come to believe that You be the Christ, God’s Son, person wey comes into the world.”
When she had talk say this, she go away, and call Mary, her sister, secretly, saying, “The Teacher is here, and is calling you.”
When she heard this, she arose sharp-sharp, and go to him.
Now Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was in the place where Martha met him.
Then the Jews who were with her in the house, and were consoling her, when dem see Mary, that she rose up sharp-sharp and go out, follow her, saying, “She is going to the tomb to weep there.”
So when Mary come to where Jesus was, and see him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, “Lord, if you would Don dey here, my brother wouldn’t have died.”
When Jesus so see her weeping, and the Jews weeping who come with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,
and talk say, “Where have you laid him?” Dem told him, “Lord, come and see.”
Jesus wept.
The Jews so talk say, “See how much affection he had for him!”
Some of dem talk say, “No fit this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?”
Jesus so, again groaning in imself, come to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.
Jesus talk say, “Take away the stone.” Martha, the sister of him who was dead, talk say to him, “Lord, by this time E get a stench, for he Don dey dead four days.”
Jesus tell am say, “Didn’t I tell una that if you believe, you would see God’s glory?”
So dem take away the stone from the place where the dead man was lying. Jesus lifted up his eyes, and talk say, “Father, I thank you that you listened to me.
I know that you always listen to me, but because of the plenty people that stands around I talk say this, that dem may believe that you sent me.”
When he had talk say this, he cried with a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”
Person wey was dead come out, bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped around with a cloth. Jesus tell dem say, “Free him, and Make e go.”
So many of the Jews, who come to Mary and see what Jesus did, believe in him.
But some of dem go away to the Pharisees, and told dem the things which Jesus had done.
The chief priests so and the Pharisees gathered a council, and talk say, “Wetin be we doing? For this man does many signs.
If we leave him alone like this, everyone will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.”
But a certain one of dem, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, talk say to dem, “You know nothing at all,
nor do you consider that it is advantageous for us that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation not perish.”
Now he didn’t say this of imself, but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation,
and not for the nation only, but that he might also gather together into one the pikin dem of God Wey be scattered abroad.
So from that day forward dem take counsel that dem might put him to death.
Jesus so walked no more openly among the Jews, but comot from there into the country near the wilderness, to a city call Ephraim. He stayed there with his disciples.
Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand. Many go up from the country to Jerusalem before the Passover, to purify themselves.
Then dem sought for Jesus and spoke one with another, as dem stood in the temple, “What do you think — that he no be coming to the feast at all?”
Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had commanded that if anyone know where he was, he should report it, that dem might seize him.
Then six days before the Passover, Jesus come to Bethany, where Lazarus was, who Bin dey dead, whom he raised from the dead.
So dem made him a supper there. Martha served, but Lazarus was one of people wey sat at the table with him.
Mary, so, take a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.
Then Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, one of his disciples, who would betray him, talk say,
“Why no be this ointment sold for three hundred denarii, and given to the poor?”
Now he talk say this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, used to steal what was put into it.
But Jesus talk say, “Leave her alone. She has kept this for the day of my burial.
For you always have the poor with you, but you no always have me.”
A large crowd so of the Jews learned that he was there, and dem come, not for Jesus’ sake only, but that dem might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also,
because on account of him many of the Jews go away and believe in Jesus.
On the next day Plenty people had come to the feast. When dem heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
dem take the branches of the palm trees, and go out to meet him, and cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is person wey comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!”
Jesus, having find a young donkey, sat on it. As it is written,
“No fear, daughter of Zion. See am, una King comes, sitting on a donkey’s colt.”
His disciples didn’t understand these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then dem remember that these things were written about him, and that dem had done these things to him.
The plenty people so that was with him when he call Lazarus out of the tomb, and raised him from the dead, was testifying about it.
For this cause also the plenty people go and met him, because dem heard that he had done this sign.
The Pharisees so talk say among themselves, “See how you accomplish nothing. See am, the world has gone after him.”
Now there were certain Greeks among those that go up to worship at the feast.
These, so, come to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and ask him, saying, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”
Philip come and told Andrew, and in turn, Andrew come with Philip, and dem told Jesus.
Jesus answer dem, “The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.
True true, I tell una, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.
Person wey loves his life will lose it. Person wey hates his life in this world will keep it to life wey no dey end.
If anyone serves me, Make e follow me. Where I be, there will my worker also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor him.
“Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this time?’ But for this cause I come to this time.
Father, glorify una name!” Then there come a voice out of the sky, saying, “I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.”
The plenty people so, who stood by and heard it, talk say that it had thundered. Others talk say, “An angel has spoken to him.”
Jesus answer, “This voice hasn’t come for my sake, but for una sakes.
Now is the judgment of this world. Now the prince of this world Go be throw out.
And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”
But he talk say this, signifying by what kind of death he should die.
The plenty people answer him, “We have heard out of the law that the Christ remains forever. How do you say, ‘The Son of Man must be lifted up?’ Wey be this Son of Man?”
Jesus so talk say to dem, “Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness no dey overtake you. Person wey walks in the darkness no dey know where he is going.
While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become pikin dem of light.” Jesus talk say these things, and he comot and hid imself from dem.
But though he had done so many signs before dem, yet dem didn’t believe in him,
that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke, “Lord, who has believe our report? To whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”
For this cause dem no fit believe, for Isaiah talk say again,
“He has blinded dem eyes and he hardened dem heart, lest dem should see with dem eyes, and perceive with dem heart, and would turn, and I would heal dem.”
Isaiah talk say these things when he see his glory, and spoke of him.
Nevertheless even of the rulers many believe in him, but because of the Pharisees dem didn’t confess it, so that dem wouldn’t be put out of the synagogue,
for dem love men’s praise more than God’s praise.
Jesus cried out and talk say, “Anybody wey believe in me, believe not in me, but in him who sent me.
Person wey sees me sees him who sent me.
I have come as a light into the world, that Anybody wey believe in me may not remain in the darkness.
If anyone listens to my sayings, and no dey believe, I no judge him. For I come not to judge the world, but to save the world.
Person wey rejects me, and no dey receive my sayings, has one who judges him. The word that I spoke, the same will judge him in the last day.
For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me, he give me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.
I know that his commandment is life wey no dey end. The things so which I speak, even as the Father has talk say to me, so I speak.”
Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the Father, having love his own who were in the world, he love dem to the end.
During supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him,
Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he come from God, and was going to God,
arose from supper, and laid aside his outer garments. He take a towel, and wrapped a towel around his waist.
Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples’ feet, and to wipe dem with the towel that was wrapped around him.
Then he come to Simon Peter. E tell am say, “Lord, do you wash my feet?”
Jesus answer him, “You no know what I be doing now, but You go understand later.”
Peter talk say to him, “You go never wash my feet!” Jesus answer him, “If I no wash you, you have no part with me.”
Simon Peter talk say to him, “Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!”
Jesus tell am say, “Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. You be clean, but not all of you.”
For he know him who would betray him, so he talk say, “You No be all clean.”
So when he had washed dem feet, put his outer garment back on, and sat down again, E tell dem say, “Do you know what I have done to you?
You call me, ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord.’ You say so correctly, for so I be.
If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed una feet, you also ought to wash each other’s feet.
For I have given you an example, that you also should do as I have done to you.
True true, I tell una, a worker No be greater than his lord, neither one Wey be sent greater than person wey sent him.
If you know these things, blessed are you if you do dem.
I no speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen. But that the Scripture may be fulfilled, ‘Person wey eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.’
From now on, I tell una before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I be he.
True true, I tell una, person wey receives whomever I send, receives me; and person wey receives me, receives him who sent me.”
When Jesus had talk say this, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, “True true, I tell una that one of You go betray me.”
The disciples looked at each other, perplexed about whom he spoke.
One of his disciples, whom Jesus love, was at the table, leaning against Jesus’ breast.
Simon Peter so beckoned to him, and talk say to him, “Tell us who it is of whom he speaks.”
He, leaning back, as he was, on Jesus’ breast, ask him, “Lord, Wey be it?”
Jesus so answer, “It is he to whom I go give this piece of bread when I have dipped it.” So when he had dipped the piece of bread, he give it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.
After the piece of bread, then Satan entered into him. Then Jesus tell am say, “Wetin you do, do sharp-sharp.”
Now no man at the table know why he talk say this to him.
For some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus tell am say, “Buy what things we need for the feast,” or that he should give something to the poor.
So having received that morsel, he go out sharp-sharp. It was night.
When he had gone out, Jesus talk say, “Now the Son of Man Don dey glorified, and God Don dey glorified in him.
If God Don dey glorified in him, God will also glorify him in imself, and he will glorify him sharp-sharp.
Little pikin dem, I go be with you a little while longer. You go seek me, and as I talk say to the Jews, ‘Where I be going, you no fit come,’ so now I tell una.
A new commandment I give to you, that you love each other. Just as I have love you, you also love each other.
By this everyone will know that You be my disciples, if you have love for each other.”
Simon Peter talk say to him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answer, “Where I be going, you no fit follow now, but You go follow afterwards.”
Peter talk say to him, “Lord, why no fit I follow you now? I go lay down my life for you.”
Jesus answer him, “Will you lay down una life for me? True true, I tell una, the rooster no go crow until you have denied me three times.
“Make una heart no worry. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
In my Father’s house are many homes. If it no be so, I would have told you. I be going to prepare a place for you.
If I go and prepare a place for you, I go come again, and will receive you to myself; that where I be, you may be there also.
Where I go, you know, and you know the way.”
Thomas talk say to him, “Lord, we no know where You be going. How can we know the way?”
Jesus tell am say, “I be the way, the truth, and the life. Nobody comes to the Father, except through me.
If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him, and have seen him.”
Philip talk say to him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that Go be enough for us.”
Jesus tell am say, “Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? Person wey has seen me has seen the Father. How do you say, ‘Show us the Father?’
No you believe that I be in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell una, I speak not from myself; but the Father who lives in me does his works.
Believe me that I be in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works’ sake.
True true, I tell una, person wey believe in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because I be going to my Father.
Anything wey You go ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
If You go ask anything in my name, I go do it.
If you love me, keep my commandments.
I go pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever, —
the Spirit of truth, whom the world no fit receive; for it no dey see him, neither knows him. You know him, for he lives with you, and Go be in you.
I go not leave you orphans. I go come to you.
Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but You go see me. Because I live, You go live also.
In that day You go know that I be in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.
One who has my commandments, and keeps dem, that person is one wey love me. One wey love me Go be love by my Father, and I go love him, and will reveal myself to him.”
Judas (not Iscariot) talk say to him, “Lord, what has happened that You be about to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?”
Jesus answer him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and We go come to him, and make our home with him.
Person wey no dey love me no dey keep my words. The word which you hear no be mine, but the Father’s who sent me.
I have talk say these things to you, while still living with you.
But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I talk say to you.
I leave peace with una. Na my own peace I give una; No be like the world gives, na so I give una. Make una heart no worry, neither let it be fearful.
You heard how I told you, ‘I go away, and I come to you.’ If you love me, you would have rejoiced, because I talk say ‘I be going to my Father;’ for the Father is greater than I.
Now I have told you before it happens so that, when it happens, you may believe.
I go no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.
But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, Make we go from here.
“I be the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.
Every branch in me that no dey bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.
You be already pruned clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.
Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch no fit bear fruit by itself, unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.
I be the vine. You be the branches. Person wey remains in me, and I in him, the same bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.
If a man no dey remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch, and is withered; and dem gather dem, throw dem into the fire, and Dem be burned.
If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, You go ask Anything wey you desire, and it Go be done for you.
“In this is my Father glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so You go be my disciples.
Even as the Father has love me, I also have love you. Remain in my love.
If you keep my commandments, You go remain in my love; even as I have kept my Father’s commandments, and remain in his love.
I have spoken these things to you, that my gladness may remain in you, and that una gladness may be made full.
“This is my commandment, that you love each other, even as I have love you.
Greater love has Nobody than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.
You be my friends, if you do Anything wey I command you.
No longer do I call you workers, for the worker no dey know what his lord does. But I have call you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.

You didn’t choose me, but I chose you, and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that una fruit should remain; that Anything wey You go ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.
“I command these things to you, that you may love each other.
If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.
If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you No be of the world, since I chose you out of the world, so the world hates you.
Remember the word that I talk say to you: ‘A worker No be greater than his lord.’ If dem persecuted me, Dem go also persecute you. If dem kept my word, Dem go also keep yours.
But all these things will dem do to you for my name’s sake, because dem no know him who sent me.
If I had not come and spoken to dem, dem would not have had sin; but now dem have no excuse for dem sin.
Person wey hates me, hates my Father also.
If I hadn’t done among dem the works which Nobody else did, dem wouldn’t have had sin. But now have dem seen and also hated both me and my Father.
But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in dem law, ‘Dem hated me without a cause.’
“When the Counselor has come, whom I go send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.
You go also testify, because you Don dey with me from the beginning.
“I have talk say these things to you so that you wouldn’t be caused to stumble.
Dem go put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time comes that Anybody wey kills You go think that he offers service to God.
Dem go do these things because dem have not known the Father, nor me.
But I have told you these things, so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about dem. I didn’t tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.
But now I be going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’
But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled una heart.
Nevertheless I tell una the truth: It is to una advantage that I go away, for if I no go away, the Counselor no go come to you. But if I go, I go send him to you.
When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;
about sin, because dem no believe in me;
about righteousness, because I be going to my Father, and you no go see me any more;
about judgment, because the prince of this world Don dey judged.
“I have yet many things to tell you, but you no fit bear dem now.

However when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he No go speak from imself; but Anything wey he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.
He will glorify me, for he will take from Wetin be mine, and will declare it to you.
All things Anything wey the Father has are mine; so I talk say that he takes of mine, and will declare it to you.
A little while, and You go not see me. Again a little while, and You go see me.”

Some of his disciples so talk say to each other, “Wetin be this that he says to us, ‘A little while, and you no go see me, and again a little while, and You go see me;’ and, ‘Because I go to the Father’?”
Dem talk say so, “Wetin be this that he says, ‘A little while’? We no know what he is saying.”

So Jesus perceived that dem want to ask him, and E tell dem say, “Do you inquire among unaself concerning this, that I talk say, ‘A little while, and you no go see me, and again a little while, and You go see me?’
True true, I tell una, that You go weep and lament, but the world will glad well-well. You go be sorrowful, but una sorrow Go be turned into gladness.

A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow, because her time has come. But when she has delivered the pikin, she no dey remember the anguish any more, for the gladness that a human being is born into the world.
So you now have sorrow, but I go see you again, and una heart will glad well-well, and Nobody will take una gladness away from you.
“In that day You go ask me no questions. True true, I tell una, Anything wey you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.
Until now, you have ask nothing in my name. Ask, and You go receive, that una gladness may be made full.
I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I go no more speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.
In that day You go ask in my name; and I no say to you, that I go pray to the Father for you,
for the Father imself loves you, because you have love me, and have believe that I come from God.
I come from the Father, and have come into the world. Again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.”
His disciples talk say to him, “See am, now you speak plainly, and speak no figures of speech.
Now we know that you know all things, and no need for anyone to question you. By this we believe that you come from God.”
Jesus answer dem, “Do you now believe?
See am, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that You go be scattered, everyone to his own place, and You go leave me alone. Yet I be not alone, because the Father is with me.
I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have oppression; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”
Jesus talk say these things, and lifting up his eyes to heaven, he talk say, “Father, the time has come. Glorify una Son, that una Son may also glorify you;
even as you give him authority over all flesh, he will give life wey no dey end to all whom you have given him.
This is life wey no dey end, that dem should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.
