If indeed dem Bin dey thinking of that country from which dem go out, dem would have had enough time to return.
But now dem desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. So God No be ashamed of dem, to be call dem God, for he has prepared a city for dem.
By faith, Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. Yes, person wey had gladly received the promises was offering up his one and only son,
to whom it was talk say, “una offspring Go be accounted as from Isaac”;
concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from the dead.
By faith, Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.
By faith, Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.
By faith, Joseph, when his end was near, made mention of the departure of the pikin dem of Israel; and give instructions concerning his bones.
By faith, Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because dem see that he was a beautiful pikin, and dem No be afraid of the king’s commandment.
By faith, Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be call the son of Pharaoh’s daughter,
choosing rather to share ill treatment with God’s people, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time;
accounting the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he looked to the reward.
By faith, he left Egypt, not fearing the serious anger of the king; for he endured, as seeing him Wey be invisible.
By faith, he kept the Passover, and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn no suppose touch dem.
By faith, dem passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, dem were swallowed up.
By faith, the walls of Jericho fell down, after dem Bin dey encircled for seven days.
By faith, Rahab the prostitute, didn’t perish with people wey were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.
What more shall I say? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets;
who, through faith subdued kingdoms, worked out righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,
quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, from weakness were made strong, grew mighty in war, and caused foreign armies to flee.
Women received dem dead by resurrection. Others were tortured, not accepting dem deliverance, that dem might obtain a better resurrection.
Others were tried by mocking and scourging, yes, moreover by bonds and imprisonment.
Dem were stoned. Dem were sawn apart. Dem were tempted. Dem were slain with the sword. Dem go around in sheep skins and in goat skins; being destitute, afflicted, ill-treated
(of whom the world No be worthy), wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.
These all, having had testimony given to dem through dem faith, didn’t receive the promise,
God having provided some better thing concerning us, so that apart from us dem no suppose be made perfect.

So Make we also, seeing We be surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and Make we run with perseverance the race that is set before us,
looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the gladness that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against imself, that you no grow weary, fainting in una souls.
You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin;
and you have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with pikin dem, “My son, no take lightly the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when You be reproved by him;
For whom the Lord loves, he chastens, and scourges every son whom he receives.”
It is for discipline that you endure. God deals with you as with pikin dem, for what son is there whom his father no dey discipline?
But if You be without discipline, of which all Don dey made partakers, then are you illegitimate, and not pikin dem.
Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid dem respect. Shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits, and live?
For dem indeed, for a few days, punished us as seemed good to dem; but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.
All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to people wey Don dey exercised through am.
So lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees,
and make straight paths for una feet, so that which is lame may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.
Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,
looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and many be defiled by it;
lest there be any sexually immoral person, or profane person, like Esau, who sold his birthright for one meal.
For you know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he find no place for a change of mind though he sought it diligently with tears.
For you have not come to a mountain that might be touched, and that burned with fire, and to blackness, darkness, storm,
the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which people wey heard it begged that not one more word should be spoken to dem,
for dem could not stand that which was commanded, “If even an animal touches the mountain, it go be stoned”;
and so fearful was the appearance that Moses talk say, “I be terrified and trembling.”
But you have come to Mount Zion, and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable plenty people of angels,
to the festal gathering and assembly of the firstborn Wey be enrolled in heaven, to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of just men made perfect,
to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better than that of Abel.
See that you no refuse him who speaks. For if dem didn’t escape when dem refused him who warned on the earth, how much more will we not escape who turn away from him who warns from heaven,
whose voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, “Yet once more I go shake not only the earth, but also the heavens.”
This phrase, “Yet once more”, signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that Don dey made, that those things which No be shaken may remain.
So, receiving a Kingdom that no fit be shaken, Make we have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,
for our God is a consuming fire.
Let brotherly love continue.
No forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.
Remember people Wey in bonds, as bound with dem; and people Wey ill-treated, since You be also in the body.
Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled: but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has talk say, “I go in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”
So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I go not fear. What can man do to me?”
Remember una leaders, men who spoke to you the word of God, and considering the results of dem conduct, imitate dem faith.
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
No be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by chop, through which people wey were so occupied No be benefited.
We have an altar from which people wey serve the holy tabernacle have no right to eat.
For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is bring into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned outside of the camp.
So Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered outside of the gate.
Make we so go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.
For we no have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.
Through him, then, Make we offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.
But no forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

Obey una leaders and submit to dem, for dem watch on behalf of una souls, as people wey will give account, that dem may do this with gladness, and not with groaning, for that would be unprofitable for you.
Pray for us, for We be persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.
I strongly urge you to do this, that I may be restored to you sooner.
Now may the God of peace, who bring again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, our Lord Jesus,
make you complete in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
But I exhort you, brothers, endure the word of exhortation; for I have written to you in few words.
Know that our brother Timothy Don dey freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I go see you.
Greet all of una leaders and all the saints. The Italians greet you.
Grace be with you all. Amen.
James, a worker of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion: Greetings.
Count it all gladness, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations,
knowing that the testing of una faith produces endurance.
Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.
But if any of you lacks wisdom, Make e ask of God, wey dey give to all liberally and without reproach; and it Go be given to him.
But Make e ask in faith, without any doubting, for person wey doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.
For let that man not think that he will receive anything from the Lord.
He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.
But let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;
and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.
For the sun arises with the scorching wind, and withers the grass, and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So also will the rich man fade away in his pursuits.
Blessed is the man who endures temptation, for when he Don dey approved, he will receive the crown of life, which the Lord promised to people wey love him.
Let no man say when he is tempted, “I be tempted by God,” for God no fit be tempted by evil, and he imself tempts Nobody.
But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust, and enticed.
Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin; and the sin, when it is full grown, produces death.
No be deceived, my beloved brothers.
Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation, nor turning shadow.
Of his own will he give birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.
So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;
for the anger of man no dey produce the righteousness of God.
So, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save una souls.
But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding una own selves.
For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;
for he sees imself, and goes away, and sharp-sharp forgets what kind of man he was.
But person wey looks into the perfect law of freedom, and continues, not being a hearer who forgets, but a doer of the work, this man Go be blessed in what he does.
If anyone among you thinks imself to be religious while he no dey bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man’s religion is worthless.
Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in dem suffering, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.
My brothers, no hold the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ of glory with partiality.
For if a man with a gold ring, in fine clothing, comes into una synagogue, and a poor man in filthy clothing also comes in;
and you pay special attention to him who wears the fine clothing, and say, “Sit here in a good place”; and you tell the poor man, “Stand there,” or “Sit by my footstool”;
haven’t you shown partiality among unaself, and become judges with evil thoughts?
Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose people Wey poor in this world to be rich in faith, and heirs of the Kingdom which he promised to people wey love him?
But you have dishonored the poor man. No the rich oppress you, and personally drag you before the courts?
No dem blaspheme the honorable name by which You be call?
However, if you fulfill the royal law, according to the Scripture, “You shall love una neighbor as yourself,” you do well.
But if you show partiality, you commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.
For Anybody wey keeps the whole law, and yet stumbles in one point, he has become guilty of all.
For person wey talk say, “No commit adultery,” also talk say, “No commit murder.” Now if you No commit adultery, but murder, you have become a transgressor of the law.
So speak, and so do, as men Wey be to be judged by a law of freedom.
For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?
And if a brother or sister is naked and in lack of daily chop,
and one of you tells dem, “Go in peace, be warmed and filled”; and yet you didn’t give dem the things the body needs, what good is it?
Even so faith, if it has no works, is dead in itself.
Yes, a man will say, “You have faith, and I have works.” Show me una faith without works, and I by my works will show you my faith.
You believe that God is one. You do well. The demons also believe, and shudder.
But do you want to know, vain man, that faith apart from works is dead?
No be Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son on the altar?
You see that faith worked with his works, and by works faith was perfected;
and the Scripture was fulfilled which says, “Abraham believe God, and it was accounted to him as righteousness”; and he was call the friend of God.
You see then that by works, a man is justified, and not only by faith.
In the same way, no be Rahab the prostitute also justified by works, in that she received the messengers, and sent dem out another way?
For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, even so faith apart from works is dead.
Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that We go receive heavier judgment.
For in many things we all stumble. If anyone no dey stumble in word, the same is a perfect man, able to bridle the whole body also.
Indeed, we put bits into the horses’ mouths so that dem may obey us, and we guide dem whole body.
See am, the ships also, though Dem be so big and are driven by fierce winds, are yet guided by a very small rudder, Anywhere wey the pilot desires.
So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!
And the tongue is a fire. The world of wickedness among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by Gehenna.
For every kind of animal, bird, creeping thing, and sea creature, is tamed, and Don dey tamed by mankind;
but nobody can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.
With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men, Wey be made in the image of God.
Out of the same mouth comes blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.
Does a spring send out from the same opening fresh and bitter water?
Can a fig tree, my brothers, yield olives, or a vine figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh water.
Wey be wise and understanding among you? Make e show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom.
But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in una heart, no boast and no lie against the truth.
This wisdom No be that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.
For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, E get confusion and every evil deed.
But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by people wey make peace.
Where do wars and fightings among you come from? No dem come from una pleasures that war in una members?
You lust, and no have. You murder and covet, and no fit obtain. You fight and make war. You no have, because you no ask.
You ask, and no receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it for una pleasures.
You adulterers and adulteresses, no you know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Anybody wey so wants to be a friend of the world makes imself an enemy of God.
Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?
But he gives more grace. So it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
Be subject so to God. But resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse una hands, you sinners; and purify una hearts, you double-minded.
Lament, mourn, and weep. Let una laughter be turned to mourning, and una gladness to gloom.
Humble unaself in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.

No speak against each other, brothers. Person wey speaks against a brother and judges his brother, speaks against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you No be a doer of the law, but a judge.
Only one is the lawgiver, Wey be able to save and to destroy. But Wey be you to judge another?
Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow let’s go into this city, and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit.”
Whereas you no know what una life Go be like tomorrow. For Wetin be una life? For You be a vapor, that appears for a little time, and then vanishes away.
For you ought to say, “If the Lord wills, We go both live, and do this or that.”
But now you glory in una boasting. All such boasting is evil.
To him so wey know to do good, and no dey do it, to him it is sin.
Come now, you rich, weep and howl for una miseries that are coming on you.
Una riches are corrupted and una garments are moth-eaten.
Una gold and una silver are corroded, and dem corrosion Go be for a testimony against you, and will eat una flesh like fire. You have laid up una treasure in the last days.
See am, the wages of the laborers who mowed una fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out, and the cries of people wey reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Armies.
You have lived delicately on the earth, and taken una pleasure. You have nourished una hearts as in a day of slaughter.
You have condemned, you have murdered the righteous one. He no dey resist you.
Be patient so, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. See am, the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and late rain.
You also be patient. Establish una hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.
No grumble, brothers, against each other, so that you no go be judged. See am, the judge stands at the door.
Take, brothers, for an example of suffering and of perseverance, the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.
See am, we call dem blessed who endured. You have heard of the perseverance of Job, and have seen the Lord in the outcome, and how the Lord is full of compassion and mercy.
But above all things, my brothers, no swear — not by heaven, or by the earth, or by any other oath; but let una “yes” be “yes”, and una “no”, “no”; so that you no fall into hypocrisy.
Is any among you suffering? Make e pray. Is any cheerful? Make e sing praises.
Is any among you sick? Make e call for the elders of the assembly, and Make dem pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord,
and the prayer of faith will heal him Wey be sick, and the Lord will raise him up. If he has committed sins, he Go be forgiven.
Confess una offenses to each other, and pray for each other, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.
Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain, and it didn’t rain on the earth for three years and six months.
He prayed again, and the sky give rain, and the earth produced its fruit.
Brothers, if any among you wanders from the truth and someone turns him back,
Make e know that person wey turns a sinner from the error of his way will save a soul from death and will cover a plenty people of sins.
Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the chosen ones Wey be living as foreigners in the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, that you may obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with his blood: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.
Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that no dey fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,
who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
Where you greatly glad well-well, though now for a little while, if need be, you Don dey put to grief in various trials,
that the proof of una faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes even though it is tested by fire, may be find to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ —
whom not having known you love; in whom, though now you no see him, yet believing, you glad well-well greatly with gladness unspeakable and full of glory —
receiving the result of una faith, the salvation of una souls.
Concerning this salvation, the prophets sought and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that would come to you,
searching for who or what kind of time the Spirit of Christ, which was in dem, pointed to, when he predicted the sufferings of Christ, and the glories that would follow dem.

To dem it was revealed, that not to themselves, but to you, dem ministered these things, which now Don dey announced to you through people wey preached the Better news to you by the Holy Spirit sent out from heaven; which things angels desire to look into.
So prepare una minds for action, be sober, and set una hope fully on the grace that Go be bring to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ —
as pikin dem of obedience, not conforming unaself according to una former lusts as in una ignorance,
but just as person wey call you is holy, you unaself also be holy in all of una behavior;
because it is written, “You go be holy; for I be holy.”
If you call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judges according to each man’s work, pass the time of una living as foreigners here in reverent fear:
knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things, with silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed down from una fathers,
but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ;
who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in this last age for una sake,
who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead, and give him glory; so that una faith and hope might be in God.
Seeing you have purified una souls in una obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection, love each other from the heart fervently:
having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains forever.
For, “All flesh is like grass, and all of man’s glory like the flower in the grass. The grass withers, and its flower falls;
but the Lord’s word endures forever.” This is the word of Better news which was preached to you.
Putting away so all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,
as newborn babies, long for the pure milk of the Word, that with it you may grow,
if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious:
coming to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.
You also, as living stones, are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
Because it is contained in Scripture, “See am, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen, and precious: Person wey believe in him No go be disappointed.”
For you who believe so is the honor, but for people Wey disobedient, “The stone which the builders rejected, has become the chief cornerstone,”
and, “a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offense.” For dem stumble at the word, being disobedient, to which also dem were appointed.
But You be a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who call you out of darkness into his marvelous light:
who in time past were no people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims, to abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;
having good behavior among the nations, so in that of which dem speak against you as evildoers, dem may by una good works, which dem see, glorify God in the day of visitation.
So subject unaself to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme;
or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to people wey do well.
For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:
as free, and not using una freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.
Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.
Workers, be in subjection to una masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.
For it is commendable if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.
For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if, when you do well, you patiently endure suffering, this is commendable with God.
For to this you were call, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving you an example, that you should follow his steps,
who No sin, “neither was deceit find in his mouth.”
Who, when he was cursed, didn’t curse back. When he suffered, didn’t threaten, but committed imself to him who judges righteously;
who his own self bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness; by whose stripes you were healed.
For you were going astray like sheep; but now have come back to the Shepherd and Overseer of una souls.
In the same way, wives, be in subjection to una own husbands; so that, even if any no obey the Word, dem may be won by the behavior of dem wives without a word;
seeing una pure behavior in fear.
Let una beauty be not just the outward adorning of braiding the hair, and of wearing jewels of gold, or of putting on fine clothing;
but in the hidden person of the heart, in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God very precious.
For this is how the holy women before, who hoped in God also adorned themselves, being in subjection to dem own husbands:
as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose pikin dem you now are, if you do well, and No be put in fear by any terror.

You husbands, in the same way, live with una wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman, as to the weaker vessel, as being also joint heirs of the grace of life; that una prayers may not be hindered.
Finally, be all like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tender hearted, courteous,
not rendering evil for evil, or insult for insult; but instead blessing; knowing that to this were you call, that you may inherit a blessing.
For, “Person wey would love life, and see good days, Make e keep his tongue from evil, and his lips from speaking deceit.
Make e turn away from evil, and do good. Make e seek peace, and pursue it.
For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to dem prayer; but the face of the Lord is against people wey do evil.”
Now Wey be person wey will harm you, if you become imitators of that which is good?
But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, You be blessed. “No fear Wetin dem fear, neither be troubled.”
But sanctify the Lord God in una hearts; and always be ready to give an answer to Everybody wey asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear:
having a good conscience; that, while You be spoken against as evildoers, dem may be disappointed who curse una good way of life in Christ.
For it is better, if it is God’s will, that you suffer for doing well than for doing evil.
Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God; being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the spirit;
in which he also go and preached to the spirits in prison,
who before were disobedient, when God waited patiently in the days of Noah, while the ship was being built. In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.
This is a symbol of baptism, which now saves you — not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God, through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
Wey be at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.
So, since Christ suffered for us in the flesh, arm unaself also with the same mind; for person wey has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin;
that you no longer should live the rest of una time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.
For we have spent enough of our past time doing the desire of the Gentiles, and having walked in lewdness, lusts, drunken binges, orgies, carousings, and abominable idolatries.
Dem think it is strange that you no run with dem into the same excess of riot, blaspheming:
who will give account to him Wey be ready to judge the living and the dead.
For to this end the Better news was preached even to the dead, that dem might be judged indeed as men in the flesh, but live as to God in the spirit.
But the end of all things is near. So be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.
And above all things be earnest in una love among unaself, for love covers a plenty people of sins.
Be hospitable to each other without grumbling.
As each has received a gift, employ it in serving each other, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.

If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God. If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
Beloved, no be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you, to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you.
But because You be partakers of Christ’s sufferings, glad well-well; that at the revelation of his glory you also may glad well-well with exceeding gladness.
If You be insulted for the name of Christ, You be blessed; because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you. On dem part he is blasphemed, but on una part he is glorified.
For let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil doer, or a meddler in other men’s matters.
But if one of you suffers for being a Christian, Make e not be ashamed; but Make e glorify God in this matter.
For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God. If it begins first with us, what will happen to people wey no obey the Better news of God?
“If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?”
So Make dem also who suffer according to the will of God in doing good entrust dem souls to him, as to a faithful Creator.
So I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will also share in the glory that Go be revealed.
Shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily, not for dishonest gain, but willingly;
neither as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making unaself examples to the flock.
When the chief Shepherd is revealed, You go receive the crown of glory that no dey fade away.
Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe unaself with humility, to subject unaself to each other; for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
Humble unaself so under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time;
casting all una worries on him, because he cares for you.
Be sober and self-controlled. Shine una eye. Una adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.
Withstand him steadfast in una faith, knowing that una brothers Wey be in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.
But may the God of all grace, who call you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.
To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.
Person Wey in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you; and so does Mark, my son.
Greet each other with a kiss of love. Peace be to you all Wey be in Christ Jesus. Amen.
Simon Peter, a worker and apostle of Jesus Christ, to people wey have obtained a like precious faith with us in the righteousness of our God and Savior, Jesus Christ:
Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,
seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who call us by his own glory and virtue;

by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises; that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust.
Yes, and for this very cause adding on una part all diligence, in una faith supply moral excellence; and in moral excellence, knowledge;
and in knowledge, self-control; and in self-control perseverance; and in perseverance godliness;
and in godliness brotherly affection; and in brotherly affection, love.
For if these things are yours and abound, dem make you to be not idle nor unfruitful to the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
For person wey lacks these things is blind, seeing only Wetin be near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.
So, brothers, be more diligent to make una calling and election sure. For if you do these things, You go never stumble.
For thus You go be richly supplied with the entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.
So I go not be negligent to remind you of these things, though you know dem, and are established in the present truth.
I think it right, as long as I be in this tent, to stir you up by reminding you;
knowing that the putting off of my tent comes swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.
Yes, I go make every effort that you may always be able to remember these things even after my departure.
For we No follow cunningly devised fables, when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
For he received from God the Father honor and glory, when the voice come to him from the Majestic Glory, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I be well pleased.”
We heard this voice come out of heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.
We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns, and the morning star arises in una hearts:
knowing this first, that no prophecy of Scripture is of private interpretation.
For no prophecy ever come by the will of man: but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit.

But false prophets also arose among the people, as false teachers will also be among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, denying even the Master who bought dem, bringing on themselves swift destruction.
Many will follow dem immoral ways, and as a result, the way of the truth Go be maligned.
In covetousness Dem go exploit you with deceptive words: whose sentence now from of old no dey linger, and dem destruction No go slumber.
For if God didn’t spare angels when dem sinned, but throw dem down to Tartarus, and committed dem to pits of darkness, to be reserved for judgment;
and didn’t spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah with seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he bring a flood on the world of the ungodly;
and turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes, condemned dem to destruction, having made dem an example to people wey would live ungodly;
and delivered righteous Lot, who was very distressed by the lustful life of the wicked
(for that righteous man dwelling among dem, was tormented in his righteous soul from day to day with seeing and hearing lawless deeds):
the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment;
but chiefly people wey walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement, and despise authority. Daring, self-willed, dem No be afraid to speak evil of dignitaries;
whereas angels, though greater in might and power, no bring a railing judgment against dem before the Lord.
But these, as unreasoning creatures, born natural animals to be taken and destroyed, speaking evil in matters about which Dem be ignorant, will in dem destroying surely be destroyed,
receiving the wages of unrighteousness; people who count it pleasure to revel in the daytime, spots and defects, reveling in dem deceit while dem feast with you;
having eyes full of adultery, and who no fit cease from sin; enticing unsettled souls; having a heart trained in greed; pikin dem of cursing;
forsaking the right way, dem go astray, having follow the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who love the wages of wrongdoing;
but he was rebuked for his own disobedience. A mute donkey spoke with a man’s voice and stopped the madness of the prophet.
These are wells without water, clouds driven by a storm; for whom the blackness of darkness Don dey reserved forever.
For, uttering great swelling words of emptiness, dem entice in the lusts of the flesh, by licentiousness, people Wey indeed escaping from people wey live in error;
promising dem liberty, while dem themselves are bondservants of corruption; for a man is bring into bondage by Anybody wey overcomes him.

For if, after dem have escaped the defilement of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, Dem be again entangled in it and overcome, the last state has become worse for dem than the first.
For it would be better for dem not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after knowing it, to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to dem.
But it has happened to dem according to the true proverb, “The dog turns to his own vomit again,” and “the sow that has washed to wallowing in the mire.”
This is now, beloved, the second letter that I have written to you; and in both of dem I stir up una sincere mind by reminding you;
that you should remember the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and the commandment of us, the apostles of the Lord and Savior:
knowing this first, that in the last days mockers will come, walking after dem own lusts,
and saying, “Where is the promise of his coming? For, from the day that the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as dem were from the beginning of the creation.”
For this dem willfully forget, that there were heavens from of old, and an earth formed out of water and amid water, by the word of God;
by which means the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished.
But the heavens that now are, and the earth, by the same word Don dey stored up for fire, being reserved against the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.
But no forget this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
The Lord No be slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness; but is patient with us, not wishing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in which the heavens will pass away with a great noise, and the elements Go be dissolved with fervent heat, and the earth and the works that are in it Go be burned up.
So since all these things Go be destroyed like this, what kind of people ought you to be in holy living and godliness,
looking for and earnestly desiring the coming of the day of God, which will cause the burning heavens to be dissolved, and the elements will melt with fervent heat?
But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.
So, beloved, seeing that you look for these things, be diligent to be find in peace, without defect and blameless in his sight.
Regard the patience of our Lord as salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also, according to the wisdom given to him, wrote to you;

as also in all of his letters, speaking in dem of these things. In those, E get some things that are hard to understand, which the ignorant and unsettled twist, as dem also do to the other Scriptures, to dem own destruction.
You so, beloved, knowing these things beforehand, beware, lest being carried away with the error of the wicked, you fall from una own steadfastness.
But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.
That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we see, and our hands touched, concerning the Word of life
(and the life was revealed, and we have seen, and testify, and declare to you the life, the life wey no dey end, which was with the Father, and was revealed to us);
that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son, Jesus Christ.
And we write these things to you, that our gladness may be fulfilled.
This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie, and no tell the truth.
But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with each other, and the blood of Jesus Christ, his Son, cleanses us from all sin.
If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth No be in us.
If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
If we say that we haven’t sinned, we make him a liar, and his word No be in us.
My little pikin dem, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.
And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.
This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.
One who says, “I know him,” and no dey keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth no be in him.
But Anybody wey keeps his word, God’s love has most certainly been perfected in him. This is how we know that We be in him:
person wey says he remains in him ought imself also to walk just like he walked.
Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.
Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you; because the darkness is passing away, and the true light already shines.
Person wey says he is in the light and hates his brother, is in the darkness even until now.
Person wey loves his brother remains in the light, and E get no occasion for stumbling in him.
But person wey hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and no dey know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.
I write to you, little pikin dem, because una sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.

I write to you, fathers, because you know him Wey be from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, little pikin dem, because you know the Father.

I have written to you, fathers, because you know him Wey be from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because You be strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
No love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love no be in him.
For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, no be the Father’s, but is the world’s.
The world is passing away with its lusts, but person wey does God’s will remains forever.
Little pikin dem, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.
Dem go out from us, but dem didn’t belong to us; for if dem had belonged to us, dem would have continued with us. But dem left, that dem might be revealed that none of dem belong to us.
You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.
I have not written to you because you no know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.
Wey be the liar but person wey denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, person wey denies the Father and the Son.
Anybody wey denies the Son, the same no dey have the Father. Person wey confesses the Son has the Father also.
So, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.
This is the promise which he promised us, the life wey no dey end.
These things I have written to you concerning people wey would lead you astray.

As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you no need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, You go remain in him.
Now, little pikin dem, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
If you know that he is righteous, you know that Everybody wey practices righteousness Don dey born of him.
See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be call pikin dem of God! For this cause the world no dey know us, because it didn’t know him.
Beloved, now We be pikin dem of God, and it No be yet revealed what We go be. But we know that, when he is revealed, We go be like him; for We go see him just as he is.
Everybody wey has this hope set on him purifies imself, even as he is pure.
Everybody wey sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.
You know that he was revealed to take away our sins, and in him is no sin.
Anybody wey remains in him no dey sin. Anybody wey sins hasn’t seen him and no dey know him.
Little pikin dem, let Nobody lead you astray. Person wey does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
Person wey sins is of the devil, for the devil Don dey sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might destroy the works of the devil.
Anybody wey is born of God no dey commit sin, because his seed remains in him; and he no fit sin, because he is born of God.
In this the pikin dem of God are revealed, and the pikin dem of the devil. Anybody wey no dey do righteousness No be of God, neither is person wey no dey love his brother.
For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love each other;
unlike Cain, who was of the evil one, and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his deeds were evil, and his brother’s righteous.
No be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.
We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. Person wey no dey love his brother remains in death.
Anybody wey hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has life wey no dey end remaining in him.
By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.
But Anybody wey has the world’s goods, and sees his brother in need, and closes his heart of compassion against him, how does God’s love remain in him?
My little pikin dem, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.
And by this we know that We be of the truth, and persuade our hearts before him,
because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.
Beloved, if our hearts no condemn us, we have boldness toward God;
and Anything wey we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.
This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love each other, even as he commanded.
Person wey keeps his commandments remains in him, and he in him. By this we know that he remains in us, by the Spirit which he give us.
Beloved, no believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether Dem be of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God,

and every spirit who no dey confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh No be of God, and this is the spirit of the Antichrist, of whom you have heard that it comes. Now it is in the world already.
You be of God, little pikin dem, and have overcome dem; because greater is person Wey in you than person Wey in the world.
Dem be of the world. So dem speak of the world, and the world hears dem.
We be of God. Person wey knows God listens to us. Person Wey not of God no dey listen to us. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
Beloved, Make we love each other, for love is of God; and everyone wey love Don dey born of God, and knows God.
Person wey no dey love no dey know God, for God is love.
By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his one and only Son into the world that we might live through him.
In this is love, not that we love God, but that he love us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
Beloved, if God love us in this way, we also ought to love each other.
Nobody has seen God at any time. If we love each other, God remains in us, and his love Don dey perfected in us.
By this we know that we remain in him and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.
We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as the Savior of the world.
Anybody wey confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him, and he in God.
We know and have believe the love which God has for us. God is love, and person wey remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.
In this love Don dey made perfect among us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as he is, even so are we in this world.
E get no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. Person wey fears No be made perfect in love.
We love him, because he first love us.
If a man says, “I love God,” and hates his brother, he is a liar; for person wey no dey love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?
This commandment we have from him, that person wey loves God should also love his brother.
Anybody wey believe that Jesus is the Christ Don dey born of God. Anybody wey loves the Father also loves the pikin Wey be born of him.
By this we know that we love the pikin dem of God, when we love God and keep his commandments.
For this is loving God, that we keep his commandments. His commandments No be grievous.
For Anything wey is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: una faith.
Wey be person wey overcomes the world, but person wey believe that Jesus is the Son of God?
This is person wey come by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and the blood. It is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.
For E get three who testify:
the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and the three agree as one.
If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God’s testimony which he has testified concerning his Son.
Person wey believe in the Son of God has the testimony in imself. Person wey no dey believe God has made him a liar, because he has not believe in the testimony that God has given concerning his Son.
The testimony is this, that God give to us life wey no dey end, and this life is in his Son.
Person wey has the Son has the life. Person wey no dey have God’s Son no dey have the life.
These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have life wey no dey end, and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God.
This is the boldness which we have toward him, that, if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.
And if we know that he listens to us, Anything wey we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have ask of him.

If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death, he shall ask, and God will give him life for people wey sin not leading to death. E get a sin leading to death. I no say that he should make a request concerning this.
All unrighteousness is sin, and E get a sin not leading to death.
We know that Anybody wey is born of God no dey sin, but person wey was born of God keeps imself, and the evil one no dey touch him.
We know that We be of God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.

We know that the Son of God has come, and has given us an understanding, that we know him Wey be true, and We be in him Wey be true, in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and life wey no dey end.
Little pikin dem, keep unaself from idols.
The elder, to the chosen lady and her pikin dem, whom I love in truth; and not I only, but also all people wey know the truth;
for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it Go be with us forever:
Grace, mercy, and peace Go be with us, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
I glad well-well greatly that I have find some of una pikin dem walking in truth, even as we Don dey commanded by the Father.
Now I beg you, dear lady, No be like though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love each other.
This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.
For many deceivers have gone out into the world, people wey no confess that Jesus Christ come in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.
Watch unaself, that we no lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.
Anybody wey transgresses and no dey remain in the teaching of Christ, no dey have God. Person wey remains in the teaching, the same has both the Father and the Son.
If anyone comes to you, and no dey bring this teaching, no receive him into una house, and no welcome him,
for person wey welcomes him participates in his evil deeds.
Having many things to write to you, I no want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you, and to speak face to face, that our gladness may be made full.
The pikin dem of una chosen sister greet you. Amen.
The elder to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.
Beloved, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be healthy, even as una soul prospers.
For I rejoiced greatly, when brothers come and testified about una truth, even as you walk in truth.
I have no greater gladness than this, to hear about my pikin dem walking in truth.
Beloved, you do a faithful work in Anything wey you accomplish for people Wey brothers and strangers.
Dem have testified about una love before the assembly. You go do well to send dem forward on dem journey in a way worthy of God,
because for the sake of the Name dem go out, taking nothing from the Gentiles.
We so ought to receive such, that we may be fellow workers for the truth.
I wrote to the assembly, but Diotrephes, wey love to be first among dem, no dey accept what we say.

So if I come, I go call attention to his deeds which he does, unjustly accusing us with wicked words. Not content with this, neither does he imself receive the brothers, and people wey would, he forbids and throws out of the assembly.
Beloved, no imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. Person wey does good is of God. Person wey does evil hasn’t seen God.
Demetrius has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself; yes, we also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.
I had many things to write to you, but I be unwilling to write to you with ink and pen;
but I hope to see you soon, and We go speak face to face. Peace be to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.
Jude, a worker of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to people Wey call, sanctified by God the Father, and kept for Jesus Christ:
Mercy to you and peace and love be multiplied.

Beloved, while I was very eager to write to you about our common salvation, I was constrained to write to you exhorting you to contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered to the saints.

For E get certain men who crept in secretly, even people wey were long ago written about for this condemnation: ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into indecency, and denying our only Master, God, and Lord, Jesus Christ.
Now I desire to remind you, though you already know this, that the Lord, having saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed people wey didn’t believe.
Angels who didn’t keep dem first domain, but deserted dem own dwelling place, he has kept in everlasting bonds under darkness for the judgment of the great day.

Even as Sodom and Gomorrah, and the cities around dem, having, in the same way as these, given themselves over to sexual immorality and gone after strange flesh, are shown as an example, suffering the punishment of eternal fire.
Yet in the same way, these also in dem dreaming defile the flesh, despise authority, and slander celestial beings.
But Michael, the archangel, when contending with the devil and arguing about the body of Moses, dared not bring against him an abusive condemnation, but talk say, “May the Lord rebuke you!”
But these speak evil of Anything wey things dem no know. Dem be destroyed in these things that dem understand naturally, like the creatures without reason.
Woe to dem! For dem go in the way of Cain, and ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire, and perished in Korah’s rebellion.

These are hidden rocky reefs in una love feasts when dem feast with you, shepherds who without fear feed themselves; clouds without water, carried along by winds; autumn trees without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;
wild waves of the sea, foaming out dem own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness Don dey reserved forever.
About these also Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, “See am, the Lord come with ten thousands of his holy ones,

to execute judgment on all, and to convict all the ungodly of all dem works of ungodliness which dem have done in an ungodly way, and of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.”
These are murmurers and complainers, walking after dem lusts (and dem mouth speaks proud things), showing respect of persons to gain advantage.
But you, beloved, remember the words which Don dey spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Dem talk say to you that “In the last time there Go be mockers, walking after dem own ungodly lusts.”
These are dem who cause divisions, and are sensual, not having the Spirit.
But you, beloved, keep building up unaself on una most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit.
Keep unaself in God’s love, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to life wey no dey end.
On some have compassion, making a distinction,
and some save, snatching dem out of the fire with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.
Now to him Wey be able to keep dem from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great gladness,
to God our Savior, who alone is wise, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and forever. Amen.
This is the Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God give him to show to his workers the things which must happen soon, which he sent and made known by his angel to his worker, John,
who testified to God’s word, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, about everything that he see.
Blessed is person wey reads and people wey hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written in it, for the time is at hand.
John, to the seven assemblies that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace, from God, Wey be and who was and Wey be to come; and from the seven Spirits Wey be before his throne;
and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him wey love us, and washed us from our sins by his blood;
and he made us to be a Kingdom, priests to his God and Father; to him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
See am, he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him, including people wey pierced him. All the tribes of the earth will mourn over him. Even so, Amen.
“I be the Alpha and the Omega, ” says the Lord God, “Wey be and who was and Wey be to come, the Almighty.”
I John, una brother and partner with you in the oppression, Kingdom, and perseverance in Christ Jesus, was on the isle that is call Patmos because of God’s Word and the testimony of Jesus Christ.
I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a loud voice, like a trumpet
saying, “Wetin you see, write in a book and send to the seven assemblies: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and to Laodicea.”
I turned to see the voice that spoke with me. Having turned, I see seven golden lamp stands.
And among the lamp stands was one like a Son of Man, clothed with a robe reaching down to his feet, and with a golden sash around his chest.
His head and his hair were white as white wool, like snow. His eyes were like a flame of fire.
His feet were like burnished brass, as if it Bin dey refined in a furnace. His voice was like the voice of many waters.
He had seven stars in his right hand. Out of his mouth proceeded a sharp two-edged sword. His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.
When I see him, I fell at his feet like a dead man. He laid his right hand on me, saying, “No fear. I be the first and the last,
and the Living one. I was dead, and see am, I be alive forever more. Amen. I have the keys of Death and of Hades.
Write so the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which will happen hereafter;
the mystery of the seven stars which you see in my right hand, and the seven golden lamp stands. The seven stars are the angels of the seven assemblies. The seven lamp stands are seven assemblies.
“To the angel of the assembly in Ephesus write: “Person wey holds the seven stars in his right hand, person wey walks among the seven golden lamp stands says these things:
“I know una works, and una toil and perseverance, and that you no fit tolerate evil men, and have tested people wey call themselves apostles, and dem No be, and find dem false.
You have perseverance and have endured for my name’s sake, and have not grown weary.
But I have this against you, that you left una first love.
Remember so from where you have fallen, and repent and do the first works; or else I be coming to you swiftly, and will move una lamp stand out of its place, unless you repent.
But this you have, that you hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
Person wey has an ear, Make e hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes I go give to eat from the tree of life, which is in the Paradise of my God.
“To the angel of the assembly in Smyrna write: “The first and the last, who was dead, and has come to life says these things:
“I know una works, oppression, and una poverty (but You be rich), and the blasphemy of people wey say Dem be Jews, and dem No be, but are a synagogue of Satan.

No fear of the things which You be about to suffer. See am, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested; and You go have oppression for ten days. Be faithful to death, and I go give you the crown of life.
Person wey has an ear, Make e hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. Person wey overcomes no go be harmed by the second death.
“To the angel of the assembly in Pergamum write: “Person wey has the sharp two-edged sword says these things:

“I know una works and where you live, where Satan’s throne is. You hold firmly to my name, and didn’t deny my faith in the days of Antipas my witness, my faithful one, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.

But I have a few things against you, because you have there some who hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to throw a stumbling block before the pikin dem of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols, and to commit sexual immorality.
So you also have some who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans likewise.
Repent so, or else I be coming to you sharp-sharp, and I go make war against dem with the sword of my mouth.

Person wey has an ear, Make e hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes, to him I go give of the hidden manna, and I go give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written, which Nobody knows but person wey receives it.
“To the angel of the assembly in Thyatira write: “The Son of God, who has his eyes like a flame of fire, and his feet are like burnished brass, says these things:
“I know una works, una love, faith, service, patient endurance, and that una last works are more than the first.

But I have this against you, that you tolerate una woman, Jezebel, who calls sheself a prophetess. She teaches and seduces my workers to commit sexual immorality, and to eat things sacrificed to idols.
I give her time to repent, but she refuses to repent of her sexual immorality.
See am, I go throw her into a bed, and people wey commit adultery with her into great oppression, unless dem repent of her works.
I go kill her pikin dem with Death, and all the assemblies will know that I be person wey searches the minds and hearts. I go give to each one of you according to una deeds.
But to you I say, to the rest Wey be in Thyatira, as many as no have this teaching, who no know what some call ‘the deep things of Satan,’ to you I say, I be not putting any other burden on you.
Nevertheless, hold that which you have firmly until I come.
Person wey overcomes, and person wey keeps my works to the end, to him I go give authority over the nations.
He will rule dem with a rod of iron, shattering dem like clay pots; as I also have received of my Father:
and I go give him the morning star.
Person wey has an ear, Make e hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

“And to the angel of the assembly in Sardis write: “Person wey has the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars says these things: “I know una works, that you have a reputation of being alive, but You be dead.
Wake up, and keep the things that remain, which you were about to throw away, for I have find no works of yours perfected before my God.
Remember so how you have received and heard. Keep it, and repent. If so you no go watch, I go come as a thief, and you no go know what hour I go come upon you.
Nevertheless you have a few names in Sardis that No defile dem garments. Dem go walk with me in white, for Dem be worthy.
Person wey overcomes Go be arrayed in white garments, and I go in no way blot his name out of the book of life, and I go confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.
Person wey has an ear, Make e hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

“To the angel of the assembly in Philadelphia write: “Person Wey holy, person Wey true, person wey has the key of David, person wey opens and Nobody can shut, and who shuts and Nobody opens, says these things:
“I know una works (see am, I have set before you an open door, which Nobody can shut), that you have a little power, and kept my word, and didn’t deny my name.
See am, I give some of the synagogue of Satan, of people wey say Dem be Jews, and dem No be, but lie. See am, I go make dem to come and worship before una feet, and to know that I have love you.
Because you kept my command to endure, I also will keep you from the hour of testing, which is to come on the whole world, to test people wey live on the earth.
I be coming sharp-sharp! Hold firmly that which you have, so that Nobody takes una crown.

Person wey overcomes, I go make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will go out from there no more. I go write on him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my God, and my own new name.
Person wey has an ear, Make e hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.
“To the angel of the assembly in Laodicea write: “The Amen, the Faithful and True Witness, the Head of God’s creation, says these things:
“I know una works, that You be neither cold nor hot. I wish you were cold or hot.
So, because You be lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I go vomit you out of my mouth.
Because you say, ‘I be rich, and have gotten riches, and have need of nothing;’ and no know that You be the wretched one, miserable, poor, blind, and naked;

I counsel you to buy from me gold refined by fire, that you may become rich; and white garments, that you may clothe yourself, and that the shame of una nakedness may not be revealed; and eye salve to anoint una eyes, that you may see.
As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous so, and repent.
See am, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I go come in to him, and will dine with him, and he with me.
Person wey overcomes, I go give to him to sit down with me on my throne, as I also overcame, and sat down with my Father on his throne.
Person wey has an ear, Make e hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.”

After these things I looked and see a door opened in heaven, and the first voice that I heard, like a trumpet speaking with me, was one saying, “Come up here, and I go show you the things which must happen after this.”
Sharp-sharp I was in the Spirit. See am, there was a throne set in heaven, and one sitting on the throne
that looked like a jasper stone and a sardius. There was a rainbow around the throne, like an emerald to look at.
Around the throne were twenty-four thrones. On the thrones were twenty-four elders sitting, dressed in white garments, with crowns of gold on dem heads.
Out of the throne proceed lightnings, sounds, and thunders. There were seven lamps of fire burning before his throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.
Before the throne was something like a sea of glass, similar to crystal. In the middle of the throne, and around the throne were four living creatures full of eyes before and behind.
The first creature was like a lion, and the second creature like a calf, and the third creature had a face like a man, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.

The four living creatures, each one of dem having six wings, are full of eyes around and within. Dem have no rest day and night, saying, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God, the Almighty, who was and Wey be and Wey be to come!”
When the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to him who sits on the throne, to him who lives forever and ever,
the twenty-four elders fall down before him who sits on the throne, and worship him who lives forever and ever, and throw dem crowns before the throne, saying,
“Worthy are you, our Lord and God, the Holy One, to receive the glory, the honor, and the power, for you created all things, and because of una desire dem existed, and were created!”
I see, in the right hand of him who sat on the throne, a book written inside and outside, sealed shut with seven seals.
I see a mighty angel proclaiming with a loud voice, “Wey be worthy to open the book, and to break its seals?”
Nobody in heaven above, or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to open the book, or to look in it.
And I wept much, because Nobody was find worthy to open the book, or to look in it.
One of the elders talk say to me, “No weep. See am, the Lion Wey be of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome; person wey opens the book and its seven seals.”

I see in the middle of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the middle of the elders, a Lamb standing, as though it Bin dey slain, having seven horns, and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent out into all the earth.
Then he come, and he take it out of the right hand of him who sat on the throne.

Now when he had taken the book, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each one having a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.
Dem sang a new song, saying, “You be worthy to take the book, and to open its seals: for you were killed, and bought us for God with una blood, out of every tribe, language, people, and nation,
and made us kings and priests to our God, and We go reign on the earth.”
I see, and I heard something like a voice of many angels around the throne, the living creatures, and the elders; and the number of dem was ten thousands of ten thousands, and thousands of thousands;
saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who Don dey killed to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!”

I heard every created thing which is in heaven, on the earth, under the earth, on the sea, and everything in dem, saying, “To him who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb be the blessing, the honor, the glory, and the dominion, forever and ever! Amen!”
The four living creatures talk say, “Amen!” The elders fell down and worshiped.
I see that the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying, as with a voice of thunder, “Come and see!”
And see am, a white horse, and person wey sat on it had a bow. A crown was given to him, and he come out conquering, and to conquer.
When he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, “Come!”
Another come out, a red horse. To him who sat on it was given power to take peace from the earth, and that dem should kill each other. There was given to him a great sword.
When he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, “Come and see!” And see am, a black horse, and person wey sat on it had a balance in his hand.
I heard a voice in the middle of the four living creatures saying, “A choenix of wheat for a denarius, and three choenix of barley for a denarius! No damage the oil and the wine!”
When he opened the fourth seal, I heard the fourth living creature saying, “Come and see!”

And see am, a pale horse, and person wey sat on it, his name was Death. Hades follow with him. Authority over one fourth of the earth, to kill with the sword, with famine, with death, and by the wild animals of the earth was given to him.
When he opened the fifth seal, I see underneath the altar the souls of people wey Bin dey killed for the Word of God, and for the testimony of the Lamb which dem had.
Dem cried with a loud voice, saying, “How long, Master, the holy and true, until you judge and avenge our blood on people wey live on the earth?”

A long white robe was given to each of dem. Dem were told that dem should rest yet for a while, until dem fellow workers and dem brothers, who would also be killed even as dem were, should complete dem course.
I see when he opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake. The sun became black as sackcloth made of hair, and the whole moon became as blood.
The stars of the sky fell to the earth, like a fig tree dropping its unripe figs when it is shaken by a great wind.
The sky was removed like a scroll when it is rolled up. Every mountain and island were moved out of dem places.
The kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains.
Dem told the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne, and from the serious anger of the Lamb,
for the great day of his serious anger has come; and Wey be able to stand?”
After this, I see four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, so that no wind would blow on the earth, or on the sea, or on any tree.
I see another angel ascend from the sunrise, having the seal of the living God. He cried with a loud voice to the four angels to whom it was given to harm the earth and the sea,
saying, “No harm the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, until we have sealed the bondservants of our God on dem foreheads!”
I heard the number of people wey were sealed, one hundred forty-four thousand, sealed out of every tribe of the pikin dem of Israel:
of the tribe of Judah were sealed twelve thousand, of the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand, of the tribe of Gad twelve thousand,
of the tribe of Asher twelve thousand, of the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand, of the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand,
of the tribe of Simeon twelve thousand, of the tribe of Levi twelve thousand, of the tribe of Issachar twelve thousand,
of the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand, of the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand, of the tribe of Benjamin were sealed twelve thousand.

After these things I looked, and see am, Plenty people, which no man could count, out of every nation and of all tribes, peoples, and languages, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, dressed in white robes, with palm branches in dem hands.
Dem cried with a loud voice, saying, “Salvation be to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!”
All the angels were standing around the throne, the elders, and the four living creatures; and dem fell on dem faces before his throne, and worshiped God,
