saying, “Amen! Blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and might, be to our God forever and ever! Amen.”
One of the elders answer, saying to me, “These Wey be arrayed in the white robes, Wey be dem, and from where did dem come?”
I told him, “My lord, you know.” He talk say to me, “These are people wey come out of the great wahala. Dem washed dem robes, and made dem white in the Lamb’s blood.
So Dem be before the throne of God, dem serve him day and night in his temple. Person wey sits on the throne will spread his tabernacle over dem.
Dem go never be hungry, neither thirsty any more; neither will the sun beat on dem, nor any heat;
for the Lamb Wey be in the middle of the throne shepherds dem, and leads dem to springs of waters of life. And God will wipe away every tear from dem eyes.”
When he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
I see the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to dem.

Another angel come and stood over the altar, having a golden censer. Much incense was given to him, that he should add it to the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar which was before the throne.
The smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, go up before God out of the angel’s hand.
The angel take the censer, and he filled it with the fire of the altar, and threw it on the earth. There follow thunders, sounds, lightnings, and an earthquake.
The seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.

The first sounded, and there follow hail and fire, mixed with blood, and dem were thrown to the earth. One third of the earth was burned up, and one third of the trees were burned up, and all green grass was burned up.
The second angel sounded, and something like a great burning mountain was thrown into the sea. One third of the sea became blood,
and one third of the living creatures which were in the sea died. One third of the ships were destroyed.
The third angel sounded, and a great star fell from the sky, burning like a torch, and it fell on one third of the rivers, and on the springs of the waters.
The name of the star is call “Wormwood.” One third of the waters became wormwood. Many people died from the waters, because dem were made bitter.

The fourth angel sounded, and one third of the sun was struck, and one third of the moon, and one third of the stars; so that one third of dem would be darkened, and the day wouldn’t shine for one third of it, and the night in the same way.

I see, and I heard an eagle, flying in mid heaven, saying with a loud voice, “Woe! Woe! Woe for people wey live on the earth, because of the other voices of the trumpets of the three angels, Wey be yet to sound!”
The fifth angel sounded, and I see a star from the sky which had fallen to the earth. The key to the pit of the abyss was given to him.
He opened the pit of the abyss, and smoke go up out of the pit, like the smoke from a burning furnace. The sun and the air were darkened because of the smoke from the pit.
Then out of the smoke come locusts on the earth, and power was given to dem, as the scorpions of the earth have power.
Dem were told that dem no suppose hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree, but only those people who no have God’s seal on dem foreheads.
Dem were given power not to kill dem, but to torment dem for five months. Dem torment was like the torment of a scorpion, when it strikes a person.
In those days people will seek death, and will in no way find it. Dem go desire to die, and death will flee from dem.
The shapes of the locusts were like horses prepared for war. On dem heads were something like golden crowns, and dem faces were like people’s faces.
Dem had hair like women’s hair, and dem teeth were like those of lions.
Dem had breastplates, like breastplates of iron. The sound of dem wings was like the sound of chariots, or of many horses rushing to war.
Dem have tails like those of scorpions, and stings. In dem tails dem have power to harm men for five months.
Dem have over dem as king the angel of the abyss. His name in Hebrew is “Abaddon”, but in Greek, he has the name “Apollyon”.
The first woe is past. See am, E get still two woes coming after this.
The sixth angel sounded. I heard a voice from the horns of the golden altar which is before God,
saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, “Free the four angels Wey be bound at the great river Euphrates!”
The four angels were freed who Bin dey prepared for that hour and day and month and year, so that dem might kill one third of mankind.
The number of the armies of the horsemen was two hundred million. I heard the number of dem.

Thus I see the horses in the vision, and people wey sat on dem, having breastplates of fiery red, hyacinth blue, and sulfur yellow; and the horses’ heads resembled lions’ heads. Out of dem mouths proceed fire, smoke, and sulfur.
By these three plagues were one third of mankind killed: by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur, which proceeded out of dem mouths.
For the power of the horses is in dem mouths, and in dem tails. For dem tails are like serpents, and have heads, and with dem dem harm.

The rest of mankind, who No be killed with these plagues, didn’t repent of the works of dem hands, that dem wouldn’t worship demons, and the idols of gold, and of silver, and of brass, and of stone, and of wood; which no fit see, hear, or walk.
Dem didn’t repent of dem murders, dem sorceries, dem sexual immorality, or dem thefts.
I see a mighty angel coming down out of the sky, clothed with a cloud. A rainbow was on his head. His face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.
He had in his hand a little open book. He set his right foot on the sea, and his left on the land.
He cried with a loud voice, as a lion roars. When he cried, the seven thunders uttered dem voices.
When the seven thunders sounded, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from the sky saying, “Seal up the things which the seven thunders talk say, and no write dem.”
The angel whom I see standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to the sky,

and swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and the things that are in it, the earth and the things that are in it, and the sea and the things that are in it, that there will no longer be delay,
but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, then the mystery of God is finished, as he declared to his workers, the prophets.
The voice which I heard from heaven, again speaking with me, talk say, “Go, take the book which is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the land.”
I go to the angel, telling him to give me the little book. He talk say to me, “Take it, and eat it up. It will make una stomach bitter, but in una mouth it Go be as sweet as honey.”
I take the little book out of the angel’s hand, and ate it up. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth. When I had eaten it, my stomach was made bitter.
Dem told me, “You must prophesy again over many peoples, nations, languages, and kings.”
A reed like a rod was given to me. Someone talk say, “Rise, and measure God’s temple, and the altar, and people wey worship in it.
Leave out the court which is outside of the temple, and no measure it, for it Don dey given to the nations. Dem go tread the holy city under foot for forty-two months.
I go give power to my two witnesses, and Dem go prophesy one thousand two hundred sixty days, clothed in sackcloth.”
These are the two olive trees and the two lamp stands, standing before the Lord of the earth.
If anyone desires to harm dem, fire proceeds out of dem mouth and devours dem enemies. If anyone desires to harm dem, he must be killed in this way.

These have the power to shut up the sky, that it may not rain during the days of dem prophecy. Dem have power over the waters, to turn dem into blood, and to strike the earth with every plague, as often as dem desire.
When dem have finished dem testimony, the beast that comes up out of the abyss will make war with dem, and overcome dem, and kill dem.
Dem dead bodies Go be in the street of the great city, which spiritually is call Sodom and Egypt, where also dem Lord was crucified.
From among the peoples, tribes, languages, and nations people will look at dem dead bodies for three and a half days, and No go allow dem dead bodies to be laid in a tomb.
People wey live on the earth glad well-well over dem, and Dem go be glad. Dem go give gifts to each other, because these two prophets tormented people wey live on the earth.
After the three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered into dem, and dem stood on dem feet. Great fear fell on people wey see dem.
I heard a loud voice from heaven saying to dem, “Come up here!” Dem go up into heaven in the cloud, and dem enemies see dem.
In that day there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell. Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the rest were terrified, and give glory to the God of heaven.
The second woe is past. See am, the third woe comes sharp-sharp.
The seventh angel sounded, and great voices in heaven follow, saying, “The kingdom of the world has become the Kingdom of our Lord, and of his Christ. He will reign forever and ever!”
The twenty-four elders, who sit on dem thrones before God’s throne, fell on dem faces and worshiped God,
saying: “We give you thanks, Lord God, the Almighty, the one Wey be and who was; because you have taken una great power, and reigned.

The nations were angry, and una serious anger come, as did the time for the dead to be judged, and to give una bondservants the prophets, dem reward, as well as to the saints, and people wey fear una name, to the small and the great; and to destroy people wey destroy the earth.”
God’s temple that is in heaven was opened, and the ark of the Lord’s covenant was seen in his temple. Lightnings, sounds, thunders, an earthquake, and great hail follow.
A great sign was seen in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.
She was with pikin. She cried out in pain, laboring to give birth.
Another sign was seen in heaven. See am, a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads seven crowns.
His tail drew one third of the stars of the sky, and threw dem to the earth. The dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when she give birth he might devour her pikin.
She give birth to a son, a male pikin, Wey be to rule all the nations with a rod of iron. Her pikin was caught up to God, and to his throne.
The woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared by God, that there dem may nourish her one thousand two hundred sixty days.
There was war in the sky. Michael and his angels made war on the dragon. The dragon and his angels made war.
Dem didn’t prevail, neither was a place find for him any more in heaven.
The great dragon was thrown down, the old serpent, person Wey call the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world. He was thrown down to the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him.

I heard a loud voice in heaven, saying, “Now the salvation, the power, and the Kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ has come; for the accuser of our brothers Don dey thrown down, who accuses dem before our God day and night.
Dem overcame him because of the Lamb’s blood, and because of the word of dem testimony. Dem didn’t love dem life, even to death.
So glad well-well, heavens, and you who live in dem. Woe to the earth and to the sea, because the devil has gone down to you, having great serious anger, knowing that he has but a short time.”
When the dragon see that he was thrown down to the earth, he persecuted the woman who give birth to the male pikin.

Two wings of the great eagle were given to the woman, that she might fly into the wilderness to her place, so that she might be nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.
The serpent spewed water out of his mouth after the woman like a river, that he might cause her to be carried away by the stream.
The earth helped the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed up the river which the dragon spewed out of his mouth.
The dragon grew angry with the woman, and go away to make war with the rest of her offspring, who keep God’s commandments and hold Jesus’ testimony.
Then I stood on the sand of the sea. I see a beast coming up out of the sea, having ten horns and seven heads. On his horns were ten crowns, and on his heads, blasphemous names.
The beast which I see was like a leopard, and his feet were like those of a bear, and his mouth like the mouth of a lion. The dragon give him his power, his throne, and great authority.
One of his heads looked like it Bin dey wounded fatally. His fatal wound was healed, and the whole earth surprise well-well at the beast.
Dem worshiped the dragon, because he give his authority to the beast, and dem worshiped the beast, saying, “Wey be like the beast? Wey be able to make war with him?”
A mouth speaking great things and blasphemy was given to him. Authority to make war for forty-two months was given to him.
He opened his mouth for blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his dwelling, people wey live in heaven.
It was given to him to make war with the saints, and to overcome dem. Authority over every tribe, people, language, and nation was given to him.
All who live on the earth will worship him, everyone whose name has not been written from the foundation of the world in the book of life of the Lamb who Don dey killed.
If anyone has an ear, Make e hear.
If anyone is to go into captivity, he will go into captivity. If anyone is to be killed with the sword, he must be killed. Here is the endurance and the faith of the saints.
I see another beast coming up out of the earth. He had two horns like a lamb, and he spoke like a dragon.
He exercises all the authority of the first beast in his presence. He makes the earth and people wey live in it to worship the first beast, whose fatal wound was healed.
He performs great signs, even making fire come down out of the sky to the earth in the sight of people.

He deceives my own people who live on the earth because of the signs he was granted to do in front of the beast; saying to people wey live on the earth, that dem should make an image to the beast who had the sword wound and lived.
It was given to him to give breath to it, to the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause as many as wouldn’t worship the image of the beast to be killed.
He causes all, the small and the great, the rich and the poor, and the free and the slave, to be given marks on dem right hands, or on dem foreheads;
and that Nobody would be able to buy or to sell, unless he has that mark, the name of the beast or the number of his name.
Here is wisdom. Person wey has understanding, Make e calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man. His number is six hundred sixty-six.
I see, and see am, the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with him a number, one hundred forty-four thousand, having his name, and the name of his Father, written on dem foreheads.
I heard a sound from heaven, like the sound of many waters, and like the sound of a great thunder. The sound which I heard was like that of harpists playing on dem harps.

Dem sing a new song before the throne, and before the four living creatures and the elders. Nobody could learn the song except the one hundred forty-four thousand, people wey Bin dey redeemed out of the earth.

These are people wey No be defiled with women, for Dem be virgins. These are people wey follow the Lamb Anywhere wey he goes. These were redeemed by Jesus from among men, the first fruits to God and to the Lamb.
In dem mouth was find no lie, for Dem be blameless.
I see an angel flying in mid heaven, having an eternal Better news to proclaim to people wey live on the earth, and to every nation, tribe, language, and people.
He talk say with a loud voice, “Fear the Lord, and give him glory; for the hour of his judgment has come. Worship him who made the heaven, the earth, the sea, and the springs of waters!”
Another, a second angel, follow, saying, “Babylon the great has fallen, which has made all the nations to drink of the wine of the serious anger of her sexual immorality.”
Another angel, a third, follow dem, saying with a great voice, “If anyone worships the beast and his image, and receives a mark on his forehead, or on his hand,

he also will drink of the wine of the serious anger of God, which is prepared unmixed in the cup of his anger. He Go be tormented with fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb.
The smoke of dem torment goes up forever and ever. Dem have no rest day and night, people wey worship the beast and his image, and Anybody wey receives the mark of his name.
Here is the perseverance of the saints, people wey keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.”
I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Write, ‘Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.’” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “that dem may rest from dem labors; for dem works follow with dem.”
I looked, and see am, a white cloud; and on the cloud one sitting like a Son of Man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.
Another angel come out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him who sat on the cloud, “Send una sickle, and reap; for the hour to reap has come; for the harvest of the earth is ripe!”
Person wey sat on the cloud thrust his sickle on the earth, and the earth was reaped.
Another angel come out of the temple which is in heaven. He also had a sharp sickle.

Another angel come out from the altar, person wey has power over fire, and he call with a great voice to him who had the sharp sickle, saying, “Send una sharp sickle, and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, for the earth’s grapes are fully ripe!”
The angel thrust his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vintage of the earth, and threw it into the great wine press of the serious anger of God.
The wine press was trodden outside of the city, and blood come out of the wine press, even to the bridles of the horses, as far as one thousand six hundred stadia.
I see another great and marvelous sign in the sky: seven angels having the seven last plagues, for in dem God’s serious anger is finished.
I see something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, and people wey overcame the beast, his image, and the number of his name, standing on the sea of glass, having harps of God.
Dem sang the song of Moses, the worker of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are una works, Lord God, the Almighty! Righteous and true are una ways, you King of the nations.
Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify una name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship before you. For una righteous acts Don dey revealed.”
After these things I looked, and the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened.
The seven angels who had the seven plagues come out, clothed with pure, bright linen, and wearing golden sashes around dem breasts.
One of the four living creatures give to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the serious anger of God, who lives forever and ever.
The temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God, and from his power. Nobody was able to enter into the temple, until the seven plagues of the seven angels would be finished.
I heard a loud voice out of the temple, saying to the seven angels, “Go and pour out the seven bowls of the serious anger of God on the earth!”
The first go, and poured out his bowl into the earth, and it became a harmful and evil sore on the people who had the mark of the beast, and who worshiped his image.
The second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and it became blood as of a dead man. Every living thing in the sea died.
The third poured out his bowl into the rivers and springs of water, and dem became blood.
I heard the angel of the waters saying, “You be righteous, Wey be and who were, you Holy One, because you have judged these things.
For dem poured out the blood of the saints and prophets, and you have given dem blood to drink. Dem deserve this.”
I heard the altar saying, “Yes, Lord God, the Almighty, true and righteous are una judgments.”
The fourth poured out his bowl on the sun, and it was given to him to scorch men with fire.
People were scorched with great heat, and people blasphemed the name of God who has the power over these plagues. Dem didn’t repent and give him glory.
The fifth poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom was darkened. Dem gnawed dem tongues because of the pain,
and dem blasphemed the God of heaven because of dem pains and dem sores. Dem didn’t repent of dem works.
The sixth poured out his bowl on the great river, the Euphrates. Its water was dried up, that the way might be prepared for the kings that come from the sunrise.
I see coming out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet, three unclean spirits, something like frogs;
for Dem be spirits of demons, performing signs; which go out to the kings of the whole inhabited earth, to gather dem together for the war of that great day of God, the Almighty.
“See am, I come like a thief. Blessed is person wey watches, and keeps his clothes, so that he no dey walk naked, and dem see his shame.”
He gathered dem together into the place which is call in Hebrew, Megiddo.
The seventh poured out his bowl into the air. A loud voice come out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, “It is done!”
There were lightnings, sounds, and thunders; and there was a great earthquake, such as No be since there were men on the earth, so great an earthquake, so mighty.

The great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. Babylon the great was remember in the sight of God, to give to her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his serious anger.
Every island fled away, and the mountains No be find.
Great hailstones, about the weight of a talent, come down out of the sky on people. People blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail, for this plague is exceedingly severe.
One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls come and spoke with me, saying, “Come here. I go show you the judgment of the great prostitute who sits on many waters,
with whom the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality, and people wey live in the earth were made drunken with the wine of her sexual immorality.”
He carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness. I see a woman sitting on a scarlet-colored animal, full of blasphemous names, having seven heads and ten horns.

The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the impurities of the sexual immorality of the earth.
And on her forehead a name was written, “MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF THE PROSTITUTES AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.”
I see the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus. When I see her, I wondered with great amazement.
The angel talk say to me, “Why do you wonder? I go tell you the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and the ten horns.

The beast that you see was, and No be; and is about to come up out of the abyss and to go into destruction. People wey live on the earth and whose names have not been written in the book of life from the foundation of the world will marvel when dem see that the beast was, and No be, and go be present.
Here is the mind that has wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits.
Dem be seven kings. Five have fallen, the one is, the other has not yet come. When he comes, he must continue a little while.
The beast that was, and No be, is imself also an eighth, and is of the seven; and he goes to destruction.
The ten horns that you see are ten kings who have received no kingdom as yet, but dem receive authority as kings, with the beast, for one hour.
These have one mind, and dem give dem power and authority to the beast.
These will war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will overcome dem, for he is Lord of lords, and King of kings, and people Wey with him are call chosen and faithful.”
He talk say to me, “The waters which you see, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, plenty people, nations, and languages.
The ten horns which you see, and the beast, these will hate the prostitute, and will make her desolate, and will make her naked, and will eat her flesh, and will burn her utterly with fire.
For God has put in dem hearts to do what he has in mind, and to be of one mind, and to give dem kingdom to the beast, until the words of God should be accomplished.
The woman whom you see is the great city, which reigns over the kings of the earth.”
After these things, I see another angel coming down out of the sky, having great authority. The earth was illuminated with his glory.

He cried with a mighty voice, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, and she has become a habitation of demons, a prison of every unclean spirit, and a prison of every unclean and hateful bird!

For all the nations have drunk of the wine of the serious anger of her sexual immorality, the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth grew rich from the abundance of her luxury.”
I heard another voice from heaven, saying, “Come out of her, my people, that you have no participation in her sins, and that you no receive of her plagues,
for her sins have reached to the sky, and God has remember her iniquities.
Return to her just as she come back, and repay her double as she did, and according to her works. In the cup which she mixed, mix to her double.
However much she glorified sheself, and grew wanton, so much give her of torment and mourning. For she says in her heart, ‘I sit a queen, and am no widow, and will in no way see mourning.’
So in one day her plagues will come: death, mourning, and famine; and she Go be utterly burned with fire; for the Lord God who has judged her is strong.
The kings of the earth, who committed sexual immorality and lived wantonly with her, will weep and wail over her, when dem look at the smoke of her burning,
standing far away for the fear of her torment, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, Babylon, the strong city! For una judgment has come in one hour.’
The merchants of the earth weep and mourn over her, for Nobody buys dem merchandise any more;

merchandise of gold, silver, precious stones, pearls, fine linen, purple, silk, scarlet, all expensive wood, every vessel of ivory, every vessel made of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble;
and cinnamon, incense, perfume, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, sheep, horses, chariots, and people’s bodies and souls.
The fruits which una soul lusted after Don dey lost to you, and all things that were dainty and sumptuous have perished from you, and You go find dem no more at all.
The merchants of these things, who were made rich by her, will stand far away for the fear of her torment, weeping and mourning;
saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, person wey was dressed in fine linen, purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls!
For in an hour such great riches are made desolate.’ Every ship master, and Everybody wey sails anywhere, and mariners, and as many as gain dem living by sea, stood far away,
and cried out as dem looked at the smoke of her burning, saying, ‘Wetin be like the great city?’

Dem throw dust on dem heads, and cried, weeping and mourning, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, in which all who had dem ships in the sea were made rich by reason of her great wealth!’ For she is made desolate in one hour.
“Glad well-well over her, O heaven, you saints, apostles, and prophets; for God has judged una judgment on her.”
A mighty angel take up a stone like a great millstone and throw it into the sea, saying, “Thus with violence will Babylon, the great city, be thrown down, and Go be find no more at all.

The voice of harpists, minstrels, flute players, and trumpeters Go be heard no more at all in you. No craftsman, of Anything wey craft, Go be find any more at all in you. The sound of a mill Go be heard no more at all in you.

The light of a lamp will shine no more at all in you. The voice of the bridegroom and of the bride Go be heard no more at all in you; for una merchants were the princes of the earth; for with una sorcery all the nations were deceived.
In her was find the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all who Don dey slain on the earth.”
After these things I heard something like a loud voice of Plenty people in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation, power, and glory belong to our God:
for true and righteous are his judgments. For he has judged the great prostitute, who corrupted the earth with her sexual immorality, and he has avenged the blood of his workers at her hand.”
A second talk say, “Hallelujah! Her smoke goes up forever and ever.”
The twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sits on the throne, saying, “Amen! Hallelujah!”
A voice come from the throne, saying, “Give praise to our God, all you his workers, you who fear him, the small and the great!”
I heard something like the voice of Plenty people, and like the voice of many waters, and like the voice of mighty thunders, saying, “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigns!
Make we glad well-well and be exceedingly glad, and Make we give the glory to him. For the marriage of the Lamb has come, and his wife has made sheself ready.”
It was given to her that she would array sheself in bright, pure, fine linen: for the fine linen is the righteous acts of the saints.
He talk say to me, “Write, ‘Blessed are people Wey invited to the marriage supper of the Lamb.’” He talk say to me, “These are true words of God.”

I fell down before his feet to worship him. He talk say to me, “Look! No do it! I be a fellow bondservant with you and with una brothers who hold the testimony of Jesus. Worship God, for the testimony of Jesus is the Spirit of Prophecy.”
I see the heaven opened, and see am, a white horse, and person wey sat on it is call Faithful and True. In righteousness he judges and makes war.
His eyes are a flame of fire, and on his head are many crowns. He has names written and a name written which Nobody knows but he imself.
He is clothed in a garment sprinkled with blood. His name is call “The Word of God.”
The armies which are in heaven follow him on white horses, clothed in white, pure, fine linen.

Out of his mouth proceeds a sharp, double-edged sword, that with it he should strike the nations. He will rule dem with an iron rod. He treads the wine press of the fierceness of the serious anger of God, the Almighty.
He has on his garment and on his thigh a name written, “KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.”
I see an angel standing in the sun. He cried with a loud voice, saying to all the birds that fly in the sky, “Come! Be gathered together to the great supper of God,

that you may eat the flesh of kings, the flesh of captains, the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses and of people wey sit on dem, and the flesh of all men, both free and slave, and small and great.”
I see the beast, and the kings of the earth, and dem armies, gathered together to make war against him who sat on the horse, and against his army.

The beast was taken, and with him the false prophet who worked the signs in his sight, with which he deceived people wey had received the mark of the beast and people wey worshiped his image. These two were thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with sulfur.
The rest were killed with the sword of him who sat on the horse, the sword which come out of his mouth. All the birds were filled with dem flesh.
I see an angel coming down out of heaven, having the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand.
He seized the dragon, the old serpent, which is the devil and Satan, who deceives the whole inhabited earth, and bound him for a thousand years,
and throw him into the abyss, and shut it, and sealed it over him, that he should deceive the nations no more, until the thousand years were finished. After this, he must be freed for a short time.

I see thrones, and dem sat on dem, and judgment was given to dem. I see the souls of people wey Bin dey beheaded for the testimony of Jesus, and for the word of God, and such as didn’t worship the beast nor his image, and didn’t receive the mark on dem forehead and on dem hand. Dem lived and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.
The rest of the dead didn’t live until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.
Blessed and holy is person wey has part in the first resurrection. Over these, the second death has no power, but Dem go be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with him one thousand years.
And after the thousand years, Satan Go be released from his prison,
and he will come out to deceive the nations which are in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather dem together to the war; the number of whom is as the sand of the sea.
Dem go up over the width of the earth, and surrounded the camp of the saints, and the beloved city. Fire come down out of heaven from God, and devoured dem.
The devil who deceived dem was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet are also. Dem go be tormented day and night forever and ever.
I see a great white throne, and him who sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away. There was find no place for dem.

I see the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and dem opened books. Another book was opened, which is the book of life. The dead were judged out of the things which were written in the books, according to dem works.
The sea give up the dead who were in it. Death and Hades give up the dead who were in dem. Dem were judged, each one according to his works.
Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death, the lake of fire.
If anyone No be find written in the book of life, he was throw into the lake of fire.
I see a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth have passed away, and the sea is no more.
I see the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.
I heard a loud voice out of heaven saying, “See am, God’s dwelling is with people, and he will live with dem, and Dem go be his people, and God imself Go be with dem as dem God.
He will wipe away from dem every tear from dem eyes. Death Go be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain, any more. The first things have passed away.”
Person wey sits on the throne talk say, “See am, I be making all things new.” He talk say, “Write, for these words of God are faithful and true.”
He talk say to me, “I have become the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. I go give freely to him Wey be thirsty from the spring of the water of life.
Person wey overcomes, I go give him these things. I go be his God, and he Go be my son.

But for the cowardly, unbelieving, sinners, abominable, murderers, sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all liars, dem part is in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur, which is the second death.”
One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls, who were loaded with the seven last plagues come, and he spoke with me, saying, “Come here. I go show you the wife, the Lamb’s bride.”
He carried me away in the Spirit to a great and high mountain, and showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God,
having the glory of God. Her light was like a most precious stone, as if it were a jasper stone, clear as crystal;
having a great and high wall; having twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels; and names written on dem, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the pikin dem of Israel.
On the east were three gates; and on the north three gates; and on the south three gates; and on the west three gates.
The wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on dem twelve names of the twelve Apostles of the Lamb.
Person wey spoke with me had for a measure a golden reed to measure the city, its gates, and its walls.
The city is square, and its length is as great as its width. He measured the city with the reed, twelve thousand twelve stadia. Its length, width, and height are equal.
Its wall is one hundred forty-four cubits, by the measure of a man, that is, of an angel.
The construction of its wall was jasper. The city was pure gold, like pure glass.
The foundations of the city’s wall were adorned with all kinds of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, chalcedony; the fourth, emerald;
the fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolite; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, topaz; the tenth, chrysoprasus; the eleventh, jacinth; and the twelfth, amethyst.
The twelve gates were twelve pearls. Each one of the gates was made of one pearl. The street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.
I see no temple in it, for the Lord God, the Almighty, and the Lamb, are its temple.
The city has no need for the sun, neither of the moon, to shine, for the very glory of God illuminated it, and its lamp is the Lamb.
The nations will walk in its light. The kings of the earth bring the glory and honor of the nations into it.
Its gates will in no way be shut by day (for there Go be no night there),
and dem shall bring the glory and the honor of the nations into it so that dem may enter.
There will in no way enter into it anything profane, or one who causes an abomination or a lie, but only people Wey written in the Lamb’s book of life.
He showed me a river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb,

in the middle of its street. On this side of the river and on that was the tree of life, bearing twelve kinds of fruits, yielding its fruit every month. The leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
There Go be no curse any more. The throne of God and of the Lamb Go be in it, and his workers serve him.
Dem go see his face, and his name Go be on dem foreheads.
There Go be no night, and dem need no lamp light; for the Lord God will illuminate dem. Dem go reign forever and ever.
He talk say to me, “These words are faithful and true. The Lord God of the spirits of the prophets sent his angel to show to his bondservants the things which must happen soon.”
“See am, I come sharp-sharp. Blessed is person wey keeps the words of the prophecy of this book.”
Now I, John, am the one who heard and see these things. When I heard and see, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel who had shown me these things.
He talk say to me, “See you no do it! I be a fellow bondservant with you and with una brothers, the prophets, and with people wey keep the words of this book. Worship God.”
He talk say to me, “No seal up the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is at hand.
Person wey acts unjustly, Make e act unjustly still. Person Wey filthy, Make e be filthy still. Person Wey righteous, Make e do righteousness still. Person Wey holy, Make e be holy still.”
“See am, I come sharp-sharp. My reward is with me, to repay to each man according to his work.
I be the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.
Blessed are people wey do his commandments, that dem may have the right to the tree of life, and may enter in by the gates into the city.
Outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone wey love and practices falsehood.
I, Jesus, have sent my angel to testify these things to you for the assemblies. I be the root and the offspring of David; the Bright and Morning Star.”
The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” Person wey hears, Make e say, “Come!” Person Wey thirsty, Make e come. Person wey desires, Make e take the water of life freely.
I testify to everyone wey hear the words of the prophecy of this book, if anyone adds to dem, may God add to him the plagues which are written in this book.
If anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, may God take away his part from the tree of life, and out of the holy city, which are written in this book.
Person wey testifies these things says, “Yes, I come sharp-sharp.” Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus.
The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with all the saints. Amen.
